# cds_flutter

> Unofficial Flutter port of the Coinbase Design System (CDS): theme tokens, light, dark and high-contrast themes, 552 icons, and accessible spring-driven components. Not affiliated with Coinbase.

Import `package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart`, wrap the app in `CdsThemeProvider`, read the theme with `context.cds`. Widgets are prefixed `Cds`; props follow CDS names; colors are `CdsColor` tokens; spacing is an 8px token scale.

## Guides

- [Accessibility](doc/guides/accessibility.md): What the components do for you, and what you still own.
- [For AI coding agents](doc/guides/for-ai-agents.md): This page is the entry point when an agent builds a Flutter app with `cds_flutter`. Install the bundled skill so your agent loads these rules automatically:
- [Getting started](doc/guides/getting-started.md): Install the package, wrap your app in `CdsThemeProvider`, and build your first screen.
- [Motion](doc/guides/motion.md): Motion answers touch. Feedback on press, springs that start from where things are, sheets that follow the finger. Nothing loops forever.
- [Theming](doc/guides/theming.md): | Type | What it is |
- [Tokens](doc/guides/tokens.md): All values come from CDS's default theme.

## Components

- [CdsAccordion](doc/components/CdsAccordion.md): A vertical list of expandable rows where at most one is open. Reach for it to tuck secondary details (fees, limits, FAQs) under short headers.
- [CdsAccordionItem](doc/components/CdsAccordionItem.md): One expandable row inside a `CdsAccordion`: a pressable header with title, optional media and an animated caret, over a collapsible panel.
- [CdsAlert](doc/components/CdsAlert.md): A short, interruptive message that asks the person to confirm or cancel, shown with `showCdsAlert`.
- [CdsAreaChart](doc/components/CdsAreaChart.md): Filled regions under one or more series, optionally stacked, built on `CdsCartesianChart`.
- [CdsAvatar](doc/components/CdsAvatar.md): A person's or entity's picture, or the first letter of their name on a colored tile when there is no picture.
- [CdsAvatarButton](doc/components/CdsAvatarButton.md): A `CdsAvatar` that can be pressed, typically to open a profile or account switcher.
- [CdsBanner](doc/components/CdsBanner.md): A message about the page or the account (an outage, a pending verification, a promotion), with an icon, text, optional actions and an optional dismiss button.
- [CdsBarChart](doc/components/CdsBarChart.md): Grouped or stacked bars, vertical or horizontal, built on `CdsCartesianChart`.
- [CdsBottomNavigation](doc/components/CdsBottomNavigation.md): A phone bottom tab bar in CDS style: icon plus label per destination, the active one drawn with the filled glyph and `fgPrimary`, at least 44px targets and the bottom safe area applied.
- [CdsBox](doc/components/CdsBox.md): The layout primitive: padding, margin, background, border, radius and elevation, all from theme tokens.
- [CdsBreadcrumb](doc/components/CdsBreadcrumb.md): A trail of links from the top of a hierarchy to the current page, for tablet and desktop layouts with deep navigation.
- [CdsButton](doc/components/CdsButton.md): A pill-shaped button with a text label, for the actions people take on a screen.
- [CdsButtonGroup](doc/components/CdsButtonGroup.md): Lays out related buttons in a row or column with the CDS 8px gap.
- [CdsCalendar](doc/components/CdsCalendar.md): A month grid for picking one date. Use it inline on a screen, or let `CdsDatePicker` show it in a popover next to a typed date.
- [CdsCarousel](doc/components/CdsCarousel.md): A horizontally paged row of items with an optional title, previous/next buttons and dot pagination. Use it for browsable sets like featured assets or learning cards.
- [CdsCartesianChart](doc/components/CdsCartesianChart.md): The shared chart frame: it computes scales from the series, reserves space for axes, handles scrubbing, and paints chart elements given as children.
- [CdsCell](doc/components/CdsCell.md): The layout primitive behind `CdsListCell` and `CdsContentCell`: media, main content, intermediary, end content and accessory in a row, with optional content below.
- [CdsCellAccessory](doc/components/CdsCellAccessory.md): The trailing icon of a cell: an arrow, a more menu, or a selection checkmark.
- [CdsCellDetail](doc/components/CdsCellDetail.md): End-aligned detail and subdetail text of a cell, such as a balance and its change.
- [CdsCellHelperText](doc/components/CdsCellHelperText.md): An assistive message under a cell, led by an icon so its tone does not rest on color alone.
- [CdsCellMedia](doc/components/CdsCellMedia.md): Media sized and shaped for the start slot of a list cell: an icon, asset, avatar, image or pictogram.
- [CdsCheckbox](doc/components/CdsCheckbox.md): A checkbox with an optional label, for turning one option on or off or selecting several items from a list.
- [CdsCheckboxCell](doc/components/CdsCheckboxCell.md): A full-width bordered row with a checkbox, a title and an optional description; the whole row is the touch target.
- [CdsCheckboxGroup](doc/components/CdsCheckboxGroup.md): A labelled set of checkboxes bound to a `Set` of selected values.
- [CdsChip](doc/components/CdsChip.md): A compact, pill-shaped element for filters, quick selections and short status. Pressable only when `onPress` is set.
- [CdsCoachmark](doc/components/CdsCoachmark.md): A small card that introduces a feature, usually pointed at it by a `CdsTour`, rendered on the inverted color scheme.
- [CdsCodeSnippet](doc/components/CdsCodeSnippet.md): A block of monospaced literal text, such as a command, wallet address or API key, with a copy button.
- [CdsCollapsible](doc/components/CdsCollapsible.md): Shows or hides content by animating its size and opacity. Use it for "Show details" toggles and as the building block of `CdsAccordion`.
- [CdsCombobox](doc/components/CdsCombobox.md): A `CdsSelect` with a search field at the top of its options, for long lists such as countries or assets.
- [CdsContainedAssetCard](doc/components/CdsContainedAssetCard.md): A compact asset tile: a header (usually a logo) over a subtitle, title and description, with extra content in the large size.
- [CdsContentCard](doc/components/CdsContentCard.md): A composable card for feed content, built from `CdsContentCardHeader`, `CdsContentCardBody` and `CdsContentCardFooter`.
- [CdsContentCardBody](doc/components/CdsContentCardBody.md): Main content of a `CdsContentCard`: title, description and optional media, with custom content below.
- [CdsContentCardFooter](doc/components/CdsContentCardFooter.md): Bottom row of a `CdsContentCard`, spreading its children apart.
- [CdsContentCardHeader](doc/components/CdsContentCardHeader.md): Top row of a `CdsContentCard`: thumbnail, title and subtitle, and an actions slot.
- [CdsContentCell](doc/components/CdsContentCell.md): A cell for longer content: a title with meta information beside it, a subtitle, and a description that wraps freely.
- [CdsContextMenu](doc/components/CdsContextMenu.md): A menu of actions for an item, opened by long-press on touch screens, right-click with a mouse, or the context-menu key.
- [CdsControlGroup](doc/components/CdsControlGroup.md): A labelled set of radios, checkboxes or switches built from a list of options, with one API for single and multiple selection.
- [CdsDataCard](doc/components/CdsDataCard.md): A card pairing a title with a data visualization such as a progress bar or circle.
- [CdsDateInput](doc/components/CdsDateInput.md): A text field for typing a date, masked as `mm/dd/yyyy` by default, with built-in validation. Reach for it when people know the date already, such as a date of birth.
- [CdsDatePicker](doc/components/CdsDatePicker.md): A typed date field with a calendar button that opens a `CdsCalendar` in a popover anchored to the field. Use it when people may either type a date or browse to it.
- [CdsDotCount](doc/components/CdsDotCount.md): A numeric badge, such as an unread count, pinned to a widget or shown on its own.
- [CdsDotStatusColor](doc/components/CdsDotStatusColor.md): A small colored dot that signals status, pinned to a widget or shown inline.
- [CdsDotSymbol](doc/components/CdsDotSymbol.md): A badge holding an icon, a small image or any widget, pinned to a widget or shown inline.
- [CdsDrawer](doc/components/CdsDrawer.md): A sheet pinned to any screen edge (start, end, top or bottom) with the same drag physics as `CdsTray` along its axis.
- [CdsDropdown](doc/components/CdsDropdown.md): A menu of options that opens from a trigger, with arrow-key navigation and typeahead.
- [CdsEmptyState](doc/components/CdsEmptyState.md): A centered message for a screen or section with nothing to show, or that failed to load: icon or illustration, a title naming the cause, a description, and up to two actions naming the next step.
- [CdsFallback](doc/components/CdsFallback.md): A skeleton placeholder shown while content loads, sized like the content it stands in for.
- [CdsFloatingAssetCard](doc/components/CdsFloatingAssetCard.md): An asset card whose media floats in its own bordered tile, with text underneath on the page background.
- [CdsFocusTrap](doc/components/CdsFocusTrap.md): Keeps keyboard focus inside its child while on screen and hands it back to the previously focused widget when removed.
- [CdsFullscreenAlert](doc/components/CdsFullscreenAlert.md): A full-screen alert for important outcomes (a failed transfer, a locked account) that the person must read and respond to.
- [CdsFullscreenModal](doc/components/CdsFullscreenModal.md): A full-screen modal with a header (logo slot, title, close button), a primary content column and an optional secondary column, for flows that need the whole screen.
- [CdsFullscreenModalLayout](doc/components/CdsFullscreenModalLayout.md): A bare full-screen surface for custom full-screen modal layouts; `showCdsFullscreenModal` adds the motion, scrim and focus trap.
- [CdsGrid](doc/components/CdsGrid.md): Arranges children in equal-width columns that wrap into rows. Use a fixed column count, or a minimum column width so the grid adapts to the screen.
- [CdsGridColumn](doc/components/CdsGridColumn.md): Places a child of `CdsGrid` across several columns or at a specific column.
- [CdsHandleBar](doc/components/CdsHandleBar.md): The grab handle at the top of a tray: shows the sheet can be dragged, and screen reader users can activate it to dismiss.
- [CdsIcon](doc/components/CdsIcon.md): A glyph from the CDS icon font: 552 icons, each drawn at 12, 16 and 24px with an outline and an active (filled) variant.
- [CdsIconButton](doc/components/CdsIconButton.md): A circular button with a single icon, for compact actions such as close, back, or favourite.
- [CdsInputChip](doc/components/CdsInputChip.md): A removable chip for a value the user entered or picked, such as a selected asset in a multi-select. Pressing it removes the value.
- [CdsInputIcon](doc/components/CdsInputIcon.md): Icons for a text field's `start` and `end` slots: `CdsInputIcon` is decorative, `CdsInputIconButton` is a transparent icon button for actions such as clear or reveal password. Both follow the field's focus color.
- [CdsInputStack](doc/components/CdsInputStack.md): The frame shared by every CDS text field: label, bordered input area with start and end slots, focus border and helper text. Reach for it to build a custom field (a masked input, a trigger that opens a picker) that must look like `CdsTextInput`.
- [CdsKbd](doc/components/CdsKbd.md): Keyboard keys drawn as keycaps, for documenting shortcuts.
- [CdsLegend](doc/components/CdsLegend.md): Lists the labeled series of the surrounding chart with their colors and shapes.
- [CdsLineChart](doc/components/CdsLineChart.md): A line chart with optional area fill, points, axes and scrubbing, built on `CdsCartesianChart`.
- [CdsLink](doc/components/CdsLink.md): Pressable text that navigates somewhere, announced to screen readers as a link.
- [CdsListCell](doc/components/CdsListCell.md): A row in a list: media, a title with optional subtitle and description, end detail, and a trailing accessory.
- [CdsListCellFallback](doc/components/CdsListCellFallback.md): A loading placeholder shaped like a `CdsListCell`.
- [CdsMediaCard](doc/components/CdsMediaCard.md): A card split into a text half (with a thumbnail) and a media half.
- [CdsMediaChip](doc/components/CdsMediaChip.md): A chip that leads with media, such as an asset icon or avatar, with the tighter padding CDS uses around it.
- [CdsMediaFallback](doc/components/CdsMediaFallback.md): Placeholder for cell media while it loads: a 48px squircle for images, a 32px circle for everything else.
- [CdsMessagingCard](doc/components/CdsMessagingCard.md): A promotional (`upsell`) or nudge card with a title, description, optional tag, call to action, media and dismiss button.
- [CdsModal](doc/components/CdsModal.md): A dialog surface for a focused task (header, scrollable body, footer actions), shown above the current route with `showCdsModal`.
- [CdsModalBody](doc/components/CdsModalBody.md): The scrollable content area of a `CdsModal`, between header and footer.
- [CdsModalFooter](doc/components/CdsModalFooter.md): The action row at the bottom of a `CdsModal`: one primary action and an optional secondary action.
- [CdsModalHeader](doc/components/CdsModalHeader.md): The title row of a `CdsModal`, with an optional back button at the start and a close button at the end.
- [CdsMultiContentModule](doc/components/CdsMultiContentModule.md): A content block with a pictogram, large title, description, a free-form primary area and an action. Use it for feature promos and summaries on a page.
- [CdsNavBarIconButton](doc/components/CdsNavBarIconButton.md): A 40x40 transparent icon button sized for navigation bars, with a 44px hit area.
- [CdsNavigationBar](doc/components/CdsNavigationBar.md): A top navigation bar with the title next to the back button, end actions, an optional bottom row, and a hairline underneath. Matches CDS `NavigationBar`, with mobile shortcuts for the common back plus title case.
- [CdsNavigationSubtitle](doc/components/CdsNavigationSubtitle.md): A muted second line under a [CdsNavigationTitle], also exposed as a header.
- [CdsNavigationTitle](doc/components/CdsNavigationTitle.md): The title in a navigation bar: headline text marked as a header for screen readers.
- [CdsNavigationTitleSelect](doc/components/CdsNavigationTitleSelect.md): A navigation title with a caret that opens a picker, for example to switch between portfolios or accounts.
- [CdsNudgeCard](doc/components/CdsNudgeCard.md): A soft prompt toward a next step, with optional media, a text call to action and a dismiss button.
- [CdsNumpad](doc/components/CdsNumpad.md): An on-screen keypad for entering amounts (digits, a decimal separator and backspace), used on buy, sell and send screens where the system keyboard would cover the amount.
- [CdsOtpInput](doc/components/CdsOtpInput.md): A one-time code field drawn as separate cells, for verification codes sent by SMS or email. Not part of CDS; it is built from the same field border, focus and helper text tokens as `CdsTextInput`.
- [CdsOverlay](doc/components/CdsOverlay.md): The dimmed scrim CDS draws behind modals, alerts, trays and tours.
- [CdsPageFooter](doc/components/CdsPageFooter.md): The bottom bar of a page that holds its main action, with optional legal text underneath.
- [CdsPageHeader](doc/components/CdsPageHeader.md): The header at the top of a page's content: a large `title1` title with optional start and end controls.
- [CdsPageIndicator](doc/components/CdsPageIndicator.md): A row of dots showing which page of a paged view is visible; the active dot stretches into a short bar. `CdsCarousel` uses it as its pagination, and you can pair it with your own `PageView`.
- [CdsPagination](doc/components/CdsPagination.md): A row of page buttons with previous and next controls, for moving through paged lists and tables.
- [CdsPercentageBarChart](doc/components/CdsPercentageBarChart.md): A part-to-whole bar: each series is a segment sized by its share of the total. Horizontal by default.
- [CdsPeriodSelector](doc/components/CdsPeriodSelector.md): Chart period tabs (1H, 1D, 1W...) with a pill that slides to the active tab.
- [CdsPoint](doc/components/CdsPoint.md): A circle marking one coordinate in data space, with an optional label.
- [CdsPopoverPanel](doc/components/CdsPopoverPanel.md): A panel anchored to a trigger for content that does not need a full modal, such as filters, account switchers or short forms.
- [CdsPortal](doc/components/CdsPortal.md): Renders its child in the nearest (or root) `Overlay`, above the rest of the screen, while keeping the theme and directionality of where it is declared.
- [CdsPressable](doc/components/CdsPressable.md): The interaction primitive behind every tappable CDS component. Use it to make a custom surface behave like CDS buttons and cells.
- [CdsProgressBar](doc/components/CdsProgressBar.md): A horizontal track that shows how far a task has progressed; value changes animate from the current position.
- [CdsProgressBarWithFixedLabels](doc/components/CdsProgressBarWithFixedLabels.md): A progress bar with fixed numeric labels at its start and end, placed above, below or beside the track.
- [CdsProgressBarWithFloatLabel](doc/components/CdsProgressBarWithFloatLabel.md): A progress bar with a numeric label that rides along with the fill, above or below the track.
- [CdsProgressCircle](doc/components/CdsProgressCircle.md): Circular progress for a known fraction, or a spinning arc while work of unknown length runs.
- [CdsRadio](doc/components/CdsRadio.md): A single radio button with an optional label. Most screens should use `CdsRadioGroup`, which manages selection and keyboard navigation for a set of radios.
- [CdsRadioCell](doc/components/CdsRadioCell.md): A full-width bordered row with a radio, a title and an optional description; the whole row is the touch target.
- [CdsRadioGroup](doc/components/CdsRadioGroup.md): A labelled set of radio buttons with single selection and arrow-key navigation.
- [CdsRangeSlider](doc/components/CdsRangeSlider.md): Picks a start and an end value from a range with two thumbs on one track. CDS has no range slider; this one shares the look, gestures and keyboard handling of `CdsSlider`.
- [CdsReferenceLine](doc/components/CdsReferenceLine.md): A horizontal line at a value or a vertical line at a category, for targets, thresholds and events.
- [CdsRefreshControl](doc/components/CdsRefreshControl.md): Pull to refresh for a vertical scrollable: the indicator follows the finger, and releasing past a threshold reloads the content.
- [CdsRemoteImage](doc/components/CdsRemoteImage.md): An image from the network or any `ImageProvider`, clipped to a CDS shape, with a loading placeholder and a fallback graphic.
- [CdsRemoteImageGroup](doc/components/CdsRemoteImageGroup.md): A row of overlapping images that collapses into a `+N` bubble past `max`.
- [CdsRollingNumber](doc/components/CdsRollingNumber.md): A number whose digits roll from their current value to the new one, for balances, prices and counters that update while people watch.
- [CdsScaffold](doc/components/CdsScaffold.md): A CDS page frame: an optional header pinned to the top, a scrolling body, and an optional footer pinned to the bottom, with safe areas and the keyboard handled.
- [CdsScrubber](doc/components/CdsScrubber.md): Highlights the scrubbed position of a chart: a dotted line, an overlay dimming later data, and a beacon on each series. At rest the beacons sit on the latest value.
- [CdsSearchInput](doc/components/CdsSearchInput.md): A filled, pill-shaped search field with a search icon at the start and a clear button once there is text. Reach for it at the top of a list or screen to filter or search.
- [CdsSectionHeader](doc/components/CdsSectionHeader.md): A title for a section of a page, with optional leading widget, icon, balance, description and an end slot for a related action.
- [CdsSegmentedControl](doc/components/CdsSegmentedControl.md): A row of mutually exclusive options with a highlight that slides to the selected one, for switching views or units within a screen ("Buy | Sell", "1D | 1W | 1M").
- [CdsSegmentedTabs](doc/components/CdsSegmentedTabs.md): Pill-shaped tabs on a tinted track. The active pill slides between options with a spring and the label colors cross-fade. Reach for it for compact, mutually exclusive modes such as Buy / Sell.
- [CdsSelect](doc/components/CdsSelect.md): A form control for choosing one option (`CdsSelect`) or several (`CdsSelect.multi`) from a list; opens a tray on phones and an anchored menu on wide screens.
- [CdsSelectChip](doc/components/CdsSelectChip.md): A chip-shaped select for filter bars; it inverts its colors while it holds a value so an applied filter stands out.
- [CdsSidebar](doc/components/CdsSidebar.md): Vertical app navigation for tablet and desktop layouts, holding `CdsSidebarItem`s and an optional `CdsSidebarMoreMenu`.
- [CdsSidebarItem](doc/components/CdsSidebarItem.md): A destination in a `CdsSidebar`: an icon and a title, highlighted when it is the current page.
- [CdsSidebarMoreMenu](doc/components/CdsSidebarMoreMenu.md): A "More" item in a `CdsSidebar` that opens a menu of extra destinations beside the sidebar.
- [CdsSlideButton](doc/components/CdsSlideButton.md): A slide-to-confirm control: the user drags a handle across the track to commit an action that should not fire on a stray tap, such as sending funds or closing an account.
- [CdsSlider](doc/components/CdsSlider.md): Picks one value from a continuous or stepped range by dragging a thumb along a track. CDS has no slider; this one is built from CDS tokens to match the selection controls.
- [CdsSparkline](doc/components/CdsSparkline.md): A small, non-interactive trend line for list rows, cards and tables.
- [CdsSparklineGradient](doc/components/CdsSparklineGradient.md): A sparkline whose line darkens from left to right in light mode, with an optional dotted area.
- [CdsSparklineInteractive](doc/components/CdsSparklineInteractive.md): A full-width price chart with period tabs. Drag across it (or long-press and drag) to read values; the header above can follow along.
- [CdsSparklineInteractiveHeader](doc/components/CdsSparklineInteractiveHeader.md): The asset header above a price chart: a label, a large tabular price and a change line, updated live while scrubbing.
- [CdsSpinner](doc/components/CdsSpinner.md): An indeterminate loading indicator for waits of unknown length.
- [CdsHStack / CdsVStack](doc/components/CdsStack.md): Rows and columns with token-based gaps. The workhorse of every CDS layout.
- [CdsStepper](doc/components/CdsStepper.md): Shows progress through a fixed sequence of steps, such as identity verification or a multi-screen form.
- [CdsStickyFooter](doc/components/CdsStickyFooter.md): A bar pinned to the bottom of a screen that holds the primary action, such as "Continue" or "Buy Bitcoin".
- [CdsSwitch](doc/components/CdsSwitch.md): An on/off switch with an optional label, for settings that take effect as soon as they change.
- [CdsTabIndicator](doc/components/CdsTabIndicator.md): The 2px bar that marks the active tab. It fills its parent's width and springs its bar to a new `x` and `width` from wherever it currently is.
- [CdsTabLabel](doc/components/CdsTabLabel.md): The text of one tab in a [CdsTabNavigation], with an optional count badge that animates in and out.
- [CdsTabNavigation](doc/components/CdsTabNavigation.md): The top-level tab bar of a screen: a horizontally scrolling row of [CdsTabLabel]s with a [CdsTabIndicator] under the active one.
- [CdsTabbedChips](doc/components/CdsTabbedChips.md): A horizontally scrolling row of chips that behaves as a tab list. The active chip inverts its color scheme. Reach for it for nested tabs and filters under a top-level tab bar.
- [CdsTable](doc/components/CdsTable.md): A data table built from `CdsTableCaption`, `CdsTableHeader`, `CdsTableBody` and `CdsTableFooter`, with rows of `CdsTableCell`s.
- [CdsTableBody](doc/components/CdsTableBody.md): Body rows of a `CdsTable`.
- [CdsTableCaption](doc/components/CdsTableCaption.md): The title of a `CdsTable`, shown above the header in `title3`.
- [CdsTableCell](doc/components/CdsTableCell.md): One cell of a `CdsTableRow`: a title with optional subtitle, or any child, with optional start and end widgets.
- [CdsTableCellFallback](doc/components/CdsTableCellFallback.md): A loading placeholder for one table cell.
- [CdsTableCellSortIcon](doc/components/CdsTableCellSortIcon.md): The up and down carets of a sortable column header, with the active direction in `fgPrimary`.
- [CdsTableFooter](doc/components/CdsTableFooter.md): Footer rows of a `CdsTable`, such as totals. Cells render in muted `body`.
- [CdsTableHeader](doc/components/CdsTableHeader.md): Header rows of a `CdsTable`. Cells render in muted `headline` and are marked as headers.
- [CdsTableRow](doc/components/CdsTableRow.md): One row of a `CdsTable` section, optionally pressable.
- [CdsTabs](doc/components/CdsTabs.md): A row of text tabs with a 2px underline that springs to the active tab. Reach for it to switch between sibling views inside a screen section.
- [CdsTag](doc/components/CdsTag.md): A short label that categorizes or flags content, such as "New" or "Pending".
- [CdsText](doc/components/CdsText.md): Text set in the CDS type ramp, colored with semantic tokens.
- [CdsTextArea](doc/components/CdsTextArea.md): A multiline `CdsTextInput` for longer text such as notes or a support message. It grows from `minLines` to `maxLines`, then scrolls, and can show a character counter.
- [CdsTextFormField](doc/components/CdsTextFormField.md): A `CdsTextInput` that takes part in a Flutter `Form`: validators, autovalidate, save and reset. Reach for it when a screen collects several fields and checks them together.
- [CdsTextInput](doc/components/CdsTextInput.md): A labeled text field with a bordered input area, optional `start`/`end` slots, prefix and suffix text, and helper text that reflects validation state. Reach for it for any single-line or short multiline text entry.
- [CdsTileButton](doc/components/CdsTileButton.md): A square button with media above a short title, for shortcut grids such as Send, Receive and Buy.
- [CdsTimePicker](doc/components/CdsTimePicker.md): A time field: type `hh:mm`, switch AM/PM, or pick from hour and minute columns in a popover opened by the clock button. CDS has no time picker; this one is built from CDS inputs and tokens.
- [CdsTimeline](doc/components/CdsTimeline.md): A vertical list of events joined by a line, each with a status dot. Use it for order history, transfer progress and account activity.
- [CdsToast](doc/components/CdsToast.md): A brief message at the bottom of the screen that confirms an action, optionally with one action button; shown with `showCdsToast`.
- [CdsTooltip](doc/components/CdsTooltip.md): A short label that explains a control, opened by long-press on touch screens and by hover or keyboard focus with a mouse or keyboard.
- [CdsTopNavBar](doc/components/CdsTopNavBar.md): The CDS React Native top navigation bar: a start slot (back or close), a centered middle (usually a [CdsNavigationTitle]), an end slot for actions, and an optional bottom row for tabs.
- [CdsTour](doc/components/CdsTour.md): Steps through feature introductions: each step dims the screen except a spotlight on its target and shows a card (usually a `CdsCoachmark`) with an arrow pointing at it.
- [CdsTray](doc/components/CdsTray.md): A bottom sheet for short tasks and pickers that follows the finger, snaps or dismisses based on release velocity, and can be grabbed mid-animation.
- [CdsUpsellCard](doc/components/CdsUpsellCard.md): A promotional card with a title, description, a button, and media anchored to the end edge.
- [CdsXAxis](doc/components/CdsXAxis.md): The horizontal axis of a cartesian chart: tick labels, grid lines, tick marks, axis line and title.
- [CdsYAxis](doc/components/CdsYAxis.md): The vertical axis of a cartesian chart: value labels, grid lines, tick marks, axis line and title.

# Accessibility

What the components do for you, and what you still own.

## Built in

- **Semantics.** Buttons, toggles, checkboxes, radios, sliders, tabs and text fields expose role, label and state. Icon-only controls require a `semanticLabel`.
- **Touch targets.** Interactive controls have a hit area of at least 44x44, even when the visible shape is smaller (an `s` icon button is a 40px circle inside a 44px target).
- **Keyboard.** Tab moves focus in visual order; Enter and Space activate; arrow keys move within radio groups, segmented controls, tabs and menus; Escape closes overlays; focus is trapped in modals and returned to the trigger on close. A focus ring (`bgLinePrimary`, 2px) appears for keyboard focus only.
- **Contrast.** Default and high-contrast palettes meet WCAG AA for text tokens on their backgrounds; the package's tests check this. `CdsThemeProvider` switches to the high-contrast theme when the platform's increase-contrast setting is on.
- **Text size.** Everything scales with the platform text size; components use minimum heights, not fixed ones.
- **Reduced motion.** See [Motion](motion.md).
- **Live regions.** Toasts, inline errors and loading states announce themselves.
- **RTL.** Layout uses start/end; icons and flush offsets flip.

## Your part

- Write labels that say what happens ("Send 0.5 ETH", not "Submit").
- Pass `semanticLabel` to `CdsIcon` when an icon carries meaning without text.
- Never use color alone for status: pair `fgNegative` with an icon or words.
- If you override colors, check them: `CdsColorUtils.isAccessible(fg, bg)`.
- Provide empty, loading and error states for every data view.

---
source: doc/guides/for-ai-agents.md
---

# For AI coding agents

This page is the entry point when an agent builds a Flutter app with `cds_flutter`. Install the bundled skill so your agent loads these rules automatically:

```sh
dart run cds_flutter:install_skill            # writes .claude/skills/cds-flutter and cds-flutter-craft
dart run cds_flutter:install_skill --agents   # also appends a pointer to AGENTS.md
```

Two skills are installed:

- **cds-flutter**: which component, token and icon to use, with the full reference docs.
- **cds-flutter-craft**: the craft standard (honest content, reflowing layouts, accessibility, fluid motion, copy, comments) and the delivery checklist an agent runs before handing over UI.

## Ground rules

1. Import once: `import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';`.
2. Root: `CdsThemeProvider` above the app. Read the theme with `context.cds`.
3. Prefer CDS components over Material widgets. Use `CdsVStack`/`CdsHStack`/`CdsBox` for layout, `CdsText` for all text, `CdsIcon` for icons.
4. Colors are `CdsColor` tokens, spacing is the 8px token scale (`padding: 2` = 16px), radius is a token key (`borderRadius: 400` = 16px). Never hardcode hex colors or pixel spacing that a token covers.
5. Every widget is prefixed `Cds`. Prop names follow CDS: `onPress`, `onChange`, `value`, `variant`, `size`, `disabled`, `loading`, `start`/`end`, `startIcon`/`endIcon`, `block`, `transparent`, `helperText`.
6. Icons: `CdsIconName.<cdsName>`; `factory` is `factoryIcon`. Search keywords: `package:cds_flutter/cds_icon_keywords.dart`.
7. Icon-only buttons need `semanticLabel`.
8. One primary button per screen.
9. Every data view has loading (`CdsFallback`), empty and error (`CdsEmptyState`) states.
10. Do not invent data presented as real. Label sample data.

## Picking components

| Need | Component |
| --- | --- |
| Main action | `CdsButton` |
| Icon action | `CdsIconButton` |
| Row in a list (asset, setting, transaction) | `CdsListCell` |
| Text field / validated form field | `CdsTextInput` / `CdsTextFormField` |
| On/off setting | `CdsSwitch` |
| Choose one of few, inline | `CdsSegmentedControl` or `CdsRadioGroup` |
| Choose from many | `CdsSelect` |
| Bottom sheet | `showCdsTray` |
| Blocking decision | `showCdsAlert` |
| Larger task in a dialog | `showCdsModal` |
| Transient confirmation | `showCdsToast` |
| Persistent inline message | `CdsBanner` |
| Status label | `CdsTag` |
| Price over time | `CdsLineChart` / `CdsSparklineInteractive` |
| Animated number | `CdsRollingNumber` |
| Tabs | `CdsTabs` / `CdsSegmentedTabs` |
| Page frame with sticky action | `CdsScaffold` + `CdsStickyFooter` |
| Placeholder while loading | `CdsFallback` |
| Empty or error screen | `CdsEmptyState` |

Every component has a reference page in `doc/components/<Name>.md` with exact parameters, defaults and examples. `llms.txt` at the package root indexes them; `llms-full.txt` contains all of them in one file.

## Screen template

```dart
class AssetScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const AssetScreen({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return CdsScaffold(
      header: CdsNavigationBar(title: 'Bitcoin', onBack: () => Navigator.of(context).pop()),
      body: const CdsVStack(padding: 3, gap: 3, children: [
        // content
      ]),
      footer: CdsStickyFooter(child: CdsButton(label: 'Buy Bitcoin', block: true, onPress: () {})),
    );
  }
}
```

The example app's sample wallet (`example/lib/sample/`) is a complete reference: bottom navigation, balance with `CdsRollingNumber`, `CdsSparklineInteractive`, asset `CdsListCell`s with loading, empty and error states, buy/send/receive flows in `showCdsTray`, `CdsSearchInput` filtering and settings with `CdsSegmentedControl`, `CdsSwitch`, `CdsSelect` and `CdsRadioGroup`.

source: doc/guides/getting-started.md

# Getting started

Install the package, wrap your app in `CdsThemeProvider`, and build your first screen.

## Install

```sh
flutter pub add cds_flutter
```

Requires Flutter 3.38 or newer. The package bundles Inter, Source Code Pro and the CDS icon font; nothing else to configure.

## Wrap your app

`CdsThemeProvider` resolves light or dark (following the system by default), switches to the high-contrast theme when the platform asks for it, and cross-fades colors when the scheme changes.

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

void main() => runApp(const App());

class App extends StatelessWidget {
  const App({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return CdsThemeProvider(
      colorScheme: CdsColorSchemePreference.system,
      child: Builder(
        builder: (context) => MaterialApp(
          // Lets Material widgets you still use (Scaffold, text selection) match CDS.
          theme: cdsMaterialTheme(context.cds),
          home: const HomeScreen(),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

`MaterialApp` is optional. Any `WidgetsApp` works; CDS widgets only need a `CdsTheme` above them (and an `Overlay`/`Navigator` for overlays).

## Build a screen

```dart
class HomeScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const HomeScreen({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ColoredBox(
      color: context.cds.color.bg,
      child: SafeArea(
        child: CdsVStack(
          padding: 3,
          gap: 2,
          children: [
            const CdsText.title1('Wallet'),
            const CdsText.body('Send and receive crypto with your self-custody wallet.', color: CdsColor.fgMuted),
            const Spacer(),
            CdsButton(label: 'Receive', block: true, onPress: () {}),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

- [Theming](theming.md): brand colors, your own fonts, forcing a scheme for a subtree.
- [Tokens](tokens.md): colors, spacing, radius, typography.
- [Motion](motion.md): springs, gestures, reduced motion.
- [Accessibility](accessibility.md)
- [Component reference](../components/)
- [For AI coding agents](for-ai-agents.md)

# Motion

Motion answers touch. Feedback on press, springs that start from where things are, sheets that follow the finger. Nothing loops forever.

## Rules every component follows

1. **Feedback on pointer-down.** Pressables tint and scale the moment a finger lands, not on release.
2. **Springs for anything touchable.** A spring starts from the current on-screen value and carries velocity, so a moving element can be grabbed and reversed without a jump.
3. **Drags follow the finger 1:1.** On release, the element continues at the finger's velocity, the resting point is projected from that velocity, and edges rubberband instead of stopping dead.
4. **Same path in and out.** A tray leaves downward because it came from below; a popover grows from its trigger.
5. **Nothing loops forever.** Spinners turn only while something is loading and only while on screen. No idle pulses, no decorative shimmer by default.
6. **Reduced motion is honored.** When the platform asks, slides and springs become instant changes or short fades.

## API

```dart
// Springs: damping ratio + response (seconds to reach the target).
CdsSprings.standard   // 1.0 / 0.35, default, no overshoot
CdsSprings.press      // 1.0 / 0.20, press feedback
CdsSprings.momentum   // 0.8 / 0.35, only after a flick
CdsSprings.sheet      // 0.86 / 0.32, trays and drawers
CdsSprings.of(dampingRatio: 0.9, response: 0.3)

// Drive an unbounded controller from where it is now, with the finger's velocity.
final c = AnimationController.unbounded(vsync: this);
CdsMotion.springTo(c, target, spring: CdsSprings.sheet, velocity: releaseVelocity);

// Where a flick would come to rest (UIScrollView deceleration).
final restingPoint = offset + CdsMotion.project(velocityPxPerSecond);

// Resistance past a boundary.
final shown = CdsMotion.rubberband(overshoot, containerExtent);

// Reduced motion.
if (CdsMotion.reduceMotion(context)) { /* fade or jump */ }
final d = CdsMotion.duration(context, CdsDurations.moderate2); // zero when reduced
```

Use an unbounded controller for springs that can overshoot; a bounded `AnimationController` clamps the value.

## Building a draggable sheet (sketch)

```dart
void onDragUpdate(DragUpdateDetails d) {
  final next = offset + d.delta.dy;
  offset = next < 0 ? -CdsMotion.rubberband(-next, height) : next; // resist above the top
  controller.value = offset;
}

void onDragEnd(DragEndDetails d) {
  final v = d.velocity.pixelsPerSecond.dy;
  final projected = offset + CdsMotion.project(v);
  final dismiss = projected > height / 2;
  CdsMotion.springTo(controller, dismiss ? height : 0, spring: CdsSprings.sheet, velocity: v);
}
```

`CdsTray` implements this fully, including handing off between the sheet and a scrollable inside it.

source: doc/guides/theming.md
---

# Theming

## The pieces

| Type | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `CdsThemeConfig` | A full theme covering both schemes: spectrum, light/dark palettes, scales, typography, shadows. Equivalent to CDS `ThemeConfig`. |
| `CdsThemeData` | A config resolved for one scheme. What `context.cds` returns. |
| `CdsTheme` | InheritedWidget that provides a `CdsThemeData`. |
| `CdsThemeProvider` | App root: picks the scheme, high contrast, animates changes. |

Built-in configs: `CdsThemeConfig.standard` (CDS default theme) and `CdsThemeConfig.highContrast`.

## Reading the theme

```dart
final cds = context.cds;
cds.color.fgMuted;                 // Color
cds.colorOf(CdsColor.bgPrimary);   // Color from a token
cds.space(2);                      // 16.0
cds.radius(400);                   // 16.0
cds.typography[CdsFont.headline];  // CdsFontStyle
cds.textStyle(CdsFont.body, color: CdsColor.fgMuted); // TextStyle
cds.spectrum.of(CdsHue.purple, 60);
cds.isDark;
```

## Choosing the scheme

```dart
CdsThemeProvider(colorScheme: CdsColorSchemePreference.dark, child: app)
```

Keep the preference in your own state (for a settings toggle) and pass it down; the provider cross-fades over 300ms, instantly under reduced motion.

### Force a scheme for one subtree

```dart
CdsTheme(
  data: context.cds.copyWith(brightness: Brightness.dark),
  child: promoCard,
)
```

## Brand colors

```dart
final brand = CdsThemeConfig.standard.copyWith(
  id: 'acme',
  lightColor: CdsThemeConfig.standard.lightColor.copyWith({
    CdsColor.bgPrimary: const Color(0xFF5B3CC4),
    CdsColor.fgPrimary: const Color(0xFF5B3CC4),
    CdsColor.bgLinePrimary: const Color(0xFF5B3CC4),
  }),
  darkColor: CdsThemeConfig.standard.darkColor.copyWith({
    CdsColor.bgPrimary: const Color(0xFF9C86F0),
    CdsColor.fgPrimary: const Color(0xFF9C86F0),
    CdsColor.bgLinePrimary: const Color(0xFF9C86F0),
  }),
);

CdsThemeProvider(config: brand, highContrastConfig: null, child: app);
```

Check text on your new colors with `CdsColorUtils.contrastRatio(fg, bg)`; aim for 4.5 or more.

## Your own fonts

The Coinbase Sans, Display and Mono fonts used by Coinbase's own theme are proprietary and are not shipped. If you hold a license for a brand font, declare it in your app's `pubspec.yaml` and map the ramp onto it:

```dart
final typography = CdsTypography.standard.map((font, style) => style.copyWith(
      fontFamily: 'BrandSans',
      monoFontFamily: 'BrandMono',
      clearFontPackage: true, // the family lives in your app, not in cds_flutter
    ));
final config = CdsThemeConfig.standard.copyWith(typography: typography);
```

Override single entries with `CdsTypography.standard.copyWith({CdsFont.display1: ...})`.

## Density

Spacing, icon, avatar and control sizes are part of the config:

```dart
final dense = CdsThemeConfig.standard.copyWith(
  sizes: const CdsSizes(iconM: 20, avatarXl: 36),
  controlSize: const CdsControlSize(checkboxSize: 16, radioSize: 16),
);
```

## Material interop

`cdsMaterialTheme(context.cds)` builds a Material `ThemeData` from the CDS theme (colors, text theme, no ink splash). `CdsMaterialTheme(child: ...)` does the same as a widget.

---
source: doc/guides/tokens.md
---

# Tokens

All values come from CDS's default theme.

## Color

Use semantic tokens (`CdsColor`) in UI. They change with light, dark and high contrast.

| Group | Tokens | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Foreground | `fg`, `fgMuted`, `fgInverse`, `fgPrimary`, `fgPositive`, `fgNegative`, `fgWarning` | Text and icons. `fgInverse` sits on bold backgrounds. |
| Background | `bg`, `bgAlternate`, `bgSecondary`, `bgTertiary`, `bgInverse`, `bgPrimary`, `bgPositive`, `bgNegative`, `bgWarning` | Surfaces and bold fills. |
| Wash | `bgPrimaryWash`, `bgSecondaryWash`, `bgPositiveWash`, `bgNegativeWash`, `bgWarningWash` | Tinted, low-emphasis backgrounds (banners, tags). |
| Elevation | `bgElevation1`, `bgElevation2` | Floating cards; overlays and menus. |
| Lines | `bgLine`, `bgLineHeavy`, `bgLinePrimary`, `bgLinePrimarySubtle`, `bgLineInverse` | Dividers, borders, focus rings. |
| Overlay | `bgOverlay` | Scrim behind modals and trays. |
| Accent | `accentSubtle{Red,Green,Blue,Purple,Yellow,Gray}`, `accentBold{...}` | Illustrative color: tags, avatars, charts. |

The raw spectrum (`CdsHue` x steps 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30 ... 100) is available through `context.cds.spectrum.of(hue, step)` for data visualisation.

## Space

`1` = 8px. Valid tokens: `0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10`.

Common choices: `0.5` between an icon and its label, `1` within a group, `2` between groups, `3` page gutter (CDS `gutter`), `4`+ between sections.

## Radius

`100` 4, `200` 8, `300` 12, `400` 16, `500` 24, `600` 32, `700` 40, `800` 48, `900` 56, `1000` pill.

## Border width

`100` 1, `200` 2, `300` 4, `400` 6, `500` 8.

## Typography

See [CdsText](../components/CdsText.md) for the ramp table. Fonts: Inter (text), Source Code Pro (mono).

## Sizes

| Kind | Values |
| --- | --- |
| Icon (`CdsIconSize`) | xs 12, s 16, m 24, l 32 |
| Avatar (`CdsAvatarSize`) | s 16, m 24, l 32, xl 40, xxl 48, xxxl 56 |
| Controls | checkbox 20, radio 20, switch 52x32 (thumb 30), tile 106 |
| Interactable height | regular 56, compact 40 |

## Elevation

`CdsElevation.level1` for cards that float, `level2` for menus, popovers and trays. Each pairs a shadow with a background token, so elevated surfaces stay distinguishable in dark mode.

## Motion

Durations (`CdsDurations`): quick 33ms; fast 100/133/150 (buttons, toggles); moderate 200/250/300 (short moves, modals); slow 350/400/500/1000 (large moves, pages).
Curves (`CdsCurves`): `global`, `enterExpressive`, `enterFunctional`, `exitExpressive`, `exitFunctional`, `linear`.
Springs (`CdsSprings`): see [Motion](motion.md).

---
source: doc/components/CdsAccordion.md
---

# CdsAccordion

A vertical list of expandable rows where at most one is open. Reach for it to tuck secondary details (fees, limits, FAQs) under short headers.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/layout/Accordion

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsAccordion(
  activeKey: open,
  onChange: (key) => setState(() => open = key),
  children: const [
    CdsAccordionItem(itemKey: 'fees', title: 'Fees', child: CdsText('Fees vary by network.')),
    CdsAccordionItem(itemKey: 'limits', title: 'Limits', child: CdsText('Limits reset daily.')),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for optional content the reader opens one section at a time. Do not hide information people need to complete a task (prices, required steps). To show or hide a single block, use `CdsCollapsible` directly.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<CdsAccordionItem>` | required | The rows, in order. Each `itemKey` must be unique. |
| `activeKey` | `String?` | `null` | Open item when controlled. Ignored when `onChange` is null. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String?>?` | `null` | Makes the accordion controlled. Called with the key to open, or `null` when the open item is closed. |
| `defaultActiveKey` | `String?` | `null` | Open item on first build when uncontrolled. |
| `borderRadius` | `int?` | `null` | Radius token for the container; clips items when set. |
| `showItemSeparators` | `bool` | `true` | Draws a `CdsDivider` between items. |

Controlled vs. uncontrolled: with `onChange` set, the accordion renders `activeKey` and never changes on its own. Without `onChange`, it keeps its own open item starting from `defaultActiveKey`.

## Examples

### Uncontrolled with a default

```dart
const CdsAccordion(
  defaultActiveKey: 'staking',
  children: [
    CdsAccordionItem(itemKey: 'staking', title: 'Staking', child: CdsText('Rewards depend on network conditions.')),
    CdsAccordionItem(itemKey: 'unstaking', title: 'Unstaking', child: CdsText('Can take several days.')),
  ],
)
```

### Rounded, without separators

```dart
const CdsAccordion(
  borderRadius: 400,
  showItemSeparators: false,
  children: [
    CdsAccordionItem(itemKey: 'a', title: 'Account', background: CdsColor.bgAlternate, child: CdsText('Details')),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

- Each header is a button with an expanded state and a label joining title, subtitle and tertiary title with commas.
- Collapsed panels are hidden from screen readers and skipped by Tab.
- Up and Down arrows move focus between headers (wrapping), Home and End jump to the first and last. Enter or Space toggles.
- Headers are at least 80px tall.

## Motion

Panels animate height and opacity (open `slow1`, close `moderate3`, `CdsCurves.global`) and reverse from their current size if toggled mid-flight. The caret rotates 180 degrees over `slow1`. Reduced motion makes both instant.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `children` |
| `activeKey` | `activeKey` |
| `defaultActiveKey` | `defaultActiveKey` |
| `onChange` / `setActiveKey` | `onChange` |
| `borderRadius` | `borderRadius` |
| `showItemSeparators` | `showItemSeparators` |
| `style`, `testID` | not ported; wrap the widget or use a `Key` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsAccordionItem.md
---

# CdsAccordionItem

One expandable row inside a `CdsAccordion`: a pressable header with title, optional media and an animated caret, over a collapsible panel.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/layout/AccordionItem

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsAccordionItem(
  itemKey: 'fees',
  title: 'Trading fees',
  subtitle: 'Charged per order',
  child: CdsText('Fees depend on order size and payment method.'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Only as a direct child of `CdsAccordion`; it reads the open key from there and asserts otherwise. For a standalone toggle, use `CdsCollapsible`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `itemKey` | `String` | required | Unique key inside the accordion. |
| `title` | `String` | required | Header title, `headline` font. |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | Panel content. |
| `subtitle` | `String?` | `null` | `label2`, `fgMuted` (or `fg` when `tertiaryTitle` is set). |
| `tertiaryTitle` | `String?` | `null` | Third line, `legal` font, `fgMuted`. |
| `media` | `Widget?` | `null` | Leading slot, such as a `CdsIcon` or avatar. |
| `onPress` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Called with `itemKey` before the accordion toggles. |
| `showHeaderBorder` | `bool` | `false` | Divider between header and panel. |
| `background` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bg` | Header color shown while pressed or hovered. |
| `caretSize` | `CdsIconSize` | `CdsIconSize.s` | Size of the caret. |
| `borderRadius` | `int?` | `null` | Radius token; clips the item. |
| `padding`, `paddingX`, `paddingY`, `paddingTop`, `paddingBottom`, `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd` | `double?` | `paddingX: 3, paddingY: 1` | Header padding as space tokens. |

The panel has padding top 2, horizontal 3, bottom 3, and caps at 400px; taller content scrolls.

## Examples

### With media and three lines

```dart
const CdsAccordionItem(
  itemKey: 'tax',
  title: 'Tax documents',
  subtitle: 'Available each February',
  tertiaryTitle: 'Downloadable as PDF',
  media: CdsIcon(CdsIconName.info),
  showHeaderBorder: true,
  child: CdsText('Download gain and loss reports from Settings.'),
)
```

## Accessibility

Header: button role, `expanded` state, label `title, subtitle, tertiaryTitle`. Focus ring on keyboard focus. Arrow key navigation is handled by the parent `CdsAccordion`.

## Motion

Header press tints without scaling (CDS `noScaleOnPress`). Caret rotates from -180 degrees (collapsed, pointing down) to 0 over `slow1`. See `CdsCollapsible` for the panel.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `itemKey` | `itemKey` |
| `title`, `subtitle`, `tertiaryTitle` | same |
| `media` | `media` |
| `children` | `child` |
| `onPress` | `onPress` |
| `showHeaderBorder` | `showHeaderBorder` |
| `background` | `background` |
| `caretSize` | `caretSize` |
| `borderRadius` | `borderRadius` |
| padding props | same names |
| `headerRef`, `panelRef`, `styles` | not ported |

source: doc/components/CdsAlert.md

# CdsAlert

A short, interruptive message that asks the person to confirm or cancel, shown with `showCdsAlert`.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/overlay/Alert

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
final remove = await showCdsAlert(
  context,
  title: 'Remove wallet?',
  body: 'You can add it again with your recovery phrase.',
  preferredActionLabel: 'Remove wallet',
  preferredActionVariant: CdsButtonVariant.negative,
  dismissActionLabel: 'Cancel',
);
if (remove == true) removeWallet();
```

## When to use / when not to

Use to confirm a destructive or irreversible action, or to report something the person must acknowledge. Keep the body to one or two sentences. Do not use for forms or long content (use `CdsModal`), or for non-blocking status (use `CdsToast` or `CdsBanner`).

## Parameters

### showCdsAlert

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| context | `BuildContext` | required | Context used to find the navigator. |
| title | `String` | required | Title in the `title3` style. |
| body | `String` | required | Message in muted `body` text. |
| preferredActionLabel | `String` | required | Label of the main button. |
| onPreferredActionPress | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Runs before the alert closes. |
| preferredActionVariant | `CdsButtonVariant` | `CdsButtonVariant.primary` | `primary` or `negative` (destructive). |
| dismissActionLabel | `String?` | `null` | Secondary button label. No secondary button when null. |
| onDismissActionPress | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Runs before the alert closes. |
| actionLayout | `Axis` | `Axis.horizontal` | `Axis.vertical` stacks buttons, preferred on top. |
| pictogram | `Widget?` | `null` | Illustration above the title. |
| useRootNavigator | `bool` | `true` | Push on the root navigator. |
| routeSettings | `RouteSettings?` | `null` | Route name and arguments. |

Returns `Future<bool?>`: `true` for the preferred action, `false` for the dismiss action, `null` for Escape or back.

### CdsAlert

Same `title`, `body`, `preferredActionLabel`, `onPreferredActionPress`, `preferredActionVariant`, `dismissActionLabel`, `onDismissActionPress`, `actionLayout` and `pictogram` as above, plus:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| onRequestClose | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Replaces the default close (`Navigator.pop` with `true`/`false`). |

The card is 318px wide max with radius 200, elevation 2. Buttons wrap to 2 lines.

## Examples

### Single acknowledgement

```dart
showCdsAlert(
  context,
  title: 'Transfer submitted',
  body: 'Sample data: 0.01 BTC will arrive in about 30 minutes.',
  preferredActionLabel: 'Done',
);
```

### Long labels, stacked

```dart
showCdsAlert(
  context,
  title: 'Turn off price alerts?',
  body: 'You will stop getting notified about Bitcoin price moves.',
  preferredActionLabel: 'Turn off price alerts',
  dismissActionLabel: 'Keep price alerts',
  actionLayout: Axis.vertical,
);
```

## Accessibility

- The route is named with the title for screen readers; the title is a heading.
- A scrim tap does not close an alert: the person chooses an action. Escape and back close it with `null`.
- Focus is trapped and restored to the trigger.
- Content scrolls at large text sizes; buttons keep 44px hit areas.

## Motion

Same as CDS: the scrim fades in over `moderate1`, the card fades over `fast1` and scales from 0.98 over `moderate3`; exit over `fast1`. Reduced motion: fade only.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `visible`, `onRequestClose` | `showCdsAlert`, result future, `onRequestClose` |
| `title`, `body` | `title`, `body` |
| `pictogram` (name) | `pictogram` (`Widget` slot; illustrations are not ported) |
| `preferredActionLabel`, `onPreferredActionPress`, `preferredActionVariant` | same names |
| `dismissActionLabel`, `onDismissActionPress` | same names |
| `actionLayout` (`'horizontal' \| 'vertical'`) | `actionLayout` (`Axis`) |

source: doc/components/CdsAreaChart.md

# CdsAreaChart

Filled regions under one or more series, optionally stacked, built on `CdsCartesianChart`.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/charts/AreaChart

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsAreaChart(
  height: 200,
  stacked: true,
  type: CdsChartAreaType.gradient,
  series: [
    CdsAreaSeries(id: 'a', data: [4, 6, 5, 8], color: CdsColor.fgPositive),
    CdsAreaSeries(id: 'b', data: [2, 3, 4, 3], color: CdsColor.fgWarning),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for volumes or totals over time, and `stacked: true` for part-to-whole over time.
- Use `CdsLineChart(showArea: true)` for a single price line with a soft fill.
- The value axis always includes the baseline (0 by default), so areas start from zero.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `series` | `List<CdsAreaSeries>` | `const []` | Series with optional `type`, `curve`, `fillOpacity` and `lineType` overrides. |
| `stacked` | `bool` | `false` | Stack every series without its own `stackId`. |
| `type` | `CdsChartAreaType` | `solid` | `solid`, `gradient` or `dotted`. |
| `curve` | `CdsChartCurve` | `bump` | Curve for edges. |
| `fillOpacity` | `double` | `1` | Fill opacity. |
| `connectNulls` | `bool` | `false` | Bridge null values. |
| `showLines` | `bool` | `false` | Draw a line along the top of each area. |
| `lineType` | `CdsChartLineType` | `solid` | Style of those lines. |
| `strokeWidth` | `double` | `2` | Width of those lines. |
| `showXAxis`, `showYAxis` | `bool` | `false` | Render the axes. |
| `xAxis`, `yAxis` | `CdsAxisConfig` | `const CdsAxisConfig()` | Scale configuration. |
| `xAxisStyle`, `yAxisStyle` | `CdsXAxis?`, `CdsYAxis?` | `null` | Visual axis options. |
| `layout` | `CdsChartLayout` | `vertical` | Chart orientation. |
| `animate` | `bool` | `true` | Enter reveal and data-change animation. Reduced motion turns it off. |
| `inset` | `CdsChartInset?` | `null` | Space around the drawing area, outside the axes. Defaults to `CdsChartInset.vertical` (top 32, sides and bottom 16) or `CdsChartInset.horizontal` (right 48, others 16). |
| `legend` | `Widget?` | `null` | Legend beside the chart, usually `const CdsLegend()`. |
| `legendPosition` | `CdsLegendPosition` | `bottom` | `top`, `bottom`, `left` or `right`. A top or bottom legend adds to `height`. |
| `enableScrubbing` | `bool` | `false` | Drag, long-press and drag, or arrow keys to inspect values. |
| `onScrubberPositionChange` | `ValueChanged<int?>?` | `null` | Scrubbed data index, or null when scrubbing ends. |
| `width` | `double?` | `null` | Defaults to the parent width. |
| `height` | `double?` | `null` | Canvas height. Defaults to the parent height, or 160 when unbounded. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Screen reader label. Defaults to each series: label, lowest, highest, latest. |
| `getScrubberAccessibilityLabel` | `String Function(int)?` | `null` | Screen reader value for a data index. |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | `const []` | Extra elements painted on top, such as `CdsScrubber` or `CdsReferenceLine`. |

For composition, `CdsArea(seriesId: ...)` inside a `CdsCartesianChart` takes `type`, `curve`, `fill`/`dangerouslySetFill`, `fillOpacity`, `connectNulls` and `animate`.

## Examples

### Stacked with outlines and a legend

```dart
CdsAreaChart(
  height: 220,
  stacked: true,
  showLines: true,
  type: CdsChartAreaType.gradient,
  legend: const CdsLegend(),
  series: [
    CdsAreaSeries(id: 'a', label: 'Series A', data: const [3, 4, 6, 5], dangerouslySetColor: context.cds.spectrum.of(CdsHue.blue, 60)),
    CdsAreaSeries(id: 'b', label: 'Series B', data: const [2, 2, 3, 4], dangerouslySetColor: context.cds.spectrum.of(CdsHue.teal, 50)),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

- The chart is one semantics container labeled with a summary of every series (lowest, highest and latest value). Override it with `accessibilityLabel` when values need units.
- With `enableScrubbing`, the chart is adjustable: its value reads the scrubbed (or latest) point, and screen reader users swipe up and down to step through points. `getScrubberAccessibilityLabel` formats that value.
- Keyboard: focus the chart, then Left and Right (Up and Down in horizontal charts) move the scrubber, Home and End jump to the ends, Escape clears. A focus ring shows for keyboard focus.
- Pair series colors with a legend or labels; color alone never identifies a series.

## Motion

- On first data, lines and areas reveal from the start edge over 500ms and bars grow from the baseline; points and beacons fade in after 350ms (CDS accessory timing).
- Data changes morph every element from its current shape to the new one with the CDS update spring (stiffness 900, damping 120). Point arrays of different lengths are resampled, so switching datasets never jumps. A resize snaps instead of morphing.
- Scrubbing follows the finger 1:1 and snaps to the nearest data index. A selection haptic fires only when the index changes.
- Reduced motion: everything changes instantly. Nothing animates at rest.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `series` (`AreaSeries`) | `series` (`CdsAreaSeries`) |
| `stacked`, `type`, `curve`, `fillOpacity`, `connectNulls` | same names |
| `showLines`, `lineType`, `strokeWidth` | same names |
| `showXAxis`, `showYAxis`, `xAxis`, `yAxis` | same names plus `xAxisStyle`/`yAxisStyle` |
| `AreaComponent`, `LineComponent`, `transitions` | not ported |

source: doc/components/CdsAvatar.md

# CdsAvatar

A person's or entity's picture, or the first letter of their name on a colored tile when there is no picture.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/media/Avatar

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsAvatar(name: 'Satoshi Nakamoto')
```

## When to use / when not to

Use for people, accounts and entities. Use `CdsRemoteImage` for asset logos and artwork, and `CdsAvatarButton` when the avatar opens something.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `String?` | `null` | Absolute image URL, loaded with `NetworkImage`. |
| `image` | `ImageProvider?` | `null` | Any image provider. Wins over `src`. |
| `name` | `String?` | `null` | Its first letter (uppercased) is shown when there is no image, or when the image fails. |
| `size` | `CdsAvatarSize` | `CdsAvatarSize.l` | Theme avatar size: s 16, m 24, l 32, xl 40, xxl 48, xxxl 56. |
| `shape` | `CdsAvatarShape` | `CdsAvatarShape.circle` | `circle`, `square` (4px corners) or `hexagon`. |
| `colorScheme` | `CdsHue` | `CdsHue.blue` | Hue of the letter tile (spectrum step 60). The letter is black or white, whichever contrasts more. |
| `borderColor` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | 2px border around a picture. Not drawn on the letter tile or hexagons. |
| `dangerouslySetSize` | `double?` | `null` | Exact size in logical px. Prefer `size`. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Screen reader label. Leave null when a visible name sits next to the avatar. |

Fallback order: `image`/`src`; then the letter tile if `name` is set; otherwise a generic silhouette.

## Examples

### Picture with fallback letter

```dart
CdsAvatar(src: user.photoUrl, name: user.displayName, size: CdsAvatarSize.xl)
```

### Colored letter tiles

```dart
Row(children: [
  for (final hue in [CdsHue.blue, CdsHue.purple, CdsHue.green])
    CdsAvatar(name: 'Ada', colorScheme: hue),
])
```

### Hexagon

```dart
CdsAvatar(image: nftImage, shape: CdsAvatarShape.hexagon, size: CdsAvatarSize.xxl)
```

## Accessibility

Hidden from screen readers unless `semanticLabel` is set; then it is announced as an image. The letter scales down instead of overflowing at large text sizes.

## Motion

A loading picture fades in over `CdsDurations.moderate1`; instant under reduced motion.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `src` | `src` (or `image` for any `ImageProvider`) |
| `name` | `name` |
| `size` | `size` |
| `shape` | `shape` |
| `colorScheme` | `colorScheme` (`CdsHue`) |
| `borderColor` | `borderColor` |
| `dangerouslySetSize` | `dangerouslySetSize` |
| `alt`, `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |

source: doc/components/CdsAvatarButton.md

# CdsAvatarButton

A `CdsAvatar` that can be pressed, typically to open a profile or account switcher.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/AvatarButton

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsAvatarButton(name: 'Satoshi', semanticLabel: 'Open profile', onPress: openProfile)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use in app bars and headers where the user's avatar leads to their account. For a decorative avatar, use `CdsAvatar`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `semanticLabel` | `String` | required | What pressing does, e.g. "Open profile". |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Null disables the button. |
| `onLongPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `src` | `String?` | `null` | Image URL. |
| `image` | `ImageProvider?` | `null` | Any image provider; wins over `src`. |
| `name` | `String?` | `null` | First letter shown without a picture. |
| `shape` | `CdsAvatarShape` | `circle` | |
| `colorScheme` | `CdsHue` | `CdsHue.blue` | Letter tile hue. |
| `borderColor` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | |
| `compact` | `bool` | `false` | `xl` (40px) avatar instead of `xxxl` (56px). |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `feedback` | `CdsHapticFeedback` | `light` | Haptic on press. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | |

## Examples

### Compact in an app bar

```dart
CdsAvatarButton(src: photoUrl, name: 'Ada', compact: true, semanticLabel: 'Switch account', onPress: switchAccount)
```

## Accessibility

Announced as a button with `semanticLabel`. Hit area is at least 44x44. Focusable; Enter and Space activate.

## Motion

Built on `CdsPressable`: tint and 0.98 scale on pointer-down with a spring; no scale under reduced motion.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `src`, `name`, `shape`, `colorScheme`, `borderColor` | same names |
| `compact` | `compact` |
| `onPress` | `onPress` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` (required) |
| `feedback` | `feedback` |

# CdsBanner

A message about the page or the account (an outage, a pending verification, a promotion), with an icon, text, optional actions and an optional dismiss button.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/feedback/Banner

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsBanner(
  variant: CdsBannerVariant.warning,
  startIcon: CdsIconName.warning,
  title: 'Verify your identity',
  description: 'Sending is paused until you finish verification.',
  primaryAction: CdsButton(
    label: 'Verify now',
    size: CdsButtonSize.xs,
    transparent: true,
    flush: CdsFlush.start,
    onPress: verify,
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use for persistent information that stays until resolved or dismissed. Use `CdsToast` for a passing confirmation and `CdsAlert` when the person must decide now.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variant | `CdsBannerVariant` | required | `informational`, `promotional`, `warning`, `error`. |
| startIcon | `CdsIconName` | required | Icon at the start; pick one that matches the meaning. |
| title | `String?` | `null` | Bold first line (`label1`), up to 2 lines. |
| description | `String?` | `null` | Body (`label2`), up to `numberOfLines`. |
| child | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom body; replaces `description`. |
| label | `String?` | `null` | Small muted line (`legal`) under the body, for example a timestamp. |
| startIconActive | `bool` | `false` | Filled icon variant. |
| hideStartIcon | `bool` | `false` | Hide the icon. |
| startIconColor | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Overrides the variant icon color. |
| startIconAccessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Makes the icon readable; decorative when null. |
| primaryAction | `Widget?` | `null` | Usually a compact transparent `CdsButton`. |
| secondaryAction | `Widget?` | `null` | Second action. |
| showDismiss | `bool` | `false` | Show a close button that collapses the banner. |
| onClose | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called after the banner collapses. |
| closeAccessibilityLabel | `String` | `'Close'` | Close button label. |
| numberOfLines | `int` | `3` | Max lines of `description`. |
| styleVariant | `CdsBannerStyleVariant` | `CdsBannerStyleVariant.contextual` | `contextual` (rounded card), `inline` (square), `global` (square with a 4px colored start bar). |
| bordered | `bool` | `false` | 1px border in the variant border color. |
| borderRadius | `int?` | `null` | Radius token. Defaults to 400 for contextual, 0 otherwise. |

Variant colors (CDS banner tokens, `CdsBannerColors.of`): informational `bgSecondary` / icon `fgPrimary`; promotional `bgPrimaryWash` / `fgPrimary`; warning `bgWarningWash` / `fgWarning`; error `bgNegativeWash` / `fgNegative`. Padding 16 vertical, 16 (contextual) or 24 horizontal.

## Examples

### Global error, dismissible

```dart
CdsBanner(
  variant: CdsBannerVariant.error,
  styleVariant: CdsBannerStyleVariant.global,
  startIcon: CdsIconName.error,
  title: 'Card payments are delayed',
  description: 'Sample data: purchases with cards may take up to 2 hours.',
  label: 'Sample data: updated 5 min ago',
  showDismiss: true,
  onClose: () => setState(() => showOutage = false),
)
```

## Accessibility

- Meaning comes from the icon and text, not color alone; give `startIconAccessibilityLabel` when the icon adds meaning beyond the title.
- The close button is labelled and has a 44px hit area.
- The banner is a semantics container so its text is read together.

## Motion

Dismissing collapses the height (`moderate2`, global) and fades out (`moderate1`), then calls `onClose`. Reduced motion: removed instantly.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `variant` | `variant` |
| `startIcon`, `startIconActive`, `hideStartIcon`, `startIconColor`, `startIconAccessibilityLabel` | same |
| `title` | `title` |
| `children` (string / node) | `description` / `child` |
| `label` | `label` |
| `primaryAction`, `secondaryAction` | same (`Widget` slots; CDS restyles `Link` actions, pass a styled button here) |
| `showDismiss`, `onClose`, `closeAccessibilityLabel` | same |
| `numberOfLines`, `styleVariant`, `bordered`, `borderRadius` | same |

source: doc/components/CdsBarChart.md

# CdsBarChart

Grouped or stacked bars, vertical or horizontal, built on `CdsCartesianChart`.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/charts/BarChart

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsBarChart(
  height: 200,
  showXAxis: true,
  xAxis: CdsAxisConfig(data: ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed']),
  series: [CdsChartSeries(id: 'volume', data: [4, 8, 6])],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it to compare discrete categories or periods (daily volume, monthly totals).
- Use `stacked: true` to show composition, and `CdsPercentageBarChart` when only shares matter.
- The category axis is a band scale (`categoryPadding` 0.3) and the value axis always includes the baseline.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `series` | `List<CdsChartSeries>` | `const []` | One bar per series per category; series sharing a `stackId` stack. |
| `stacked` | `bool` | `false` | Stack every series into one bar per category. |
| `layout` | `CdsChartLayout` | `vertical` | `horizontal` makes bars grow to the right. |
| `barPadding` | `double` | `0.1` | Gap between side-by-side bars in one category, as a fraction of the band. |
| `borderRadius` | `double` | `4` | Corner radius in pixels, capped at half the bar thickness. |
| `fillOpacity` | `double` | `1` | Bar opacity. |
| `stackGap` | `double` | `0` | Pixel gap between stacked bars. The stack keeps its total length. |
| `barMinSize` | `double` | `0` | Minimum bar length in pixels. |
| `roundBaseline` | `bool` | `false` | Round the end touching the baseline too. |
| `showXAxis`, `showYAxis` | `bool` | `false` | Render the axes. |
| `xAxis`, `yAxis` | `CdsAxisConfig` | `const CdsAxisConfig()` | Scale configuration. The category axis defaults to `band`. |
| `xAxisStyle`, `yAxisStyle` | `CdsXAxis?`, `CdsYAxis?` | `null` | Visual axis options. |
| `animate` | `bool` | `true` | Enter reveal and data-change animation. Reduced motion turns it off. |
| `inset` | `CdsChartInset?` | `null` | Space around the drawing area, outside the axes. Defaults to `CdsChartInset.vertical` (top 32, sides and bottom 16) or `CdsChartInset.horizontal` (right 48, others 16). |
| `legend` | `Widget?` | `null` | Legend beside the chart, usually `const CdsLegend()`. |
| `legendPosition` | `CdsLegendPosition` | `bottom` | `top`, `bottom`, `left` or `right`. A top or bottom legend adds to `height`. |
| `enableScrubbing` | `bool` | `false` | Drag, long-press and drag, or arrow keys to inspect values. |
| `onScrubberPositionChange` | `ValueChanged<int?>?` | `null` | Scrubbed data index, or null when scrubbing ends. |
| `width` | `double?` | `null` | Defaults to the parent width. |
| `height` | `double?` | `null` | Canvas height. Defaults to the parent height, or 160 when unbounded. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Screen reader label. Defaults to each series: label, lowest, highest, latest. |
| `getScrubberAccessibilityLabel` | `String Function(int)?` | `null` | Screen reader value for a data index. |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | `const []` | Extra elements painted on top, such as `CdsScrubber` or `CdsReferenceLine`. |

`CdsBarPlot` draws the bars inside a `CdsCartesianChart`; it takes `seriesIds` plus the bar options above. `cdsBarLayout(data, ...)` returns the computed `CdsBarGeometry` list for custom painters.

## Examples

### Stacked with a gap

```dart
const CdsBarChart(
  height: 220,
  stacked: true,
  stackGap: 2,
  showXAxis: true,
  showYAxis: true,
  legend: CdsLegend(),
  xAxis: CdsAxisConfig(data: ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu']),
  yAxisStyle: CdsYAxis(showGrid: true),
  series: [
    CdsChartSeries(id: 'buys', label: 'Buys', data: [30, 42, 25, 50], color: CdsColor.fgPositive),
    CdsChartSeries(id: 'sells', label: 'Sells', data: [20, 18, 33, 21], color: CdsColor.fgNegative),
  ],
)
```

### Horizontal

```dart
const CdsBarChart(
  height: 160,
  layout: CdsChartLayout.horizontal,
  showYAxis: true,
  yAxis: CdsAxisConfig(data: ['A', 'B', 'C']),
  yAxisStyle: CdsYAxis(position: CdsYAxisPosition.left),
  series: [CdsChartSeries(id: 'a', data: [12, 30, 21])],
)
```

## Accessibility

- The chart is one semantics container labeled with a summary of every series (lowest, highest and latest value). Override it with `accessibilityLabel` when values need units.
- With `enableScrubbing`, the chart is adjustable: its value reads the scrubbed (or latest) point, and screen reader users swipe up and down to step through points. `getScrubberAccessibilityLabel` formats that value.
- Keyboard: focus the chart, then Left and Right (Up and Down in horizontal charts) move the scrubber, Home and End jump to the ends, Escape clears. A focus ring shows for keyboard focus.
- Pair series colors with a legend or labels; color alone never identifies a series.

## Motion

- On first data, lines and areas reveal from the start edge over 500ms and bars grow from the baseline; points and beacons fade in after 350ms (CDS accessory timing).
- Data changes morph every element from its current shape to the new one with the CDS update spring (stiffness 900, damping 120). Point arrays of different lengths are resampled, so switching datasets never jumps. A resize snaps instead of morphing.
- Scrubbing follows the finger 1:1 and snaps to the nearest data index. A selection haptic fires only when the index changes.
- Reduced motion: everything changes instantly. Nothing animates at rest.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `series` (`BarSeries`) | `series` (`CdsChartSeries`) |
| `stacked`, `layout`, `barPadding`, `borderRadius`, `fillOpacity` | same names |
| `stackGap`, `barMinSize`, `roundBaseline` | same names |
| `stackMinSize`, `stroke`, `strokeWidth` | not ported |
| `BarComponent`, `BarStackComponent`, `transitions` | not ported |
| `BarPlot` | `CdsBarPlot` |

source: doc/components/CdsBottomNavigation.md

# CdsBottomNavigation

A phone bottom tab bar in CDS style: icon plus label per destination, the active one drawn with the filled glyph and `fgPrimary`, at least 44px targets and the bottom safe area applied.

CDS reference: none. This is a cds_flutter extra built from CDS tokens. CDS React Native leaves the bottom tab bar to the app's navigator, and `TabNavigation` is a top tab bar only.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
String destination = 'home';

CdsBottomNavigation(
  items: const [
    CdsBottomNavigationItem(id: 'home', icon: CdsIconName.home, label: 'Home'),
    CdsBottomNavigationItem(id: 'trade', icon: CdsIconName.trading, label: 'Trade'),
    CdsBottomNavigationItem(id: 'wallet', icon: CdsIconName.wallet, label: 'Wallet'),
  ],
  value: destination,
  onChange: (id) => setState(() => destination = id),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for three to five top-level destinations of a phone app.
- On tablets and desktop prefer [CdsSidebar](CdsSidebar.md).
- Do not use for switching views inside one screen; use [CdsTabs](CdsTabs.md).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| items | `List<CdsBottomNavigationItem>` | required | Destinations in display order. |
| value | `String` | required | Id of the selected destination. |
| onChange | `ValueChanged<String>` | required | Called with the picked id. |
| background | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bg` | Bar background. |
| bordered | `bool` | `true` | Hairline (`bgLine`) above the bar. |
| showLabels | `bool` | `true` | `false` shows icons only; labels are still read by screen readers. |
| respectSafeArea | `bool` | `true` | Pads the bottom by `MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).bottom`. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String` | `'Main navigation'` | Names the bar. |

`CdsBottomNavigationItem`:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | `String` | required | Unique id. |
| icon | `CdsIconName` | required | Outlined when inactive, filled (`active: true`) when selected. |
| label | `String` | required | Shown in `legal` under the icon. |
| count | `int?` | `null` | Badge on the icon when greater than zero. |
| max | `int?` | `null` (99) | Counts above this show as `max+`. |
| disabled | `bool` | `false` | Cannot be selected. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Overrides the read label (default: label, plus count when set). |

## Examples

### With a badge, in a scaffold

```dart
CdsScaffold(
  body: pages[destination]!,
  footer: CdsBottomNavigation(
    items: const [
      CdsBottomNavigationItem(id: 'home', icon: CdsIconName.home, label: 'Home'),
      CdsBottomNavigationItem(id: 'alerts', icon: CdsIconName.bell, label: 'Alerts', count: 4),
    ],
    value: destination,
    onChange: (id) => setState(() => destination = id),
  ),
)
```

## Accessibility

- Tab bar with tab children, selected state and tap action.
- Selection is shown by the filled glyph and color together, never color alone.
- Arrow keys, Home and End move the selection.
- Each item is at least 56px tall and 44px wide.

## Motion

- Items get the standard `CdsPressable` press feedback (tint and 0.98 scale on pointer-down; scale off under reduced motion).
- Selection changes fire a selection haptic.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS concept | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| Icon `active` glyph for the current tab | `CdsBottomNavigationItem.icon` drawn with `active: true` when selected |
| `DotCount` | `count`, `max` |
