source: doc/components/CdsBox.md
---

# CdsBox

The layout primitive: padding, margin, background, border, radius and elevation, all from theme tokens.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/layout/Box

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsBox(
  padding: 2,
  background: CdsColor.bgSecondary,
  borderRadius: 400,
  child: CdsText('Your balance is protected by 2-step verification.'),
)
```

## Token scales

- Space (`padding*`, `margin*`): `0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10` where `1` is 8px. An invalid value asserts in debug.
- Radius (`borderRadius`): `0, 100 (4), 200 (8), 300 (12), 400 (16), 500 (24), 600 (32), 700 (40), 800 (48), 900 (56), 1000 (pill)`.
- Border width (`borderWidth`): `0, 100 (1), 200 (2), 300 (4), 400 (6), 500 (8)`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | |
| `padding`, `paddingX`, `paddingY`, `paddingTop`, `paddingBottom`, `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd` | `double?` | `null` | Space tokens. Specific sides win over axes, axes over `padding`. Start/end flip in RTL. |
| `margin`, `marginX`, ... `marginEnd` | `double?` | `null` | Same cascade, outside the background. |
| `background` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | |
| `dangerouslySetBackground` | `Color?` | `null` | |
| `borderColor` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Setting it adds a 1px border. |
| `borderWidth` | `int?` | `null` | Border width token. |
| `bordered` | `bool` | `false` | 1px `bgLine` border. |
| `borderRadius` | `int?` | `null` | Radius token. |
| `elevation` | `CdsElevation` | `none` | `level1` (cards) or `level2` (overlays): adds the theme shadow and switches the background to `bgElevation1/2`, which stays visible in dark mode where shadows do not. |
| `width`, `height`, `minWidth`, `minHeight`, `maxWidth`, `maxHeight` | `double?` | `null` | Logical pixels. |
| `alignment` | `AlignmentGeometry?` | `null` | Align the child. |
| `clip` | `bool` | `false` | Clip the child to the rounded corners. |

## Examples

```dart
CdsBox(elevation: CdsElevation.level1, borderRadius: 500, padding: 3, child: card)
CdsBox(bordered: true, borderRadius: 300, paddingX: 2, paddingY: 1.5, child: row)
```

## CDS React Native mapping

Prop names match `<Box>` one to one (`padding={2}` is `padding: 2`, `background="bgSecondary"` is `background: CdsColor.bgSecondary`). Flex props live on `CdsHStack` / `CdsVStack`.

source: doc/components/CdsBreadcrumb.md

# CdsBreadcrumb

A trail of links from the top of a hierarchy to the current page, for tablet and desktop layouts with deep navigation.

CDS reference: none. This is a cds_flutter extra built from CDS tokens.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsBreadcrumb(
  items: [
    CdsBreadcrumbItem(label: 'Assets', onPress: () => go('/assets')),
    CdsBreadcrumbItem(label: 'Bitcoin', onPress: () => go('/assets/btc')),
    const CdsBreadcrumbItem(label: 'Transactions'),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use on wide layouts where pages sit three or more levels deep. On phones, a back button in `CdsTopNavBar` is clearer. Do not use as the only navigation.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<CdsBreadcrumbItem>` | required | Levels from top to current. The last item is the current page. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `String` | `'Breadcrumb'` | Label for the group. |
| `maxItems` | `int?` | `null` | When exceeded, keeps the first item and the last `maxItems - 1` items and collapses the rest into `...`. Must be at least 2. |
| `expandAccessibilityLabel` | `String` | `'Show all levels'` | Screen reader label for the `...` button, which expands the trail. |

`CdsBreadcrumbItem({required String label, VoidCallback? onPress})`. `onPress` is ignored on the last item.

## Examples

### Collapsed middle

```dart
CdsBreadcrumb(
  maxItems: 3,
  items: [
    CdsBreadcrumbItem(label: 'Home', onPress: () {}),
    CdsBreadcrumbItem(label: 'Assets', onPress: () {}),
    CdsBreadcrumbItem(label: 'Bitcoin', onPress: () {}),
    CdsBreadcrumbItem(label: 'Wallets', onPress: () {}),
    const CdsBreadcrumbItem(label: 'Transactions'),
  ],
)
// Home > ... > Wallets > Transactions
```

## Visual reference

Earlier items are `label2` in `fgMuted`; the current page is `label1` in `fg`. Separators are `caretRight` at size `xs` in `fgMuted` (`caretLeft` in RTL), with 4px gaps. Items wrap onto new lines instead of overflowing.

## Accessibility

- The trail is a group labelled `accessibilityLabel`. Earlier items are buttons; the current page is not interactive and carries the selected state.
- Every link has a 44px minimum hit area.

## Motion

Links use `CdsPressable` press feedback with a `bgSecondary` wash while pressed or hovered.

## CDS React Native mapping

No CDS equivalent.

source: doc/components/CdsButton.md
---

# CdsButton

A pill-shaped button with a text label, for the actions people take on a screen.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/Button

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsButton(label: 'Buy Bitcoin', onPress: () => buy())
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use one `primary` button for the main action of a screen. Pair it with `secondary` for the alternative.
- Use `negative` only for destructive or irreversible actions, `positive` for confirming a good outcome.
- Use `transparent: true` for low-emphasis actions in headers and toolbars.
- For an icon-only action use `CdsIconButton`. For navigation inside text use `CdsLink`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String` | required | Button text. Truncates after `maxLines`. |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called on tap, Enter or Space. `null` renders the button disabled. |
| `onLongPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called on long press. |
| `variant` | `CdsButtonVariant` | `primary` | `primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`, `foregroundMuted`, `positive`, `negative`, `inverse`. |
| `size` | `CdsButtonSize` | `l` | `xs` (label1 font), `s`, `m`, `l` (56px tall). |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Dims the button and blocks presses. |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Shows a spinner in place of the label, keeps the width, blocks presses, announces "loading". |
| `transparent` | `bool` | `false` | No background until pressed or hovered. |
| `block` | `bool` | `false` | Stretch to the parent's width. |
| `startIcon` / `endIcon` | `CdsIconName?` | `null` | Icons before / after the label. |
| `startIconActive` / `endIconActive` | `bool` | `false` | Use the filled glyph. |
| `start` / `end` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom slots; override the icons. |
| `flush` | `CdsFlush?` | `null` | `start` or `end`: offsets the padding so the label aligns with the edge content. |
| `noScaleOnPress` | `bool` | `false` | Disable the 0.98 press scale. |
| `maxLines` | `int` | `1` | Lines before the label truncates. |
| `feedback` | `CdsHapticFeedback?` | light for xs/s, normal for m/l | Haptic fired on press. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | label | Override what screen readers announce. |
| `semanticHint` | `String?` | `null` | Extra screen reader hint. |
| `focusNode`, `autofocus` | | | Keyboard focus control. |

## Examples

### Primary and secondary pair

```dart
CdsHStack(gap: 1, children: [
  Expanded(child: CdsButton(label: 'Cancel', variant: CdsButtonVariant.secondary, block: true, onPress: close)),
  Expanded(child: CdsButton(label: 'Send USDC', block: true, onPress: send)),
])
```

### Loading while a request runs

```dart
CdsButton(label: 'Place order', block: true, loading: isSubmitting, onPress: submit)
```

### With icons

```dart
CdsButton(label: 'Receive', startIcon: CdsIconName.arrowDown, variant: CdsButtonVariant.secondary, onPress: receive)
```

### Destructive, low emphasis

```dart
CdsButton(label: 'Remove wallet', variant: CdsButtonVariant.negative, transparent: true, onPress: confirmRemove)
```

## Accessibility

- Announced as a button with its label; disabled and loading states are exposed.
- Hit area is at least 44px tall even at `xs`.
- Focusable with Tab; Enter and Space activate; the focus ring uses `bgLinePrimary`.

## Motion

Pointer-down tints the background and scales the button to 0.98 with a spring that starts from the current scale, so rapid taps never jump. Release eases back. Reduced motion keeps the tint and drops the scale.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `label` |
| `onPress` | `onPress` |
| `variant`, `size`, `disabled`, `loading`, `transparent`, `block` | same names |
| `startIcon`, `endIcon`, `start`, `end`, `flush` | same names (`flush: CdsFlush.start`) |
| `compact` (deprecated) | `size: CdsButtonSize.s` |
| `numberOfLines` | `maxLines` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |

source: doc/components/CdsButtonGroup.md

# CdsButtonGroup

Lays out related buttons in a row or column with the CDS 8px gap.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/layout/ButtonGroup

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsButtonGroup(
  block: true,
  children: [
    CdsButton(label: 'Sell', variant: CdsButtonVariant.secondary, onPress: sell),
    CdsButton(label: 'Buy', onPress: buy),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for two or three actions that belong together, such as Buy and Sell. Keep one primary button per group.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required | Usually `CdsButton`s. |
| `block` | `bool` | `false` | Share the full width equally. `CdsButton` children are rebuilt with `block: true`. |
| `direction` | `Axis` | `Axis.horizontal` | `Axis.vertical` stacks the buttons at full width. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Names the group for screen readers. |

Without `block`, a horizontal row that runs out of width shrinks its buttons (labels ellipsize) instead of overflowing.

## Examples

### Vertical

```dart
CdsButtonGroup(
  direction: Axis.vertical,
  children: [
    CdsButton(label: 'Buy Bitcoin', onPress: buy),
    CdsButton(label: 'Not now', variant: CdsButtonVariant.secondary, onPress: dismiss),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

With `accessibilityLabel` the group is a labeled container; each button keeps its own semantics and 44px target.

## Motion

None beyond the buttons' own press feedback.

## CDS React Native mapping

CDS ships `ButtonGroup` for web only.

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `children` |
| `block` | `block` |
| `direction` (`'horizontal' \| 'vertical'`) | `direction` (`Axis`) |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `accessibilityLabel` |

# CdsCalendar

A month grid for picking one date. Use it inline on a screen, or let `CdsDatePicker` show it in a popover next to a typed date.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/other/Calendar

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsCalendar(
  selectedDate: date,
  onPressDate: (d) => setState(() => date = d),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it when the day of the week or nearby dates matter to the choice (scheduling a transfer, picking a start date). For a date the user already knows by heart, such as a date of birth, `CdsDateInput` is faster. For a field that offers both, use `CdsDatePicker`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selectedDate` | `DateTime?` | `null` | Day drawn with the primary fill. Time of day is ignored. |
| `seedDate` | `DateTime?` | `null` | Month shown first when `selectedDate` is null. |
| `onPressDate` | `ValueChanged<DateTime>?` | `null` | Called with the pressed day at midnight. Null makes days read-only. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Dims the calendar and blocks every interaction. |
| `hideControls` | `bool` | `false` | Hides the previous and next month arrows. |
| `disabledDates` | `List<DateTime>` | `const []` | Individual days that cannot be picked. |
| `disabledDateRanges` | `List<DateTimeRange>` | `const []` | Inclusive ranges that cannot be picked. Each day is expanded into a set, so keep ranges reasonable. |
| `highlightedDates` | `List<DateTime>` | `const []` | Days drawn with `fgPrimary` text. |
| `highlightedDateRanges` | `List<DateTimeRange>` | `const []` | Inclusive ranges drawn with `fgPrimary` text. |
| `minDate` | `DateTime?` | `null` | Earliest selectable day, inclusive. Browsing before its month is blocked. |
| `maxDate` | `DateTime?` | `null` | Latest selectable day, inclusive. Browsing after its month is blocked. |
| `currentDate` | `DateTime?` | `DateTime.now()` | The day treated as today (bordered). Pass a fixed day in tests. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | Moves keyboard focus to the selected day, today, or the first available day on first build. |
| `disabledDateError` | `String` | `'Date unavailable'` | Accessibility hint on unavailable days. |
| `nextArrowSemanticLabel` | `String` | `'Go to next month'` | Label of the next month button. |
| `previousArrowSemanticLabel` | `String` | `'Go to previous month'` | Label of the previous month button. |
| `todaySemanticHint` | `String` | `'Today'` | Accessibility hint on today's date. |
| `highlightedDateSemanticHint` | `String` | `'Highlighted'` | Accessibility hint on highlighted dates. |

`DateTimeRange` comes from `package:flutter/material.dart`.

The first month shown is the month of `selectedDate`, then `seedDate`, then today, or `maxDate` when it is earlier than today. The calendar tracks the month being browsed itself; when `selectedDate` changes to a day in another month, it jumps there.

## Examples

### Limit to the next 30 days

```dart
final now = DateTime.now();
final today = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day);
CdsCalendar(
  selectedDate: date,
  onPressDate: (d) => setState(() => date = d),
  minDate: today,
  maxDate: today.add(const Duration(days: 30)),
)
```

### Unavailable and highlighted days

```dart
CdsCalendar(
  selectedDate: date,
  onPressDate: (d) => setState(() => date = d),
  disabledDateRanges: [DateTimeRange(start: DateTime(2026, 12, 24), end: DateTime(2026, 12, 26))],
  highlightedDates: [DateTime(2026, 12, 1), DateTime(2026, 12, 15)],
  disabledDateError: 'Transfers are not processed on holidays',
)
```

### One fixed month without arrows

```dart
CdsCalendar(
  seedDate: DateTime(2026, 12, 1),
  minDate: DateTime(2026, 12, 1),
  maxDate: DateTime(2026, 12, 31),
  hideControls: true,
  onPressDate: (d) {},
)
```

## Accessibility

- Each day is a button labeled like "Monday 3 November 2026", with `selected` set on the selected day and hints for today, highlighted and unavailable days.
- The month title is a header. Changing month announces the new month ("December 2026").
- The grid is one Tab stop: focus lands on the selected day, today, or the first available day. Arrow keys move by day and week (left and right swap in RTL), Page Up and Page Down by month, Home and End to the start and end of the week. Enter or Space selects. Moving past the month edge shows the adjacent month.
- Unavailable days are skipped by the keyboard and cannot receive focus.
- Days have a 44px hit area around the 40px circle. Day numbers and weekday initials stop growing at 1.4x text scale so the grid still fits a phone; the month title scales freely.
- Labels are English and weeks start on Sunday, matching CDS. Override the `...SemanticLabel`, `...SemanticHint` and `disabledDateError` strings to localize what screen readers read.

## Motion

Pressing a day gives the standard `CdsPressable` press feedback and a light haptic. Changing month fades the new grid in (`moderate1`, enter-functional easing). Under reduced motion the new month appears at once.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `selectedDate` | `selectedDate` |
| `seedDate` | `seedDate` |
| `onPressDate` | `onPressDate` |
| `disabled` | `disabled` |
| `hideControls` | `hideControls` |
| `disabledDates` (dates and `[start, end]` tuples) | `disabledDates` + `disabledDateRanges` |
| `highlightedDates` (dates and tuples) | `highlightedDates` + `highlightedDateRanges` |
| `minDate` / `maxDate` | `minDate` / `maxDate` |
| `disabledDateError` | `disabledDateError` |
| `nextArrowAccessibilityLabel` | `nextArrowSemanticLabel` |
| `previousArrowAccessibilityLabel` | `previousArrowSemanticLabel` |
| `todayAccessibilityHint` | `todaySemanticHint` |
| `highlightedDateAccessibilityHint` | `highlightedDateSemanticHint` |
| `ref.focusInitialDate()` | `autofocus` |
| `styles` | not ported |

Differences from CDS: each day sits in a 44px slot with a 4px gap (CDS uses 40px cells with an 8px gap), so circles keep the same spacing while meeting the 44px target. Unavailable days show their message as an accessibility hint rather than a tooltip. Keyboard navigation is added.

---
source: doc/components/CdsCarousel.md

# CdsCarousel

A horizontally paged row of items with an optional title, previous/next buttons and dot pagination. Use it for browsable sets like featured assets or learning cards.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/layout/Carousel

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsCarousel(
  title: 'Top movers',
  itemWidth: 280,
  onChangePage: (page) => setState(() => this.page = page),
  children: [for (final asset in assets) AssetCard(asset)],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for a handful of parallel items the user may skim. Do not put content people must see in later pages, and prefer a vertical list when items need comparing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required | Items. Each is laid out at `itemWidth`; heights are equalized to the tallest item. |
| `itemWidth` | `double?` | `null` | Item width in px. Null makes each item as wide as the carousel. |
| `gap` | `double` | `1` | Space token between items. |
| `snapMode` | `CdsCarouselSnapMode` | `page` | `item`: every item starts a page until the remaining items fit. `page`: items visible together form a page. |
| `drag` | `CdsCarouselDrag` | `snap` | `none`, `free` (momentum, stops anywhere) or `snap`. |
| `initialPage` | `int` | `0` | Page shown on first layout, without animation. Later changes are ignored. |
| `title` | `String?` | `null` | Title above the carousel, `title3`, one line. |
| `hideNavigation` | `bool` | `false` | Hides previous/next (and play/pause) buttons. |
| `hidePagination` | `bool` | `false` | Hides the dots. |
| `onChangePage` | `ValueChanged<int>?` | `null` | Called after a drag, button, dot, key or autoplay page change. |
| `onDragStart`, `onDragEnd` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Drag lifecycle. |
| `autoplay` | `bool` | `false` | Advances pages on a timer, wrapping to the first page. |
| `autoplayInterval` | `Duration` | `3000ms` | Time between autoplay steps. |
| `controller` | `CdsCarouselController?` | `null` | Reads `activePageIndex`/`totalPages` and calls `goToPage`. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `String?` | `title` or `'Carousel'` | Label of the carousel node. |
| `nextPageAccessibilityLabel` | `String` | `'Next page'` | |
| `previousPageAccessibilityLabel` | `String` | `'Previous page'` | |
| `paginationAccessibilityLabel` | `String Function(int)` | `Go to page N` | Label for each dot. |
| `startAutoplayAccessibilityLabel` | `String` | `'Play Carousel'` | |
| `stopAutoplayAccessibilityLabel` | `String` | `'Pause Carousel'` | |

`CdsCarouselController` is a `ChangeNotifier`: `activePageIndex`, `totalPages` (0 before layout), `goToPage(int)`. Dispose it when you own it.

## Examples

### Narrow items that snap per item

```dart
CdsCarousel(
  itemWidth: 160,
  snapMode: CdsCarouselSnapMode.item,
  hideNavigation: true,
  children: cards,
)
```

### Driven from outside

```dart
final controller = CdsCarouselController();

CdsCarousel(controller: controller, children: cards);
controller.goToPage(2);
```

### Autoplay

```dart
CdsCarousel(title: 'Learn', autoplay: true, children: lessons)
```

## Accessibility

- The carousel is one node labeled with `accessibilityLabel`, value `Page N of M`, and scroll actions (swipe gestures in TalkBack/VoiceOver) that move to the next or previous page. Each item reports `N of M`; only visible items are in the semantics tree.
- Left and Right arrows page when the carousel has focus (mirrored in RTL); a focus ring shows.
- Buttons are `CdsIconButton`s with 44px targets. Dots have 44px tall targets but small horizontal ones, so buttons and swipe stay the primary navigation.

## Motion

- Dragging follows the finger 1:1 from where it was grabbed, with `CdsMotion.rubberband` resistance past the first and last page.
- On release, `CdsMotion.project` turns the finger's velocity into a projected resting point. `snap` picks the page nearest to it (in `page` mode, at most one page from where the drag began); `free` stops at the projection, clamped to the content.
- The settle is a spring that starts with the finger's velocity: `CdsSprings.momentum` after a flick, `CdsSprings.standard` otherwise. Buttons, dots and keys use `standard` from the current position, so presses during motion redirect smoothly.
- Haptic selection fires on page change.
- Autoplay is off by default. It stops as soon as the user drags, hovers, focuses the carousel or presses a control, and stays stopped until they press play. It never runs under reduced motion (the play button is hidden then), pauses while `TickerMode` is off, and its timer is cancelled on dispose.
- Reduced motion: page changes are instant.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` (`CarouselItem` elements) | `children` (any widgets) plus `itemWidth` |
| `drag` | `drag` |
| `snapMode` | `snapMode` |
| `initialPage` | `initialPage` |
| `hideNavigation`, `hidePagination` | same |
| `title` (string or node) | `title` (`String`) |
| `onChangePage`, `onDragStart`, `onDragEnd` | same |
| `autoplay`, `autoplayInterval` (ms) | `autoplay`, `autoplayInterval` (`Duration`) |
| accessibility label props | same names |
| `ref` (`goToPage`) | `controller` |
| `loop` | not supported |
| `NavigationComponent`, `PaginationComponent`, `paginationVariant`, `styles` | not ported |

---
source: doc/components/CdsCartesianChart.md

# CdsCartesianChart

The shared chart frame: it computes scales from the series, reserves space for axes, handles scrubbing, and paints chart elements given as children.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/charts/CartesianChart

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsCartesianChart(
  height: 200,
  enableScrubbing: true,
  series: [CdsChartSeries(id: 'prices', data: [10, 22, 29, 45, 98, 45, 22])],
  children: [
    CdsYAxis(showGrid: true),
    CdsLine(seriesId: 'prices'),
    CdsScrubber(),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it to combine element types: bars with a line, reference lines, labeled points.
- Use `CdsLineChart`, `CdsAreaChart` or `CdsBarChart` when one element type is enough; they build this for you.
- Children paint in order. Put axes first so grid lines sit behind data, and `CdsScrubber` last.
- Elements read the chart through `CdsCartesianChartScope.of(context)`, which exposes scales, the drawing area and series for custom painters.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `series` | `List<CdsChartSeries>` | `const []` | Data series. Elements refer to them by `id`. |
| `layout` | `CdsChartLayout` | `vertical` | `vertical`: x is the category axis. `horizontal`: y is the category axis. |
| `xAxis` | `CdsAxisConfig` | `const CdsAxisConfig()` | Scale for x. The category axis defaults to `linear` with a `strict` domain of 0 to length - 1. |
| `yAxis` | `CdsAxisConfig` | `const CdsAxisConfig()` | Scale for y. The value axis defaults to a `nice` domain over every value (stacked totals when series share a `stackId`). |
| `animate` | `bool` | `true` | Enter reveal and data-change animation. Reduced motion turns it off. |
| `inset` | `CdsChartInset?` | `null` | Space around the drawing area, outside the axes. Defaults to `CdsChartInset.vertical` (top 32, sides and bottom 16) or `CdsChartInset.horizontal` (right 48, others 16). |
| `legend` | `Widget?` | `null` | Legend beside the chart, usually `const CdsLegend()`. |
| `legendPosition` | `CdsLegendPosition` | `bottom` | `top`, `bottom`, `left` or `right`. A top or bottom legend adds to `height`. |
| `enableScrubbing` | `bool` | `false` | Drag, long-press and drag, or arrow keys to inspect values. |
| `onScrubberPositionChange` | `ValueChanged<int?>?` | `null` | Scrubbed data index, or null when scrubbing ends. |
| `width` | `double?` | `null` | Defaults to the parent width. |
| `height` | `double?` | `null` | Canvas height. Defaults to the parent height, or 160 when unbounded. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Screen reader label. Defaults to each series: label, lowest, highest, latest. |
| `getScrubberAccessibilityLabel` | `String Function(int)?` | `null` | Screen reader value for a data index. |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | `const []` | Extra elements painted on top, such as `CdsScrubber` or `CdsReferenceLine`. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | Focus node for keyboard scrubbing. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | Focus the chart on first build. |

### CdsChartSeries

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `String` | required | Unique id. |
| `data` | `List<double?>` | `const []` | Values in category order. `null` (or NaN) leaves a gap. |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Name for legends, beacon labels and screen readers. |
| `color` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Color token. Defaults to `fgPrimary`. |
| `dangerouslySetColor` | `Color?` | `null` | Raw color, for spectrum palettes: `context.cds.spectrum.of(CdsHue.blue, 60)`. |
| `stackId` | `String?` | `null` | Series sharing a stack id stack on each other (positives up, negatives down). |
| `legendShape` | `CdsLegendShape` | `circle` | `circle`, `square`, `squircle` or `pill`. |

### CdsAxisConfig

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scaleType` | `CdsAxisScaleType?` | `null` | `linear` or `band`. Defaults to `linear`; bar charts default the category axis to `band`. |
| `data` | `List<String>?` | `null` | Category labels; also sets the number of positions. |
| `domain` | `CdsAxisDomain?` | `null` | Fix `min` and/or `max`. Unset sides come from the data. |
| `domainLimit` | `CdsDomainLimit?` | `null` | `nice` rounds outward (value axis default), `strict` uses exact bounds (category axis default). |
| `categoryPadding` | `double?` | `null` | Empty fraction of each band, 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.3. |
| `baseline` | `double?` | `null` | Value bars and areas grow from. Defaults to 0. |
| `includeBaseline` | `bool` | `false` | Extend a computed domain to contain the baseline. Bar and area charts turn it on. |

## Examples

### Bars with a price line and a target

```dart
const CdsCartesianChart(
  height: 240,
  xAxis: CdsAxisConfig(scaleType: CdsAxisScaleType.band, data: ['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4']),
  yAxis: CdsAxisConfig(includeBaseline: true),
  legend: CdsLegend(),
  series: [
    CdsChartSeries(id: 'volume', label: 'Volume', data: [40, 55, 38, 61], color: CdsColor.bgLineHeavy),
    CdsChartSeries(id: 'price', label: 'Price', data: [52, 48, 57, 60]),
  ],
  children: [
    CdsXAxis(),
    CdsYAxis(showGrid: true),
    CdsBarPlot(seriesIds: ['volume']),
    CdsLine(seriesId: 'price', curve: CdsChartCurve.monotone),
    CdsReferenceLine(dataY: 50, label: 'Target'),
  ],
)
```

### Reading the scrubbed index

```dart
CdsCartesianChart(
  height: 200,
  enableScrubbing: true,
  onScrubberPositionChange: (index) => debugPrint('scrubbed '),
  series: const [CdsChartSeries(id: 'a', data: [3, 5, 4, 6])],
  children: const [CdsLine(seriesId: 'a'), CdsScrubber()],
)
```

## Accessibility

- The chart is one semantics container labeled with a summary of every series (lowest, highest and latest value). Override it with `accessibilityLabel` when values need units.
- With `enableScrubbing`, the chart is adjustable: its value reads the scrubbed (or latest) point, and screen reader users swipe up and down to step through points. `getScrubberAccessibilityLabel` formats that value.
- Keyboard: focus the chart, then Left and Right (Up and Down in horizontal charts) move the scrubber, Home and End jump to the ends, Escape clears. A focus ring shows for keyboard focus.
- Pair series colors with a legend or labels; color alone never identifies a series.

## Motion

- On first data, lines and areas reveal from the start edge over 500ms and bars grow from the baseline; points and beacons fade in after 350ms (CDS accessory timing).
- Data changes morph every element from its current shape to the new one with the CDS update spring (stiffness 900, damping 120). Point arrays of different lengths are resampled, so switching datasets never jumps. A resize snaps instead of morphing.
- Scrubbing follows the finger 1:1 and snaps to the nearest data index. A selection haptic fires only when the index changes.
- Reduced motion: everything changes instantly. Nothing animates at rest.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `series` | `series` (`CdsChartSeries`) |
| `children` | `children` |
| `layout` | `layout` |
| `animate` | `animate` |
| `xAxis`, `yAxis` (config) | `xAxis`, `yAxis` (`CdsAxisConfig`, one axis each) |
| `inset` | `inset` |
| `legend` (`true` or node) | `legend` (`const CdsLegend()` or any widget) |
| `legendPosition` | `legendPosition` |
| `enableScrubbing`, `onScrubberPositionChange` | same names |
| `getScrubberAccessibilityLabel` | `getScrubberAccessibilityLabel` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `accessibilityLabel` |
| `width`, `height` | `width`, `height` |
| `fontFamilies`, `fontProvider` | not needed; labels use the theme typography |
| series `gradient` | not ported |

source: doc/components/CdsCell.md

# CdsCell

The layout primitive behind `CdsListCell` and `CdsContentCell`: media, main content, intermediary, end content and accessory in a row, with optional content below.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/data-display/ListCell

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsCell(
  media: const CdsCellMedia.icon(CdsIconName.wallet),
  end: const CdsText.body(r'$120.00'),
  accessory: const CdsCellAccessory(CdsCellAccessoryType.arrow),
  onPress: openWallet,
  child: const CdsText.headline('Cash'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Reach for `CdsListCell` first. Use `CdsCell` for layouts the list cell cannot express.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | Main content. Grows into free space. |
| `media` | `Widget?` | `null` | Fixed-size leading media. |
| `intermediary` | `Widget?` | `null` | Natural width; shrinks unless `middle` has priority. |
| `end` | `Widget?` | `null` | Grows into free space; shrinks unless `end` has priority. |
| `accessory` | `Widget?` | `null` | Fixed-size trailing widget. |
| `bottomContent` | `Widget?` | `null` | Under the row, `rowGap` away. |
| `onPress` / `onLongPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | 50% opacity, presses blocked. |
| `selected` | `bool` | `false` | Fills with `background`; selected semantics flag. |
| `priority` | `Set<CdsCellPriority>` | `{}` | |
| `alignItems` | `CrossAxisAlignment` | `center` | |
| `gap` | `double` | `2` | Space token between row pieces. |
| `rowGap` | `double` | `1` | Space token above `bottomContent`. |
| `background` | `CdsColor` | `bgAlternate` | Selected fill. |
| `borderRadius` | `int` | `200` | |
| `bordered` | `bool` | `false` | 1px `bgLine` border. |
| `minHeight` / `maxHeight` | `double?` | `null` | Include the outer spacing. |
| `endWidth` | `double?` | `null` | Fixed end width. |
| `innerSpacing` | `CdsCellSpacing?` | `CdsCellSpacing.defaultInner` | |
| `outerSpacing` | `CdsCellSpacing?` | `CdsCellSpacing.defaultOuter` | |
| `feedback` | `CdsHapticFeedback` | `none` | |
| `semanticLabel` / `semanticHint` | `String?` | `null` | |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | |

### CdsCellSpacing

`CdsCellSpacing({double? padding, paddingX, paddingY, paddingTop, paddingBottom, paddingStart, paddingEnd, marginX})`, all space tokens. Presets: `defaultInner` (`paddingX: 2, paddingY: 1, marginX: -2`), `defaultOuter` (`paddingX: 3, paddingY: 1`), `condensedInner` (`paddingX: 3, paddingY: 1, marginX: 0`), `condensedOuter` (all 0). The negative inner `marginX` pulls the press and selection highlight 16px into the gutter while content stays aligned 24px from the edge.

## Examples

### Custom main content

```dart
CdsCell(
  bordered: true,
  child: Row(children: [const CdsText.headline('Network'), const SizedBox(width: 8), const CdsTag('Beta')]),
)
```

## Accessibility

Pressable cells are one button with merged text. Non-pressable cells form one semantics container.

## Motion

Pointer-down tint from `CdsPressable`, no scale.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `child` |
| `media`, `intermediary`, `end`, `accessory`, `bottomContent` | same names |
| `accessoryNode` | `accessory` (already a widget) |
| `detail` (deprecated) | `end` |
| `detailWidth` | `endWidth` |
| `priority`, `selected`, `disabled`, `onPress`, `innerSpacing`, `outerSpacing` | same names |

# CdsCellAccessory

The trailing icon of a cell: an arrow, a more menu, or a selection checkmark.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/data-display/ListCell

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsCellAccessory(CdsCellAccessoryType.arrow)
```

## When to use / when not to

`CdsListCell` and `CdsContentCell` build this from their `accessory` parameter. Use it directly with `CdsCell`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `CdsCellAccessoryType` | required | `arrow` (muted caret toward the end edge, mirrored in RTL), `more` (muted dots), `selected` (`fgPrimary` checkmark), `unselected` (invisible checkmark that keeps alignment). |

## Accessibility

Decorative; the selected state is announced by the cell.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `type` | `type` (positional) |

# CdsCellDetail

End-aligned detail and subdetail text of a cell, such as a balance and its change.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/data-display/ListCell

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsCellDetail(detail: r'$4,201.10', subdetail: '+2.4%', variant: CdsCellDetailVariant.positive)
```

## When to use / when not to

`CdsListCell` builds this from `detail` and `subdetail`. Use it in `CdsCell.end`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `detail` | `String?` | `null` | One `body` line. |
| `detailNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Wins over `detail`. |
| `subdetail` | `String?` | `null` | One line colored by `variant`. |
| `subdetailNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Wins over `subdetail`. |
| `variant` | `CdsCellDetailVariant` | `foregroundMuted` | `foregroundMuted`, `negative`, `positive`, `warning`. |
| `subdetailFont` | `CdsFont` | `label2` | |

## Accessibility

Pair color with a sign or word ("+2.4%", "Failed") so meaning does not rest on color.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| all props | same names |

# CdsCellMedia

Media sized and shaped for the start slot of a list cell: an icon, asset, avatar, image or pictogram.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/media/CellMedia

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsListCell(title: 'Security', media: const CdsCellMedia.icon(CdsIconName.shield))
```

## When to use / when not to

Use in `CdsListCell.media` and `CdsContentCell.media` for consistent sizing. CDS now also accepts media passed directly (any widget works in `media`).

## Constructors

| Constructor | Box | Rendering |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CdsCellMedia.icon(CdsIconName name, {bool active = false, CdsColor color = CdsColor.fg, String? semanticLabel})` | 32px | 16px icon |
| `CdsCellMedia.asset({required ImageProvider source, String? semanticLabel})` | 32px | circle, dark mode enhancements |
| `CdsCellMedia.avatar({required ImageProvider source, String? semanticLabel})` | 32px | circle, dark mode enhancements |
| `CdsCellMedia.image({required ImageProvider source, String? semanticLabel})` | 48px | squircle, `BoxFit.contain` |
| `CdsCellMedia.pictogram(Widget illustration, {String? semanticLabel})` | 48px | your artwork |

Sizes come from `CdsCellMediaSizes.media` (32) and `CdsCellMediaSizes.image` (48).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `CdsCellMediaType` | set by constructor | `asset`, `avatar`, `image`, `icon`, `pictogram`. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Label when the media carries meaning. |

## Examples

### Asset in a list cell

```dart
CdsListCell(title: 'Bitcoin', media: CdsCellMedia.asset(source: btcLogo))
```

## Accessibility

Decorative unless `semanticLabel` is set.

## Motion

Images fade in like `CdsRemoteImage`.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `type="icon"`, `name`, `active`, `color` | `CdsCellMedia.icon(name, active:, color:)` |
| `type="asset"` / `"avatar"` / `"image"`, `source` | named constructor with `source` |
| `type="pictogram"`, `illustration` | `CdsCellMedia.pictogram(illustration)` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |

# CdsCheckbox

A checkbox with an optional label, for turning one option on or off or selecting several items from a list.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/Checkbox

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsCheckbox(
  label: 'Remember this device',
  checked: remember,
  onChange: (value) => setState(() => remember = value),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for independent options the user can combine, or for a single opt-in such as accepting terms.
- Use `indeterminate` on a parent checkbox when only some of its children are checked.
- Use `CdsSwitch` for a setting that takes effect immediately, and `CdsRadio` / `CdsRadioGroup` when exactly one option may be chosen.
- For a list of options use `CdsCheckboxGroup` or `CdsControlGroup.checkbox`; for rich rows with a description use `CdsCheckboxCell`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | `bool` | `false` | Whether the box is checked. Controlled. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | `null` | Called with `!checked` on tap. Null makes the checkbox inert and dimmed. |
| `indeterminate` | `bool` | `false` | Partially selected. Shows a minus glyph unless `checked` is also true; announced as mixed. |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Label next to the box. Also the accessibility label. |
| `labelNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom label widget. Takes precedence over `label`. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Blocks interaction and dims to 50%. |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Blocks interaction and dims, but is announced as read-only rather than disabled. |
| `controlColor` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.fgInverse` | Glyph color. |
| `background` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Box fill in both states. Defaults to `bg` off, `bgPrimary` on. |
| `borderColor` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Box border in both states. Defaults to `bgLineHeavy` off, `bgPrimary` on. |
| `borderRadius` | `int` | `100` | Radius token (4px). |
| `borderWidth` | `int` | `100` | Border width token (1px). |
| `elevation` | `CdsElevation` | `CdsElevation.none` | Box shadow. |
| `controlSize` | `double?` | `null` | Box size in px. Defaults to `theme.controlSize.checkboxSize` (20). The glyph is four fifths of it. |
| `font` | `CdsFont` | `CdsFont.body` | Label ramp entry. |
| `color` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Fixed label color. By default the label moves from `fgMuted` to `fg` when checked. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Replaces the label for screen readers. Required when there is no `label`. |
| `semanticHint` | `String?` | `null` | Extra hint read after the label. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | Focus node for the control. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | Request focus on first build. |

## Examples

### Indeterminate parent

```dart
final all = selected.length == assets.length;
CdsCheckbox(
  label: 'All assets',
  checked: all,
  indeterminate: selected.isNotEmpty && !all,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => selected = v ? {...assets} : {}),
)
```

### Without a visible label

```dart
CdsCheckbox(
  semanticLabel: 'Select Bitcoin',
  checked: selected.contains('btc'),
  onChange: (v) => toggle('btc', v),
)
```

### Disabled and read-only

```dart
const CdsCheckbox(label: 'Unavailable', disabled: true)
const CdsCheckbox(label: 'Required', checked: true, readOnly: true)
```

## Accessibility

- Exposes checked state (`checked: true/false`, or `mixed` when indeterminate), the label, enabled state and a tap action. Read-only boxes are announced as read-only.
- The hit area is padded to at least 44x44 even though the box is 20px.
- Tab focuses the checkbox and shows the CDS focus ring; Space or Enter toggles.
- The box centers on the label's first line and follows text scaling; long labels wrap.

## Motion

- On change the glyph scales from 0.9 to 1 and fades in over `CdsDurations.moderate1` with `CdsCurves.enterFunctional` (out with `CdsCurves.global`), and fill, border and label color cross-fade with it. Toggling mid-animation reverses from the current value.
- Press feedback: the row dims to 82% opacity on pointer-down. A light haptic fires on toggle.
- Reduced motion: the new state appears immediately.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `checked` | `checked` |
| `onChange(value, checked)` | `onChange(bool)` (groups handle values) |
| `indeterminate` | `indeterminate` |
| `children` | `label` / `labelNode` |
| `disabled` / `readOnly` | `disabled` / `readOnly` |
| `controlColor`, `background`, `borderColor`, `borderRadius`, `borderWidth`, `elevation`, `controlSize` | same names |
| `font`, `color` | `font`, `color` |
| `accessibilityLabel` / `accessibilityHint` | `semanticLabel` / `semanticHint` |
| `value` | not needed; see `CdsControlGroup` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsCheckboxCell.md
---

# CdsCheckboxCell

A full-width bordered row with a checkbox, a title and an optional description; the whole row is the touch target.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/CheckboxCell

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsCheckboxCell(
  title: 'Recurring buy',
  description: 'Repeat this purchase every week',
  checked: recurring,
  onChange: (value) => setState(() => recurring = value),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for opt-ins and multi-select lists where each option needs a description.
- Use `CdsCheckbox` or `CdsCheckboxGroup` for plain labels, and `CdsRadioCell` when only one row may be chosen.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String` | required | Title in `headline`. Also part of the accessibility label. |
| `titleNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom title widget; `title` is still used for the accessibility label. |
| `description` | `String?` | `null` | Muted `body` text under the title. |
| `descriptionNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom description widget. |
| `checked` | `bool` | `false` | Whether the row is selected. Controlled. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | `null` | Called with `!checked` when the row is pressed. Null makes the row inert and dimmed. |
| `indeterminate` | `bool` | `false` | Partially selected; announced as mixed. |
| `controlColor` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.fgInverse` | Checkbox glyph color. |
| `controlSize` | `double?` | `null` | Checkbox size in px. Defaults to `theme.controlSize.checkboxSize`. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Blocks interaction and dims to 50%. |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Blocks interaction and dims, announced as read-only. |
| `padding` | `double` | `2` | Space token around the content (16px). |
| `columnGap` | `double` | `2` | Space token between the control and the text. |
| `rowGap` | `double` | `0` | Space token between title and description. |
| `borderWidth` | `int` | `100` | Resting border width token (1px). |
| `borderRadius` | `int` | `200` | Radius token (8px). |
| `background` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bg` | Row fill. |
| `borderColor` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bgLine` | Resting border color. |
| `pressedBorderColor` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bgPrimary` | Border color while pressed. |
| `pressedBorderWidth` | `int` | `200` | Border width token while pressed (2px). |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Defaults to "title, description". |
| `semanticHint` | `String?` | `null` | Defaults to "Tap to check this option", or "Tap to uncheck this option" when checked. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | Focus node for the row. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | Request focus on first build. |

## Examples

### Several rows

```dart
CdsVStack(
  gap: 1.5,
  children: [
    CdsCheckboxCell(title: 'Email', description: 'Weekly summary', checked: email, onChange: setEmail),
    CdsCheckboxCell(title: 'Push', description: 'Price moves over 5%', checked: push, onChange: setPush),
    const CdsCheckboxCell(title: 'SMS', description: 'Not available in your region', disabled: true),
  ],
)
```

### Disabled

```dart
const CdsCheckboxCell(title: 'Wire', description: 'Not available on weekends', disabled: true)
```

## Accessibility

- The row is one node exposing the combined label, the CDS hint, checked state (or mixed when indeterminate), enabled or read-only state and a tap action.
- Tab focuses the row and shows the focus ring; Space or Enter activates.
- Text wraps freely and the control stays centered on the title's first line at any text scale.

## Motion

- Pointer-down fades in a 2px `pressedBorderColor` border over the resting one (`CdsDurations.moderate1`, enter-functional in, exit-functional out) and the content dims to 82%.
- The control animates as on `CdsCheckbox`. A light haptic fires on press.
- Reduced motion: the pressed border and control state change immediately.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | `title` / `titleNode` |
| `description` | `description` / `descriptionNode` |
| `checked` | `checked` |
| `onChange(value, checked)` | `onChange(bool)` |
| `indeterminate` | `indeterminate` |
| `controlColor`, `controlSize` | `controlColor`, `controlSize` |
| `disabled` / `readOnly` | `disabled` / `readOnly` |
| `padding`, `columnGap`, `rowGap` | same names |
| `borderWidth`, `borderRadius`, `background`, `borderColor` | same names |
| `pressedBorderColor`, `pressedBorderWidth` | same names |
| `accessibilityLabel` / `accessibilityHint` | `semanticLabel` / `semanticHint` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsCheckboxGroup.md
---

# CdsCheckboxGroup

A labelled set of checkboxes bound to a `Set` of selected values.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/CheckboxGroup

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsCheckboxGroup<String>(
  label: 'Assets to watch',
  options: const [
    CdsControlOption(value: 'btc', label: 'Bitcoin'),
    CdsControlOption(value: 'eth', label: 'Ethereum'),
  ],
  selectedValues: watched,
  onChange: (next) => setState(() => watched = next),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for a list of independent options where any number can be chosen.
- Use `CdsRadioGroup` when only one may be chosen and `CdsCheckboxCell` rows when options need descriptions.
- This is a thin wrapper over `CdsControlGroup.checkbox` with CDS's tighter default `gap` of 0. Each checkbox already has a 44px tall hit area, which provides the visual spacing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `List<CdsControlOption<T>>` | required | Options in display order. See `CdsControlGroup` for `CdsControlOption`. |
| `selectedValues` | `Set<T>` | required | Checked values. Controlled. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<Set<T>>?` | `null` | Called with the full next set after a checkbox toggles. |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Heading in `headline`. Also the group's accessibility label. |
| `labelNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom heading. |
| `gap` | `double` | `0` | Space token between options. |
| `direction` | `Axis` | `Axis.vertical` | `Axis.horizontal` lays options in a wrapping row. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Disables every option. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Overrides `label` for screen readers. |

## Examples

### Read-only and disabled options

```dart
CdsCheckboxGroup<String>(
  label: 'Send me',
  options: const [
    CdsControlOption(value: 'price', label: 'Price alerts'),
    CdsControlOption(value: 'security', label: 'Security alerts', readOnly: true),
    CdsControlOption(value: 'promo', label: 'Promotions', disabled: true),
  ],
  selectedValues: {...alerts, 'security'},
  onChange: (next) => setState(() => alerts = next..remove('security')),
)
```

## Accessibility

- A labelled semantics container; each checkbox reports its checked state, label and enabled or read-only state.
- Every checkbox is a tab stop; Space toggles the focused one.

## Motion

See `CdsCheckbox`: the glyph scales and fades over `CdsDurations.moderate1`, reversibly, and reduced motion applies changes immediately.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` (`Checkbox` elements) | `options` (`List<CdsControlOption<T>>`) |
| `selectedValues` (`Set`) | `selectedValues` (`Set<T>`) |
| `onChange(value)` (toggled value) | `onChange(Set<T>)` (next set) |
| `label` | `label` / `labelNode` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |

source: doc/components/CdsChip.md

# CdsChip

A compact, pill-shaped element for filters, quick selections and short status. Pressable only when `onPress` is set.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/Chip

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsChip(label: 'Gainers', onPress: () => setState(() => filter = 'gainers'))
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for filter rows, suggestions and small toggles.
- Use `CdsMediaChip` when the chip leads with an asset icon or avatar, and `CdsInputChip` for removable values.
- Do not use as a primary action; use `CdsButton`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Text in the middle. |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom middle content; overrides `label`. |
| `start` | `Widget?` | `null` | Leading widget. |
| `end` | `Widget?` | `null` | Trailing widget. |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Makes the chip pressable. |
| `size` | `CdsChipSize` | `s` | `s`: 16/8px padding, `headline`. `xs`: 12/6px padding, `label1`. |
| `active` | `bool` | `false` | Inverts the color scheme inside the chip. |
| `activeBackground` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Background while active; disables inversion. |
| `activeColor` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Label color while active; disables inversion. |
| `background` | `CdsColor` | `bgSecondary` | |
| `color` | `CdsColor` | `fg` | Label color. |
| `font` | `CdsFont?` | by size | Overrides the label ramp entry. |
| `maxWidth` | `double` | `200` | Content past this truncates with an ellipsis. |
| `numberOfLines` | `int` | `1` | |
| `gap` | `double` | `1` | Space token between slots and label. |
| `paddingX`, `paddingY`, `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd` | `double?` | by size | Space token overrides. |
| `borderRadius` | `int` | `700` | Radius token (40px). |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Dims and blocks presses. |
| `feedback` | `CdsHapticFeedback` | `light` | Haptic on press. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Replaces the read label. |
| `semanticHint` | `String?` | `null` | |
| `excludeChildSemantics` | `bool` | `false` | Read `semanticLabel` alone. |
| `selected` | `bool?` | `null` | Selected state for screen readers. Pass it for filter chips. |
| `focusNode`, `autofocus` | | | Keyboard focus. |

## Examples

### Filter row

```dart
CdsHStack(gap: 1, wrap: true, children: [
  for (final f in ['All', 'Gainers', 'Losers'])
    CdsChip(label: f, active: filter == f, selected: filter == f, onPress: () => setState(() => filter = f)),
])
```

### With slots, small size

```dart
CdsChip(
  label: 'Sort',
  size: CdsChipSize.xs,
  end: const CdsIcon(CdsIconName.caretDown, size: CdsIconSize.xs),
  onPress: openSort,
)
```

### Explicit active colors

```dart
CdsChip(label: 'Pro', active: true, activeBackground: CdsColor.bgPrimary, activeColor: CdsColor.fgInverse)
```

When you set `activeBackground` or `activeColor`, icons in `start` and `end` are not recolored; give them a matching `color`.

## Accessibility

- A pressable chip is a button; its label is the visible text unless `semanticLabel` is set. Pass `selected` so filter state is announced.
- The hit area is padded to 44px even for `xs`.
- Tab focuses; Enter and Space press.

## Motion

Pressable chips tint and scale to 0.98 on pointer-down (`CdsPressable`). Static chips do not animate.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` (string) | `label` |
| `children` (node) | `child` |
| `start`, `end`, `onPress`, `size`, `active`, `activeBackground`, `activeColor`, `background`, `color`, `font`, `maxWidth`, `numberOfLines`, `gap`, `borderRadius` | same names |
| `compact` (deprecated) | `size: CdsChipSize.xs` |
| `inverted`, `invertColorScheme` (deprecated) | `active` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |

source: doc/components/CdsCoachmark.md

# CdsCoachmark

A small card that introduces a feature, usually pointed at it by a `CdsTour`, rendered on the inverted color scheme.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/overlay/Coachmark

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsCoachmark(
  title: 'Recurring buys',
  content: 'Buy a fixed amount every week to smooth out price swings.',
  action: CdsButton(label: 'Next', size: CdsButtonSize.s, onPress: next),
  onClose: stopTour,
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use inside a `CdsTour` step, or anchored to a feature the first time someone sees it. Keep it to one idea. Do not use for errors or required decisions.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title | `String` | required | Heading in `headline`. |
| content | `String` | required | Body in `body`. |
| titleWidget | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom title; overrides `title` visually. |
| contentWidget | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom body; overrides `content` visually. |
| action | `Widget?` | `null` | Usually a small `CdsButton` such as "Next". |
| checkbox | `Widget?` | `null` | Control at the start of the action row, for example "Don't show again". |
| media | `Widget?` | `null` | Image above the text, edge to edge. |
| onClose | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Shows a close button in the top end corner. |
| width | `double?` | `null` | Fixed width; never wider than the screen minus 16px each side. |
| closeButtonAccessibilityLabel | `String` | `'Close'` | Close button label. |

Surface: radius 400, `bg` of the inverted scheme, 16px padding.

## Examples

### With media

```dart
CdsCoachmark(
  width: 300,
  media: const SizedBox(height: 120, child: Placeholder()),
  title: 'Price alerts',
  content: 'Get notified when an asset moves 5% in a day.',
  action: CdsButton(label: 'Turn on alerts', size: CdsButtonSize.s, onPress: enableAlerts),
)
```

## Accessibility

The card is a semantics container; the title is a heading; the close button is labelled with a 44px hit area.

## Motion

None of its own; `CdsTour` fades and slides it in.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `title` (string / node) | `title` / `titleWidget` |
| `content` (string / node) | `content` / `contentWidget` |
| `action`, `checkbox`, `media` | same (`Widget` slots) |
| `onClose`, `width`, `closeButtonAccessibilityLabel` | same |

# CdsCodeSnippet

A block of monospaced literal text, such as a command, wallet address or API key, with a copy button.

Not part of CDS. Styled with CDS tokens: `bgAlternate` fill, 1px `bgLine` border, 12px corners, Source Code Pro.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsCodeSnippet('flutter pub add cds_flutter')
```

## When to use / when not to

Use where people copy exact text. For short inline values, use `CdsText(mono: true)`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | `String` | required (positional) | |
| `title` | `String?` | `null` | Muted caption above the code. |
| `showCopyButton` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `onCopy` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called after the text is on the clipboard. |
| `wrap` | `bool` | `false` | Wrap long lines instead of scrolling horizontally. |
| `maxLines` | `int?` | `null` | Truncate after this many lines. |
| `font` | `CdsFont` | `label2` | Rendered in the mono family. |
| `copyLabel` | `String` | `'Copy'` | Visible button text. |
| `copiedLabel` | `String` | `'Copied'` | Visible after copying; announced to screen readers. |
| `copySemanticLabel` | `String?` | "Copy {title}" or "Copy code" | |
| `confirmationDuration` | `Duration` | 2 seconds | How long the confirmation shows. |

## Examples

### Wallet address

```dart
CdsCodeSnippet(address, title: 'Deposit address', wrap: true, onCopy: () => log('copied'))
```

## Accessibility

The copy button is a labelled button with a 44px hit area. After copying, its label changes to `copiedLabel` in a live region, so screen readers announce it. Confirmation pairs a checkmark icon with text, not color alone.

## Motion

Icon and label cross-fade over `fast3`; instant under reduced motion. The confirmation reverts once after `confirmationDuration`.

## CDS React Native mapping

Not in CDS. Inspired by shadcn_flutter's CodeSnippet.

source: doc/components/CdsCollapsible.md

# CdsCollapsible

Shows or hides content by animating its size and opacity. Use it for "Show details" toggles and as the building block of `CdsAccordion`.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/layout/Collapsible

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsCollapsible(
  collapsed: !showDetails,
  child: const CdsText('Network fee: 0.00021 ETH'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it to reveal optional content in place. For several sections with one open at a time, use `CdsAccordion`. For content that should overlay the page, use a tray or modal instead.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `collapsed` | `bool` | required | Hides the content when true. |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | The content. |
| `direction` | `Axis` | `Axis.vertical` | `Axis.horizontal` animates width instead of height. |
| `maxHeight` | `double?` | `null` | Caps the expanded height in px; taller content scrolls. Vertical only. |
| `maxWidth` | `double?` | `null` | Caps the expanded width in px; wider content scrolls. Horizontal only. |
| `padding`, `paddingX`, `paddingY`, `paddingTop`, `paddingBottom`, `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd` | `double?` | `null` | Space tokens around the content. |

## Examples

### Scrolls past a maximum height

```dart
CdsCollapsible(
  collapsed: collapsed,
  maxHeight: 200,
  paddingX: 3,
  child: termsText,
)
```

### Horizontal

Wrap it in `Flexible` inside a row so long content can wrap instead of overflowing.

```dart
CdsHStack(gap: 1, children: [
  toggleButton,
  Flexible(
    child: CdsCollapsible(
      collapsed: hideChip,
      direction: Axis.horizontal,
      child: const CdsText('Filters applied'),
    ),
  ),
])
```

## Accessibility

While `collapsed` is true the content is excluded from semantics and from focus traversal, so screen readers and the Tab key skip it.

## Motion

- Vertical: height and opacity together, `slow1` (350ms) to open and `moderate3` (300ms) to close, `CdsCurves.global`.
- Horizontal: width over the first half, fade in over the second; closing fades first, then shrinks (200ms total), following the CDS delayed horizontal specs.
- One controller drives both directions, so toggling mid-flight reverses from the current size without a jump.
- Content that starts expanded appears with no animation.
- Reduced motion: instant.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `collapsed` | `collapsed` |
| `children` | `child` |
| `direction` (`'vertical' \| 'horizontal'`) | `direction` (`Axis`) |
| `maxHeight`, `maxWidth` | same |
| padding props | same names |
| `scrollViewProps`, `style` | not ported |

source: doc/components/CdsCombobox.md

# CdsCombobox

A `CdsSelect` with a search field at the top of its options, for long lists such as countries or assets.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/Combobox

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsCombobox<String>(
  label: 'Country',
  value: country,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => country = v),
  options: const [
    CdsSelectOption(value: 'us', label: 'United States'),
    CdsSelectOption(value: 'gb', label: 'United Kingdom'),
    CdsSelectOption(value: 'de', label: 'Germany'),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use when people know what they are looking for and the list is long (10 or more). For short lists use `CdsSelect`.

## Parameters

All `CdsSelect` parameters (`options`, `value`, `onChange`, `label`, `placeholder`, `helperText`, `variant`, `size`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `start`, `presentation`, `accessibilityLabel`, `accessibilityHint`, `emptyOptionsLabel`, `onOpen`, `onClose`), plus:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| searchText | `String?` | `null` | Controlled search text. |
| onSearch | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Called as the search text changes. |
| filterFunction | `CdsComboboxFilter<T>?` | `null` | `List<CdsSelectOption<T>> Function(List<CdsSelectOption<T>> options, String searchText)`. Defaults to `cdsDefaultComboboxFilter`: label or description contains the text, ignoring case. |
| defaultSearchText | `String` | `''` | Initial search text when uncontrolled. |
| searchPlaceholder | `String` | `'Search'` | Search field placeholder. |

`CdsCombobox.multi` adds `maxSelectedOptionsToShow` (3), `hiddenSelectedOptionsLabel` ('more') and `removeSelectedOptionAccessibilityLabel` ('Remove'). Comboboxes have no select-all row.

When no option matches, `emptyOptionsLabel` is shown.

## Examples

### Custom filter (prefix match)

```dart
CdsCombobox<String>(
  label: 'Asset',
  value: asset,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => asset = v),
  filterFunction: (options, text) => [
    for (final o in options)
      if (o.displayLabel.toLowerCase().startsWith(text.toLowerCase())) o,
  ],
  options: const [
    CdsSelectOption(value: 'btc', label: 'Bitcoin'),
    CdsSelectOption(value: 'eth', label: 'Ethereum'),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

The search field is focused when the options open and labelled with its placeholder; a labelled clear button appears once text is entered. Typeahead is off (typing goes to the search field); arrow keys still move through options once focus is in the list.

## Motion

Same as `CdsSelect`.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `searchText`, `onSearch` | same |
| `filterFunction` | `filterFunction` |
| `defaultSearchText` | same |
| `hideSearchInput` | not ported (use `CdsSelect`) |
| `type: 'multi'` | `CdsCombobox.multi` |
| Select props | same as `CdsSelect` |

The search field sits at the top of the menu or tray instead of inside the control.

source: doc/components/CdsContainedAssetCard.md

# CdsContainedAssetCard

A compact asset tile: a header (usually a logo) over a subtitle, title and description, with extra content in the large size.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/cards/ContainedAssetCard

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsContainedAssetCard(
  header: CdsRemoteImage(source: btcLogo, size: CdsAvatarSize.xl, shape: CdsShape.circle),
  subtitle: 'BTC',
  title: r'$64,201.10',
  description: '+2.4% today',
  onPress: () => openAsset('BTC'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

CDS deprecates this card; prefer `CdsMediaCard` for new screens.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `header` | `Widget` | required | |
| `title` / `titleNode` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | One `headline` line. Required. |
| `subtitle` / `subtitleNode` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | One muted `legal` line. |
| `description` / `descriptionNode` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | One muted `label2` line. |
| `size` | `CdsAssetCardSize` | `s` | `s`: 156px square. `l`: 327 to 359px wide, `child` fills the end half. |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | Large-size content. |
| `minWidth` / `maxWidth` | `double?` | per size | |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | subtitle, title, description | |

The card is at least 156px tall and grows with large text instead of clipping.

## Accessibility

A pressable card is one button labelled from its text.

## Motion

Pressable cards tint and scale to 0.98 on pointer-down; no scale under reduced motion.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `header`, `size`, `onPress`, `minWidth`, `maxWidth` | same names |
| `title`, `subtitle`, `description` (string / node) | `x` / `xNode` |
| `children` | `child` |

# CdsContentCard

A composable card for feed content, built from `CdsContentCardHeader`, `CdsContentCardBody` and `CdsContentCardFooter`.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/cards/ContentCard

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsContentCard(
  background: CdsColor.bgAlternate,
  children: [
    const CdsContentCardHeader(title: 'Market update', subtitle: 'News', thumbnail: CdsAvatar(name: 'Market')),
    const CdsContentCardBody(title: 'Bitcoin trading volume rose 12% this week', description: 'Sample data.'),
    CdsContentCardFooter(children: [
      const CdsText.label2('Sample data', color: CdsColor.fgMuted),
      CdsButton(label: 'Share', size: CdsButtonSize.s, variant: CdsButtonVariant.secondary, onPress: share),
    ]),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use for news, posts and editorial content in a feed. Use `CdsMediaCard` for asset tiles and `CdsMessagingCard` for promotions.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required | Header, body, footer or any widgets, stacked. |
| `padding` | `double` | `2` | Space token around the content. |
| `gap` | `double` | `2` | Space token between children. |
| `borderRadius` | `int` | `500` | 24px corners. |
| `background` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | No background by default, as in CDS. |
| `bordered` | `bool` | `false` | 1px `bgLine` border. |
| `elevation` | `CdsElevation` | `none` | Shadow plus the matching surface color. |
| `minWidth` | `double` | `280` | |
| `maxWidth` | `double` | `800` | |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Makes the whole card a button. Inner buttons stay separately pressable and reachable. |
| `feedback` | `CdsHapticFeedback` | `none` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Required when `onPress` is set (asserted): what the card opens. |

Sub-widgets: [CdsContentCardHeader](CdsContentCardHeader.md), [CdsContentCardBody](CdsContentCardBody.md), [CdsContentCardFooter](CdsContentCardFooter.md).

## Examples

### Pressable card with inner actions

```dart
CdsContentCard(
  background: CdsColor.bgAlternate,
  onPress: openArticle,
  semanticLabel: 'Read: Staking rewards are now paid weekly',
  children: [
    CdsContentCardHeader(
      title: 'Newsroom',
      actions: CdsIconButton(CdsIconName.more, semanticLabel: 'More options', transparent: true, onPress: openMenu),
    ),
    const CdsContentCardBody(title: 'Staking rewards are now paid weekly'),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

A pressable card is one button labelled `semanticLabel`. Its content text remains readable and inner buttons remain separate focus stops; a tap on an inner button does not press the card.

## Motion

Pressable cards tint on pointer-down and scale to 0.98 with `CdsSprings.press`, springing back with `CdsSprings.standard` from wherever they are. No scale under reduced motion.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `children` |
| `padding`, `gap`, `borderRadius`, `minWidth`, `maxWidth` | same names |
| other `VStack` style props | `background`, `bordered`, `elevation` |
| (pressable via wrapping) | `onPress` + `semanticLabel` |

# CdsContentCardBody

Main content of a `CdsContentCard`: title, description and optional media, with custom content below.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/cards/ContentCardBody

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsContentCardBody(
  title: 'Staking rewards are now paid weekly',
  description: 'Sample data.',
  media: CdsRemoteImage(source: art, width: double.infinity, aspectRatio: 16 / 9),
)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String?` | `null` | Up to two `headline` lines. |
| `titleNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | |
| `description` | `String?` | `null` | Up to three muted `label2` lines. |
| `descriptionNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Also the place for supplemental data such as a price and its change. |
| `media` | `Widget?` | `null` | Clipped to 24px corners. |
| `mediaPlacement` | `CdsContentCardMediaPlacement` | `top` | `top`, `bottom` (full width) or `start`, `end` (96px square beside the text). |
| `gap` | `double` | `1` | Space token between the content and `child`. |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom content below. |

## Accessibility

Text keeps its own semantics.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `title`, `description` (string / node) | `title`/`titleNode`, `description`/`descriptionNode` |
| `body` (deprecated) | `description` |
| `label` (deprecated) | `descriptionNode` or `child` |
| `media`, `mediaPlacement` | same names |
| `mediaPosition` (deprecated: left/right) | `mediaPlacement: start/end` |
| `children` | `child` |

# CdsContentCell

A cell for longer content: a title with meta information beside it, a subtitle, and a description that wraps freely.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/data-display/ContentCell

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsContentCell(
  media: const CdsCellMedia.icon(CdsIconName.bell),
  title: 'Price alert',
  meta: '2m ago',
  description: 'Bitcoin rose above your alert price.',
  onPress: openAlert,
)
```

## When to use / when not to

CDS deprecates ContentCell in favour of `CdsListCell`. Use it when the description must wrap without a line limit, such as notifications and messages.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` / `titleNode` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | `headline`; two lines, or one with a description outside `condensed`. |
| `subtitle` / `subtitleNode` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | `label2`, or `label1` when condensed. |
| `description` / `descriptionNode` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | Muted `body`, no line limit. |
| `meta` / `metaNode` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | Muted `label2` at the end of the title line. Needs a title or subtitle. In `condensed`, it moves beside the accessory. |
| `media` | `Widget?` | `null` | Leading media. |
| `accessory` | `CdsCellAccessoryType?` | `null` | |
| `accessoryNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | |
| `spacingVariant` | `CdsCellSpacingVariant` | `normal` | As in `CdsListCell`. |
| `priority` | `Set<CdsCellPriority>` | `{}` | |
| `selected` | `bool` | `false` | Fills with `background` and shows a checkmark. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `onPress` / `onLongPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `alignItems` | `CrossAxisAlignment` | `start` | Vertical alignment of the row pieces. |
| `background` | `CdsColor` | `bgAlternate` | |
| `borderRadius` | `int?` | `200`, `0` when condensed | |
| `innerSpacing` / `outerSpacing` | `CdsCellSpacing?` | per variant | |
| `feedback` | `CdsHapticFeedback` | `none` | |
| `semanticLabel` / `semanticHint` | `String?` | `null` | |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | |

## Examples

### Condensed notification

```dart
CdsContentCell(
  spacingVariant: CdsCellSpacingVariant.condensed,
  title: 'Deposit received',
  meta: '9:41',
  description: 'Sample data. Your USDC deposit is available.',
  accessory: CdsCellAccessoryType.arrow,
  onPress: openDeposit,
)
```

## Accessibility

Same as `CdsListCell`: one button with merged text when pressable, selected flag when selected.

## Motion

Pointer-down tint, no scale.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `title`, `subtitle`, `description`, `meta` and their `*Node` props | same names |
| `media`, `accessory`, `accessoryNode`, `spacingVariant`, `selected`, `disabled`, `onPress` | same names |
| `compact` (deprecated) | `spacingVariant: compact` |
| `accessibilityLabel`, `accessibilityHint` | `semanticLabel`, `semanticHint` |

# CdsContextMenu

A menu of actions for an item, opened by long-press on touch screens, right-click with a mouse, or the context-menu key.

CDS reference: Not a CDS docs page. This is an addition that reuses CDS dropdown styling and motion.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsContextMenu(
  actions: [
    CdsContextMenuAction(label: 'Copy address', icon: CdsIconName.copy, onPress: copy),
    CdsContextMenuAction(label: 'Remove', icon: CdsIconName.trashCan, destructive: true, onPress: remove),
  ],
  child: const CdsText('Sample data: 0x12ab...9f'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use for secondary actions on list items or addresses. Always offer the same actions somewhere visible too (a "More" button), because long-press is not discoverable.

## Parameters

### CdsContextMenu

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| child | `Widget` | required | The item. |
| actions | `List<CdsContextMenuAction>` | required | Menu actions. |
| disabled | `bool` | `false` | Do not open. |
| onOpen | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called on open. |
| onClose | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called on close. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Label for the menu. |

### CdsContextMenuAction

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | `String` | required | Action label. |
| onPress | `VoidCallback` | required | Runs after the menu closes. |
| icon | `CdsIconName?` | `null` | Leading icon. |
| destructive | `bool` | `false` | Label and icon in `fgNegative`. |
| disabled | `bool` | `false` | Not selectable. |

The menu opens at the press point (or below the item for the keyboard), 200 to 280px wide, max 360px tall.

## Examples

### Disabled action

```dart
CdsContextMenu(
  actions: [
    CdsContextMenuAction(label: 'Share', icon: CdsIconName.share, onPress: share),
    CdsContextMenuAction(label: 'Edit label', icon: CdsIconName.pencil, disabled: true, onPress: () {}),
  ],
  child: const CdsText('Sample data: Savings wallet'),
)
```

## Accessibility

Screen readers get a long-press action ("Show actions"). Keyboard: the context-menu key or Shift+F10 opens it; arrows move, Enter chooses, Escape closes and restores focus. Rows are 44px minimum.

## Motion

Fade plus a short slide and slight scale from the press point (`moderate3`, global), reversed on close; reduced motion fades.

## CDS React Native mapping

No CDS equivalent.

source: doc/components/CdsControlGroup.md
