# CdsControlGroup

A labelled set of radios, checkboxes or switches built from a list of options, with one API for single and multiple selection.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/ControlGroup

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsControlGroup<String>.radio(
  label: 'Payment method',
  options: const [
    CdsControlOption(value: 'bank', label: 'Bank account'),
    CdsControlOption(value: 'card', label: 'Debit card'),
  ],
  value: method,
  onChange: (value) => setState(() => method = value),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use when the options come from data and render as a plain list of controls.
- Use `CdsRadioCell` / `CdsCheckboxCell` rows instead when each option needs a description or a bordered card look.
- `CdsRadioGroup` and `CdsCheckboxGroup` are thin wrappers over this widget, kept for parity with CDS.

## Parameters

Constructors:

- `CdsControlGroup<T>.radio({required List<CdsControlOption<T>> options, required T? value, ValueChanged<T>? onChange, ...})`: single selection; `onChange` receives the selected value.
- `CdsControlGroup<T>.checkbox({required List<CdsControlOption<T>> options, required Set<T> value, ValueChanged<Set<T>>? onChange, ...})`: multiple selection; `onChange` receives the full next set.
- `CdsControlGroup<T>.switches({...same as checkbox})`: multiple selection rendered as `CdsSwitch`.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `List<CdsControlOption<T>>` | required | Options in display order. |
| `value` | `T?` (radio) / `Set<T>` (checkbox, switches) | required | Current selection. Controlled. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<T>?` (radio) / `ValueChanged<Set<T>>?` | `null` | Selection callback. Null makes every option inert. |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Heading above the options in `headline`. Also the group's accessibility label. |
| `labelNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom heading. Takes precedence over `label`. |
| `gap` | `double` | `2` | Space token between options (16px). |
| `direction` | `Axis` | `Axis.vertical` | `Axis.horizontal` lays options in a wrapping row. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Disables every option. |
| `controlColor` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Radio dot color, checkbox glyph color, or switch track color when on. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Overrides `label` for screen readers. |
| `radioSemanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Radio only. Appended to each option's label with `{{number}}` and `{{total}}` filled in, e.g. `'{{number}} of {{total}}'`. |

`CdsControlOption<T>`:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `T` | required | Value reported through `onChange`. |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Option label. |
| `labelNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom label widget. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Disables this option; arrow keys skip it. |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Read-only option. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Required when `label` is null. |
| `semanticHint` | `String?` | `null` | Extra hint. |

## Examples

### Checkboxes

```dart
CdsControlGroup<String>.checkbox(
  label: 'Contact me by',
  options: const [
    CdsControlOption(value: 'email', label: 'Email'),
    CdsControlOption(value: 'push', label: 'Push notifications'),
  ],
  value: channels,
  onChange: (next) => setState(() => channels = next),
)
```

### Switches

```dart
CdsControlGroup<String>.switches(
  label: 'Privacy',
  options: const [
    CdsControlOption(value: 'hide', label: 'Hide balances'),
    CdsControlOption(value: 'share', label: 'Share usage data'),
  ],
  value: privacy,
  onChange: (next) => setState(() => privacy = next),
)
```

### Horizontal radios

```dart
CdsControlGroup<String>.radio(
  label: 'Frequency',
  direction: Axis.horizontal,
  options: const [
    CdsControlOption(value: 'daily', label: 'Daily'),
    CdsControlOption(value: 'weekly', label: 'Weekly'),
  ],
  value: frequency,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => frequency = v),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The group is a labelled semantics container. Radio groups use `SemanticsRole.radioGroup`.
- Radio groups are a single tab stop: Tab lands on the selected option, or the first enabled one when nothing is selected. Up/Down and Left/Right move focus and selection to the next or previous enabled option and wrap at the ends; Left/Right are mirrored in right-to-left layouts.
- Checkbox and switch groups keep every option as its own tab stop; Space toggles.

## Motion

Each control animates as documented on `CdsRadio`, `CdsCheckbox` and `CdsSwitch`. The group adds no motion.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `ControlComponent={Radio}` | `CdsControlGroup.radio` |
| `ControlComponent={Checkbox}` | `CdsControlGroup.checkbox` |
| `ControlComponent={Switch}` | `CdsControlGroup.switches` |
| `options` | `options` (`CdsControlOption<T>`) |
| `value` (string or array) | `value` (`T?` or `Set<T>`) |
| `onChange(value, checked)` | `onChange(T)` or `onChange(Set<T>)` |
| `label` | `label` / `labelNode` |
| `gap` | `gap` |
| `direction` | `direction` |
| `aria-label` / `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |
| `role` | set by constructor |

# CdsDataCard

A card pairing a title with a data visualization such as a progress bar or circle.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/cards/DataCard

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsDataCard(
  title: 'Savings goal',
  subtitle: r'$450 of $1,000',
  thumbnail: const CdsCellMedia.icon(CdsIconName.wallet),
  child: const CdsProgressCircle(progress: 0.45, size: 48),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use for goals, limits and progress summaries. The visualization is a widget slot, so any progress or chart widget fits.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String?` | `null` | Up to two `headline` lines. A title or `titleNode` is required. |
| `titleNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | |
| `subtitle` | `String?` | `null` | One muted `label2` line above the title. |
| `subtitleNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | |
| `titleAccessory` | `Widget?` | `null` | Right after the title, e.g. a `CdsTag`. |
| `thumbnail` | `Widget?` | `null` | Image or icon in the header. |
| `layout` | `CdsDataCardLayout` | `vertical` | `vertical` stacks header over visualization; `horizontal` puts them side by side. |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | The visualization. |
| `background` | `CdsColor` | `bgAlternate` | |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `feedback` | `CdsHapticFeedback` | `none` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | subtitle and title | Card button label when pressable. |

## Examples

### Horizontal

```dart
CdsDataCard(
  layout: CdsDataCardLayout.horizontal,
  title: 'Weekly limit',
  subtitle: 'Sample data',
  child: const CdsProgressCircle(progress: 0.7, size: 64, showLabel: true),
)
```

## Accessibility

When pressable, the card is one button labelled with its subtitle and title.

## Motion

Pressable cards tint and scale to 0.98 on pointer-down; no scale under reduced motion.

## CDS React Native mapping

This follows the current CDS DataCard (`@coinbase/cds-mobile/alpha/data-card`). The older DataCard with `progress`/`progressVariant` props is deprecated in CDS.

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `title`, `subtitle` (string / node) | `title`/`titleNode`, `subtitle`/`subtitleNode` |
| `titleAccessory`, `thumbnail`, `layout` | same names |
| `children` | `child` |
| `renderAsPressable` + `onPress` | `onPress` |

# CdsDateInput

A text field for typing a date, masked as `mm/dd/yyyy` by default, with built-in validation. Reach for it when people know the date already, such as a date of birth.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/other/DateInput

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsDateInput(
  label: 'Date of birth',
  date: birthday,
  onChangeDate: (d) => setState(() => birthday = d),
  error: error,
  onErrorDate: (e) => setState(() => error = e),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for dates people type faster than they browse to. When seeing the week matters, use `CdsDatePicker` (typed field plus calendar) or `CdsCalendar`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `date` | `DateTime?` | required | The date shown. A non-null date replaces the text; null leaves the text alone so an incomplete value can be edited. |
| `onChangeDate` | `ValueChanged<DateTime?>` | required | Called with the parsed date when the text becomes a complete valid date, and with null when a complete date is edited or turns invalid. |
| `error` | `CdsDateInputValidationError?` | `null` | Current error, shown as negative helper text. Pass back what `onErrorDate` reports. |
| `onErrorDate` | `ValueChanged<CdsDateInputValidationError?>?` | `null` | Called after `onChangeDate` when validation fails, and with null when a previous non-custom error no longer applies. |
| `required` | `bool` | `false` | Leaving the field incomplete after typing reports a `required` error. |
| `separator` | `String` | `'/'` | Single character between fields. |
| `dateOrder` | `CdsDateOrder` | `CdsDateOrder.mdy` | `mdy`, `dmy` or `ymd`. |
| `minDate` | `DateTime?` | `null` | Earliest valid day, inclusive. |
| `maxDate` | `DateTime?` | `null` | Latest valid day, inclusive. |
| `disabledDates` | `List<DateTime>` | `const []` | Days that are rejected with `disabledDateError`. |
| `disabledDateRanges` | `List<DateTimeRange>` | `const []` | Inclusive ranges that are rejected. |
| `requiredError` | `String` | `'This field is required'` | Message for `required` errors. |
| `invalidDateError` | `String` | `'Please enter a valid date'` | Message for impossible dates (02/30/2026) and dates over 100 years outside `minDate`/`maxDate`. |
| `disabledDateError` | `String` | `'Date unavailable'` | Message for dates outside the range or in the disabled set. |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Field label and accessibility label. |
| `labelNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom label widget. |
| `labelVariant` | `CdsInputLabelVariant` | `outside` | Label above or inside the field. |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | `'   /   /'` | Blanks around the separator, as in CDS. |
| `helperText` | `String?` | error message, else the pattern (`mm/dd/yyyy`) | Text under the field. |
| `variant` | `CdsInputVariant?` | `negative` with an error, else `foregroundMuted` | Field sentiment. |
| `size` | `CdsTextInputSize?` | `l` | Density inside the border. |
| `compact` | `bool` | `false` | Dense field with an inline label. |
| `start` | `Widget?` | `null` | Content inside the border before the text. |
| `end` | `Widget?` | `null` | Content inside the border after the text. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Blocks editing and dims the field. |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Shows the date without allowing edits. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | Focus the field on first build. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | Focus node of the text field. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Raw text after every edit. Prefer `onChangeDate`. |
| `onFocus` / `onBlur` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Focus changes. |
| `onSubmitEditing` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Keyboard done action. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `label` | Accessibility label override. |
| `semanticHint` | `String?` | helper text | Accessibility hint override. |

`CdsDateInputValidationError` has `type` (`CdsDateInputValidationErrorType.required`, `invalid`, `disabled` or `custom`) and `message`. Errors with type `custom` come from your app (for example server-side checks) and are never cleared by the input.

### Event order

As in CDS:

1. Typing into an empty field: `onChange`, `onChange`, ..., `onChangeDate`, `onErrorDate`.
2. Editing a complete date: `onChange`, `onChangeDate(null)`, `onChange`, ..., `onChangeDate`, `onErrorDate`.

### Typing rules

Only digits and the separator are accepted. The separator is inserted when the user types a digit where it belongs, a separator typed anywhere else is ignored, and pasted digits are reformatted (`03152026` becomes `03/15/2026`). The number keyboard is shown.

## Examples

### Required, no future dates

```dart
CdsDateInput(
  label: 'Date of birth',
  date: birthday,
  onChangeDate: (d) => setState(() => birthday = d),
  error: error,
  onErrorDate: (e) => setState(() => error = e),
  required: true,
  maxDate: DateTime.now(),
)
```

### Day first with dots

```dart
CdsDateInput(
  label: 'Travel date',
  date: date,
  onChangeDate: (d) => setState(() => date = d),
  dateOrder: CdsDateOrder.dmy,
  separator: '.',
)
```

### App-provided error

```dart
CdsDateInput(
  label: 'Settlement date',
  date: date,
  onChangeDate: (d) => setState(() => date = d),
  error: const CdsDateInputValidationError(
    CdsDateInputValidationErrorType.custom,
    'Markets are closed on this date. Pick another business day.',
  ),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The field reads its label and, as a hint, the expected pattern. Errors appear with an info icon and are announced as a live region.
- Everything else follows `CdsTextInput`: 44px slots, focus border, text scaling without clipping.

## Motion

Same as `CdsTextInput`: the focus border fades in with `moderate1` enter-functional easing, and is instant under reduced motion.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `date` / `onChangeDate` | `date` / `onChangeDate` |
| `error` / `onErrorDate` | `error` / `onErrorDate` |
| `required` | `required` |
| `separator` | `separator` |
| locale-derived field order | `dateOrder` |
| `minDate` / `maxDate` | `minDate` / `maxDate` |
| `disabledDates` (dates and tuples) | `disabledDates` + `disabledDateRanges` |
| `requiredError` / `invalidDateError` / `disabledDateError` | same names |
| `label`, `labelNode`, `labelVariant`, `placeholder`, `helperText`, `variant`, `size`, `compact`, `start`, `end`, `disabled`, `readOnly` | same names |
| `onChange` (native event) | `onChange` (text) |
| `onBlur` / `onFocus` | `onBlur` / `onFocus` |
| `accessibilityLabel` / `accessibilityHint` | `semanticLabel` / `semanticHint` |

Differences from CDS: CDS derives the field order from the device locale through `Intl`; here it is the explicit `dateOrder` parameter, defaulting to US order like CDS's default locale.

---
source: doc/components/CdsDatePicker.md
---

# CdsDatePicker

A typed date field with a calendar button that opens a `CdsCalendar` in a popover anchored to the field. Use it when people may either type a date or browse to it.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/other/DatePicker

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsDatePicker(
  label: 'Start date',
  date: start,
  onChangeDate: (d) => setState(() => start = d),
  error: error,
  onErrorDate: (e) => setState(() => error = e),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for scheduling and ranges where the week matters. For dates people know by heart, `CdsDateInput` alone is quicker. For an always-visible month, use `CdsCalendar`.

## Parameters

All typing and validation parameters behave as in `CdsDateInput`: `date`, `onChangeDate`, `error`, `onErrorDate`, `required`, `separator`, `dateOrder`, `minDate`, `maxDate`, `disabledDates`, `disabledDateRanges`, `requiredError`, `invalidDateError`, `disabledDateError`, `label`, `labelNode`, `labelVariant`, `placeholder`, `helperText`, `variant`, `size`, `compact`, `start`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `focusNode`, `onChange`, `semanticLabel`. The `end` slot holds the calendar button.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `date` | `DateTime?` | required | The date shown and selected in the calendar. |
| `onChangeDate` | `ValueChanged<DateTime?>` | required | Called from typing (see `CdsDateInput`) and when a day is picked. |
| `seedDate` | `DateTime?` | `null` | Month the calendar opens on when `date` is null. |
| `highlightedDates` | `List<DateTime>` | `const []` | Days drawn with `fgPrimary` text in the calendar. |
| `highlightedDateRanges` | `List<DateTimeRange>` | `const []` | Highlighted ranges. |
| `currentDate` | `DateTime?` | `DateTime.now()` | The day treated as today in the calendar. |
| `onOpen` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | The calendar opened. |
| `onConfirm` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | A day was picked. Fires before `onChangeDate`. |
| `onCancel` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | The calendar closed without a pick. |
| `onClose` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Fires last, after `onConfirm` or `onCancel`. |
| `openCalendarSemanticLabel` | `String` | `'Open calendar'` | Label of the calendar button. |
| `nextArrowSemanticLabel` | `String` | `'Go to next month'` | Passed to the calendar. |
| `previousArrowSemanticLabel` | `String` | `'Go to previous month'` | Passed to the calendar. |
| `highlightedDateSemanticHint` | `String` | `'Highlighted'` | Passed to the calendar. |
| `semanticHint` | `String` | `'Enter date or select from calendar using the calendar button.'` | Hint on the text field. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Blocks typing and the calendar button. |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Shows the date; the calendar button is disabled. |

### Event order

As in CDS:

1. Picking a date: `onOpen`, `onConfirm`, `onChangeDate`, `onErrorDate(null)` (only when a non-custom error was showing), `onClose`.
2. Closing without picking: `onOpen`, `onCancel`, `onClose`.
3. Typing: see `CdsDateInput`.

## Examples

### Within the next year

```dart
final now = DateTime.now();
CdsDatePicker(
  label: 'First purchase',
  date: date,
  onChangeDate: (d) => setState(() => date = d),
  error: error,
  onErrorDate: (e) => setState(() => error = e),
  required: true,
  minDate: DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day),
  maxDate: DateTime(now.year + 1, now.month, now.day),
)
```

### Track open and close

```dart
CdsDatePicker(
  label: 'Date',
  date: date,
  onChangeDate: (d) => setState(() => date = d),
  onConfirm: () => setState(() => lastEvent = 'picked'),
  onCancel: () => setState(() => lastEvent = 'dismissed'),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The calendar button is labeled "Open calendar". Opening moves focus into the calendar on the selected day, today, or the first available day; closing returns focus to the calendar button.
- Escape closes the calendar. Tapping outside the field and the popover closes it too.
- The calendar keeps its own keyboard support (arrows, Page Up/Down, Home/End, Enter). See `CdsCalendar`.

## Motion

The popover grows from the edge of the field it is attached to: scale from 0.95 and fade in over `moderate1` with enter-functional easing, and leave the same way with exit-functional easing. It opens below the field, or above it when there is not enough room below. Under reduced motion it appears and disappears at once.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `date` / `onChangeDate` / `error` / `onErrorDate` | same names |
| `onOpen` / `onClose` / `onConfirm` / `onCancel` | same names |
| `seedDate`, `minDate`, `maxDate`, `highlightedDates`, `disabledDates` | same names, plus `...Ranges` lists for tuples |
| `openCalendarAccessibilityLabel` | `openCalendarSemanticLabel` |
| `nextArrowAccessibilityLabel` / `previousArrowAccessibilityLabel` | `nextArrowSemanticLabel` / `previousArrowSemanticLabel` |
| `highlightedDateAccessibilityHint` | `highlightedDateSemanticHint` |
| `accessibilityHint` | `semanticHint` |
| `confirmText`, `confirmButtonAccessibilityHint`, `closeCalendarAccessibilityLabel` | not used (no tray footer) |
| `styles` | not ported |

Differences from CDS: CDS mobile shows the calendar in a bottom tray with a Confirm button. This port shows it in a popover anchored to the field, and picking a day confirms at once, because the shared tray component is not part of this package's dates module. The event order is unchanged.

# CdsDotCount

A numeric badge, such as an unread count, pinned to a widget or shown on its own.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/other/DotCount

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsDotCount(
  count: unread,
  semanticLabel: '$unread unread notifications',
  child: CdsIconButton(CdsIconName.bell, semanticLabel: 'Notifications', onPress: openInbox),
)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | `int` | required | 0 or less hides the badge. |
| `max` | `int` | `99` | Larger counts show as `99+`. |
| `variant` | `CdsDotCountVariant` | `negative` | `bgNegative` fill. CDS defines only this variant. |
| `pin` | `CdsDotPinPlacement?` | `topEnd` with a child | `topStart`, `topEnd`, `bottomStart`, `bottomEnd`. |
| `overlap` | `CdsDotOverlap?` | `null` | `circular` pulls the badge inward for round hosts. |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | The anchor. Without it the badge renders inline. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | the number | What the count means. |

The badge is at least 24x24 with 6px side padding, `caption` text in `fgInverse`, and a 1px `bgSecondary` ring.

## Examples

### Inline

```dart
const CdsDotCount(count: 3)
```

## Accessibility

Labelled with `semanticLabel` (or the shown number). The count text carries the meaning, not the color.

## Motion

Enters with fade and scale 0.9 to 1 over `moderate1` (`enterFunctional`) and exits the reverse (`global` curve), keeping the last count visible while it leaves. Instant under reduced motion. The badge is centered on the pinned corner, mirrored in RTL.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `count`, `max`, `variant`, `pin`, `overlap`, `children` | `count`, `max`, `variant`, `pin`, `overlap`, `child` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |
| `height`, style props | not exposed |

# CdsDotStatusColor

A small colored dot that signals status, pinned to a widget or shown inline.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/other/DotStatusColor

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsDotStatusColor(
  variant: CdsDotVariant.positive,
  pin: CdsDotPinPlacement.bottomEnd,
  overlap: CdsDotOverlap.circular,
  semanticLabel: 'Online',
  child: const CdsAvatar(name: 'Ada', size: CdsAvatarSize.xxl),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use for presence and attention markers. Color alone does not reach everyone: set `semanticLabel`, and show the status in text nearby where you can.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `CdsDotVariant` | required | `positive` (`bgPositive`), `negative` (`bgNegative`), `primary` (`bgPrimary`), `foregroundMuted` (`fgMuted`), `warning` (`bgWarning`). |
| `size` | `CdsIconSize` | `s` | Diameter: xs 12, s 16, m 24, l 32. |
| `pin` | `CdsDotPinPlacement?` | `topEnd` with a child | |
| `overlap` | `CdsDotOverlap?` | `null` | |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | The status the color stands for. Without it the dot is hidden from screen readers. |

## Accessibility

See above: always pair with `semanticLabel` or visible text.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `variant`, `size`, `pin`, `overlap` | same names |
| `children` | `child` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |

# CdsDotSymbol

A badge holding an icon, a small image or any widget, pinned to a widget or shown inline.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/other/DotSymbol

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsDotSymbol(
  iconName: CdsIconName.checkmark,
  pin: CdsDotPinPlacement.bottomEnd,
  overlap: CdsDotOverlap.circular,
  semanticLabel: 'Verified',
  child: const CdsAvatar(name: 'Ada', size: CdsAvatarSize.xxl),
)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `iconName` | `CdsIconName?` | `null` | Icon on a `background` circle with a 2px `borderColor` ring and 4px padding. |
| `source` | `ImageProvider?` | `null` | Circular image with a 1px `borderColor` ring and dark mode enhancements. |
| `symbol` | `Widget?` | `null` | Any widget, as is. |
| `size` | `CdsIconSize` | `s` | Icon or image size. |
| `active` | `bool` | `false` | Filled icon glyph. |
| `color` | `CdsColor` | `fgInverse` | Icon color. |
| `background` | `CdsColor` | `bgPrimary` | |
| `borderColor` | `CdsColor` | `bgSecondary` | |
| `pin` | `CdsDotPinPlacement?` | `topEnd` with a child | |
| `overlap` | `CdsDotOverlap?` | `null` | |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | What the symbol means. |

## Examples

### Network logo on an asset

```dart
CdsDotSymbol(source: networkLogo, pin: CdsDotPinPlacement.bottomEnd, child: CdsRemoteImage(source: assetLogo, size: CdsAvatarSize.xxl, shape: CdsShape.circle))
```

## Accessibility

Hidden unless `semanticLabel` is set.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `iconName`, `size`, `active`, `color`, `background`, `borderColor`, `pin`, `overlap`, `symbol` | same names |
| `source` (string or object) | `source` (`ImageProvider`) |
| `children` | `child` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |

# CdsDrawer

A sheet pinned to any screen edge (start, end, top or bottom) with the same drag physics as `CdsTray` along its axis.

CDS reference: closest page is https://cds.coinbase.com/components/overlay/Tray (CDS mobile ships Drawer without a docs page).

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
showCdsDrawer<void>(
  context,
  builder: (context) => const CdsDrawer(
    pin: CdsDrawerPin.start,
    child: CdsText('Sample data: account menu'),
  ),
);
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a start or end drawer for navigation menus or filter panels; a top drawer for short notices. For bottom sheets with a title, prefer `CdsTray`.

## Parameters

### showCdsDrawer<T>

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| context | `BuildContext` | required | Context used to find the navigator. |
| builder | `WidgetBuilder` | required | Builds the `CdsDrawer`. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Names the route. |
| useRootNavigator | `bool` | `true` | Push on the root navigator. |
| routeSettings | `RouteSettings?` | `null` | Route name and arguments. |

### CdsDrawer

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| child | `Widget` | required | Drawer content. Side drawers wrap it in a `SafeArea`. |
| pin | `CdsDrawerPin` | `CdsDrawerPin.bottom` | `start`, `end` (follow text direction), `top`, `bottom`. |
| hideHandleBar | `bool` | `false` | Only bottom drawers show a handle. |
| handleBarVariant | `CdsHandleBarVariant` | `CdsHandleBarVariant.outside` | Handle placement for bottom drawers. |
| handleBarAccessibilityLabel | `String` | `'Dismiss'` | Handle label. |
| verticalDrawerPercentageOfView | `double` | `0.75` | Max height share for top and bottom drawers. |
| horizontalDrawerPercentageOfView | `double` | `0.85` | Width share for start and end drawers. |
| preventDismissGestures | `bool` | `false` | Disable swipe and scrim-tap dismissal. |
| onCloseComplete | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called after leaving when not shown with `showCdsDrawer`. |
| onOpenComplete | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called when the entry settles. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Label for the drawer. |
| reduceMotion | `bool?` | `null` | Overrides the platform setting. |

Static: `CdsDrawer.close(BuildContext context, [Object? result])`.

Side drawers have square corners and full height; top drawers round their bottom corners (radius 600).

## Examples

### Filters from the end edge

```dart
showCdsDrawer<void>(
  context,
  builder: (context) => CdsDrawer(
    pin: CdsDrawerPin.end,
    child: Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
      child: CdsButton(label: 'Show top gainers', onPress: () => CdsDrawer.close(context)),
    ),
  ),
);
```

## Accessibility

Focus trapped and restored; Escape and back close; separate semantics scope. Swipe direction for start/end mirrors in right-to-left layouts.

## Motion

Same as `CdsTray`, along the drawer's axis: 1:1 drag, rubberband past open, velocity projection decides stay or dismiss, `CdsSprings.sheet` with release velocity, interruptible, exits the way it entered, scrim proportional to position. Reduced motion: fades.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `pin` (`'left' \| 'right' \| 'top' \| 'bottom'`) | `pin` (`start`, `end`, `top`, `bottom`; start/end follow text direction) |
| `children` | `child` |
| `hideHandleBar`, `handleBarVariant`, `handleBarAccessibilityLabel` | same |
| `verticalDrawerPercentageOfView` | same |
| `preventDismissGestures` | same |
| `onCloseComplete`, `onOpenComplete`, `reduceMotion`, `accessibilityLabel` | same |

source: doc/components/CdsDropdown.md

# CdsDropdown

A menu of options that opens from a trigger, with arrow-key navigation and typeahead.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/overlay/PopoverPanel (CDS web Dropdown is built on the same popover)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsDropdown<String>(
  value: currency,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => currency = v),
  builder: (context, controller) => CdsButton(
    label: 'Currency: $currency',
    variant: CdsButtonVariant.secondary,
    onPress: controller.toggle,
  ),
  content: const [
    CdsMenuItem(value: 'USD', label: 'US Dollar'),
    CdsMenuItem(value: 'EUR', label: 'Euro'),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use for a short menu attached to a button. For a form field with a label and helper text, use `CdsSelect` (it switches to a tray on phones). For actions on an item, use `CdsContextMenu`.

## Parameters

### CdsDropdown<T>

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| builder | `CdsPopoverTriggerBuilder` | required | Builds the trigger; call `controller.toggle`. |
| content | `List<CdsMenuItem<T>>` | required | The options. |
| value | `T?` | `null` | Selected value (shows a check mark). |
| onChange | `ValueChanged<T>?` | `null` | Called with the chosen value. |
| disableCloseOnOptionChange | `bool` | `false` | Keep the menu open after a choice. |
| placement | `CdsPlacement` | `CdsPlacement.bottomStart` | Preferred position; flips when needed. |
| gap | `double` | `0.5` | Space token between trigger and menu. |
| width | `double?` | `null` | Fixed menu width. |
| minWidth | `double?` | `null` | Minimum menu width. |
| maxWidth | `double?` | `null` | Maximum menu width. |
| maxHeight | `double` | `cdsDropdownMaxHeight` (300) | Maximum menu height; the list scrolls. |
| block | `bool` | `false` | Trigger and menu take the parent's width. |
| disabled | `bool` | `false` | Keep the menu closed. |
| disableTypeFocus | `bool` | `false` | Turn off typeahead. |
| showOverlay | `bool` | `false` | Dim the page behind the menu. |
| controller | `CdsPopoverController?` | `null` | Control open state from outside. |
| onOpenMenu | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called on open. |
| onCloseMenu | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called on close. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Label for the menu. |
| restoreFocusOnUnmount | `bool` | `true` | Return focus to the trigger on close. |

### CdsMenuItem<T>

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | `T` | required | Value passed to `onChange`. |
| label | `String?` | `null` | Row title in `headline`; also used for typeahead. |
| description | `String?` | `null` | Muted second line. |
| media | `Widget?` | `null` | Leading content, for example an asset icon. |
| accessory | `Widget?` | `null` | Trailing indicator; replaces the check mark. |
| end | `Widget?` | `null` | Trailing content before the accessory, for example a balance. |
| disabled | `bool` | `false` | Not selectable. |
| onPress | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called on press in addition to `onChange`. |

Rows are at least 44px tall, 16px horizontal padding. The selected row has a `bgSecondary` background and a check mark.

## Examples

### With descriptions and balances

```dart
CdsDropdown<String>(
  value: account,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => account = v),
  builder: (context, c) => CdsButton(label: 'Pay from', onPress: c.toggle),
  content: const [
    CdsMenuItem(value: 'cash', label: 'Cash', description: 'Sample data: 1,240.00 USD'),
    CdsMenuItem(value: 'card', label: 'Debit card', description: 'Sample data: ending 4242'),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

- Opening moves focus to the selected option (or the first one); Up/Down move, Home/End jump, typing jumps to a matching label, Enter/Space choose, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger.
- Selected state is exposed (`selected`) and shown with a check mark, not color alone.
- Every row has a 44px minimum height.

## Motion

Same as `CdsPopoverPanel`: fade plus 16px slide and slight scale from the trigger over `moderate3`, reversed on exit; reduced motion fades. Rows give pointer-down feedback.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` (trigger) | `builder(context, controller)` |
| `content` (MenuItems) | `content` (`List<CdsMenuItem<T>>`) |
| `value`, `onChange` | `value`, `onChange` (typed `T`, not only strings) |
| `disableCloseOnOptionChange`, `disableTypeFocus`, `showOverlay`, `block`, `disabled` | same |
| `width`, `minWidth`, `maxWidth`, `maxHeight` | same |
| `onOpenMenu`, `onCloseMenu`, `onBlur` | `onOpenMenu`, `onCloseMenu` |
| `contentPosition` | `placement`, `gap` |
| ref `openMenu` / `closeMenu` | `controller.open()` / `controller.close()` |

# CdsEmptyState

A centered message for a screen or section with nothing to show, or that failed to load: icon or illustration, a title naming the cause, a description, and up to two actions naming the next step.

CDS reference: none. This is a cds_flutter extra built from CDS tokens.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsEmptyState(
  icon: CdsIconName.wallet,
  title: 'No assets yet',
  description: 'Assets you buy or receive appear here.',
  primaryAction: 'Buy Bitcoin',
  onPrimaryActionPress: openBuy,
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it when a list, search or screen has no content, or when loading failed. Name the cause in the title and the next step in the action ("Try again", "Buy Bitcoin"). For a short inline error next to a field, use helper text instead.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String` | required | `title3`, centered, announced as a heading. |
| `media` | `Widget?` | `null` | Illustration slot; replaces the icon circle. |
| `icon` | `CdsIconName?` | `info` (empty), `error` (error) | Icon in a 64px circle. |
| `description` | `String?` | `null` | `body`, `fgMuted`, centered. |
| `primaryAction` | `String?` | `null` | Label of the first `CdsButton` (primary; secondary in the error variant). |
| `onPrimaryActionPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `secondaryAction` | `String?` | `null` | Label of a transparent secondary `CdsButton`. |
| `onSecondaryActionPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `variant` | `CdsEmptyStateVariant` | `empty` | `empty` or `error`. |

## Examples

### Error

```dart
CdsEmptyState(
  variant: CdsEmptyStateVariant.error,
  title: 'Prices did not load',
  description: 'Check your connection, then try again.',
  primaryAction: 'Try again',
  onPrimaryActionPress: reload,
)
```

## Accessibility

- The title is a heading.
- The error variant is a live region, so screen readers announce it when it appears.
- Status is not color alone: the error variant pairs `bgNegativeWash`/`fgNegative` with the `error` glyph and the title text.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

| Closest CDS piece | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `PageHeader` + `MultiContentModule` used in CDS empty and error page stories | `title`, `description`, `primaryAction` |
| `Pictogram` / `SpotSquare` illustrations | `media` |

source: doc/components/CdsFallback.md

# CdsFallback

A skeleton placeholder shown while content loads, sized like the content it stands in for.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/feedback/Fallback

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const Column(children: [
  CdsFallback(width: 150, height: 24, rectWidthVariant: 0),
  CdsFallback(width: 150, height: 24, rectWidthVariant: 1),
])
```

## When to use / when not to

Use where content will appear in a known shape (rows, avatars, prices). For an unknown wait with no layout, use `CdsSpinner`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| height | `double` | required | Height in px. |
| width | `double?` | `null` | Width in px. Null fills the available width. |
| shape | `CdsFallbackShape` | `CdsFallbackShape.rectangle` | `rectangle` (0 radius), `square` (4), `squircle` (8), `circle`. |
| disableRandomRectWidth | `bool` | `false` | Use `width` exactly. |
| rectWidthVariant | `int?` | `null` | Picks from a fixed cycle of 10 widths for deterministic variety. |
| shimmer | `bool` | `false` | Sweep a highlight across while shown. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `'Loading'` | Read by screen readers; null hides the placeholder from them. |

Rectangles with a numeric width get a width within 25% of `width` (random per mount unless `rectWidthVariant` or `disableRandomRectWidth` is set), like CDS. Color: gray at 5% alpha (CDS `fallbackShimmer`), highlight at 10%.

## Examples

### Avatar and two text lines, shimmering

```dart
Row(children: [
  const CdsFallback(width: 40, height: 40, shape: CdsFallbackShape.circle, shimmer: true),
  const SizedBox(width: 12),
  Expanded(
    child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: const [
      CdsFallback(width: 120, height: 16, rectWidthVariant: 2, shimmer: true, accessibilityLabel: null),
      SizedBox(height: 8),
      CdsFallback(width: 80, height: 16, rectWidthVariant: 5, shimmer: true, accessibilityLabel: null),
    ]),
  ),
])
```

## Accessibility

Announces `accessibilityLabel` ("Loading"). When showing many placeholders, label one and pass `null` to the rest.

## Motion

Static by default. With `shimmer`, a highlight sweeps across every 1300ms, at most 10 times (as CDS), pausing off screen. Under reduced motion the shimmer is off.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `width`, `height` | `width`, `height` |
| `shape` | `shape` (`hexagon` not ported) |
| `disableRandomRectWidth`, `rectWidthVariant` | same |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `accessibilityLabel` |
| (always shimmers) | `shimmer` (off by default per the package motion contract) |

source: doc/components/CdsFloatingAssetCard.md

# CdsFloatingAssetCard

An asset card whose media floats in its own bordered tile, with text underneath on the page background.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/cards/FloatingAssetCard

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsFloatingAssetCard(
  media: CdsRemoteImage(source: art, width: double.infinity, height: double.infinity, shape: CdsShape.rectangle),
  subtitle: 'Collection',
  title: 'Genesis drop',
  description: 'Sample data',
  onPress: openCollection,
)
```

## When to use / when not to

CDS deprecates this card; prefer `CdsMediaCard` for new screens.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `media` | `Widget` | required | Fills the 156px tall tile. |
| `title` / `titleNode` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | Up to three `headline` lines. Required. |
| `subtitle` / `subtitleNode` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | One muted `legal` line. |
| `description` / `descriptionNode` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | Up to two muted `label2` lines. |
| `size` | `CdsAssetCardSize` | `s` | Max width 156 (`s`) or 359 (`l`). |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | subtitle, title, description | |

## Accessibility

A pressable card is one button labelled from its text.

## Motion

Pressable cards tint and scale to 0.98 on pointer-down; no scale under reduced motion.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `media`, `size`, `onPress` | same names |
| `title`, `subtitle`, `description` (string / node) | `x` / `xNode` |

# CdsFocusTrap

Keeps keyboard focus inside its child while on screen and hands it back to the previously focused widget when removed.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/overlay/FocusTrap

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsFocusTrap(
  onEscPress: close,
  child: const MyCustomDialog(),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Every CDS modal overlay (modal, alert, tray, drawer, popover, dropdown) already uses it. Use it directly only for custom overlays.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| child | `Widget` | required | Content to trap focus in. |
| onEscPress | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called on Escape while focus is inside. |
| disableFocusTrap | `bool` | `false` | Let Tab leave the child at the ends. |
| restoreFocusOnUnmount | `bool` | `true` | Refocus the previously focused widget on unmount. |
| disableAutoFocus | `bool` | `false` | Do not move focus in on mount. |
| disableArrowKeyNavigation | `bool` | `true` | When false, Up/Down also move focus. |

## Examples

### Arrow keys move between buttons

```dart
CdsFocusTrap(
  disableArrowKeyNavigation: false,
  child: Column(children: [
    CdsButton(label: 'Buy Bitcoin', onPress: buy),
    CdsButton(label: 'Sell Bitcoin', onPress: sell),
  ]),
)
```

## Accessibility

Tab and Shift+Tab wrap inside the trap. Focus restoration runs after the trap is torn down so the closing overlay cannot steal it back.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop (web) | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `child` |
| `onEscPress` | `onEscPress` |
| `disableFocusTrap` | `disableFocusTrap` |
| `restoreFocusOnUnmount` | `restoreFocusOnUnmount` |
| `disableArrowKeyNavigation` | `disableArrowKeyNavigation` (default `true` here, `false` in CDS) |
| `focusTabIndexElements`, `respectNegativeTabIndex`, `includeTriggerInFocusTrap` | not applicable to Flutter focus |

The arrow-key default differs from CDS so arrow keys keep working inside multi-line text fields.

# CdsFullscreenAlert

A full-screen alert for important outcomes (a failed transfer, a locked account) that the person must read and respond to.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/overlay/FullscreenAlert

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
final retry = await showCdsFullscreenAlert(
  context,
  title: 'Transfer failed',
  body: 'Your bank declined the transfer. Try another payment method.',
  preferredActionLabel: 'Try again',
  dismissActionLabel: 'Close',
);
```

## When to use / when not to

Use when the outcome changes what the person can do next and deserves the whole screen. For quick confirmations use `CdsAlert`.

## Parameters

### showCdsFullscreenAlert

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| context | `BuildContext` | required | Context used to find the navigator. |
| title | `String` | required | Title in `title3`. |
| body | `String` | required | Muted body text. |
| preferredActionLabel | `String` | required | Main button label. |
| onPreferredActionPress | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Runs before closing. |
| preferredActionVariant | `CdsButtonVariant` | `CdsButtonVariant.primary` | `primary` or `negative`. |
| dismissActionLabel | `String?` | `null` | Secondary button label. |
| onDismissActionPress | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Runs before closing. |
| heroSquare | `Widget?` | `null` | Illustration above the title. |
| closeAccessibilityLabel | `String` | `'Close'` | Close button label. |
| useRootNavigator | `bool` | `true` | Push on the root navigator. |
| routeSettings | `RouteSettings?` | `null` | Route name and arguments. |

Returns `Future<bool?>`: `true` preferred, `false` dismiss, `null` close button, Escape or back.

### CdsFullscreenAlert

Same fields as above (without navigator options), plus `onRequestClose` (`ValueChanged<bool?>?`, default `null`), which replaces `Navigator.pop(result)`.

Layout: content centered; actions at the bottom, stacked full width on phones (preferred on top) and side by side from 560px.

## Examples

### Destructive outcome

```dart
showCdsFullscreenAlert(
  context,
  title: 'Close your account?',
  body: 'Withdraw your balance first. Closed accounts cannot be reopened.',
  preferredActionLabel: 'Close account',
  preferredActionVariant: CdsButtonVariant.negative,
  dismissActionLabel: 'Keep account',
);
```

## Accessibility

Route named by the title; title is a heading; focus trapped and restored; close button labelled with a 44px hit area; content scrolls at 2x text.

## Motion

Fullscreen modal motion: fade and 80px rise (`moderate3` in, `moderate1` out). Reduced motion: fade only.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `visible`, `onRequestClose` | `showCdsFullscreenAlert`, `onRequestClose` |
| `title`, `body` | same |
| `heroSquare` (name) | `heroSquare` (`Widget` slot) |
| `preferredActionLabel`, `onPreferredActionPress`, `preferredActionVariant` | same |
| `dismissActionLabel`, `onDismissActionPress` | same |
| `closeAccessibilityLabel` | same |

CDS mobile has no FullscreenAlert; this follows CDS web.

---
source: doc/components/CdsFullscreenModal.md

# CdsFullscreenModal

A full-screen modal with a header (logo slot, title, close button), a primary content column and an optional secondary column, for flows that need the whole screen.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/overlay/FullscreenModal

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
showCdsFullscreenModal<void>(
  context,
  builder: (context) => const CdsFullscreenModal(
    title: 'Verify your identity',
    primaryContent: CdsText('Have your ID ready. This takes about 3 minutes.'),
  ),
);
```

## When to use / when not to

Use for onboarding, identity verification, or a checkout with a summary panel. For a short task use `CdsModal`; for a blocking outcome message use `CdsFullscreenAlert`; for a custom full-screen layout use `CdsFullscreenModalLayout`.

## Parameters

### showCdsFullscreenModal<T>

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| context | `BuildContext` | required | Context used to find the navigator. |
| builder | `WidgetBuilder` | required | Builds a `CdsFullscreenModal` or `CdsFullscreenModalLayout`. |
| shouldCloseOnEscPress | `bool` | `true` | When false, Escape does nothing. |
| restoreFocusOnUnmount | `bool` | `true` | Return focus to the trigger on close. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Names the route for screen readers. |
| useRootNavigator | `bool` | `true` | Push on the root navigator. |
| routeSettings | `RouteSettings?` | `null` | Route name and arguments. |

Returns `Future<T?>` with the value passed to `Navigator.pop`.

### CdsFullscreenModal

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| primaryContent | `Widget` | required | Main content column (max 800px wide). |
| title | `String?` | `null` | Header title in the `title1` style. |
| logo | `Widget?` | `null` | Brand mark at the start of the header. No default: this package ships no Coinbase logos. |
| secondaryContent | `Widget?` | `null` | Below the primary content on phones; a 400px column beside it from 768px. |
| hideDivider | `bool` | `false` | Hide the divider under the header. |
| showSecondaryContentDivider | `bool` | `false` | Divider between primary and secondary content. |
| closeAccessibilityLabel | `String` | `'Close'` | Label of the close button. |
| onRequestClose | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Close button handler. Defaults to `Navigator.maybePop`. |

Content insets follow CDS web: 32px on phones, an 80px start inset from 560px, side-by-side columns from 768px, a 240px start inset from 1280px. Content scrolls.

## Examples

### With a summary column

```dart
CdsFullscreenModal(
  title: 'Buy Bitcoin',
  primaryContent: const CdsText('Choose an amount and a payment method.'),
  secondaryContent: const CdsText('Sample data: 25 USD, fee 0.99 USD'),
  showSecondaryContentDivider: true,
)
```

## Accessibility

Focus is trapped in the modal and restored on close. Escape and the back button close it. The title is a heading. The close button is labelled and has a 44px hit area.

## Motion

CDS fullscreen modal tokens: fades in and rises 80px over `moderate3` (enterFunctional); leaves the same way over `moderate1` (exitFunctional). The scrim fades with the global curve. Reduced motion: a `fast1` fade only.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `visible`, `onRequestClose` | `showCdsFullscreenModal`, `Navigator.pop`, `onRequestClose` |
| `title` | `title` |
| `logo` | `logo` (slot only, no default logo) |
| `primaryContent` | `primaryContent` |
| `secondaryContent` | `secondaryContent` |
| `hideDivider` | `hideDivider` |
| `showSecondaryContentDivider` | `showSecondaryContentDivider` |
| `closeAccessibilityLabel` | `closeAccessibilityLabel` |
| `shouldCloseOnEscPress`, `restoreFocusOnUnmount`, `accessibilityLabel` | parameters of `showCdsFullscreenModal` |

CDS mobile has no FullscreenModal; this follows CDS web.

---
source: doc/components/CdsFullscreenModalLayout.md

# CdsFullscreenModalLayout

A bare full-screen surface for custom full-screen modal layouts; `showCdsFullscreenModal` adds the motion, scrim and focus trap.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/overlay/FullscreenModalLayout

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
showCdsFullscreenModal<void>(
  context,
  builder: (context) => const CdsFullscreenModalLayout(
    child: Center(child: CdsText('Sample data: onboarding step 1 of 3')),
  ),
);
```

## When to use / when not to

Use when `CdsFullscreenModal`'s header and columns do not fit your design. Remember to give people a way to close (a close button calling `Navigator.pop`); Escape and back also close.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| child | `Widget` | required | The full layout. |
| background | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bg` | Surface color. |
| safeArea | `bool` | `true` | Keep `child` clear of the notch and home indicator. |

## Examples

### With a close button

```dart
CdsFullscreenModalLayout(
  child: Column(children: [
    Align(
      alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerEnd,
      child: CdsIconButton(CdsIconName.close, semanticLabel: 'Close', onPress: () => Navigator.pop(context)),
    ),
    const Expanded(child: Center(child: CdsText('Sample data: your portfolio summary'))),
  ]),
)
```

## Accessibility

The route traps and restores focus. Provide your own labelled close control.

## Motion

Provided by `showCdsFullscreenModal` (fade and 80px rise, reduced motion fades only).

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `child` |
| `visible`, `onRequestClose`, `shouldCloseOnEscPress`, `restoreFocusOnUnmount`, `accessibilityLabel` | `showCdsFullscreenModal` parameters |

In CDS this component owns the motion and focus trap; in Flutter the route does, and this widget is the surface.

# CdsGrid

Arranges children in equal-width columns that wrap into rows. Use a fixed column count, or a minimum column width so the grid adapts to the screen.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/layout/Grid

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsGrid(
  columns: 2,
  gap: 2,
  children: [for (final asset in assets) AssetTile(asset)],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for tiles and dashboards where items share a column rhythm. For a single row or column, use `CdsHStack`/`CdsVStack`. For long, scrolling collections, use a `GridView` (it builds lazily).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required | Cells. Wrap one in `CdsGridColumn` to span or position it. |
| `columns` | `int?` | `null` | Fixed column count. Wins over `columnMin`. |
| `columnMin` | `double?` | `null` | Minimum column width in px; the count is as many as fit (CSS `auto-fill`). |
| `gap` | `double` | `0` | Space token between rows and columns. |
| `columnGap` | `double?` | `gap` | Space token between columns. |
| `rowGap` | `double?` | `gap` | Space token between rows. |

With neither `columns` nor `columnMin`, the grid has one column. Cells in a row are stretched to the tallest cell. The grid needs a bounded width.

## Examples

### Responsive

```dart
CdsGrid(
  columnMin: 160,
  gap: 1,
  children: tiles,
)
```

### Spans

```dart
CdsGrid(
  columns: 4,
  gap: 1,
  children: [
    CdsGridColumn(colSpan: 4, child: header),
    CdsGridColumn(colSpan: 3, child: chart),
    stats,
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

Children keep their reading order (row by row, start to end). In RTL the first column is on the right.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

CDS ships `Grid` for web only; this follows the web props.

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `columns` | `columns` |
| `columnMin` | `columnMin` (px) |
| `columnMax` | not ported (always `1fr`) |
| `gap`, `columnGap`, `rowGap` | same |
| `templateColumns`, `rows` | not ported |

---
source: doc/components/CdsGridColumn.md

# CdsGridColumn

Places a child of `CdsGrid` across several columns or at a specific column.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/layout/GridColumn

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsGrid(
  columns: 4,
  children: [
    CdsGridColumn(colSpan: 2, child: summary),
    CdsGridColumn(colStart: 4, child: action),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Only as a direct child of `CdsGrid`. Plain children span one column, so wrap only cells that need more.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | Cell content. |
| `colSpan` | `int` | `1` | Columns to cover, clamped to the grid's column count. |
| `colStart` | `int?` | `null` | 1-based column to start at. If the current row is already past it, the cell moves to the next row. |

## Examples

### Full-width header

```dart
CdsGridColumn(colSpan: 12, child: header)
```

## Accessibility

No semantics of its own.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop (web) | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `colSpan` | `colSpan` |
| `colStart` | `colStart` |
| `colEnd`, `gridColumn` | not ported; use `colStart` + `colSpan` |

# CdsHandleBar

The grab handle at the top of a tray: shows the sheet can be dragged, and screen reader users can activate it to dismiss.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/overlay/Tray (HandleBar is part of Tray)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsHandleBar(onAccessibilityPress: close)
```

## When to use / when not to

`CdsTray` and bottom `CdsDrawer` already include one. Use it directly only in a custom sheet.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variant | `CdsHandleBarVariant` | `CdsHandleBarVariant.outside` | `outside`: 64x4, `bgSecondary`. `inside`: 32x4, `bgInverse` at 40%. |
| onAccessibilityPress | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called when a screen reader user activates the handle. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String` | `'Dismiss'` | Screen reader label. |

16px vertical padding around the 4px bar.

## Examples

### Inside variant

```dart
CdsHandleBar(variant: CdsHandleBarVariant.inside, onAccessibilityPress: close)
```

## Accessibility

Exposed as a button with `accessibilityLabel` when `onAccessibilityPress` is set.

## Motion

None; the sheet it belongs to moves.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `variant` | `variant` |
| `onAccessibilityPress` | `onAccessibilityPress` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `accessibilityLabel` |
| `panHandlers` | not needed: the sheet handles drags |

source: doc/components/CdsIcon.md

# CdsIcon

A glyph from the CDS icon font: 552 icons, each drawn at 12, 16 and 24px with an outline and an active (filled) variant.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/media/Icon

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsIcon(CdsIconName.arrowLeft)
CdsIcon(CdsIconName.home, active: true, color: CdsColor.fgPrimary)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `CdsIconName` | required (positional) | Use the enum; names match CDS web (`'arrowLeft'` is `CdsIconName.arrowLeft`). `factory` is `factoryIcon`. Brand logos from the original font (Coinbase, Base, Apple, Google, social networks, PayPal) are not included. |
| `size` | `CdsIconSize` | `m` | `xs` 12, `s` 16, `m` 24, `l` 32. |
| `pixelSize` | `double?` | `null` | Exact size; overrides `size`. The closest source glyph (12/16/24) is used. |
| `active` | `bool` | `false` | Filled variant for selected states. |
| `color` | `CdsColor` | `fg` | |
| `dangerouslySetColor` | `Color?` | `null` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Without it the icon is decorative and hidden from screen readers. |

## Finding an icon

- Browse the Icons page in the example app (search by name or keyword).
- Look up from a CDS web name: `CdsIconGlyph.byCdsName('wallet')`.
- Keyword search data lives in a separate import so apps that do not need it do not ship it:
  `import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_icon_keywords.dart';` then `cdsIconKeywords[CdsIconName.wallet]`.

## Accessibility

Decorative by default. When an icon is the only carrier of meaning (a status mark with no text), pass `semanticLabel`.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `<Icon name="add" size="m" color="fgMuted" active />` | `CdsIcon(CdsIconName.add, size: CdsIconSize.m, color: CdsColor.fgMuted, active: true)` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsIconButton.md

# CdsIconButton

A circular button with a single icon, for compact actions such as close, back, or favourite.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/IconButton

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsIconButton(CdsIconName.close, semanticLabel: 'Close', onPress: () => Navigator.pop(context))
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use when the icon is universally understood (close, back, search, more). Otherwise use a `CdsButton` with a label.
- `semanticLabel` is required because the icon alone says nothing to a screen reader.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `CdsIconName` | required (positional) | Icon to show. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String` | required | What the button does, read by screen readers. |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | `null` renders disabled. |
| `onLongPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `variant` | `CdsButtonVariant` | `secondary` | Same variants as `CdsButton`. |
| `size` | `CdsButtonSize` | `s` | Visual circle: xs 32, s 40, m 48, l 56px. |
| `iconSize` | `CdsIconSize?` | `s` for xs/s, `m` for m/l | |
| `active` | `bool` | `false` | Filled glyph for toggled states. |
| `disabled`, `loading`, `transparent` | `bool` | `false` | As on `CdsButton`. |
| `flush` | `CdsFlush?` | `null` | Align with an edge by offsetting padding. |
| `feedback` | `CdsHapticFeedback?` | by size | |
| `minTapTargetSize` | `double` | `44` | Hit area padding. Set `0` to match CDS layout exactly. |

## Examples

### Toolbar action

```dart
CdsIconButton(CdsIconName.bell, semanticLabel: 'Notifications', transparent: true, onPress: openInbox)
```

### Toggle

```dart
CdsIconButton(
  CdsIconName.star,
  semanticLabel: isWatched ? 'Remove from watchlist' : 'Add to watchlist',
  active: isWatched,
  onPress: () => setState(() => isWatched = !isWatched),
)
```

## Accessibility

Announced as a button with `semanticLabel`. The visible circle follows CDS sizing; the hit area is padded to 44px.

## Motion

Same press feedback as `CdsButton`.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `name` | positional `name` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` (required) |
| `compact` (default true in CDS) | `size: CdsButtonSize.s` (default) |
| `variant`, `size`, `iconSize`, `active`, `transparent`, `flush`, `loading` | same names |

---
source: doc/components/CdsInputChip.md
---

# CdsInputChip

A removable chip for a value the user entered or picked, such as a selected asset in a multi-select. Pressing it removes the value.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/InputChip

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsInputChip(label: 'BTC', onPress: () => setState(() => selected.remove('BTC')))
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use to show chosen values that can be removed one at a time.
- Do not use for filters that toggle on and off; use `CdsChip` with `active`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String` | required | The value. |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Removes the value. `null` shows a non-interactive chip. |
| `start` | `Widget?` | `null` | Leading media. |
| `size` | `CdsChipSize` | `s` | |
| `active` | `bool` | `true` | Inverted colors, as in CDS. |
| `activeBackground`, `activeColor` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Paint explicit active colors instead of inverting. |
| `maxWidth` | `double` | `200` | |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `feedback` | `CdsHapticFeedback` | `light` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `'Remove $label'` | |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | |

## Examples

### Selected assets

```dart
CdsHStack(gap: 1, wrap: true, children: [
  for (final a in selected)
    CdsInputChip(label: a, onPress: () => setState(() => selected.remove(a))),
])
```

### Not inverted

```dart
CdsInputChip(label: 'ETH', active: false, onPress: remove)
```

## Accessibility

Announced as a button labeled "Remove BTC" (from `semanticLabel`); the close icon is decorative. After removal, move focus to a sensible neighbor if the removed chip had keyboard focus.

## Motion

Same as `CdsChip`.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` / `value` (deprecated) | `label` |
| `onPress`, `start`, `active`, `size` | same names |
| `accessibilityLabel` (default `Remove ${children}`) | `semanticLabel` (same default) |

---
source: doc/components/CdsInputIcon.md
---

# CdsInputIcon

Icons for a text field's `start` and `end` slots: `CdsInputIcon` is decorative, `CdsInputIconButton` is a transparent icon button for actions such as clear or reveal password. Both follow the field's focus color.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/TextInput

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsTextInput(
  label: 'Wallet address',
  start: const CdsInputIcon(CdsIconName.wallet),
  end: CdsInputIconButton(
    CdsIconName.close,
    semanticLabel: 'Clear address',
    onPress: () => setState(() => address = ''),
  ),
  value: address,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => address = v),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use `CdsInputIcon` to hint at the field's content (a search glass, a currency).
- Use `CdsInputIconButton` for one action tied to the field.
- Do not put more than one button in a slot; move extra actions next to the field.

## Parameters

### CdsInputIcon

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `CdsIconName` | required (positional) | Glyph. |
| `color` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.fg` | Used when there is no enclosing field or `disableInheritFocusStyle` is set. |
| `active` | `bool` | `false` | Filled glyph. |
| `disableInheritFocusStyle` | `bool` | `false` | Keep `color` while the field is focused. |
| `compact` | `bool` | `false` | 8px horizontal padding instead of 16px. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Decorative (hidden from screen readers) when null. |

Size is `CdsIconSize.s` (16px).

### CdsInputIconButton

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `CdsIconName` | required (positional) | Glyph. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String` | required | What the button does. |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Disabled when null. |
| `variant` | `CdsButtonVariant` | `primary` | Used when there is no enclosing field or `disableInheritFocusStyle` is set. |
| `disableInheritFocusStyle` | `bool` | `false` | Keep `variant` regardless of the field's state. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `active` | `bool` | `false` | Filled glyph. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | |

Inside a field the button is `primary` (blue glyph) when the field's focused variant is anything but `foregroundMuted` or `secondary`, and `secondary` otherwise. It renders a transparent `CdsIconButton` with a 44px hit area, 8px start and 4px end padding.

## Examples

### Follow the focus color

```dart
const CdsTextInput(label: 'Search', start: CdsInputIcon(CdsIconName.search))
```

### Fixed color

```dart
const CdsInputIcon(CdsIconName.info, color: CdsColor.fgMuted, disableInheritFocusStyle: true)
```

## Accessibility

`CdsInputIcon` is hidden from screen readers unless you pass `semanticLabel`. `CdsInputIconButton` requires `semanticLabel`, is keyboard focusable and activates with Enter or Space.

## Motion

`CdsInputIconButton` inherits `CdsPressable` feedback: tint and 0.98 scale on pointer-down. Color changes with focus are immediate.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `InputIcon` `name`, `color`, `active` | `CdsInputIcon` `name`, `color`, `active` |
| `disableInheritFocusStyle` | same name |
| `compact` | `compact` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |
| `InputIconButton` `name`, `onPress`, `variant` | `CdsInputIconButton` `name`, `onPress`, `variant` |
| `InputIconButton` `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` (required) |

---
source: doc/components/CdsInputStack.md
---

# CdsInputStack

The frame shared by every CDS text field: label, bordered input area with start and end slots, focus border and helper text. Reach for it to build a custom field (a masked input, a trigger that opens a picker) that must look like `CdsTextInput`.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/TextInput

This page also covers the helpers that go with it: `CdsInputLabel`, `CdsHelperText`, `CdsTextInputFocusVariant`, and the enums `CdsInputVariant`, `CdsTextInputSize`, `CdsInputLabelVariant`.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsInputStack(
  labelNode: const CdsInputLabel('Network'),
  inputNode: const Padding(
    padding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
    child: CdsText('Ethereum'),
  ),
  endNode: const CdsInputIcon(CdsIconName.caretDown),
  helperTextNode: const CdsHelperText('Sample data'),
  onFieldPress: openPicker,
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for custom fields that need the CDS field look and focus behavior.
- Use `CdsTextInput` for ordinary text entry; it already composes this stack.
- `inputNode` brings its own padding. `CdsTextInput` uses 16px horizontal and 8, 12 or 16px vertical depending on size.

## Parameters

### CdsInputStack

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `inputNode` | `Widget` | required | The editable area. |
| `labelNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Above the field, or inside it when `labelVariant` is `inside`. |
| `helperTextNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Below the field. |
| `startNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Inside the border, before `inputNode`. |
| `endNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Inside the border, after `inputNode`. |
| `prependNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Outside the border, before the field. Squares the start corners. |
| `appendNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Outside the border, after the field. Squares the end corners. |
| `variant` | `CdsInputVariant` | `foregroundMuted` | Border color source. |
| `focused` | `bool` | `false` | Shows the focus border and switches to the focused variant. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Dims the whole stack to 50%. |
| `borderWidth` | `int` | `100` | Border width token (1px). |
| `focusedBorderWidth` | `int?` | `null` (= `borderWidth`) | Extra width token added while focused. |
| `borderRadius` | `int` | `200` | Radius token (8px). |
| `labelVariant` | `CdsInputLabelVariant` | `outside` | Where `labelNode` goes. `inside` stacks it above `inputNode` with 6px vertical padding. |
| `inputBackground` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bg` | Ignored for `secondary`, which uses `bgSecondary`. |
| `onFieldPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Makes the bordered area pressable. For trigger-style fields only. |

### CdsInputLabel

`const CdsInputLabel(String text, {CdsColor color = CdsColor.fgMuted, CdsFont font = CdsFont.label2, double paddingStart = 0, double paddingEnd = 0, double paddingY = 0.5})`

Padding values are space tokens.

### CdsHelperText

`const CdsHelperText(String text, {CdsColor color = CdsColor.fgMuted, TextAlign align = TextAlign.start, String errorIconSemanticLabel = 'error'})`

With `color: CdsColor.fgNegative` it leads with a filled `info` icon (12px) aligned to the first line.

### CdsTextInputFocusVariant

`const CdsTextInputFocusVariant({required CdsInputVariant variant, required Widget child})`

An inherited widget the stack places around its slots. `CdsTextInputFocusVariant.maybeOf(context)` returns the focused variant, which `CdsInputIcon` and `CdsInputIconButton` use to follow the focus color.

### CdsInputVariant

| Value | Border | Helper text and caret |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `positive` | `bgPositive` | `fgPositive` |
| `negative` | `bgNegative` | `fgNegative` |
| `foreground` | `bgInverse` | `fg` |
| `primary` | `bgPrimary` | `fgPrimary` |
| `foregroundMuted` | `bgLineHeavy` | `fgMuted` |
| `secondary` | none, `bgSecondary` fill | `fgMuted` |

`variant.focusedVariant(focused)` returns `primary` while focused, except for `positive` and `negative`, which keep their color so validation stays visible.

### CdsTextInputSize

`s`, `m`, `l`: 8, 12 and 16px vertical padding inside the border.

### CdsInputLabelVariant

`outside` (above the field) or `inside` (inside the border).

## Examples

### Prepend and append

```dart
CdsInputStack(
  prependNode: const CdsBox(padding: 2, background: CdsColor.bgSecondary, child: CdsText('https://')),
  inputNode: const Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(16), child: CdsText('example.com')),
)
```

### Error helper

```dart
const CdsHelperText('Enter a valid address', color: CdsColor.fgNegative)
```

## Accessibility

The stack adds no semantics of its own. The widget you pass as `inputNode` provides the field semantics; `CdsTextInput` shows how (labeled text field, helper as hint, errors in a live region). With `onFieldPress` the area is focusable and activates with Enter and Space.

## Motion

When `focused` turns true, a second border fades in over the first in `CdsDurations.moderate1` with `CdsCurves.enterFunctional`, and fades out with `CdsCurves.exitFunctional`. It sits half outside the field, so layout never shifts. Reduced motion makes it instant.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `inputNode`, `labelNode`, `helperTextNode` | same names |
| `startNode`, `endNode`, `prependNode`, `appendNode` | same names |
| `variant`, `focused`, `disabled` | same names |
| `borderWidth`, `focusedBorderWidth`, `borderRadius` | same names |
| `labelVariant`, `inputBackground`, `onFieldPress` | same names |
| `borderStyle`, `borderFocusedStyle` | computed from `variant` and `focused` |
| `enableColorSurge`, `width`, `height` | not ported |
| `HelperText` `color`, `errorIconAccessibilityLabel` | `CdsHelperText` `color`, `errorIconSemanticLabel` |
| `InputLabel` | `CdsInputLabel` |
| `TextInputFocusVariantContext` | `CdsTextInputFocusVariant` |

# CdsKbd

Keyboard keys drawn as keycaps, for documenting shortcuts.

Not part of CDS. Styled with CDS tokens: `bgAlternate` keys, `bgLineHeavy` border with a heavier bottom edge, `label2` text.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsKbd(['⌘', 'K'])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `keys` | `List<String>` | required (positional) | One entry per key, in press order. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | spoken key names | |

`CdsKbd.spokenLabel(keys)` returns the spoken form: ⌘ Command, ⇧ Shift, ⌥ Option, ⌃ Control, ↵ Enter, ⏎ Return, ⌫ Delete, ⎋ Escape, ⇥ Tab, arrows by name.

## Examples

```dart
Row(children: [const CdsText.label2('Search'), const SizedBox(width: 8), const CdsKbd(['Ctrl', 'K'])])
```

## Accessibility

One node labelled with the spoken keys ("Command K"). Keys wrap onto new lines instead of overflowing at large text sizes.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

Not in CDS. Inspired by shadcn_flutter's KeyboardDisplay.

# CdsLegend

Lists the labeled series of the surrounding chart with their colors and shapes.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/charts/Legend

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsLineChart(
  height: 200,
  legend: CdsLegend(),
  series: [
    CdsLineSeries(id: 'a', label: 'Series A', data: [1, 2, 3]),
    CdsLineSeries(id: 'b', label: 'Series B', data: [2, 1, 3], color: CdsColor.fgWarning),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it whenever a chart shows more than one series, so color is never the only way to tell them apart.
- Pass it as the chart's `legend`. Series without a `label` are skipped.
- Outside a chart, pass `series` directly.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `seriesIds` | `List<String>?` | `null` | Series to show. Defaults to every labeled series. |
| `series` | `List<CdsChartSeries>?` | `null` | Series to list when used outside a chart. |
| `direction` | `Axis` | `Axis.horizontal` | `horizontal` wraps entries in centered rows; `vertical` stacks them. |
| `justifyContent` | `WrapAlignment` | `WrapAlignment.center` | Row alignment. |
| `columnGap` | `double` | `2` | Space token between entries. |
| `rowGap` | `double` | `0.75` | Space token between rows. |
| `padding` | `double` | `1` | Space token around the legend. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `String` | `'Legend'` | Label of the legend group. |

Each entry is a `CdsLegendEntry(label:, color:, shape:)`: a 10px shape (`circle`, `square`, `squircle`, or a 6x24 `pill`) and a `label1` label.

## Examples

### Vertical legend on the right

```dart
const CdsBarChart(
  height: 200,
  legend: CdsLegend(direction: Axis.vertical),
  legendPosition: CdsLegendPosition.right,
  series: [
    CdsChartSeries(id: 'a', label: 'Buys', data: [3, 4], color: CdsColor.fgPositive, legendShape: CdsLegendShape.squircle),
    CdsChartSeries(id: 'b', label: 'Sells', data: [2, 5], color: CdsColor.fgNegative, legendShape: CdsLegendShape.squircle),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

The legend is a semantics container labeled "Legend"; each entry's text is read in order. The shape is decorative.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `seriesIds` | `seriesIds` |
| `flexDirection` | `direction` |
| `justifyContent`, `columnGap`, `rowGap` | same names |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `accessibilityLabel` |
| series `legendShape` | `CdsChartSeries.legendShape` |
| `EntryComponent`, `ShapeComponent`, `styles` | not ported; compose `CdsLegendEntry` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsLineChart.md
