# CdsLineChart

A line chart with optional area fill, points, axes and scrubbing, built on `CdsCartesianChart`.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/charts/LineChart

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsLineChart(
  height: 200,
  showArea: true,
  enableScrubbing: true,
  series: [CdsLineSeries(id: 'prices', data: [10, 22, 29, 45, 98, 45, 22], color: CdsColor.fgPositive)],
  children: [CdsScrubber()],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for values over time or across ordered categories, one or many series.
- Add `CdsScrubber` to `children` with `enableScrubbing: true` so people can read exact values.
- Use `CdsBarChart` for discrete comparisons and `CdsSparkline` for tiny inline trends.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `series` | `List<CdsLineSeries>` | `const []` | Series with optional per-series overrides of the styling below. |
| `curve` | `CdsChartCurve` | `bump` | `bump`, `catmullRom`, `linear`, `monotone`, `natural`, `step`, `stepBefore`, `stepAfter`, `basis`. |
| `type` | `CdsChartLineType` | `solid` | `solid` or `dotted`. |
| `showArea` | `bool` | `false` | Fill under each line. |
| `areaType` | `CdsChartAreaType` | `gradient` | `gradient` (30% to 0% toward the baseline), `solid` or `dotted`. |
| `strokeWidth` | `double` | `2` | Line width. |
| `opacity` | `double` | `1` | Opacity of lines, areas and points. |
| `points` | `bool` | `false` | Draw a `CdsPoint` at every value. |
| `connectNulls` | `bool` | `false` | Bridge null values instead of leaving gaps. |
| `showXAxis`, `showYAxis` | `bool` | `false` | Render the axes. |
| `xAxis`, `yAxis` | `CdsAxisConfig` | `const CdsAxisConfig()` | Scale configuration. See `CdsCartesianChart`. |
| `xAxisStyle` | `CdsXAxis?` | `null` | Visual options for the x axis, used when `showXAxis` is true. |
| `yAxisStyle` | `CdsYAxis?` | `null` | Visual options for the y axis, used when `showYAxis` is true. |
| `animate` | `bool` | `true` | Enter reveal and data-change animation. Reduced motion turns it off. |
| `inset` | `CdsChartInset?` | `null` | Space around the drawing area, outside the axes. Defaults to `CdsChartInset.vertical` (top 32, sides and bottom 16) or `CdsChartInset.horizontal` (right 48, others 16). |
| `legend` | `Widget?` | `null` | Legend beside the chart, usually `const CdsLegend()`. |
| `legendPosition` | `CdsLegendPosition` | `bottom` | `top`, `bottom`, `left` or `right`. A top or bottom legend adds to `height`. |
| `enableScrubbing` | `bool` | `false` | Drag, long-press and drag, or arrow keys to inspect values. |
| `onScrubberPositionChange` | `ValueChanged<int?>?` | `null` | Scrubbed data index, or null when scrubbing ends. |
| `width` | `double?` | `null` | Defaults to the parent width. |
| `height` | `double?` | `null` | Canvas height. Defaults to the parent height, or 160 when unbounded. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Screen reader label. Defaults to each series: label, lowest, highest, latest. |
| `getScrubberAccessibilityLabel` | `String Function(int)?` | `null` | Screen reader value for a data index. |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | `const []` | Extra elements painted on top, such as `CdsScrubber` or `CdsReferenceLine`. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | Focus node for keyboard scrubbing. |

`CdsLineSeries` adds nullable `curve`, `type`, `showArea`, `areaType`, `strokeWidth`, `opacity`, `points` and `connectNulls` to `CdsChartSeries`; set values override the chart-level ones.

To compose lines by hand, use `CdsLine(seriesId: ...)` inside a `CdsCartesianChart`. It takes the same styling plus `stroke`/`dangerouslySetStroke`, `pointBuilder` (return a `CdsPoint` or null per value) and `animate`.

## Examples

### Two series with axes and a legend

```dart
CdsLineChart(
  height: 240,
  showXAxis: true,
  showYAxis: true,
  legend: const CdsLegend(),
  xAxis: const CdsAxisConfig(data: ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri']),
  yAxisStyle: CdsYAxis(showGrid: true, tickLabelFormatter: (v) => '\$${v.toInt()}'),
  series: const [
    CdsLineSeries(id: 'a', label: 'Series A', data: [12, 18, 15, 22, 20]),
    CdsLineSeries(id: 'b', label: 'Series B', data: [8, 9, 14, 11, 16], color: CdsColor.fgWarning, type: CdsChartLineType.dotted),
  ],
)
```

### Gaps and points

```dart
const CdsLineChart(
  height: 160,
  points: true,
  series: [CdsLineSeries(id: 'a', data: [4, 6, null, 7, 9])],
)
```

## Accessibility

- The chart is one semantics container labeled with a summary of every series (lowest, highest and latest value). Override it with `accessibilityLabel` when values need units.
- With `enableScrubbing`, the chart is adjustable: its value reads the scrubbed (or latest) point, and screen reader users swipe up and down to step through points. `getScrubberAccessibilityLabel` formats that value.
- Keyboard: focus the chart, then Left and Right (Up and Down in horizontal charts) move the scrubber, Home and End jump to the ends, Escape clears. A focus ring shows for keyboard focus.
- Pair series colors with a legend or labels; color alone never identifies a series.

## Motion

- On first data, lines and areas reveal from the start edge over 500ms and bars grow from the baseline; points and beacons fade in after 350ms (CDS accessory timing).
- Data changes morph every element from its current shape to the new one with the CDS update spring (stiffness 900, damping 120). Point arrays of different lengths are resampled, so switching datasets never jumps. A resize snaps instead of morphing.
- Scrubbing follows the finger 1:1 and snaps to the nearest data index. A selection haptic fires only when the index changes.
- Reduced motion: everything changes instantly. Nothing animates at rest.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `series` (`LineSeries`) | `series` (`CdsLineSeries`) |
| `curve`, `type`, `showArea`, `areaType` | same names |
| `strokeWidth`, `opacity`, `points`, `connectNulls` | same names (`points` function form: `CdsLine.pointBuilder`) |
| `showXAxis`, `showYAxis` | same names |
| `xAxis`, `yAxis` (config and visuals) | `xAxis`/`yAxis` (config) and `xAxisStyle`/`yAxisStyle` (visuals) |
| `LineComponent`, `AreaComponent` | not ported; compose `CdsLine`/`CdsArea` in `CdsCartesianChart` |
| `transition`, `transitions` | not ported; CDS default timing is built in |
| other `CartesianChart` props | same as `CdsCartesianChart` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsLink.md
---

# CdsLink

Pressable text that navigates somewhere, announced to screen readers as a link.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/typography/Link

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsLink('View all assets', onPress: openAssets)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use for navigation. Use `CdsButton` for actions that change data.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String` | required (positional) | |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called before `to` is opened. |
| `to` | `String?` | `null` | URL handed to the nearest `CdsLinkScope`. |
| `font` | `CdsFont?` | `null` | Null inherits the ambient `DefaultTextStyle` (CDS `font="inherit"`). |
| `color` | `CdsColor` | `fgPrimary` | |
| `underline` | `bool?` | `true` when `inline`, else `false` | |
| `mono` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `inline` | `bool` | `false` | No 44px tap padding, underlined by default; for use in a `WidgetSpan`. |
| `maxLines` | `int?` | `null` | |
| `align` | `TextAlign?` | `null` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Replaces `label` for screen readers. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | |

### CdsLinkScope

cds_flutter has no dependencies, so it cannot open URLs itself. `CdsLinkScope({required void Function(String url) onOpen, required Widget child})` receives every `to`:

```dart
CdsLinkScope(onOpen: (url) => launchUrl(Uri.parse(url)), child: app)
```

## Examples

### Inline in a sentence

```dart
CdsText.rich(TextSpan(children: [
  const TextSpan(text: 'By continuing you accept the '),
  WidgetSpan(
    alignment: PlaceholderAlignment.baseline,
    baseline: TextBaseline.alphabetic,
    child: CdsLink('user agreement', inline: true, font: CdsFont.body, onPress: openTerms),
  ),
  const TextSpan(text: '.'),
]))
```

A `WidgetSpan` does not break across lines, so keep inline link text short.

## Accessibility

Announced as a link (not a button), with `linkUrl` set from `to`. Standalone links have a 44px hit area; all links are focusable and activate with Enter. Inline links are underlined so they do not rely on color alone.

## Motion

Content dims to 82% on pointer-down (from `CdsPressable`); no scale.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `label` |
| `to` | `to` (opened through `CdsLinkScope`) |
| `onPress`, `color`, `font`, `underline`, `mono` | same names |
| `forceOpenOutsideApp`, `preventRedirectionIntoApp`, `readerMode` | handle in your `CdsLinkScope.onOpen` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsListCell.md
---

# CdsListCell

A row in a list: media, a title with optional subtitle and description, end detail, and a trailing accessory.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/data-display/ListCell

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsListCell(
  spacingVariant: CdsCellSpacingVariant.condensed,
  media: CdsCellMedia.asset(source: btcLogo),
  title: 'Bitcoin',
  description: 'BTC',
  detail: r'$64,201.10',
  subdetail: '+2.4%',
  variant: CdsCellDetailVariant.positive,
  accessory: CdsCellAccessoryType.arrow,
  onPress: () => openAsset('BTC'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for settings rows, asset lists, transaction lists and selectable options.
- Prefer `spacingVariant: condensed` for new screens; `normal` (the CDS default) and `compact` are deprecated in CDS.
- Use `CdsContentCell` when the description must wrap without a line limit.
- Avoid interactive `end` content (buttons, switches) together with `onPress`: the row is one button for screen readers.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String?` | `null` | `headline`. Two lines, or one when a description is shown outside `condensed`. |
| `titleNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom title; wins over `title`. You own style and truncation. |
| `subtitle` | `String?` | `null` | One muted `label1` line between title and description. |
| `subtitleNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | |
| `description` | `String?` | `null` | Muted `body` (`label2` when condensed). One line with a title, two without, unless `multiline`. |
| `descriptionNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | |
| `detail` | `String?` | `null` | End-aligned `body` value. |
| `detailNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | |
| `subdetail` | `String?` | `null` | Line under `detail`, colored by `variant` (`body`, or `label2` when condensed). |
| `subdetailNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | |
| `variant` | `CdsCellDetailVariant` | `foregroundMuted` | `foregroundMuted`, `negative`, `positive`, `warning`. |
| `media` | `Widget?` | `null` | Leading icon, avatar or image. See `CdsCellMedia`. |
| `intermediary` | `Widget?` | `null` | Between the title stack and the end content. |
| `end` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom end content; replaces `detail`/`subdetail`. |
| `accessory` | `CdsCellAccessoryType?` | `null` | `arrow`, `more`, `selected`, `unselected`. |
| `accessoryNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom accessory; wins over `accessory`. |
| `helperText` | `Widget?` | `null` | Content under the row, usually `CdsCellHelperText`. |
| `spacingVariant` | `CdsCellSpacingVariant` | `normal` | `normal` (80px min height), `compact` (40px min height), `condensed` (no min height, no outer padding, square corners). |
| `priority` | `Set<CdsCellPriority>` | `{}` | Pieces that keep their natural width when space runs out: `start` (title), `middle` (intermediary), `end`. Others shrink in proportion to their width. |
| `selected` | `bool` | `false` | Fills with `background`, shows a checkmark, sets the selected semantics flag. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Dims to 50% and blocks presses. |
| `disableSelectionAccessory` | `bool` | `false` | Keep `accessory` (or none) instead of the checkmark when selected. |
| `disableMultilineTitle` | `bool` | `false` | Always one title line. |
| `multiline` | `bool` | `false` | Description wraps without a limit. |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Makes the row a button. |
| `onLongPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `background` | `CdsColor` | `bgAlternate` | Fill when selected. |
| `borderRadius` | `int?` | `200`, or `0` when condensed | Radius token of the highlight. |
| `minHeight` | `double?` | per variant | Overrides the variant minimum height. |
| `detailWidth` | `double?` | `null` | Fixed width for the end content. |
| `innerSpacing` | `CdsCellSpacing?` | per variant | Content padding. Default `paddingX: 2, paddingY: 1, marginX: -2`. |
| `outerSpacing` | `CdsCellSpacing?` | per variant | Wrapper padding. Default `paddingX: 3, paddingY: 1`. |
| `feedback` | `CdsHapticFeedback` | `none` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Replaces the label built from the row's text. |
| `semanticHint` | `String?` | `null` | |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | |

## Examples

### Selectable options

```dart
for (final currency in ['USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'])
  CdsListCell(
    spacingVariant: CdsCellSpacingVariant.condensed,
    title: currency,
    selected: currency == value,
    accessory: CdsCellAccessoryType.unselected,
    onPress: () => onChange(currency),
  )
```

### Helper text

```dart
CdsListCell(
  title: 'Bank account',
  description: 'Ending in 42',
  helperText: const CdsCellHelperText('Verification pending', variant: CdsCellHelperTextVariant.warning),
)
```

### Keep the balance whole

```dart
CdsListCell(title: longName, detail: balance, priority: const {CdsCellPriority.end})
```

### Loading, empty and error states

Show `CdsListCellFallback` rows while loading. For empty and error states, render a single explanatory row or message that names the cause and the next action, for example `CdsListCell(title: 'No transactions yet', description: 'Buy crypto to see activity here.')`.

## Accessibility

With `onPress`, the row is one button whose label merges its text; `selected` sets the selected flag. Focusable; Enter and Space activate. Helper text prefixes "Warning:" or "Error:" for screen readers, and pairs color with an icon. Text wraps or truncates; nothing clips at 2x text size.

## Motion

Pointer-down tint from `CdsPressable` (no scale, as in CDS). Reduced motion keeps the tint.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `title`, `titleNode`, `subtitle`, `subtitleNode`, `description`, `descriptionNode` | same names |
| `detail`, `detailNode`, `subdetail`, `subdetailNode`, `variant` | same names |
| `media`, `intermediary`, `end`, `accessory`, `accessoryNode`, `helperText` | same names |
| `action` (deprecated) | `end` |
| `compact` (deprecated) | `spacingVariant: CdsCellSpacingVariant.compact` |
| `spacingVariant`, `priority`, `selected`, `disabled` | same names (`priority` is a `Set`) |
| `disableSelectionAccessory`, `disableMultilineTitle`, `multiline` | same names |
| `innerSpacing`, `outerSpacing` | `CdsCellSpacing` |
| `detailWidth`, `minHeight`, `borderRadius`, `background` | same names |
| `accessibilityLabel`, `accessibilityHint` | `semanticLabel`, `semanticHint` |
| `styles` | not supported; use the `*Node` slots |

# CdsListCellFallback

A loading placeholder shaped like a `CdsListCell`.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/data-display/ListCell

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
Column(children: [
  for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++)
    CdsListCellFallback(title: true, description: true, detail: true, media: CdsCellMediaType.asset, rectWidthVariant: i),
])
```

## When to use / when not to

Show while list data loads. Turn on the pieces the loaded cell will have so the layout does not jump.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `subtitle` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `description` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `detail` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `subdetail` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `helperText` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `media` | `CdsCellMediaType?` | `null` | 48px squircle for `image`, 32px circle otherwise. |
| `accessory` | `CdsCellAccessoryType?` | `null` | |
| `accessoryNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | |
| `spacingVariant` | `CdsCellSpacingVariant` | `normal` | Match the loaded cells. |
| `rectWidthVariant` | `int?` | `null` | Varies bar widths deterministically; pass the row index. |
| `innerSpacing` / `outerSpacing` | `CdsCellSpacing?` | per variant | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `'Loading'` | Read once per placeholder. |

`CdsMediaFallback(CdsCellMediaType type)` is the media placeholder on its own.

## Accessibility

Each placeholder is one node labelled `semanticLabel`; the bars are hidden. Bars use one line height of the matching font, scaled with text size.

## Motion

None. CDS sweeps a shimmer across fallbacks; this port keeps them still so nothing animates on its own.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `title`, `subtitle`, `description`, `detail`, `subdetail`, `helperText`, `media`, `accessory`, `accessoryNode` | same names |
| `rectWidthVariant` | `rectWidthVariant` |
| `disableRandomRectWidth` | always on unless `rectWidthVariant` is set |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |

# CdsMediaCard

A card split into a text half (with a thumbnail) and a media half.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/cards/MediaCard

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsMediaCard(
  thumbnail: const CdsAvatar(name: 'Ethereum'),
  subtitle: 'ETH',
  title: 'Ethereum',
  description: 'Sample data',
  media: CdsRemoteImage(source: art, width: double.infinity, height: double.infinity, shape: CdsShape.rectangle),
  onPress: () => openAsset('ETH'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use for asset and collection tiles. It replaces `CdsContainedAssetCard` and `CdsFloatingAssetCard` in CDS.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `thumbnail` | `Widget` | required | Image, avatar or icon at the top of the text half. |
| `title` / `titleNode` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | Up to two `headline` lines. |
| `subtitle` / `subtitleNode` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | One muted `legal` line above the title. |
| `description` / `descriptionNode` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | Up to two muted `label2` lines. |
| `media` | `Widget?` | `null` | Fills its half at full height. Without media, the text half fills the card. |
| `mediaPlacement` | `CdsMediaCardMediaPlacement` | `end` | `start` or `end`. |
| `background` | `CdsColor` | `bgAlternate` | |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `feedback` | `CdsHapticFeedback` | `none` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | subtitle, title, description | Card button label when pressable. |

## Accessibility

A pressable card is one button labelled from its text.

## Motion

Pressable cards tint and scale to 0.98 on pointer-down; no scale under reduced motion.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `title`, `subtitle`, `description` (string / node) | `x` / `xNode` |
| `thumbnail`, `media`, `mediaPlacement` | same names |
| `renderAsPressable` + `onPress` | `onPress` |

# CdsMediaChip

A chip that leads with media, such as an asset icon or avatar, with the tighter padding CDS uses around it.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/MediaChip

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsMediaChip(label: 'Base', start: networkLogo, onPress: () => pick('base'))
```

`start` is any widget. This package does not ship asset logos or avatars; CDS uses a 24px circle.

## When to use / when not to

- Use when the media identifies the option faster than text (assets, networks, people).
- Use `CdsChip` when there is no media.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Text after the media. |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom middle content; overrides `label`. |
| `start` | `Widget?` | `null` | Leading media. |
| `end` | `Widget?` | `null` | Trailing icon, e.g. a caret. |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Makes the chip pressable. |
| `size` | `CdsChipSize` | `s` | |
| `active`, `activeBackground`, `activeColor` | | `false`, `null`, `null` | As on `CdsChip`. |
| `background` | `CdsColor` | `bgSecondary` | |
| `color` | `CdsColor` | `fg` | |
| `maxWidth` | `double` | `200` | |
| `numberOfLines` | `int` | `1` | |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `feedback` | `CdsHapticFeedback` | `light` | |
| `semanticLabel`, `semanticHint` | `String?` | `null` | Give a `semanticLabel` when there is no `label`. |
| `excludeChildSemantics` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `selected` | `bool?` | `null` | Selected state for screen readers. |
| `focusNode`, `autofocus` | | | |

### Padding rules

Spacing comes from `cdsMediaChipSpacing({required bool start, required bool label, required bool end, CdsChipSize size})`, a port of CDS `getMediaChipSpacingProps`. Values are space tokens:

| Slots | Start | End | Vertical | Gap |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label only | 2 (xs 1.5) | 2 (xs 1.5) | 1 (xs 0.75) | 1 |
| media only | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| media + end | 1 | 1.5 | 1 | 0.75 |
| media + label | 1 | 2 (xs 1.5) | 1 (xs 0.75) | 0.75 |
| label + end | 2 (xs 1.5) | 1.5 | 1 (xs 0.75) | 0.75 |
| media + label + end | 1 | 1.5 | 1 (xs 0.75) | 0.75 |

## Examples

### Network picker

```dart
CdsHStack(gap: 1, wrap: true, children: [
  for (final n in networks)
    CdsMediaChip(
      label: n.name,
      start: n.logo,
      active: selected == n.id,
      selected: selected == n.id,
      onPress: () => setState(() => selected = n.id),
    ),
])
```

### Media with a caret

```dart
CdsMediaChip(
  start: assetLogo,
  end: const CdsIcon(CdsIconName.caretDown, size: CdsIconSize.xs),
  semanticLabel: 'Choose asset',
  onPress: openAssetPicker,
)
```

## Accessibility

Same as `CdsChip`. Media-only chips need `semanticLabel`.

## Motion

Same as `CdsChip`.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `label` / `child` |
| `start`, `end`, `size`, `active`, `onPress` | same names |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsMediaFallback.md

# CdsMessagingCard

A promotional (`upsell`) or nudge card with a title, description, optional tag, call to action, media and dismiss button.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/cards/MessagingCard

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsMessagingCard(
  type: CdsMessagingCardType.nudge,
  title: 'Turn on price alerts',
  description: 'Get notified when Bitcoin moves 5% in a day.',
  action: 'Set up alerts',
  onActionButtonPress: openAlerts,
  onDismissButtonPress: dismiss,
  media: const CdsIcon(CdsIconName.bell, size: CdsIconSize.l),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use `upsell` to promote a product and `nudge` to suggest a next step. It replaces `CdsNudgeCard` and `CdsUpsellCard` in CDS.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `CdsMessagingCardType` | required | `upsell`: `bgPrimary`, inverse text, small secondary button. `nudge`: `bgAlternate`, primary-colored text action. |
| `title` / `titleNode` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | Up to two `headline` lines. |
| `description` / `descriptionNode` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | Up to three `label2` lines. |
| `tag` / `tagNode` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | `tag` renders a `CdsTag` above the title. |
| `action` | `String?` | `null` | Label of the default call to action. |
| `actionNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom call to action; wins over `action`. |
| `onActionButtonPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `actionButtonSemanticLabel` | `String?` | `action` | |
| `onDismissButtonPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Shows a close button in the top end corner. |
| `dismissButton` | `Widget?` | `null` | Replaces the default close button. |
| `dismissButtonSemanticLabel` | `String?` | "Dismiss {title}" or "Dismiss card" | |
| `media` | `Widget?` | `null` | Vertically centered beside the text. |
| `mediaPlacement` | `CdsMessagingCardMediaPlacement` | `end` | `start` or `end`. |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Whole-card press. Action and dismiss stay separate. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | tag, title, description | Card button label when pressable. |

## Examples

### Upsell with media at the start

```dart
CdsMessagingCard(
  type: CdsMessagingCardType.upsell,
  mediaPlacement: CdsMessagingCardMediaPlacement.start,
  tag: 'New',
  title: 'Earn rewards on USDC',
  description: 'Sample data. Rates vary.',
  action: 'Start earning',
  onActionButtonPress: openEarn,
  media: CdsRemoteImage(source: art, width: 96, height: 96, shape: CdsShape.rectangle),
)
```

## Accessibility

Action and dismiss buttons are separate buttons with labels; the dismiss button has a 44px hit area. A pressable card is one button labelled from its text.

## Motion

Pressable cards tint and scale to 0.98 on pointer-down; no scale under reduced motion.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `type`, `mediaPlacement`, `media` | same names |
| `title`, `description`, `tag`, `action` (string / node) | `x` / `xNode` |
| `onActionButtonPress`, `onDismissButtonPress`, `dismissButton` | same names |
| `actionButtonAccessibilityLabel`, `dismissButtonAccessibilityLabel` | `actionButtonSemanticLabel`, `dismissButtonSemanticLabel` |
| `renderAsPressable` + `onPress` | `onPress` |

# CdsModal

A dialog surface for a focused task (header, scrollable body, footer actions), shown above the current route with `showCdsModal`.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/overlay/Modal

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
final confirmed = await showCdsModal<bool>(
  context,
  builder: (context) => CdsModal(children: [
    const CdsModalHeader(title: 'Send USDC'),
    const CdsModalBody(child: CdsText('Review the transfer before sending.')),
    CdsModalFooter(
      primaryAction: CdsButton(label: 'Send USDC', onPress: () => Navigator.pop(context, true)),
      secondaryAction: CdsButton(
        label: 'Cancel',
        variant: CdsButtonVariant.secondary,
        onPress: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
      ),
    ),
  ]),
);
```

## When to use / when not to

Use for a task that needs the person's full attention but is short: confirming details, editing one setting, choosing from a few options.

Do not use for a yes/no confirmation (use `CdsAlert`), for pickers on phones (use `CdsTray`), for multi-step flows that need the whole screen (use `CdsFullscreenModal`), or for information that should not block the page (use `CdsBanner` or `CdsToast`).

## Parameters

### showCdsModal<T>

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| context | `BuildContext` | required | Context used to find the navigator. |
| builder | `WidgetBuilder` | required | Builds the modal, usually a `CdsModal`. |
| disableOverlayPress | `bool` | `false` | When true, tapping the scrim does not close the modal. |
| shouldCloseOnEscPress | `bool` | `true` | When false, Escape does nothing. |
| restoreFocusOnUnmount | `bool` | `true` | Return keyboard focus to the trigger on close. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Names the route for screen readers. |
| useRootNavigator | `bool` | `true` | Push on the root navigator. |
| routeSettings | `RouteSettings?` | `null` | Name and arguments for the route. |

Returns `Future<T?>` that completes with the value passed to `Navigator.pop(context, value)`, or `null` when closed by scrim, Escape, back button or the header close button.

### CdsModal

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `List<Widget>` | required | Usually `CdsModalHeader`, `CdsModalBody`, `CdsModalFooter`, in that order. |
| onRequestClose | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called by the header close button. Defaults to `Navigator.maybePop`. |
| hideDividers | `bool` | `false` | Remove header and footer dividers and the body's vertical padding. |
| hideCloseButton | `bool` | `false` | Hide the close button in `CdsModalHeader`. |
| width | `double?` | `null` | Fixed card width on wide screens. |
| maxWidth | `double` | `cdsModalMaxWidth` (612) | Card width cap on wide screens. |
| maxHeight | `double?` | `null` | Card height cap. Defaults to the screen height minus 80px above and below. |
| background | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Surface color. Defaults to the elevation surface (`bgElevation2`). |
| borderRadius | `int` | `200` | Radius token for the card on wide screens. |
| elevation | `CdsElevation` | `CdsElevation.level2` | Shadow and surface level. |
| dangerouslyDisableResponsiveness | `bool` | `false` | Keep the centered card on narrow screens. |

Layout: below `cdsModalFullscreenBreakpoint` (768px) the modal fills the screen with square corners and safe-area padding, as CDS does on phones. From 768px it is a centered card, 24px side margin, up to 612px wide.

## Examples

### Hide dividers

```dart
CdsModal(
  hideDividers: true,
  children: [
    const CdsModalHeader(title: 'Price alert set'),
    const CdsModalBody(child: CdsText('Sample data: we will notify you when Bitcoin reaches 70,000 USD.')),
    CdsModalFooter(primaryAction: CdsButton(label: 'Done', onPress: () => Navigator.pop(context))),
  ],
)
```

### Keep the modal open on scrim tap

```dart
showCdsModal<void>(
  context,
  disableOverlayPress: true,
  builder: (context) => CdsModal(children: [
    const CdsModalHeader(title: 'Unsaved changes'),
    const CdsModalBody(child: CdsText('Save your recurring buy before leaving.')),
    CdsModalFooter(primaryAction: CdsButton(label: 'Save recurring buy', onPress: () => Navigator.pop(context))),
  ]),
);
```

## Accessibility

- The route is a separate semantics scope (`scopesRoute`), named by `accessibilityLabel` when given.
- Focus moves into the modal and is trapped there: Tab and Shift+Tab cycle inside. On close, focus returns to the trigger.
- Escape and the Android back button close the modal unless `shouldCloseOnEscPress` is false (Escape only).
- The header title is marked as a heading; close and back buttons have labels (`closeAccessibilityLabel`, `backAccessibilityLabel`) and 44px hit areas.
- The body scrolls, so text at 2x scale never overflows.

## Motion

CDS modal tokens: the dialog fades in over `fast1` and scales from 0.98 to 1 over `moderate3` (enterFunctional); the scrim fades in over `moderate1`. Exit fades and scales back over `fast1` (global curve). Under reduced motion both directions are a `fast1` fade with no scale.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `visible` | Call `showCdsModal`; close with `Navigator.pop` |
| `onRequestClose` | `CdsModal.onRequestClose` (header close) and route pop |
| `onDidClose` | `await showCdsModal(...)` |
| `children` | `children` |
| `hideDividers` | `hideDividers` |
| `hideCloseButton` | `hideCloseButton` |
| `disableOverlayPress` (web) | `showCdsModal(disableOverlayPress:)` |
| `shouldCloseOnEscPress` (web) | `showCdsModal(shouldCloseOnEscPress:)` |
| `restoreFocusOnUnmount` (web) | `showCdsModal(restoreFocusOnUnmount:)` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `showCdsModal(accessibilityLabel:)` |
| `width`, `maxWidth`, `maxHeight`, `background`, `borderRadius`, `elevation` | same names |
| `dangerouslyDisableResponsiveness` (web) | `dangerouslyDisableResponsiveness` |

Notes: the hidden scale is 0.98, from the CDS `modal` animation tokens. The responsive layout follows CDS web (fullscreen below 768px, card above), which matches CDS mobile's fullscreen modal on phones.

---
source: doc/components/CdsModalBody.md
---

# CdsModalBody

The scrollable content area of a `CdsModal`, between header and footer.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/overlay/ModalBody

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsModalBody(child: CdsText('Transfers settle in about 2 minutes.'))
```

## When to use / when not to

Place it directly in `CdsModal.children`. It returns a `Flexible`, so it must be a direct child of the modal's column; wrapping it in another widget breaks the layout. Its content scrolls when taller than the space left.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| child | `Widget` | required | Body content. |
| paddingX | `double` | `3` | Horizontal space token. |
| paddingY | `double?` | `null` | Vertical space token. Defaults to 3, or 0 when the modal hides its dividers. |
| controller | `ScrollController?` | `null` | Controller for the body's scroll view. |

In a fullscreen modal (narrow screens) the body fills the remaining height so the footer sits at the bottom; in a card it takes its content height.

## Examples

### Long content

```dart
CdsModalBody(
  child: Column(children: [
    for (var i = 0; i < 20; i++) CdsText('Sample data: transaction ${i + 1}'),
  ]),
)
```

## Accessibility

Content scrolls instead of clipping, so it stays readable at 2x text scale.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `child` |
| `paddingX`, `paddingY` | `paddingX`, `paddingY` |
| ScrollView props | `controller` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsModalFooter.md
---

# CdsModalFooter

The action row at the bottom of a `CdsModal`: one primary action and an optional secondary action.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/overlay/ModalFooter

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsModalFooter(
  primaryAction: CdsButton(label: 'Save', onPress: save),
  secondaryAction: CdsButton(label: 'Cancel', variant: CdsButtonVariant.secondary, onPress: close),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use as the last child of `CdsModal`. Use `direction: Axis.vertical` when labels are too long to sit side by side.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| primaryAction | `Widget` | required | Usually a `CdsButton`. |
| secondaryAction | `Widget?` | `null` | Usually a secondary `CdsButton`. |
| direction | `Axis` | `Axis.horizontal` | Horizontal: secondary then primary, equal widths. Vertical: primary on top. |
| paddingX | `double` | `3` | Horizontal space token. |
| paddingY | `double` | `2` | Vertical space token. |

`CdsButton` actions are stretched to full width automatically (CDS sets `block` on footer buttons). Other widgets are laid out as given. Buttons are 8px apart.

## Examples

### Stacked actions

```dart
CdsModalFooter(
  direction: Axis.vertical,
  primaryAction: CdsButton(label: 'Turn on two-step verification', onPress: enable),
  secondaryAction: CdsButton(label: 'Not now', variant: CdsButtonVariant.secondary, onPress: close),
)
```

## Accessibility

Buttons keep their own labels and 44px hit areas. Visual order matches focus order.

## Motion

None of its own.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `primaryAction` | `primaryAction` |
| `secondaryAction` | `secondaryAction` |
| `direction` | `direction` (`Axis`) |
| `paddingX`, `paddingY` | `paddingX`, `paddingY` |

# CdsModalHeader

The title row of a `CdsModal`, with an optional back button at the start and a close button at the end.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/overlay/ModalHeader

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsModalHeader(title: 'Choose a network')
```

## When to use / when not to

Use as the first child of `CdsModal`. For custom headers (an asset icon next to the title), pass `titleWidget`. Do not use outside a modal; the close button reads its behavior from the enclosing `CdsModal`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title | `String?` | `null` | Centered title in the `headline` style. |
| titleWidget | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom title content; overrides `title`. |
| onBackButtonClick | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Shows a back arrow at the start when set. |
| backAccessibilityLabel | `String` | `'Back'` | Screen reader label of the back button. |
| closeAccessibilityLabel | `String` | `'Close'` | Screen reader label of the close button. |
| paddingX | `double` | `3` | Horizontal space token. |
| paddingY | `double` | `2` | Vertical space token. |

The close button calls `CdsModal.onRequestClose` (default `Navigator.maybePop`) and is hidden when `CdsModal.hideCloseButton` is true. The bottom divider is hidden when `CdsModal.hideDividers` is true.

## Examples

### Back navigation inside a modal

```dart
CdsModalHeader(
  title: 'Network fee',
  onBackButtonClick: () => setState(() => step = 0),
)
```

## Accessibility

The title is marked as a heading. Both buttons are `CdsIconButton`s with required labels and 44px hit areas.

## Motion

None of its own; buttons give press feedback through `CdsPressable`.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `title` (string) | `title` |
| `title` (node) | `titleWidget` |
| `onBackButtonClick` | `onBackButtonClick` |
| `backAccessibilityLabel` | `backAccessibilityLabel` |
| `closeAccessibilityLabel` | `closeAccessibilityLabel` |
| `paddingX`, `paddingY` | `paddingX`, `paddingY` |

# CdsMultiContentModule

A content block with a pictogram, large title, description, a free-form primary area and an action. Use it for feature promos and summaries on a page.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/layout/MultiContentModule

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsMultiContentModule(
  title: 'Earn on your crypto',
  description: 'Stake eligible assets and receive rewards.',
  action: 'Start staking',
  onActionPress: openStaking,
  child: rewardsSummary,
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for a self-contained section with one call to action. For a tappable card in a list, use a card component; for an empty or failed screen, use `CdsEmptyState`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String` | required | `title1`, announced as a heading. |
| `pictogram` | `Widget?` | `null` | Illustration slot above the title (CDS uses a 48x48 pictogram). |
| `description` | `String?` | `null` | `body`, `fgMuted`, up to 3 lines. |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | Primary content below the description. |
| `action` | `String?` | `null` | Label of a primary `CdsButton`. |
| `onActionPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Action handler; null disables the button. |
| `actionAccessibilityLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Overrides the button's spoken label. |
| `end` | `Widget?` | `null` | Content below the action, such as legal text. |
| `bordered` | `bool` | `false` | 1px `bgLine` border and horizontal padding 3. |

Layout: 16px gap between parts, 32px vertical padding, radius token 400.

## Examples

### Bordered with legal text

```dart
CdsMultiContentModule(
  bordered: true,
  pictogram: const CdsIcon(CdsIconName.trading, size: CdsIconSize.l),
  title: 'Earn on your crypto',
  action: 'Start staking',
  onActionPress: openStaking,
  end: const CdsText('Rates are variable.', font: CdsFont.legal, color: CdsColor.fgMuted),
)
```

## Accessibility

The title is a heading. The action is a standard `CdsButton` with a 44px target.

## Motion

None beyond the button's press feedback.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `pictogram` (name or node) | `pictogram` (`Widget`) |
| `title` | `title` |
| `description` | `description` |
| `children` | `child` |
| `action` (string or element) | `action` (`String`); pass a custom widget through `end` |
| `onActionPress` | `onActionPress` |
| `actionAccessibilityLabel` | `actionAccessibilityLabel` |
| `end` | `end` |
| `bordered` | `bordered` |

# CdsNavBarIconButton

A 40x40 transparent icon button sized for navigation bars, with a 44px hit area.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/navigation/TopNavBar (`NavBarIconButton`)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsNavBarIconButton(CdsIconName.close, semanticLabel: 'Close', onPress: close)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use in the `start` and `end` slots of [CdsTopNavBar](CdsTopNavBar.md), [CdsNavigationBar](CdsNavigationBar.md) and [CdsPageHeader](CdsPageHeader.md).
- Use `CdsIconButton` elsewhere; it has a visible background.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name | `CdsIconName` | required (positional) | Icon. |
| semanticLabel | `String` | required | What the button does, for screen readers. |
| onPress | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Null disables the button. |
| active | `bool` | `false` | Filled glyph. |
| size | `CdsIconSize` | `CdsIconSize.m` | Icon size. |
| color | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.fg` | Icon color. |
| disabled | `bool` | `false` | Disables the button. |
| feedback | `CdsHapticFeedback` | `light` | Haptic on press. |

## Examples

### Toggled state

```dart
CdsNavBarIconButton(CdsIconName.star, semanticLabel: 'Watchlist', active: watched, onPress: toggleWatch)
```

## Accessibility

- Button role with `semanticLabel`; Enter and Space activate; visible focus ring.
- 44x44 hit area around the 40px visual.

## Motion

Press feedback from `CdsPressable`: `bgSecondary` tint appears on pointer-down and the button scales to 0.98 (no scale under reduced motion).

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `name` | `name` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |
| `onPress` | `onPress` |
| `active` | `active` |
| `size` | `size` |
| `color` | `color` |
| `disabled` | `disabled` |

# CdsNavigationBar

A top navigation bar with the title next to the back button, end actions, an optional bottom row, and a hairline underneath. Matches CDS `NavigationBar`, with mobile shortcuts for the common back plus title case.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/navigation/NavigationBar

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsNavigationBar(
  title: 'Bitcoin',
  subtitle: 'BTC',
  onBack: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for detail screens where the title belongs with the back button.
- Use [CdsTopNavBar](CdsTopNavBar.md) for a centered title.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title | `String?` | `null` | Shown with [CdsNavigationTitle](CdsNavigationTitle.md). |
| subtitle | `String?` | `null` | Shown with [CdsNavigationSubtitle](CdsNavigationSubtitle.md) under the title. |
| child | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom content; overrides `title` and `subtitle`. |
| onBack | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Shows a back button in the start slot. |
| backIcon | `CdsIconName` | `CdsIconName.arrowLeft` | Becomes `arrowRight` in RTL when left at the default. |
| backAccessibilityLabel | `String` | `'Back'` | Back button label. |
| start | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom leading control; overrides the back button. |
| end | `Widget?` | `null` | Trailing actions. |
| bottom | `Widget?` | `null` | Full-width row below the bar. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String` | `'main navigation'` | Names the bar region. |
| background | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bg` | Bar background. |
| bordered | `bool` | `true` | `bgLine` hairline under the bar. |
| paddingX | `double` | `2` | Space token. |
| paddingTop | `double` | `2` | Space token, below the top safe area. |
| paddingBottom | `double?` | `2` without `bottom`, `0` with it | Space token. |
| columnGap | `double` | `1` | Space token between start, content and end. |
| rowGap | `double` | `1` | Space token between the bar and `bottom`. |
| respectSafeArea | `bool` | `true` | Adds the top safe area above the bar. |

## Examples

### With actions

```dart
CdsNavigationBar(
  title: 'Bitcoin',
  onBack: pop,
  end: Row(
    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
    children: [
      CdsNavBarIconButton(CdsIconName.star, semanticLabel: 'Add to watchlist', onPress: watch),
      CdsNavBarIconButton(CdsIconName.share, semanticLabel: 'Share', onPress: share),
    ],
  ),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The bar is a labelled container; title and subtitle are headers.
- The back button is a labelled 44px button and mirrors in RTL.
- At large text sizes the title ellipsizes and the bar grows taller.

## Motion

The start slot collapses or expands (`CdsDurations.fast1`, `CdsCurves.global`) when it is added or removed; instant under reduced motion.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop (web `NavigationBar`) | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `start` | `start` (or `onBack`) |
| `children` | `child` (or `title` / `subtitle`) |
| `end` | `end` |
| `bottom` | `bottom` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `accessibilityLabel` |
| `background` | `background` |
| `paddingX`, `paddingTop`, `paddingBottom` | same |
| `columnGap`, `rowGap` | same |

# CdsNavigationSubtitle

A muted second line under a [CdsNavigationTitle], also exposed as a header.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/navigation/NavigationTitle (`NavigationSubtitle`)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsNavigationSubtitle('Step 2 of 3')
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for short context under a navigation title: a ticker, a step count, an account name.
- [CdsNavigationBar](CdsNavigationBar.md) renders it for you via `subtitle`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| subtitle | `String` | required (positional) | Text. |
| font | `CdsFont` | `CdsFont.label2` | Font. |
| color | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.fgMuted` | Color. |
| maxLines | `int?` | `1` | Ellipsizes beyond this. |
| align | `TextAlign?` | `null` | Alignment. |

## Examples

### Under a centered title

```dart
CdsTopNavBar(
  child: const Column(
    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
    children: [CdsNavigationTitle('Send'), CdsNavigationSubtitle('USDC')],
  ),
)
```

## Accessibility

Exposed with the header flag, matching CDS.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `subtitle` |
| `font` | `font` |
| `color` | `color` |

# CdsNavigationTitle

The title in a navigation bar: headline text marked as a header for screen readers.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/navigation/NavigationTitle

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsNavigationTitle('Send Bitcoin')
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use in the middle of [CdsTopNavBar](CdsTopNavBar.md) or as custom content of [CdsNavigationBar](CdsNavigationBar.md).
- Use [CdsNavigationTitleSelect](CdsNavigationTitleSelect.md) when the title opens a picker.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title | `String` | required (positional) | Text. |
| font | `CdsFont` | `CdsFont.headline` | Font. |
| color | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.fg` | Color. |
| maxLines | `int?` | `1` | Ellipsizes beyond this. |
| align | `TextAlign?` | `null` | Alignment. |

## Examples

### Two lines

```dart
const CdsNavigationTitle('Recurring buy for Ethereum', maxLines: 2, align: TextAlign.center)
```

## Accessibility

Exposed with the header flag so screen reader users can jump to it.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `title` |
| `font` | `font` |
| `color` | `color` |
| `numberOfLines` | `maxLines` |
| `accessibilityRole="header"` | always a header |

---
source: doc/components/CdsNavigationTitleSelect.md

# CdsNavigationTitleSelect

A navigation title with a caret that opens a picker, for example to switch between portfolios or accounts.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/navigation/NavigationTitleSelect

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
bool open = false;

CdsNavigationTitleSelect(
  label: 'Main portfolio',
  open: open,
  onPress: () async {
    setState(() => open = true);
    await showMyPortfolioPicker(context);
    setState(() => open = false);
  },
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use when the screen's content depends on one choice the user switches occasionally.
- This widget only renders the trigger and calls `onPress`. Open your own tray, sheet or menu there.
- Use a regular select input for form fields.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | `String` | required | The selected option's label. |
| onPress | `VoidCallback?` | required | Opens your picker. `null` disables the trigger. |
| open | `bool` | `false` | Pass `true` while your picker is showing: the caret flips and the expanded state is announced. |
| color | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.fg` | Text and caret color. |
| font | `CdsFont` | `CdsFont.headline` | Label font. |
| semanticHint | `String?` | `null` | Spoken after the label, for example `'Switch portfolio'`. |

## Examples

### In a top navigation bar

```dart
CdsTopNavBar(
  start: CdsNavBarIconButton(CdsIconName.arrowLeft, semanticLabel: 'Back', onPress: pop),
  child: CdsNavigationTitleSelect(label: portfolio, open: open, onPress: openPicker),
)
```

## Accessibility

- Button with the header flag, expanded state from `open`, and an optional hint.
- 44px minimum hit area; Enter and Space activate.
- Presses within 500ms of the previous one are ignored, so a double tap does not open two pickers.

## Motion

The caret rotates 180 degrees over `CdsDurations.moderate1` with `CdsCurves.global` when `open` changes; instant under reduced motion.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `options`, `value` | resolve the label yourself and pass `label` |
| `onChange` | handled by your picker; this widget calls `onPress` |
| `color`, `font` | `color`, `font` |

Deviation: CDS opens its own `Tray` with option cells. Overlays live in another part of this package, so this widget leaves the picker to the caller and exposes `open` for the caret and semantics.

# CdsNudgeCard

A soft prompt toward a next step, with optional media, a text call to action and a dismiss button.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/cards/NudgeCard

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsNudgeCard(
  title: 'Add a backup',
  description: 'Save your recovery phrase so you keep access.',
  action: 'Back up now',
  onActionPress: startBackup,
  onDismissPress: dismiss,
  media: const CdsIcon(CdsIconName.shield, size: CdsIconSize.l),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

CDS deprecates NudgeCard; prefer `CdsMessagingCard` with `type: nudge` for new screens.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` / `titleNode` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | `headline`. |
| `description` / `descriptionNode` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | `label2`. |
| `media` | `Widget?` | `null` | Pictogram names are not supported (pictograms are not bundled); pass artwork. |
| `mediaPosition` | `CdsNudgeCardMediaPosition` | `right` | `left` or `right`. |
| `action` | `String?` | `null` | Primary-colored text call to action. |
| `actionNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Wins over `action`. |
| `onActionPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `onDismissPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Transparent close button in the top end corner. |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Whole-card press. |
| `maxLines` | `int` | `3` | Line limit for title and description. |
| `width` | `double?` | parent width | |
| `minHeight` | `double?` | `null` | |
| `background` | `CdsColor` | `bgAlternate` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | "Dismiss the {title} card" | Dismiss button label. |

## Accessibility

Dismiss and action are separate buttons; a pressable card is one button labelled with its title and description.

## Motion

Pressable cards tint and scale to 0.98 on pointer-down; no scale under reduced motion.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `title`, `description`, `action` (string / node) | `x` / `xNode` |
| `pictogram` | not supported; use `media` |
| `media`, `mediaPosition`, `onActionPress`, `onDismissPress`, `onPress`, `width`, `minHeight`, `background` | same names |
| `numberOfLines` | `maxLines` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |

# CdsNumpad

An on-screen keypad for entering amounts (digits, a decimal separator and backspace), used on buy, sell and send screens where the system keyboard would cover the amount.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/Numpad

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
String amount = '';

CdsNumpad(
  onPress: (key) => setState(() => amount = CdsNumpad.apply(amount, key, maxDecimals: 2)),
  onClear: () => setState(() => amount = ''),
)
```

The numpad holds no value. You keep the string and update it from `onPress`. `CdsNumpad.apply` implements the usual amount rules so you do not have to.

## When to use / when not to

- Use for numeric amounts on a dedicated entry screen.
- Do not use for free text, phone numbers with symbols, or one-time codes (use `CdsOtpInput`). For a numeric field inside a form, use `CdsTextInput` with `keyboardType: TextInputType.number`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onPress` | `ValueChanged<CdsNumpadKey>` | required | Called for every key press. |
| `onLongPress` | `ValueChanged<CdsNumpadKey>?` | `null` | Called when any key is long-pressed. |
| `onClear` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called when backspace is long-pressed. Clear the value here. |
| `separator` | `String` | `'.'` | Text on the separator key. `''` hides the key. |
| `hideSeparator` | `bool` | `false` | Hides the separator key, keeps its slot, removes it from the accessibility tree. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Dims the keys and blocks presses. |
| `accessory` | `Widget?` | `null` | Shown above the keys, e.g. the amount or a max button. |
| `action` | `Widget?` | `null` | Shown below the keys, e.g. a `CdsButton`. |
| `gap` | `double` | `2` | Space token between `accessory`, keys and `action`. |
| `background` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Fill behind the whole numpad. |
| `feedback` | `CdsHapticFeedback` | `light` | Haptic on each key press. |
| `separatorSemanticLabel` | `String` | `'period'` | Screen reader label for the separator key. |
| `deleteSemanticLabel` | `String` | `'delete'` | Screen reader label for backspace. |

### CdsNumpadKey

A sealed class. Switch over it exhaustively:

| Key | Constructor / constant | Subclass |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Digit 0 to 9 | `CdsNumpadKey.digit(int value)` | `CdsNumpadDigit` (field `value`) |
| Separator | `CdsNumpadKey.separator` | `CdsNumpadSeparator` |
| Backspace | `CdsNumpadKey.delete` | `CdsNumpadDelete` |

### CdsNumpad.apply

`static String apply(String value, CdsNumpadKey key, {String separator = '.', int? maxDecimals, int? maxLength})`

- delete removes the last character;
- the separator is added once, as `0.` when the value is empty, and ignored when `separator` is empty or `maxDecimals` is `0`;
- a leading `0` is replaced by the next digit;
- digits stop once `maxDecimals` decimals or `maxLength` characters exist.

## Examples

### Amount with a review button

```dart
CdsNumpad(
  accessory: CdsText(amount.isEmpty ? r'$0' : '\$$amount', font: CdsFont.display3, tabularNumbers: true),
  action: CdsButton(label: 'Review order', block: true, onPress: amount.isEmpty ? null : review),
  onPress: (key) => setState(() => amount = CdsNumpad.apply(amount, key, maxDecimals: 2)),
  onClear: () => setState(() => amount = ''),
)
```

### Whole numbers with a comma locale

```dart
CdsNumpad(
  hideSeparator: true,
  onPress: (key) => setState(() => shares = CdsNumpad.apply(shares, key, maxDecimals: 0)),
)

CdsNumpad(
  separator: ',',
  onPress: (key) => setState(() => amount = CdsNumpad.apply(amount, key, separator: ',')),
)
```

### Reacting to each key

```dart
onPress: (key) {
  switch (key) {
    case CdsNumpadDigit(:final value): log('digit $value');
    case CdsNumpadSeparator(): log('separator');
    case CdsNumpadDelete(): log('delete');
  }
}
```

## Accessibility

- Each key is a button labeled with its digit, `separatorSemanticLabel` or `deleteSemanticLabel`.
- Keys are in Tab order and activate with Enter or Space. While a key has focus, hardware digits, `.`/`,` and Backspace also work.
- Keys are 48px tall and one third of the width, above the 44px minimum.

## Motion

Each key tints and scales to 0.98 on pointer-down (`CdsPressable`). Presses within 100ms of the previous one are ignored, like CDS. A light haptic fires on each press; long-press fires a medium haptic.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `onPress(value: number \| 'SEPARATOR' \| 'DELETE')` | `onPress(CdsNumpadKey)` |
| `onLongPress` | `onLongPress` (plus `onClear` for backspace) |
| `separator`, `hideSeparator`, `disabled`, `accessory`, `action`, `gap`, `background` | same names |
| `separatorAccessibilityLabel` | `separatorSemanticLabel` |
| `deleteAccessibilityLabel` | `deleteSemanticLabel` |
| `feedback` (default `none`) | `feedback` (default `light`, see note) |

Note: CDS defaults `feedback` to none. This port defaults to a light haptic so each key press is felt; pass `CdsHapticFeedback.none` to match CDS.

---
source: doc/components/CdsOtpInput.md
---

# CdsOtpInput

A one-time code field drawn as separate cells, for verification codes sent by SMS or email. Not part of CDS; it is built from the same field border, focus and helper text tokens as `CdsTextInput`.

CDS reference: none (extra component). Field styling follows https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/TextInput

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsOtpInput(
  label: 'Verification code',
  value: code,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => code = v),
  onComplete: verify,
)
```

Control it with `value` + `onChange`, or with a `controller`.

## When to use / when not to

- Use for short fixed-length codes: SMS or email verification, two-factor codes, PINs.
- Use `CdsTextInput` for codes of unknown length or long recovery phrases.

## Behavior

- One hidden text field drives all cells. Typing fills the next cell; backspace clears the last filled cell and moves back.
- Pasting a code fills every cell. Characters the formatter rejects are dropped and extra characters are cut at `length`.
- The platform's one-time-code autofill is enabled (`AutofillHints.oneTimeCode`).
- The caret always sits after the last character, so cells fill in order.
- `onComplete` fires each time the code reaches `length` characters.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `length` | `int` | `6` | Number of cells. Must be positive. |
| `controller` | `TextEditingController?` | `null` | Owns the code when given. |
| `value` | `String?` | `null` | Code to show when no controller is given. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Whole code after every edit. |
| `onComplete` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Code reached `length` characters. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Label above the cells. Tapping it focuses the field. |
| `helperText` | `String?` | `null` | Text under the cells, colored by `variant`. |
| `helperTextErrorIconSemanticLabel` | `String` | `'error'` | |
| `variant` | `CdsInputVariant` | `foregroundMuted` | `negative` marks every cell invalid and shows the error icon. |
| `obscureText` | `bool` | `false` | Show a dot for each character. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Not editable, 50% opacity. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `keyboardType` | `TextInputType` | `TextInputType.number` | |
| `inputFormatters` | `List<TextInputFormatter>?` | `null` (digits only) | Replaces the digits-only filter. |
| `font` | `CdsFont` | `CdsFont.title3` | Ramp entry for the characters. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Defaults to `label`, then `'Verification code'`. |

Cells share the available width equally with 8px gaps. Each cell is at least 52px tall (12px vertical padding plus the `title3` line height) and grows with text scale.

## Examples

### Error after a failed check

```dart
CdsOtpInput(
  value: code,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => code = v),
  variant: failed ? CdsInputVariant.negative : CdsInputVariant.foregroundMuted,
  helperText: failed ? 'That code is not right. Check the latest SMS and try again.' : null,
)
```

### Letters and digits

```dart
CdsOtpInput(
  length: 8,
  keyboardType: TextInputType.text,
  inputFormatters: [FilteringTextInputFormatter.allow(RegExp('[A-Z0-9]'))],
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => code = v),
)
```

### PIN

```dart
const CdsOtpInput(label: 'PIN', length: 4, obscureText: true)
```

## Accessibility

- Screen readers see one text field labeled `semanticLabel ?? label ?? 'Verification code'`, with a hint that names the position, for example "Digit 3 of 6", or "All 6 digits entered". The visual cells are hidden from the semantics tree.
- With `obscureText`, the field value is obscured for screen readers too.
- `negative` helper text is a live region and carries an info icon.
- Reachable with Tab; the active cell shows the focus border.

## Motion

The active cell's focus border cross-fades in `CdsDurations.moderate1` (`enterFunctional` in, `exitFunctional` out) as it moves from cell to cell. Reduced motion makes it instant.

## CDS React Native mapping

Not in CDS. Closest equivalents:

| CDS concept | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| TextInput `variant`, `helperText`, `label` | same names |
| TextInput `secureTextEntry` | `obscureText` |
| TextInput `keyboardType` | `keyboardType` |

source: doc/components/CdsOverlay.md

# CdsOverlay

The dimmed scrim CDS draws behind modals, alerts, trays and tours.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/overlay/Overlay

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsOverlay(onPress: () => Navigator.of(context).maybePop())
```

## When to use / when not to

Built into every CDS overlay. Use it directly when building a custom overlay. It fills its parent.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| opacity | `double` | `1` | 0 hides, 1 shows the full `bgOverlay` color. |
| onPress | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Tap handler. |
| semanticLabel | `String?` | `null` | Makes the scrim a labelled button for screen readers when `onPress` is set (for example "Dismiss"). |

## Examples

### Dim in step with a custom sheet

```dart
AnimatedBuilder(
  animation: sheetProgress,
  builder: (context, _) => CdsOverlay(opacity: sheetProgress.value, onPress: close),
)
```

## Accessibility

Hidden from screen readers unless `semanticLabel` and `onPress` are both set.

## Motion

None of its own; animate `opacity`.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `opacity` (Animated value) | `opacity` (`double`) |
| `onTouchStart` / `onClick` | `onPress` |

# CdsPageFooter

The bottom bar of a page that holds its main action, with optional legal text underneath.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/navigation/PageFooter

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsPageFooter(
  action: CdsButton(label: 'Continue', block: true, onPress: next),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for the one primary action of a flow step.
- Wrap it in [CdsStickyFooter](CdsStickyFooter.md) or pass it as [CdsScaffold](CdsScaffold.md)'s `footer` to pin it above the keyboard and home indicator.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| action | `Widget` | required | Usually a block `CdsButton` or a button group. |
| legalText | `String?` | `null` | `legal`, `fgMuted`, centered under the action with a 16px gap. |
| background | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Fill behind the footer. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Names the footer region. |

Layout: 24px horizontal and 12px vertical padding; at least 80px tall without legal text; content centered.

## Examples

### With legal text

```dart
CdsPageFooter(
  action: CdsButton(label: 'Buy Bitcoin', block: true, onPress: buy),
  legalText: 'Prices update every 30 seconds.',
)
```

## Accessibility

A labelled container when `accessibilityLabel` is set; the action keeps its own button semantics.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `action` | `action` |
| `legalText` | `legalText` |
| `background` | `background` |
| `accessibilityRole="toolbar"` | labelled container via `accessibilityLabel` |

# CdsPageHeader

The header at the top of a page's content: a large `title1` title with optional start and end controls.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/navigation/PageHeader

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsPageHeader(
  start: CdsNavBarIconButton(CdsIconName.close, semanticLabel: 'Close', onPress: close),
  title: 'Verify your identity',
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for flows and full-screen tasks (onboarding, verification, empty and error pages) where the title is the page's main heading.
- Use [CdsTopNavBar](CdsTopNavBar.md) or [CdsNavigationBar](CdsNavigationBar.md) for compact app-bar style navigation.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| start | `Widget?` | `null` | Leading control, inset by 24px. |
| title | `String?` | `null` | Shown in `title1` as a header. |
| titleWidget | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom title; overrides `title`. |
| end | `Widget?` | `null` | Trailing control, inset by 24px. |
| background | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Fill behind the header. |

Layout: the first row is at least 72px tall with 8px vertical padding. With `start`, a title and `end` all set, the controls share the first row and the title moves to a second row.

## Examples

### Title with both controls

```dart
CdsPageHeader(
  start: CdsNavBarIconButton(CdsIconName.arrowLeft, semanticLabel: 'Back', onPress: pop),
  title: 'Review order',
  end: CdsNavBarIconButton(CdsIconName.info, semanticLabel: 'Help', onPress: help),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The title is exposed as a header.
- The row grows with text size; nothing clips at 200% text.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `start` | `start` |
| `title` (string or node) | `title` / `titleWidget` |
| `end` | `end` |
| `background` | `background` |

# CdsPageIndicator

A row of dots showing which page of a paged view is visible; the active dot stretches into a short bar. `CdsCarousel` uses it as its pagination, and you can pair it with your own `PageView`.

CDS reference: none. This is a cds_flutter extra built from CDS tokens.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsPageIndicator(
  totalPages: 4,
  activePageIndex: page,
  onPressPage: (index) => controller.goToPage(index),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it under paged content to show position. Do not use it as the only way to navigate: the dots are small. Pair it with swipe or previous/next buttons.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `totalPages` | `int` | required | Number of dots. |
| `activePageIndex` | `int` | required | Zero-based active page. |
| `onPressPage` | `ValueChanged<int>?` | `null` | Called with a page index when its dot is pressed. Null makes the dots display-only. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `String Function(int)?` | `Go to page N` | Label for each dot. |

Dots are 4px tall, 4px wide (24px when active), radius token 100, 4px apart, `bgPrimary` when active and `bgLine` otherwise.

## Examples

### With a PageView

```dart
PageView(
  controller: pageController,
  onPageChanged: (i) => setState(() => page = i),
  children: pages,
),
CdsPageIndicator(
  totalPages: pages.length,
  activePageIndex: page,
  onPressPage: (i) => pageController.animateToPage(i, duration: CdsDurations.moderate3, curve: CdsCurves.global),
)
```

## Accessibility

Each dot is a button with `selected` state and a label. Hit areas are padded to 44px tall; horizontally they are the dot plus its share of the gap, so they stay small.

## Motion

The width change animates over `fast1` with `CdsCurves.global`; instant under reduced motion.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop (`DefaultCarouselPagination`) | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `totalPages` | `totalPages` |
| `activePageIndex` | `activePageIndex` |
| `onPressPage` | `onPressPage` |
| `paginationAccessibilityLabel` | `accessibilityLabel` |
| `variant` (`'pill'`, deprecated) | not ported |

---
source: doc/components/CdsPagination.md
---

# CdsPagination

A row of page buttons with previous and next controls, for moving through paged lists and tables.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/navigation/Pagination

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsPagination(
  totalPages: 12,
  activePage: page,
  onChange: (next) => setState(() => page = next),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use for data split into numbered pages, such as transaction history or a table, where users jump to a specific page. For a short swipeable set of cards use `CdsCarousel` with its page dots. For infinite feeds, load more on scroll instead.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `totalPages` | `int` | required | Number of pages. Values below 1 are treated as 1. |
| `activePage` | `int` | required | Current page, 1-based. Must be within `1..totalPages`. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<int>` | required | Receives the page the user picked. Not called for the current page. |
| `siblingCount` | `int` | `1` | Pages shown on each side of the active page. |
| `boundaryCount` | `int` | `1` | Pages always shown at the start and end. |
| `showFirstLastButtons` | `bool` | `false` | Adds "First" and "Last" text buttons at the ends. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Disables every control. |
| `firstPageButtonLabel` | `String` | `'First'` | Text of the first-page button. |
| `lastPageButtonLabel` | `String` | `'Last'` | Text of the last-page button. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `String` | `'Pagination'` | Label for the whole group. |
| `accessibilityLabels` | `CdsPaginationAccessibilityLabels` | `CdsPaginationAccessibilityLabels()` | Screen reader labels: `next` ('Next page'), `previous` ('Previous page'), `first` ('First page'), `last` ('Last page'), `page` (`(n) => 'Page $n'`). |

`cdsPaginationItems({required int activePage, required int totalPages, int siblingCount = 1, int boundaryCount = 1})` returns the `List<CdsPaginationItem>` the row renders: `CdsPaginationPageItem(page, selected:)` or `CdsPaginationEllipsisItem()`. It is the CDS `usePagination` algorithm and is handy for custom layouts and tests.

## Examples

### With first and last buttons

```dart
CdsPagination(
  totalPages: 40,
  activePage: page,
  showFirstLastButtons: true,
  onChange: (next) => setState(() => page = next),
)
```

### Wider window around the active page

```dart
CdsPagination(
  totalPages: 20,
  activePage: 10,
  siblingCount: 2,
  boundaryCount: 2,
  onChange: (_) {},
)
// 1 2 ... 8 9 [10] 11 12 ... 19 20
```

## Accessibility

- The row is a semantics group labelled `accessibilityLabel`. Each page button reads "Page N"; the current page carries the selected state.
- The ellipsis is hidden from screen readers.
- Left and Right arrow keys move focus between page buttons (mirrored in RTL); Enter or Space activates.
- When previous or next becomes disabled after a press, focus moves to the first or last page button instead of being lost.
- All controls have 44px hit areas. The row wraps instead of overflowing at large text sizes.

## Motion

Buttons use `CdsPressable` press feedback (tint and 0.98 scale on pointer-down). Page changes are instant.

## CDS React Native mapping

CDS ships Pagination for web only; this port follows the web API.

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `totalPages` | `totalPages` |
| `activePage` | `activePage` |
| `onChange` | `onChange` |
| `siblingCount` | `siblingCount` |
| `boundaryCount` | `boundaryCount` |
| `showFirstLastButtons` | `showFirstLastButtons` |
| `disabled` | `disabled` |
| `firstPageButtonLabel` / `lastPageButtonLabel` | `firstPageButtonLabel` / `lastPageButtonLabel` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `accessibilityLabel` |
| `accessibilityLabels` | `accessibilityLabels` |
| `PaginationPageButtonComponent` and other component overrides | not supported; build a custom row from `cdsPaginationItems` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsPercentageBarChart.md
