# CdsPercentageBarChart

A part-to-whole bar: each series is a segment sized by its share of the total. Horizontal by default.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/charts/PercentageBarChart

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsPercentageBarChart(
  height: 16,
  series: [
    CdsPercentageBarSeries.single(id: 'a', value: 70, label: 'Segment A', color: CdsColor.fgPositive),
    CdsPercentageBarSeries.single(id: 'b', value: 45, label: 'Segment B', color: CdsColor.fgNegative),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for a split that sums to a whole: buy versus sell volume, allocation, vote shares.
- Pass several values per series to draw one bar per group (rows when horizontal).
- Negative values, null and missing indices count as zero. If every group sums to zero, nothing is drawn; show an empty state around it.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `series` | `List<CdsPercentageBarSeries>` | `const []` | Segments. `data` is `List<double?>` (one value per bar); `CdsPercentageBarSeries.single(value: ...)` fills the first bar only. |
| `layout` | `CdsChartLayout` | `horizontal` | Bar orientation. |
| `roundBaseline` | `bool` | `true` | Round the start of the bar too. |
| `inset` | `CdsChartInset` | `const CdsChartInset()` | No space around the bar by default. |
| `borderRadius` | `double` | `4` | Segment corner radius. `1000` makes pill ends. |
| `stackGap` | `double` | `0` | Pixel gap between segments; the bar keeps its full length. |
| `barMinSize` | `double` | `0` | Minimum segment length in pixels. |
| `barPadding` | `double` | `0.1` | Band fraction between groups. |
| `showXAxis`, `showYAxis` | `bool` | `false` | Render axes. The value axis is fixed to 0 to 100; the category axis padding defaults to 0. |
| `xAxis`, `yAxis`, `xAxisStyle`, `yAxisStyle` | see `CdsBarChart` | | Axis configuration and visuals. |
| `animate` | `bool` | `true` | Grow and morph segments. |
| `legend`, `legendPosition` | `Widget?`, `CdsLegendPosition` | `null`, `bottom` | Legend. |
| `width`, `height` | `double?` | `null` | Size. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Defaults to each segment's label and rounded share, for example "Buy 61%". |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | `const []` | Extra elements. |

## Examples

### Pill ends with gaps

```dart
CdsPercentageBarChart(
  height: 28,
  borderRadius: 1000,
  stackGap: 2,
  series: [
    CdsPercentageBarSeries.single(id: 'a', value: 45, label: 'A', dangerouslySetColor: context.cds.spectrum.of(CdsHue.purple, 30)),
    CdsPercentageBarSeries.single(id: 'b', value: 30, label: 'B', dangerouslySetColor: context.cds.spectrum.of(CdsHue.blue, 30)),
    CdsPercentageBarSeries.single(id: 'c', value: 20, label: 'C', dangerouslySetColor: context.cds.spectrum.of(CdsHue.teal, 30)),
  ],
)
```

### Several groups with labels

```dart
const CdsPercentageBarChart(
  height: 100,
  stackGap: 2,
  showYAxis: true,
  yAxis: CdsAxisConfig(data: ['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3'], categoryPadding: 0.45),
  yAxisStyle: CdsYAxis(position: CdsYAxisPosition.left),
  series: [
    CdsPercentageBarSeries(id: 'a', data: [40, null, 20], label: 'A', color: CdsColor.fgPositive),
    CdsPercentageBarSeries(id: 'b', data: [-10, 60, 30], label: 'B', color: CdsColor.fgWarning),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

The chart is one node labeled with every segment's share of the first group. Pass `accessibilityLabel` for multi-group charts or localized text, and show the shares as text (a legend with percentages) so color is never the only cue.

## Motion

Segments grow from the start on first render and morph with the CDS update spring when shares change. Instant under reduced motion.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `series` (`data: number | number[]`) | `series` (`CdsPercentageBarSeries` / `.single`) |
| `layout`, `roundBaseline`, `inset` | same names, same defaults |
| `borderRadius`, `stackGap`, `barMinSize` | same names |
| other `BarChart` props | see `CdsBarChart` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsPeriodSelector.md
---

# CdsPeriodSelector

Chart period tabs (1H, 1D, 1W...) with a pill that slides to the active tab.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/charts/PeriodSelector

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsPeriodSelector(
  tabs: const [
    CdsPeriodSelectorTab(id: '1D', label: '1D'),
    CdsPeriodSelectorTab(id: '1W', label: '1W'),
    CdsPeriodSelectorTab(id: '1M', label: '1M'),
  ],
  activeTab: '1D',
  onChange: (id) {},
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it under or above a chart to switch its time range. It is controlled: keep the active id in state and update it in `onChange`.
- `CdsSparklineInteractive` has its own built-in period row; use this with `CdsLineChart` and other charts.
- For general content switching use segmented tabs instead.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tabs` | `List<CdsPeriodSelectorTab>` | required | Options: `id`, `label`, optional `labelWidget` and `semanticLabel`. |
| `activeTab` | `String?` | required | Id of the selected tab, or null. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String>` | required | Called with the pressed tab's id (not for the already active tab). |
| `background` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.transparent` | Track color. |
| `activeBackground` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bgPrimaryWash` | Sliding pill color. |
| `color` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.fg` | Inactive label color. |
| `activeColor` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.fgPrimary` | Active label color. |
| `font` | `CdsFont` | `CdsFont.label1` | Label ramp entry. |
| `block` | `bool` | `true` | Spread tabs across the full width (CDS `width: 100%`, `space-between`). |
| `gap` | `double` | `0` | Space token between tabs when `block` is false. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Disable every tab. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Label for the group. |

`CdsLiveTabLabel({label = 'LIVE', color = CdsColor.fgNegative, font = CdsFont.label1, hideDot = false})` is a ready-made `labelWidget` for a real-time period.

## Examples

### Live period

```dart
class PeriodPicker extends StatefulWidget {
  const PeriodPicker({super.key});

  @override
  State<PeriodPicker> createState() => _PeriodPickerState();
}

class _PeriodPickerState extends State<PeriodPicker> {
  String _period = 'LIVE';

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final live = _period == 'LIVE';
    return CdsPeriodSelector(
      activeBackground: live ? CdsColor.bgNegativeWash : CdsColor.bgPrimaryWash,
      activeColor: live ? CdsColor.fgNegative : CdsColor.fgPrimary,
      tabs: const [
        CdsPeriodSelectorTab(id: 'LIVE', label: 'LIVE', labelWidget: CdsLiveTabLabel(), semanticLabel: 'Live'),
        CdsPeriodSelectorTab(id: '1D', label: '1D'),
        CdsPeriodSelectorTab(id: '1W', label: '1W'),
      ],
      activeTab: _period,
      onChange: (id) => setState(() => _period = id),
    );
  }
}
```

## Accessibility

- Each tab is a button with selected state and a 44x44 hit area. `1H`, `1D`, `1W`, `1M` and `1Y` are read as "1 hour", "1 day" and so on; set `semanticLabel` for other labels.
- Keyboard: Tab focuses a tab, Enter or Space selects it, Left and Right arrows move the selection within the group (mirrored in RTL).
- A selection haptic fires on change.

## Motion

The pill slides to the new tab with `CdsSprings.standard`, starting from wherever it is, and labels cross-fade color over 150ms. Under reduced motion the pill jumps.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `tabs` (`{id, label}`) | `tabs` (`CdsPeriodSelectorTab`) |
| `activeTab` (tab object) | `activeTab` (tab id) |
| `onChange` | `onChange` (receives the id) |
| `background`, `activeBackground`, `activeColor`, `font` | same names |
| `width="100%"` / `fit-content` | `block: true` / `false` |
| `gap` | `gap` |
| `LiveTabLabel` | `CdsLiveTabLabel` |
| `TabComponent`, `TabsActiveIndicatorComponent` | not ported |

# CdsPoint

A circle marking one coordinate in data space, with an optional label.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/charts/Point

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsLineChart(
  height: 200,
  series: [CdsLineSeries(id: 'a', data: [10, 22, 29, 45, 98, 45])],
  children: [CdsPoint(dataX: 4, dataY: 98, label: 'High', labelPosition: CdsPointLabelPosition.top)],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it to call out specific values: a high, a low, a purchase.
- For a marker at every value, use `points: true` on the line instead.
- Points outside the drawing area are hidden.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataX` | `double` | required | X in data space (the category index in vertical charts). |
| `dataY` | `double` | required | Y in data space (the value in vertical charts). |
| `fill` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Fill token. Defaults to `fgPrimary`. |
| `dangerouslySetFill` | `Color?` | `null` | Raw fill color. |
| `radius` | `double` | `5` | Radius in pixels. |
| `stroke` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Ring color. Defaults to `bg`, so the point reads as cut out of the line. |
| `strokeWidth` | `double` | `2` | Ring width; 0 removes it. |
| `opacity` | `double` | `1` | Point and label opacity. |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Text near the point (`label2`, `fgMuted` by default). |
| `labelPosition` | `CdsPointLabelPosition` | `center` | `top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right` or `center`. |
| `labelOffset` | `double?` | `null` | Distance from the point. Defaults to twice the radius. |
| `labelFont` | `CdsFont` | `CdsFont.label2` | Label ramp entry. |
| `animate` | `bool?` | `null` | Overrides the chart's `animate`. |

## Examples

### Low and high markers

```dart
const CdsLineChart(
  height: 200,
  series: [CdsLineSeries(id: 'a', data: [30, 12, 25, 40, 33])],
  children: [
    CdsPoint(dataX: 1, dataY: 12, label: 'Low', labelPosition: CdsPointLabelPosition.bottom, fill: CdsColor.fgNegative),
    CdsPoint(dataX: 3, dataY: 40, label: 'High', labelPosition: CdsPointLabelPosition.top, fill: CdsColor.fgPositive),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

Points are painted; include what they mark in the chart's `accessibilityLabel` (for example "High 40 on Thursday").

## Motion

Points fade in after the line reveal (150ms after a 350ms delay) and follow data changes with the CDS update spring. Instant under reduced motion.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `dataX`, `dataY`, `radius`, `strokeWidth`, `opacity` | same names |
| `fill` | `fill` or `dangerouslySetFill` |
| `stroke` | `stroke` |
| `label`, `labelPosition`, `labelOffset`, `labelFont` | same names |
| `xAxisId`, `yAxisId`, `LabelComponent`, `transitions` | not ported |

# CdsPopoverPanel

A panel anchored to a trigger for content that does not need a full modal, such as filters, account switchers or short forms.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/overlay/PopoverPanel

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsPopoverPanel(
  builder: (context, controller) => CdsButton(label: 'Filters', onPress: controller.toggle),
  contentBuilder: (context, close) => Padding(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
    child: CdsButton(label: 'Show top gainers', onPress: close),
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use on wide screens for secondary content tied to a control. On phones prefer `CdsTray`. For a list of options use `CdsDropdown`; for a one-line hint use `CdsTooltip`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| builder | `CdsPopoverTriggerBuilder` | required | `Widget Function(BuildContext, CdsPopoverController)`; call `controller.toggle` from the trigger's `onPress`. |
| content | `Widget?` | `null` | Panel content. One of `content` or `contentBuilder` is required. |
| contentBuilder | `CdsPopoverContentBuilder?` | `null` | `Widget Function(BuildContext, VoidCallback closePopover)`; overrides `content`. |
| controller | `CdsPopoverController?` | `null` | Control open state from outside. |
| placement | `CdsPlacement` | `CdsPlacement.bottomStart` | Preferred position; flips when it does not fit. |
| gap | `double` | `0.5` | Space token between trigger and panel. |
| panelWidth | `double?` | `null` | Fixed width. |
| minPanelWidth | `double?` | `null` | Minimum width. |
| maxPanelWidth | `double?` | `null` | Maximum width. |
| panelHeight | `double?` | `null` | Fixed height. |
| maxPanelHeight | `double?` | `null` | Maximum height; otherwise limited to the space on the chosen side. |
| showOverlay | `bool` | `false` | Dim the page; tapping the scrim closes. |
| block | `bool` | `false` | Trigger and panel take the parent's width. |
| disabled | `bool` | `false` | Keep the panel closed. |
| onOpen | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called on open. |
| onClose | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called on close. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Label for the panel. |
| restoreFocusOnUnmount | `bool` | `true` | Return focus to the trigger on close. |

Panel surface: `bg`, 1px `bgLine` border, radius 400, elevation 2. Content scrolls inside the panel.

### CdsPopoverController

`CdsPopoverController({bool initiallyOpen = false})`, a `ChangeNotifier` with `isOpen`, `open()`, `close()`, `toggle()`. Shared by `CdsPopoverPanel`, `CdsDropdown`.

### CdsPlacement

`top`, `topStart`, `topEnd`, `bottom`, `bottomStart`, `bottomEnd`, `left`, `leftStart`, `leftEnd`, `right`, `rightStart`, `rightEnd`. `start`/`end` alignments follow text direction for top and bottom placements.

## Examples

### Controlled from outside

```dart
final controller = CdsPopoverController();

CdsPopoverPanel(
  controller: controller,
  placement: CdsPlacement.bottomEnd,
  builder: (context, c) => CdsIconButton(CdsIconName.more, semanticLabel: 'More', onPress: c.toggle),
  content: const Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(16), child: CdsText('Sample data: account details')),
)
```

## Accessibility

Focus moves into the panel and is trapped while open; Escape or a tap outside closes it and focus returns to the trigger. The panel is a semantics container labelled by `accessibilityLabel`.

## Motion

CDS dropdown tokens: opacity plus a 16px slide away from the trigger over `moderate3` (global curve), with a slight scale from the edge facing the trigger so the panel grows out of it. Exit reverses the same path. Reduced motion: a `fast1` fade.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` (trigger) | `builder(context, controller)` |
| `content` (node / render prop) | `content` / `contentBuilder` |
| `contentPosition.placement`, `contentPosition.gap` | `placement`, `gap` |
| `panelWidth`, `minPanelWidth`, `maxPanelWidth`, `panelHeight`, `maxPanelHeight` | same |
| `showOverlay`, `block`, `disabled` | same |
| `onOpen`, `onClose` | same |
| `restoreFocusOnUnmount`, `accessibilityLabel` | same |
| ref `openPopover` / `closePopover` | `controller.open()` / `controller.close()` |

The trigger is built with `builder` instead of being a wrapped child, so the trigger keeps its own `onPress` and enabled state.

# CdsPortal

Renders its child in the nearest (or root) `Overlay`, above the rest of the screen, while keeping the theme and directionality of where it is declared.

CDS reference: Not a CDS docs page. Closest is https://cds.coinbase.com/components/overlay/PortalProvider (CDS web `Portal`).

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsPortal(
  visible: showNotice,
  child: const Align(alignment: Alignment.topCenter, child: CdsText('Sample data: maintenance at 02:00 UTC')),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use for custom floating layers. For standard overlays use the dedicated components, which already render above the page.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| child | `Widget` | required | Rendered in the overlay, sized to the overlay. |
| visible | `bool` | `true` | Show or hide the portal content. |
| useRootOverlay | `bool` | `false` | Use the root overlay so it also covers nested navigators. |

The widget itself takes no space in place.

## Examples

### Root overlay

```dart
CdsPortal(useRootOverlay: true, child: const Center(child: CdsSpinner(size: CdsSpinnerSize.large)))
```

## Accessibility

Content keeps its semantics; position it so it does not cover controls people need.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS API | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `Portal` / `PortalProvider` | `CdsPortal` (no provider needed: Flutter apps already have an `Overlay`) |

source: doc/components/CdsPressable.md

# CdsPressable

The interaction primitive behind every tappable CDS component. Use it to make a custom surface behave like CDS buttons and cells.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/Pressable

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsPressable(
  onPress: () => openAsset('btc'),
  background: CdsColor.bgSecondary,
  borderRadius: 400,
  semanticLabel: 'Bitcoin',
  child: const CdsBox(padding: 2, child: CdsText.headline('Bitcoin')),
)
```

## What it gives you

- Pointer-down feedback: background tint (CDS blend at 0.82) and a 0.98 scale driven by a spring that starts from the current value.
- Hover tint (0.88) on pointer devices.
- Keyboard: focusable, visible focus ring, Enter and Space activate.
- Leading-edge debounce (500ms) so double taps do not push a route twice.
- Haptic feedback on commit.
- Button semantics with label, hint, selected and toggled state.
- Optional 44px minimum hit area.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | |
| `onPress`, `onLongPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `onPressIn`, `onPressOut` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Fire on pointer down / up or cancel. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Dims (0.5) and blocks input. |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Blocks input without dimming. |
| `background` | `CdsColor` | `transparent` | |
| `dangerouslySetBackground` | `Color?` | `null` | |
| `borderColor` | `CdsColor?` | background | |
| `borderWidth` | `int` | `0` | Border width token. |
| `borderRadius` | `int?` | `null` | Radius token. |
| `elevation` | `CdsElevation` | `none` | |
| `transparentWhileInactive` | `bool` | `false` | Background appears only while pressed or hovered. |
| `noScaleOnPress` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `feedback` | `CdsHapticFeedback` | `none` | `light`, `normal`, `heavy`, `selection`. |
| `debounce` | `Duration` | 500ms | `Duration.zero` disables. |
| `minTapTargetSize` | `double` | `0` | Pads layout and hit area to this size. |
| `block` | `bool` | `false` | Full width. |
| `semanticLabel`, `semanticHint` | `String?` | `null` | |
| `selected`, `toggled`, `checked`, `mixed`, `expanded`, `inMutuallyExclusiveGroup` | `bool?` | `null` | State exposed to assistive tech. |
| `isButton` | `bool` | `true` | Set false for cells that are not buttons semantically. |
| `excludeChildSemantics` | `bool` | `false` | Announce only `semanticLabel`. |
| `mergeChildSemantics` | `bool` | `true` | Set false when the surface contains its own buttons so they stay separately reachable. |
| `focusNode`, `autofocus`, `mouseCursor` | | | |

## Motion

Press uses `CdsSprings.press`, release `CdsSprings.standard`, both from the current scale and velocity. Reduced motion disables the scale.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `onPress`, `onPressIn`, `onPressOut`, `disabled`, `loading`, `background`, `borderColor`, `borderRadius`, `elevation`, `transparentWhileInactive`, `noScaleOnPress`, `feedback`, `block` | same names |
| `debounceTime` / `disableDebounce` | `debounce` |
| `accessibilityLabel`, `accessibilityHint` | `semanticLabel`, `semanticHint` |

source: doc/components/CdsProgressBar.md

# CdsProgressBar

A horizontal track that shows how far a task has progressed; value changes animate from the current position.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/feedback/ProgressBar

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsProgressBar(progress: 0.4, accessibilityLabel: 'Verification progress')
```

## When to use / when not to

Use for determinate progress (uploads, steps completed, goal funding). Add labels with `CdsProgressBarWithFixedLabels` or `CdsProgressBarWithFloatLabel`. Use `CdsSpinner` when progress is unknown.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| progress | `double` | `0` | 0 to 1 (clamped). |
| weight | `CdsProgressWeight` | `CdsProgressWeight.normal` | Track height: thin 2, normal 4, semiheavy 8, heavy 12. |
| color | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bgPrimary` | Fill color. |
| disabled | `bool` | `false` | Fill in `bgLineHeavy`. |
| disableAnimateOnMount | `bool` | `false` | Start at `progress` instead of filling from 0. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | What is progressing. |
| onAnimationStart | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called when the value starts animating. |
| onAnimationEnd | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called when the animation ends. |

Track: `bgLine`, radius 200. The fill grows from the start edge (mirrored in right-to-left).

## Examples

### Heavy, positive

```dart
const CdsProgressBar(progress: 0.75, weight: CdsProgressWeight.heavy, color: CdsColor.bgPositive)
```

## Accessibility

Exposes the percentage as its semantic value ("40%") and `accessibilityLabel` as its label.

## Motion

Changes animate from wherever the bar is over `slow3` with the global curve (CDS `animateProgressBaseSpec`). Reduced motion: jumps to the value.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `progress`, `weight`, `color`, `disabled` | same |
| `disableAnimateOnMount` | same |
| `accessibilityLabel` | same |
| `onAnimationStart`, `onAnimationEnd` | same |

---
source: doc/components/CdsProgressBarWithFixedLabels.md
---

# CdsProgressBarWithFixedLabels

A progress bar with fixed numeric labels at its start and end, placed above, below or beside the track.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/feedback/ProgressBarWithFixedLabels

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsProgressBarWithFixedLabels(
  progress: 0.3,
  startLabel: CdsProgressBarLabel(30),
  endLabel: CdsProgressBarLabel(100),
  labelPlacement: CdsProgressLabelPlacement.below,
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use when the start and end values matter (raised versus goal). For a label that follows the fill, use `CdsProgressBarWithFloatLabel`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| progress | `double` | required | 0 to 1. |
| startLabel | `CdsProgressBarLabel?` | `null` | Label at the start. |
| endLabel | `CdsProgressBarLabel?` | `null` | Label at the end. |
| labelPlacement | `CdsProgressLabelPlacement` | `CdsProgressLabelPlacement.beside` | `above`, `below`, `beside`. |
| disabled | `bool` | `false` | Dims labels and grays the bar. |
| disableAnimateOnMount | `bool` | `false` | Labels and bar start at their values. |
| weight | `CdsProgressWeight` | `CdsProgressWeight.normal` | Bar weight. |
| color | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bgPrimary` | Bar fill. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Bar label. |
| child | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom bar; defaults to a `CdsProgressBar` from `progress`. |

### CdsProgressBarLabel

`const CdsProgressBarLabel(double value, {Widget Function(double value, bool disabled)? render})`. Default text is `'${value.round()}%'` in `label2` with tabular figures; the number counts from its previous value.

## Examples

### Custom label text

```dart
CdsProgressBarWithFixedLabels(
  progress: 0.6,
  startLabel: CdsProgressBarLabel(3, render: (v, _) => CdsText('Sample data: ${v.round()} of 5 steps')),
  labelPlacement: CdsProgressLabelPlacement.above,
)
```

## Accessibility

The bar exposes its percentage; labels are plain text read in order. Labels never clip at large text sizes.

## Motion

Bar and numbers animate together over `slow3` (global curve) from their current values. Reduced motion: instant.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `startLabel`, `endLabel` (`number \| {value, render}`) | `CdsProgressBarLabel(value, render:)` |
| `labelPlacement` | `labelPlacement` |
| `disabled`, `disableAnimateOnMount` | same |
| `children` (ProgressBar) | `child` (optional; built from `progress` by default) |

---
source: doc/components/CdsProgressBarWithFloatLabel.md
---

# CdsProgressBarWithFloatLabel

A progress bar with a numeric label that rides along with the fill, above or below the track.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/feedback/ProgressBarWithFloatLabel

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsProgressBarWithFloatLabel(progress: 0.6, label: CdsProgressBarLabel(60))
```

## When to use / when not to

Use when the current value is what matters. For start and end values use `CdsProgressBarWithFixedLabels`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| progress | `double` | required | 0 to 1. |
| label | `CdsProgressBarLabel` | required | Value shown at the fill's end. |
| labelPlacement | `CdsProgressLabelPlacement` | `CdsProgressLabelPlacement.above` | `above` or `below` (`beside` asserts). |
| disabled | `bool` | `false` | Dims the label and grays the bar. |
| disableAnimateOnMount | `bool` | `false` | Start at the value. |
| weight | `CdsProgressWeight` | `CdsProgressWeight.normal` | Bar weight. |
| color | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bgPrimary` | Bar fill. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Bar label. |
| child | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom bar. |

The label's end edge tracks the fill's end and never leaves the track. Label color `fgMuted`.

## Examples

### Below the bar

```dart
const CdsProgressBarWithFloatLabel(
  progress: 0.25,
  label: CdsProgressBarLabel(25),
  labelPlacement: CdsProgressLabelPlacement.below,
)
```

## Accessibility

The bar carries the semantic value; the floating label is excluded to avoid reading the number twice.

## Motion

Label position and number animate with the bar over `slow3` (global curve). Reduced motion: instant.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `label` | `label` (`CdsProgressBarLabel`) |
| `labelPlacement` | `labelPlacement` |
| `progress`, `disabled`, `disableAnimateOnMount` | same |
| `children` | `child` |

# CdsProgressCircle

Circular progress for a known fraction, or a spinning arc while work of unknown length runs.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/feedback/ProgressCircle

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsProgressCircle(progress: 0.6, size: 64, showLabel: true)
CdsProgressCircle.indeterminate(size: 24)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `progress` | `double` | required (determinate) | 0 to 1; changes animate over `slow3` with the global curve. |
| `size` | `double` | 48 (determinate), 24 (indeterminate) | Diameter. |
| `weight` | `CdsProgressWeight` | `normal` (4px), `thin` for indeterminate | `thin` 2, `normal` 4, `semiheavy` 8, `heavy` 12. |
| `color` | `CdsColor` | `bgPrimary`, `fgMuted` for indeterminate | Arc color. The track uses `bgLine`. |
| `showLabel` | `bool` | `false` | Percentage in the center. |
| `content` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom center content. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `animate` | `bool` | `true` | Animate value changes. Turn off when `progress` already follows a gesture. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `'Loading'` for indeterminate | |

## Motion

The indeterminate arc rotates once per second only while it is mounted and on screen. Under reduced motion it holds still and the "Loading" label carries the state.

## Accessibility

Determinate circles expose their value as a percentage; indeterminate ones use a live region.

source: doc/components/CdsRadio.md

# CdsRadio

A single radio button with an optional label. Most screens should use `CdsRadioGroup`, which manages selection and keyboard navigation for a set of radios.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/Radio

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsRadio(
  label: 'Bank account',
  checked: method == 'bank',
  onChange: (_) => setState(() => method = 'bank'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use when exactly one option from a small, visible set must be chosen.
- Prefer `CdsRadioGroup` or `CdsControlGroup.radio` over hand-placed radios: they make the set one tab stop with arrow-key selection.
- Use `CdsRadioCell` when each option needs a description, and `CdsCheckbox` when several options can be chosen.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | `bool` | `false` | Whether this radio is selected. Controlled. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | `null` | Called with `!checked` on tap. Null makes the radio inert and dimmed. |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Label next to the circle. Also the accessibility label. |
| `labelNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom label widget. Takes precedence over `label`. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Blocks interaction and dims to 50%. |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Blocks interaction and dims, announced as read-only. |
| `controlColor` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bgPrimary` | Dot color and checked border color. |
| `background` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bg` | Circle fill. |
| `borderColor` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Border in both states. Defaults to `bgLineHeavy` off and `controlColor` on. |
| `borderWidth` | `int` | `100` | Border width token (1px). |
| `elevation` | `CdsElevation` | `CdsElevation.none` | Circle shadow. |
| `controlSize` | `double?` | `null` | Circle size in px. Defaults to `theme.controlSize.radioSize` (20). |
| `dotSize` | `double?` | `null` | Dot diameter. Defaults to two thirds of the control size. |
| `font` | `CdsFont` | `CdsFont.body` | Label ramp entry. |
| `color` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Fixed label color. By default `fgMuted` off and `fg` on. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Replaces the label for screen readers. Required when there is no `label`. |
| `semanticHint` | `String?` | `null` | Extra hint. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | Focus node for the control. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | Request focus on first build. |

## Examples

### Custom color

```dart
CdsRadio(
  label: 'Earn rewards',
  checked: true,
  controlColor: CdsColor.bgPositive,
  onChange: (_) {},
)
```

### Disabled

```dart
const CdsRadio(label: 'Wire transfer', disabled: true)
```

## Accessibility

- Exposes checked state, membership in a mutually exclusive group, the label, enabled state and a tap action.
- Hit area padded to at least 44x44. Tab focuses, Space or Enter selects. Arrow keys work inside `CdsRadioGroup`.

## Motion

- The dot scales from 0.9 to 1 and fades in over `CdsDurations.moderate1` (`CdsCurves.enterFunctional` in, `CdsCurves.global` out); the border and label color cross-fade with it, reversibly.
- Light haptic on press. Reduced motion shows the new state immediately.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `checked` | `checked` |
| `onChange(value, checked)` | `onChange(bool)` |
| `children` | `label` / `labelNode` |
| `controlColor`, `background`, `borderColor`, `borderWidth`, `elevation`, `controlSize`, `dotSize` | same names |
| `disabled` / `readOnly` | `disabled` / `readOnly` |
| `accessibilityLabel` / `accessibilityHint` | `semanticLabel` / `semanticHint` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsRadioCell.md

# CdsRadioCell

A full-width bordered row with a radio, a title and an optional description; the whole row is the touch target.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/RadioCell

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsRadioCell(
  title: 'Instant',
  description: 'Arrives in minutes. 1.5% fee',
  checked: speed == 'instant',
  onChange: (_) => setState(() => speed = 'instant'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for a single choice where each option needs a description, such as transfer speed or account type.
- Stack several cells and keep exactly one `checked`. Use `CdsRadioGroup` for plain labels.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String` | required | Title in `headline`. Also part of the accessibility label. |
| `titleNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom title widget; `title` is still used for the accessibility label. |
| `description` | `String?` | `null` | Muted `body` text under the title. |
| `descriptionNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom description widget. |
| `checked` | `bool` | `false` | Whether the row is selected. Controlled. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | `null` | Called with `!checked` when the row is pressed. Null makes the row inert and dimmed. |
| `controlColor` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bgPrimary` | Radio dot color. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Blocks interaction and dims to 50%. |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Blocks interaction and dims, announced as read-only. |
| `padding` | `double` | `2` | Space token around the content (16px). |
| `columnGap` | `double` | `2` | Space token between the control and the text. |
| `rowGap` | `double` | `0` | Space token between title and description. |
| `borderWidth` | `int` | `100` | Resting border width token (1px). |
| `borderRadius` | `int` | `200` | Radius token (8px). |
| `background` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bg` | Row fill. |
| `borderColor` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bgLine` | Resting border color. |
| `pressedBorderColor` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bgPrimary` | Border color while pressed. |
| `pressedBorderWidth` | `int` | `200` | Border width token while pressed (2px). |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Defaults to "title, description". |
| `semanticHint` | `String?` | `null` | Defaults to "Tap to select this option", or "Tap to unselect this option" when checked. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | Focus node for the row. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | Request focus on first build. |

## Examples

### A set of cells

```dart
Widget cell(String value, String title, String description) => CdsRadioCell(
      title: title,
      description: description,
      checked: speed == value,
      onChange: (_) => setState(() => speed = value),
    );

CdsVStack(gap: 1.5, children: [
  cell('standard', 'Standard', '1 to 3 business days. No fee'),
  cell('instant', 'Instant', 'Arrives in minutes. 1.5% fee'),
])
```

### Disabled

```dart
const CdsRadioCell(title: 'Wire', description: 'Not available on weekends', disabled: true)
```

## Accessibility

- The row is one node exposing the combined label, the CDS hint, checked state and mutually exclusive group membership, enabled or read-only state and a tap action.
- Tab focuses the row and shows the focus ring; Space or Enter activates.
- Text wraps freely and the control stays centered on the title's first line at any text scale.

## Motion

- Pointer-down fades in a 2px `pressedBorderColor` border over the resting one (`CdsDurations.moderate1`, enter-functional in, exit-functional out) and the content dims to 82%.
- The control animates as on `CdsRadio`. A light haptic fires on press.
- Reduced motion: the pressed border and control state change immediately.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | `title` / `titleNode` |
| `description` | `description` / `descriptionNode` |
| `checked` | `checked` |
| `onChange(value, checked)` | `onChange(bool)` |
| `controlColor` | `controlColor` |
| `disabled` / `readOnly` | `disabled` / `readOnly` |
| `padding`, `columnGap`, `rowGap` | same names |
| `borderWidth`, `borderRadius`, `background`, `borderColor` | same names |
| `pressedBorderColor`, `pressedBorderWidth` | same names |
| `accessibilityLabel` / `accessibilityHint` | `semanticLabel` / `semanticHint` |

source: doc/components/CdsRadioGroup.md

# CdsRadioGroup

A labelled set of radio buttons with single selection and arrow-key navigation.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/RadioGroup

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsRadioGroup<String>(
  label: 'Payment method',
  options: const [
    CdsControlOption(value: 'bank', label: 'Bank account'),
    CdsControlOption(value: 'card', label: 'Debit card'),
  ],
  value: method,
  onChange: (value) => setState(() => method = value),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for two to about seven mutually exclusive options that should all be visible.
- For longer lists use a select (see the overlays category). For options with descriptions use `CdsRadioCell` rows.
- This is a thin wrapper over `CdsControlGroup.radio`; both behave identically.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `List<CdsControlOption<T>>` | required | Options in display order. See `CdsControlGroup` for `CdsControlOption`. |
| `value` | `T?` | required | Selected value, or null for none. Controlled. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<T>?` | `null` | Called with the value the user selects. |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Heading in `headline`. Also the group's accessibility label. |
| `labelNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom heading. |
| `gap` | `double` | `2` | Space token between options. |
| `direction` | `Axis` | `Axis.vertical` | `Axis.horizontal` lays options in a wrapping row. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Disables every option. |
| `controlColor` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bgPrimary` | Dot and checked border color. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Overrides `label` for screen readers. |
| `radioSemanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Appended to each option's label with `{{number}}` and `{{total}}` replaced, e.g. `'{{number}} of {{total}}'`. |

## Examples

### Horizontal

```dart
CdsRadioGroup<String>(
  label: 'Frequency',
  direction: Axis.horizontal,
  gap: 3,
  options: const [
    CdsControlOption(value: 'daily', label: 'Daily'),
    CdsControlOption(value: 'weekly', label: 'Weekly'),
    CdsControlOption(value: 'monthly', label: 'Monthly'),
  ],
  value: frequency,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => frequency = v),
)
```

### Disabled option and position announcements

```dart
CdsRadioGroup<String>(
  label: 'Payment method',
  radioSemanticLabel: '{{number}} of {{total}}',
  options: const [
    CdsControlOption(value: 'bank', label: 'Bank account'),
    CdsControlOption(value: 'gift', label: 'Gift card', disabled: true),
  ],
  value: method,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => method = v),
)
```

## Accessibility

- Semantics container with `SemanticsRole.radioGroup` and the group label; each radio reports checked state and mutually exclusive group membership.
- One tab stop: Tab lands on the selected option (or the first enabled one), and the next Tab leaves the group.
- Arrow Down/Right select the next enabled option, Up/Left the previous, wrapping at the ends. Left and Right are mirrored in right-to-left layouts. Disabled options are skipped.

## Motion

Each radio's dot scales and fades in over `CdsDurations.moderate1`, reversibly; see `CdsRadio`. Reduced motion shows changes immediately.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `options` (`Record<value, label>`) | `options` (`List<CdsControlOption<T>>`) |
| `value` | `value` |
| `onChange(value, checked)` | `onChange(T)` |
| `label` | `label` / `labelNode` |
| `direction`, `gap` | `direction`, `gap` |
| `controlColor` | `controlColor` |
| `radioAccessibilityLabel` | `radioSemanticLabel` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |

source: doc/components/CdsRangeSlider.md

# CdsRangeSlider

Picks a start and an end value from a range with two thumbs on one track. CDS has no range slider; this one shares the look, gestures and keyboard handling of `CdsSlider`.

CDS reference: none (extra component)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsRangeValues price = (start: 20000, end: 60000);

CdsRangeSlider(
  values: price,
  min: 0,
  max: 100000,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => price = v),
  startSemanticLabel: 'Minimum price',
  endSemanticLabel: 'Maximum price',
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for filters with a lower and upper bound, such as a price or date range. For a single value use `CdsSlider`. When users need exact bounds, pair it with two `CdsTextInput` fields or use them instead.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | `CdsRangeValues` | required | `({double start, double end})`, with `start <= end`. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<CdsRangeValues>?` | required | Called with both values whenever either thumb moves. Null disables the slider. |
| `onChangeStart` | `ValueChanged<CdsRangeValues>?` | `null` | Called once when a change begins. |
| `onChangeEnd` | `ValueChanged<CdsRangeValues>?` | `null` | Called once with the final values. |
| `min` | `double` | `0` | |
| `max` | `double` | `1` | Must be greater than `min`. |
| `divisions` | `int?` | `null` | Number of discrete steps. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `startSemanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessibility label of the start thumb. |
| `endSemanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessibility label of the end thumb. |
| `formatValue` | `String Function(double)?` | percentage of the range | Text read by screen readers for each value. |
| `startFocusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | |
| `endFocusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | |

`CdsRangeValues` is a typedef for the record `({double start, double end})`, so values compare by content: `(start: 1, end: 2) == (start: 1, end: 2)`.

## Examples

### Stepped percentage band

```dart
CdsRangeSlider(
  values: band,
  divisions: 20,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => band = v),
  startSemanticLabel: 'Lower bound',
  endSemanticLabel: 'Upper bound',
)
```

### Apply the filter on release

```dart
CdsRangeSlider(
  values: draft,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => draft = v),
  onChangeEnd: applyFilter,
  startSemanticLabel: 'From',
  endSemanticLabel: 'To',
)
```

## Accessibility

- Each thumb is focusable on its own and is a separate slider in the semantics tree, with its own label and value.
- The thumbs cannot cross: the start thumb's maximum is the end value and the end thumb's minimum is the start value, for drags, taps, keys and semantic actions alike. Home on the end thumb moves it to the start value.
- Keyboard handling matches `CdsSlider`.

## Motion

- A drag or tap moves the nearest thumb. When both thumbs sit on the same spot, the one that can move toward the pointer is picked.
- Drags follow the finger from the grab point; release, taps and outside changes spring from the current position. Reduced motion jumps instead.

## CDS React Native mapping

CDS has no range slider. Names follow CDS conventions:

| Convention | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value` / `onChange` | `values` / `onChange` |
| `disabled` | `disabled` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `startSemanticLabel` / `endSemanticLabel` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsReferenceLine.md
---

# CdsReferenceLine

A horizontal line at a value or a vertical line at a category, for targets, thresholds and events.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/charts/ReferenceLine

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsLineChart(
  height: 200,
  series: [CdsLineSeries(id: 'a', data: [30, 42, 55, 48, 61])],
  children: [CdsReferenceLine(dataY: 50, label: 'Target')],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use `dataY` for a level (a target price, a limit) and `dataX` for a moment (a launch, an order).
- Set exactly one of `dataX` and `dataY`.
- Use `labelElevated` when the label sits over busy data.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataX` | `double?` | `null` | Category position for a vertical line. |
| `dataY` | `double?` | `null` | Value for a horizontal line. |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Text near the line, kept inside the canvas. |
| `labelPosition` | `CdsReferenceLineLabelPosition?` | `null` | Horizontal lines: `left`, `center`, `right` (default). Vertical lines: `top` (default), `middle`, `bottom`. |
| `labelFont` | `CdsFont` | `CdsFont.label2` | Label ramp entry, colored `fgMuted`. |
| `labelDx`, `labelDy` | `double` | `0` | Label offset in pixels. |
| `labelElevated` | `bool` | `false` | Draw the label on an elevated `bgElevation1` pill with a shadow. |
| `lineType` | `CdsChartLineType` | `dotted` | `dotted` (CDS default) or `solid`. |
| `stroke` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bgLine` | Line color token. |
| `dangerouslySetStroke` | `Color?` | `null` | Raw line color. |
| `strokeWidth` | `double` | `2` | Line width. |
| `opacity` | `double` | `1` | Line and label opacity. |

## Examples

### Event marker and elevated level

```dart
const CdsLineChart(
  height: 200,
  series: [CdsLineSeries(id: 'a', data: [30, 42, 55, 48, 61])],
  children: [
    CdsReferenceLine(dataX: 2, label: 'Launch'),
    CdsReferenceLine(dataY: 45, label: 'Limit', labelElevated: true, stroke: CdsColor.fgNegative),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

Painted only; mention the reference in the chart's `accessibilityLabel` when it matters.

## Motion

None; the line moves with its scale immediately, as in CDS.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `dataX`, `dataY`, `label`, `labelPosition` | same names |
| `labelFont`, `labelDx`, `labelDy`, `labelElevated` | same names |
| `stroke`, `strokeWidth`, `opacity` | same names (`stroke` is a token; raw: `dangerouslySetStroke`) |
| `LineComponent` | `lineType` |
| `LabelComponent`, `labelBoundsInset`, `styles` | not ported |

source: doc/components/CdsRefreshControl.md

# CdsRefreshControl

Pull to refresh for a vertical scrollable: the indicator follows the finger, and releasing past a threshold reloads the content.

CDS reference: none. This is a cds_flutter extra built from CDS tokens.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsRefreshControl(
  onRefresh: loadPrices,
  child: ListView(
    physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
    children: rows,
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use on lists whose data changes on the server, such as prices or activity. Do not use as the only way to refresh; also refresh on screen focus or offer a button for users who cannot drag.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | A vertical scrollable. Use `AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics` so short lists can be pulled. |
| `onRefresh` | `Future<void> Function()` | required | Reloads the content. The spinner shows until the future completes. |
| `triggerDistance` | `double` | `80` | Pull distance, in logical pixels, that arms a refresh. |
| `indicatorSize` | `double` | `24` | Ring diameter. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String` | `'Refreshing'` | Announced while refreshing. |
| `refreshActionLabel` | `String` | `'Refresh'` | Name of the screen reader custom action. |

## Behavior

1. Pulling down at the top of the list moves the indicator 1:1 with the finger. Past `triggerDistance` it slows with `CdsMotion.rubberband`.
2. While pulling, a determinate ring fills from 0 to 100% of `triggerDistance`. Nothing spins before release. A light haptic fires once when the threshold is crossed.
3. Releasing past the threshold calls `onRefresh`; the indicator settles at the threshold and shows `CdsProgressCircle.indeterminate` until the future completes, then springs back.
4. Releasing short of the threshold springs back without refreshing.

Works with bouncing (iOS) and clamping (Android) physics. New pulls are ignored while a refresh is running.

## Accessibility

- The indeterminate indicator is a live region announcing `semanticLabel`.
- A "Refresh" custom semantics action runs `onRefresh` without a drag.

## Motion

Return and settle use `CdsMotion.springTo` with `CdsSprings.standard`, starting from wherever the indicator is. Under reduced motion the indicator jumps to its target with no spring. The spinner runs only while `onRefresh` is pending.

## CDS React Native mapping

No CDS component. React Native apps use `RefreshControl` from React Native; `onRefresh` maps directly, and `refreshing` is driven by the returned future.

source: doc/components/CdsRemoteImage.md

# CdsRemoteImage

An image from the network or any `ImageProvider`, clipped to a CDS shape, with a loading placeholder and a fallback graphic.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/media/RemoteImage

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsRemoteImage.network('https://example.com/btc.png', shape: CdsShape.circle, size: CdsAvatarSize.l)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use for asset logos, artwork and card media. Use `CdsAvatar` for people (it adds the letter fallback).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | `ImageProvider?` | `null` | The image. Null shows the fallback. `CdsRemoteImage.network(url)` sets a `NetworkImage`. |
| `size` | `CdsAvatarSize?` | `null` (= `m`, 24px) | Square size from the avatar scale, used when `width` and `height` are both null. |
| `width` | `double?` | `null` | Logical px. `double.infinity` fills the parent. |
| `height` | `double?` | `null` | Logical px. |
| `aspectRatio` | `double?` | `null` | Width / height. Derives the missing dimension. |
| `shape` | `CdsShape?` | `null` (= `square`) | `circle`, `squircle` (8px), `square` (4px), `rectangle`, `hexagon`. Inside a `CdsRemoteImageGroup`, defaults to the group's shape. |
| `fit` | `BoxFit` | `BoxFit.cover` | |
| `borderColor` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | 2px border. |
| `darkModeEnhancementsApplied` | `bool` | `false` | In dark mode, fills transparent areas with `bgInverse` and adds a 1px `bgLineHeavy` border, so dark asset icons stay visible. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Screen reader label. Null hides decorative images. |
| `fallbackSemanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Label while the fallback shows. |
| `placeholder` | `Widget?` | `bgSecondary` fill | Shown while loading. |
| `fallback` | `Widget?` | CDS fallback graphic | Shown when `source` is null or fails to load. |

## Examples

### Full-width media with a ratio

```dart
CdsRemoteImage(source: art, width: double.infinity, aspectRatio: 16 / 9, shape: CdsShape.squircle)
```

### Custom error fallback

```dart
CdsRemoteImage(source: NetworkImage(url), size: CdsAvatarSize.xl, fallback: const CdsIcon(CdsIconName.image))
```

## Accessibility

Decorative by default. With `semanticLabel`, announced as an image.

## Motion

Fades in over `CdsDurations.moderate1` with `CdsCurves.enterFunctional` once the first frame arrives. Images already in cache appear without a fade. Instant under reduced motion. The placeholder is static.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `source` (string or object) | `source` (`ImageProvider`) or `CdsRemoteImage.network(url)` |
| `size`, `width`, `height`, `shape`, `borderColor` | same names |
| `aspectRatio` (`[w, h]`) | `aspectRatio` (`w / h`) |
| `resizeMode` | `fit` |
| `darkModeEnhancementsApplied` | `darkModeEnhancementsApplied` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |
| `fallbackAccessibilityLabel` | `fallbackSemanticLabel` |

# CdsRemoteImageGroup

A row of overlapping images that collapses into a `+N` bubble past `max`.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/media/RemoteImageGroup

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsRemoteImageGroup(
  max: 3,
  semanticLabel: 'Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and 2 more',
  children: [for (final logo in logos) CdsRemoteImage(source: logo)],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use to show a set of assets or participants compactly. Use a list when each item needs its own label or action.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required | Usually `CdsRemoteImage`s; other widgets are boxed to the same size. |
| `max` | `int` | `4` | Children shown before `+N`. |
| `size` | `CdsAvatarSize` | `CdsAvatarSize.m` | Size of every child. |
| `dangerouslySetSize` | `double?` | `null` | Exact px size; overrides `size`. |
| `shape` | `CdsShape` | `CdsShape.circle` | Applied to children that do not set their own shape. |
| `borderWidth` | `int?` | `null` | Border width token around each child, e.g. `200` for 2px. |
| `borderColor` | `CdsColor?` | `bg` when `borderWidth` is set | Ring color. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Summary read instead of the images. |

Overlap follows CDS: 8px at 40px and below, 16px above. The first child is drawn on top.

## Examples

### Separated by rings

```dart
CdsRemoteImageGroup(size: CdsAvatarSize.xxl, borderWidth: 200, children: [...])
```

## Accessibility

Pass `semanticLabel`; the images and the `+N` text are then hidden from screen readers.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `children` |
| `max` | `max` |
| `size` (`AvatarSize`) | `size` |
| `size` (number) | `dangerouslySetSize` |
| `shape`, `borderWidth`, `borderColor` | same names |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |

# CdsRollingNumber

A number whose digits roll from their current value to the new one, for balances, prices and counters that update while people watch.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/numbers/RollingNumber

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsRollingNumber(value: 12345.67, format: const CdsNumberFormat.currency())
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for a value that changes in place: a portfolio balance, a live price, a scrubbed chart value.
- Turn on `colorPulseOnUpdate` when the direction of change matters (prices). Leave it off for neutral counters.
- Do not use it for static numbers. `CdsText(..., tabularNumbers: true)` is cheaper and reads the same.
- Do not use it for numbers inside long running text. It renders as one row and does not wrap.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `num` | required | The number to show. Also drives the roll direction and the color pulse when `formattedValue` is set. |
| `format` | `CdsNumberFormat` | `const CdsNumberFormat()` | How `value` becomes text (en-US decimal, grouping on, up to 3 fraction digits). See [CdsNumberFormat](#cdsnumberformat). |
| `formattedValue` | `String?` | `null` | Preformatted text shown instead of formatting `value`. The fraction is split at `.`. |
| `prefix` | `String?` | `null` | Text before the number, such as `+`. Pulses with the number and is announced. |
| `suffix` | `String?` | `null` | Text after the number, such as `' BTC'`. Pulses with the number and is announced. |
| `start` | `Widget?` | `null` | Widget before the prefix, such as a `CdsIcon`. Not announced. |
| `end` | `Widget?` | `null` | Widget after the suffix. Not announced. |
| `font` | `CdsFont` | `CdsFont.body` | Type ramp entry. Digit cells are exactly one line tall. |
| `color` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.fg` | Base text color. A pulse returns to this color. |
| `mono` | `bool` | `false` | Use the monospace family. |
| `tabularNumbers` | `bool` | `true` | Equal-width digits. Keep it on so the row does not change width mid-roll. |
| `colorPulseOnUpdate` | `bool` | `false` | Tint the text when the value changes, then fade back to `color`. |
| `positivePulseColor` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.fgPositive` | Pulse color when the value goes up. |
| `negativePulseColor` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.fgNegative` | Pulse color when the value goes down. |
| `enableSubscriptNotation` | `bool` | `false` | Show two or more leading fraction zeros as a subscript count: `0.00009` renders as `0.0₄9`. |
| `transition` | `CdsRollingNumberTransition` | `const CdsRollingNumberTransition()` | Digit roll, fade and pulse timing. |
| `digitTransitionVariant` | `CdsDigitTransitionVariant` | `every` | `every` rolls through each intermediate digit. `single` slides straight to the new digit. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Replaces the announced value. Defaults to `prefix + formatted + suffix`. |
| `semanticLabelPrefix` | `String?` | `null` | Announced before the value, for example `'up'`. |
| `semanticLabelSuffix` | `String?` | `null` | Announced after the value. |
| `liveRegion` | `bool` | `true` | Screen readers announce value changes. |

### CdsRollingNumberTransition

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ySpring` | `SpringDescription` | mass 0.3, stiffness 280, damping 18 | Spring for the digit roll (the CDS default). |
| `yDuration` | `Duration?` | `null` | Set to use a timed roll with `yCurve` instead of the spring. |
| `yCurve` | `Curve` | `CdsCurves.global` | Curve for a timed roll. |
| `opacityDuration` | `Duration` | `CdsDurations.fast2` (133ms) | Fade for the `single` variant. |
| `opacityCurve` | `Curve` | `CdsCurves.global` | Curve for the fade. |
| `colorDuration` | `Duration` | `CdsDurations.slow4` (1000ms) | Time for a pulse to return to the base color. |
| `colorCurve` | `Curve` | `CdsCurves.global` | Curve for the pulse. |

### CdsNumberFormat

The package has no `intl` dependency, so `CdsNumberFormat` covers the `Intl.NumberFormat` options CDS examples use, with en-US rules by default.

| Constructor | Output for `1234.5` |
| --- | --- |
| `CdsNumberFormat()` | `1,234.5` |
| `CdsNumberFormat.currency()` | `$1,234.50` |
| `CdsNumberFormat.currency(symbol: '€')` | `€1,234.50` |
| `CdsNumberFormat.percent()` (value `0.1234`) | `12%` |
| `CdsNumberFormat(notation: CdsNumberNotation.compact)` | `1.2K` |
| `CdsNumberFormat(decimalSeparator: ',', groupSeparator: '.')` | `1.234,5` |
| `CdsNumberFormat.custom(fn, decimalSeparator: '.')` | whatever `fn` returns |

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `style` | `CdsNumberFormatStyle` | `decimal` | `decimal`, `currency`, `percent` (multiplies by 100). |
| `currencySymbol` | `String` | `r'$'` | Placed before the number for `currency`. Named `symbol` on `CdsNumberFormat.currency`. |
| `minimumFractionDigits` | `int?` | 0 (decimal, percent), 2 (currency) | |
| `maximumFractionDigits` | `int?` | 3 (decimal), 0 (percent), 2 (currency) | Compact notation defaults to two significant digits (`1.2K`, `98K`, `123K`). |
| `useGrouping` | `bool` | `true` | Group thousands with `groupSeparator`. |
| `notation` | `CdsNumberNotation` | `standard` | `compact` uses `K`, `M`, `B`, `T`. |
| `signDisplay` | `CdsNumberSignDisplay` | `auto` | `auto`, `always`, `exceptZero`, `never`. |
| `decimalSeparator` | `String` | `'.'` | Also tells the roller where the fraction starts. |
| `groupSeparator` | `String` | `','` | |

## Examples

### Balance with a color pulse

```dart
CdsRollingNumber(
  value: balance,
  font: CdsFont.display3,
  format: const CdsNumberFormat.currency(),
  colorPulseOnUpdate: true,
)
```

### Change with direction icon and percent suffix

```dart
final up = change >= 0;
CdsRollingNumber(
  value: change.abs(),
  color: up ? CdsColor.fgPositive : CdsColor.fgNegative,
  format: const CdsNumberFormat.currency(),
  start: CdsIcon(
    up ? CdsIconName.diagonalUpArrow : CdsIconName.diagonalDownArrow,
    size: CdsIconSize.xs,
    color: up ? CdsColor.fgPositive : CdsColor.fgNegative,
  ),
  suffix: ' (${(change.abs() / price * 100).toStringAsFixed(2)}%)',
  semanticLabelPrefix: up ? 'up' : 'down',
)
```

### Crypto amount with prefix and suffix

```dart
CdsRollingNumber(
  value: 0.5,
  prefix: '+',
  suffix: ' BTC',
  format: const CdsNumberFormat(minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 8),
)
```

### Compact and tiny values

```dart
CdsRollingNumber(
  value: 98345.67,
  format: const CdsNumberFormat.currency(notation: CdsNumberNotation.compact),
) // $98K

CdsRollingNumber(
  value: 0.00009,
  enableSubscriptNotation: true,
  format: const CdsNumberFormat(maximumFractionDigits: 8),
) // 0.0₄9
```

### Your own formatter

Pass any `String Function(num)`, for example one built on `package:intl` in your app:

```dart
String euros(num v) => '${v.toStringAsFixed(2).replaceAll('.', ',')} €';

CdsRollingNumber(value: 1234.5, format: const CdsNumberFormat.custom(euros, decimalSeparator: ','))
```

### Single digit transition and custom timing

```dart
CdsRollingNumber(
  value: count,
  digitTransitionVariant: CdsDigitTransitionVariant.single,
  transition: const CdsRollingNumberTransition(
    yDuration: CdsDurations.moderate3,
    colorDuration: CdsDurations.moderate3,
  ),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The widget is one semantics node whose label is the final formatted value (`prefix + formatted + suffix`, plus `semanticLabelPrefix` and `semanticLabelSuffix`). Rolling digit glyphs are excluded, so screen readers never read intermediate digits.
- `liveRegion: true` (default) asks screen readers to announce updates politely, like CDS `accessibilityLiveRegion="polite"`.
- Subscript notation is visual only: the label reads the full value (`0.00009`).
- The color pulse is not the only signal of direction. Pair it with an icon (`start`) or a sign (`prefix`, `signDisplay`) and `semanticLabelPrefix` such as `'up'` or `'down'`.
- Text scales with the platform setting. Digit cells are sized from the scaled line height.

## Motion

- Each changed digit rolls with a spring (mass 0.3, stiffness 280, damping 18) that starts from its current position and velocity, so rapid updates redirect mid-roll without a jump.
- Columns added after the first frame (going from `$999` to `$1,000`) roll up from 0. Columns that disappear are removed instantly, like CDS.
- `single` slides the new digit in from below when the value grows and from above when it shrinks, with a 133ms fade.
- The color pulse jumps to the pulse color and fades back to `color` over 1000ms with `CdsCurves.global`. It does not fire when the formatted text is unchanged (`125,000` to `125,001` shown as `125K`).
- Reduced motion: digits change instantly and the pulse is skipped. Nothing loops; all animations end once the value settles.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value` | `value` |
| `format` (`Intl.NumberFormatOptions`) | `format` (`CdsNumberFormat`) |
| `locale` | `CdsNumberFormat.decimalSeparator` / `groupSeparator`, or `CdsNumberFormat.custom` |
| `formattedValue` | `formattedValue` |
| `prefix` / `suffix` (string) | `prefix` / `suffix` |
| `prefix` / `suffix` (ReactNode) | `start` / `end` |
| `font` | `font` |
| `color` | `color` |
| `mono` | `mono` |
| `tabularNumbers` | `tabularNumbers` |
| `colorPulseOnUpdate` | `colorPulseOnUpdate` |
| `positivePulseColor` / `negativePulseColor` | `positivePulseColor` / `negativePulseColor` |
| `enableSubscriptNotation` | `enableSubscriptNotation` |
| `transition.y` | `transition.ySpring` or `transition.yDuration` + `yCurve` |
| `transition.opacity` | `transition.opacityDuration` + `opacityCurve` |
| `transition.color` | `transition.colorDuration` + `colorCurve` |
| `digitTransitionVariant` | `digitTransitionVariant` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |
| `accessibilityLabelPrefix` / `accessibilityLabelSuffix` | `semanticLabelPrefix` / `semanticLabelSuffix` |
| `accessibilityLiveRegion` | `liveRegion` |
| `RollingNumber*Component`, `styles` | not ported |

# CdsScaffold

A CDS page frame: an optional header pinned to the top, a scrolling body, and an optional footer pinned to the bottom, with safe areas and the keyboard handled.

CDS reference: none. This is a cds_flutter extra built from CDS tokens.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsScaffold(
  header: CdsTopNavBar(
    start: CdsNavBarIconButton(CdsIconName.backArrow, semanticLabel: 'Back', onPress: pop),
    child: const CdsNavigationTitle('Send'),
  ),
  body: const SendForm(),
  footer: CdsStickyFooter(
    child: CdsButton(label: 'Send USDC', block: true, onPress: send),
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use as the root of a screen in a CDS app instead of Material `Scaffold`. It does not provide app bars, drawers or snack bars; compose CDS components into its slots.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `header` | `Widget?` | `null` | Pinned above the body, padded below the status bar. |
| `body` | `Widget` | required | Page content. |
| `footer` | `Widget?` | `null` | Pinned below the body, e.g. `CdsStickyFooter`. |
| `background` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bg` | Fills the whole page, including behind safe areas. |
| `scrollable` | `bool` | `true` | Wraps `body` in a `SingleChildScrollView`. Set false when `body` is a `ListView` or `CustomScrollView`. |
| `bodyPadding` | `EdgeInsetsGeometry?` | `null` | Padding around `body` inside the scroll view. |
| `scrollController` | `ScrollController?` | `null` | Controller for the scroll view when `scrollable` is true. |
| `resizeToAvoidKeyboard` | `bool` | `true` | Lifts the footer and shrinks the body when the keyboard opens. |
| `showHeaderDivider` | `bool` | `true` | Fades in a `bgLine` hairline under the header once the body scrolls. |

## Safe areas and keyboard

- With a header, the header clears the top inset; without one, the body does.
- With a footer, the footer receives the bottom inset (so `CdsStickyFooter` pads for the home indicator); without one, the body's scroll padding does.
- While the keyboard is open, the footer sits directly above it and the bottom inset is removed, so the gap is not counted twice.
- Left and right insets pad the whole page in landscape.

## Examples

### List body

```dart
CdsScaffold(
  scrollable: false,
  header: const CdsPageHeader(title: 'Activity'),
  body: ListView.builder(itemCount: rows.length, itemBuilder: (context, i) => rows[i]),
)
```

## Accessibility

The frame adds no semantics of its own; reading order is header, body, footer.

## Motion

The header divider fades over `CdsDurations.fast3`; instant under reduced motion.

## CDS React Native mapping

No CDS equivalent. CDS apps compose `TopNavBar`, a `ScrollView` and `StickyFooter` inside a safe-area view; `CdsScaffold` does that composition.

source: doc/components/CdsScrubber.md

# CdsScrubber

Highlights the scrubbed position of a chart: a dotted line, an overlay dimming later data, and a beacon on each series. At rest the beacons sit on the latest value.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/charts/Scrubber

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsLineChart(
  height: 200,
  enableScrubbing: true,
  series: [CdsLineSeries(id: 'a', data: [10, 22, 29, 45, 98, 45, 22])],
  children: [CdsScrubber()],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Add it last in `children` of any chart with `enableScrubbing: true`.
- Read the scrubbed index with the chart's `onScrubberPositionChange` to update a header or readout.
- Beacon labels appear for series with a `label`; hide them with `hideBeaconLabels` when a legend or header already names the series.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `seriesIds` | `List<String>?` | `null` | Series that get a beacon. Defaults to all. |
| `hideLine` | `bool` | `false` | Hide the dotted line and its label. |
| `hideOverlay` | `bool` | `false` | Hide the `bg` overlay (80% opacity) over data after the scrubbed point. |
| `overlayOffset` | `double` | `2` | Overlay overhang so thick strokes stay covered. |
| `hideBeaconLabels` | `bool` | `false` | Hide series labels next to beacons (always hidden in horizontal charts). |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Fixed text above the line. |
| `labelBuilder` | `String Function(int)?` | `null` | Text above the line for each data index. Overrides `label`. |
| `labelFont` | `CdsFont` | `CdsFont.label2` | Line label ramp entry. |
| `labelElevated` | `bool` | `false` | Draw the line label on an elevated pill. |
| `lineStroke` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Line color. Defaults to `bgLine`. |
| `beaconStroke` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Beacon ring color. Defaults to `bg`. |
| `beaconLabelFont` | `CdsFont` | `CdsFont.label1` | Beacon label ramp entry, colored with the series color. |
| `beaconLabelPreferredSide` | `CdsScrubberLabelSide` | `right` | Labels flip sides when there is no room. |
| `beaconLabelHorizontalOffset` | `double` | `16` | Distance from beacon to label. |
| `beaconLabelMinGap` | `double` | `4` | Minimum vertical gap between labels; overlapping labels are spread apart. |

## Examples

### Day label above the line

```dart
CdsLineChart(
  height: 220,
  enableScrubbing: true,
  series: const [
    CdsLineSeries(id: 'a', label: 'Series A', data: [4, 6, 5, 8]),
    CdsLineSeries(id: 'b', label: 'Series B', data: [3, 2, 6, 7], color: CdsColor.fgWarning),
  ],
  children: [CdsScrubber(labelBuilder: (i) => 'Day ${i + 1}')],
)
```

## Accessibility

The scrubber is drawn; the chart exposes the scrubbed value to screen readers and handles arrow keys. See `CdsCartesianChart`.

## Motion

- The line, overlay and beacons track the finger 1:1, snapping to the nearest data index. A selection haptic fires when the index changes, never on every frame.
- When data changes at rest, beacons follow the line's morph with the same spring.
- Beacons fade in after the line reveal. CDS's optional idle pulse is not ported because it loops.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `seriesIds`, `hideLine`, `hideOverlay`, `overlayOffset`, `hideBeaconLabels` | same names |
| `label` (string / function) | `label` / `labelBuilder` |
| `labelFont`, `labelElevated`, `lineStroke`, `beaconStroke` | same names |
| `beaconLabelFont`, `beaconLabelPreferredSide`, `beaconLabelHorizontalOffset`, `beaconLabelMinGap` | same names |
| `idlePulse`, `ref.pulse()` | not ported (looping motion) |
| `BeaconComponent`, `LineComponent`, `styles`, `transitions` | not ported |

# CdsSearchInput

A filled, pill-shaped search field with a search icon at the start and a clear button once there is text. Reach for it at the top of a list or screen to filter or search.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/SearchInput

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsSearchInput(
  placeholder: 'Search assets',
  value: query,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => query = v),
  onSearch: runSearch,
)
```

Control it with `value` + `onChange`, or with a `controller`, like `CdsTextInput`.

## When to use / when not to

- Use to search or filter content.
- Use `CdsTextInput` for regular data entry; the search look implies a query, not a value that gets saved.

## Behavior

- While focused, the search icon becomes a back arrow. Pressing it calls `onBack` and removes focus (dismissing the keyboard). Set `disableBackArrow` to keep the search icon, or `startIcon` to fix the glyph.
- Pressing the search icon calls `onSearch` with the current text and focuses the field.
- Submitting from the keyboard (search action) calls `onSearch`.
- The clear button shows when the text is not empty. It calls `onClear`, clears the text, keeps focus, then calls `onChange('')` and `onSearch('')`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `controller` | `TextEditingController?` | `null` | Owns the text when given. |
| `value` | `String?` | `null` | Text to show when no controller is given. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Full text after every edit, and `''` after clear. |
| `onSearch` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Submit, search icon press, and clear (with `''`). |
| `onClear` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Clear button pressed. |
| `onBack` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Back arrow pressed. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | `'Search'` | |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Optional label above the field. |
| `helperText` | `String?` | `null` | |
| `size` | `CdsTextInputSize?` | `null` (`l`) | |
| `compact` | `bool` | `false` | Size `s`. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `bordered` | `bool` | `true` | Shows the focus border. The resting field has no border. |
| `borderRadius` | `int` | `1000` | Radius token (pill). |
| `font` | `CdsFont` | `CdsFont.body` | |
| `startIcon` | `CdsSearchInputStartIcon?` | `null` | `search` or `backArrow`. Fixes the glyph. |
| `hideStartIcon` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `disableBackArrow` | `bool` | `false` | Keep the search glyph while focused. |
| `hideEndIcon` | `bool` | `false` | Never show the clear button. |
| `end` | `Widget?` | `null` | Replaces the clear button. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `onFocus` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `onBlur` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `inputFormatters` | `List<TextInputFormatter>?` | `null` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Defaults to `label`, then `placeholder`. |
| `startIconSemanticLabel` | `String` | `'Back'` | Back arrow label. |
| `searchIconSemanticLabel` | `String` | `'Search'` | Search icon button label. |
| `clearIconSemanticLabel` | `String` | `'Clear text'` | |

## Examples

### Fixed search glyph

```dart
CdsSearchInput(
  disableBackArrow: true,
  value: query,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => query = v),
)
```

### Compact in a toolbar

```dart
const CdsSearchInput(compact: true, placeholder: 'Search')
```

## Accessibility

- The field is a text field node labeled by `semanticLabel ?? label ?? placeholder`.
- The start icon and clear button are separate buttons with their own labels and are reachable by keyboard.
- Tapping the icons does not count as tapping outside the field, so focus is kept on desktop.

## Motion

Same as `CdsTextInput`: the focus border cross-fades in `moderate1`; instant under reduced motion. The icon swap on focus is immediate.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value` / `onChangeText` | `value` / `onChange` |
| `onSearch`, `onClear`, `onBack` | same names |
| `startIcon` (`'search' \| 'backArrow'`) | `startIcon` (`CdsSearchInputStartIcon`) |
| `hideStartIcon`, `hideEndIcon`, `disableBackArrow`, `end` | same names |
| `startIconAccessibilityLabel`, `clearIconAccessibilityLabel` | `startIconSemanticLabel`, `clearIconSemanticLabel` |
| (none) | `searchIconSemanticLabel` |
| `borderRadius` (default 1000), `compact`, `size`, `disabled`, `placeholder` | same names |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |

# CdsSectionHeader

A title for a section of a page, with optional leading widget, icon, balance, description and an end slot for a related action.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/navigation/SectionHeader

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsSectionHeader(title: 'Your assets')
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use above a list or group of cards to name it and offer a "See all" style action.
- Use [CdsPageHeader](CdsPageHeader.md) for the page's main title.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title | `String` | required | `title3`, exposed as a header. |
| start | `Widget?` | `null` | Before the title, for example an asset avatar. |
| icon | `CdsIconName?` | `null` | `xs` icon after the title. |
| iconActive | `bool` | `false` | Filled glyph for `icon`. |
| balance | `String?` | `null` | `title3` with tabular digits, under the title. |
| description | `String?` | `null` | `body`, `fgMuted`, at most 2 lines. |
| end | `Widget?` | `null` | Trailing action. Wraps below the text when both do not fit. |
| padding | `double` | `2` | Space token around the header. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Labels the whole header as one container. |

## Examples

### Balance and action

```dart
CdsSectionHeader(
  title: 'Your assets',
  balance: r'$1,204.18',
  description: 'Sample data',
  icon: CdsIconName.info,
  end: CdsButton(label: 'See all', variant: CdsButtonVariant.secondary, size: CdsButtonSize.s, onPress: openAll),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The title is a header.
- The end slot wraps below at large text sizes instead of clipping.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | `title` |
| `start` | `start` |
| `icon` (name or node) | `icon` |
| `iconActive` | `iconActive` |
| `balance` | `balance` |
| `description` | `description` |
| `end` | `end` |
| `padding` | `padding` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `accessibilityLabel` |
