# CdsSegmentedControl

A row of mutually exclusive options with a highlight that slides to the selected one, for switching views or units within a screen ("Buy | Sell", "1D | 1W | 1M").

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/SegmentedControl

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsSegmentedControl<String>(
  value: side,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => side = v),
  options: const [
    CdsSegmentedControlOption(value: 'buy', label: 'Buy'),
    CdsSegmentedControlOption(value: 'sell', label: 'Sell'),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for 2 to 5 short options that change what the current screen shows.
- Do not use for navigation between screens (use tabs) or for settings that submit a form (use `CdsRadioGroup`).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `List<CdsSegmentedControlOption<T>>` | required | At least two. |
| `value` | `T` | required | Selected value. A value matching no option shows no highlight. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<T>?` | `null` | Called with the newly selected value. `null` makes the control read-only. |
| `block` | `bool` | `false` | Fill the parent width. Otherwise every segment is as wide as the widest label. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Dims the segments and ignores taps, drags and keys. |
| `iconSize` | `CdsIconSize` | `m` | Size of icon options. |
| `feedback` | `CdsHapticFeedback` | `selection` | Haptic when the selection changes. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Names the group for screen readers. |

### CdsSegmentedControlOption<T>

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `T` | required | |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Text label. Give either `label` or `icon`. |
| `icon` | `CdsIconName?` | `null` | Icon label. |
| `iconActive` | `bool` | `false` | Filled glyph. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `label` | Required in practice for icon options. |

## Examples

### Full-width range picker

```dart
CdsSegmentedControl<String>(
  value: range,
  block: true,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => range = v),
  semanticLabel: 'Chart range',
  options: [
    for (final r in const ['1D', '1W', '1M', '1Y', 'All']) CdsSegmentedControlOption(value: r, label: r),
  ],
)
```

### Icons

```dart
CdsSegmentedControl<String>(
  value: chart,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => chart = v),
  options: const [
    CdsSegmentedControlOption(value: 'line', icon: CdsIconName.chartLine, semanticLabel: 'Line chart'),
    CdsSegmentedControlOption(value: 'bar', icon: CdsIconName.chartBar, semanticLabel: 'Bar chart'),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

- The group is a container labeled `semanticLabel`. Each segment is a button in a mutually exclusive group with a `selected` state, labeled by its `semanticLabel` or `label`.
- Tab reaches the segments; Enter or Space selects; Left and Right arrows move the selection (mirrored in RTL).
- The selected segment adds a checkmark and a heavier weight, so state is not conveyed by color alone.
- Segments are at least 44px tall.

## Motion

- The highlight springs (`CdsSprings.standard`) from wherever it is to the selected segment, so rapid changes never jump.
- Dragging across the control selects the segment under the finger as it passes, with a selection haptic on each change. If the drag starts on the highlight, the highlight follows the finger 1:1 (with a rubberband past the ends) and on release springs to the selected segment carrying the finger's velocity.
- Reduced motion moves the highlight instantly.

## CDS React Native mapping

CDS ships SegmentedControl on web only (deprecated there in favor of SegmentedTabs). This port follows the web visuals: `bgAlternate` track, `bgPrimaryWash` highlight, `fgPrimary` headline label with a checkmark.

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `options` (`{ value, label, accessibilityLabel }`) | `options` (`CdsSegmentedControlOption`) |
| `type: 'icon'` + `label: IconName` | `CdsSegmentedControlOption(icon: ...)` |
| `iconSize`, `value`, `onChange`, `block`, `disabled` | same names |

Deviations: the highlight is one rounded shape that slides between segments instead of per-segment backgrounds, and the control is controlled (`value` is required) rather than holding its own copy.

---
source: doc/components/CdsSegmentedTabs.md
---

# CdsSegmentedTabs

Pill-shaped tabs on a tinted track. The active pill slides between options with a spring and the label colors cross-fade. Reach for it for compact, mutually exclusive modes such as Buy / Sell.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/navigation/SegmentedTabs

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
String side = 'buy';

CdsSegmentedTabs(
  accessibilityLabel: 'Order type',
  tabs: const [
    CdsTabValue(id: 'buy', label: 'Buy'),
    CdsTabValue(id: 'sell', label: 'Sell'),
  ],
  activeTab: side,
  onChange: (id) => setState(() => side = id),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for two to four short options that switch a mode or view.
- Use [CdsTabs](CdsTabs.md) when labels are longer or there are more options.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| tabs | `List<CdsTabValue>` | required | Options in display order. |
| activeTab | `String?` | required | Id of the active option; `null` shows no pill. |
| onChange | `ValueChanged<String>` | required | Called with the picked id. |
| disabled | `bool` | `false` | Disables every option. |
| equalWidth | `bool` | `false` | Fill the parent's width and split it evenly. |
| color | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.fg` | Inactive label color. |
| activeColor | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.fgInverse` | Active label color. |
| background | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bgSecondary` | Track color. |
| activeBackground | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bgInverse` | Pill color. |
| borderRadius | `int` | `700` | Track radius token. |
| font | `CdsFont` | `CdsFont.headline` | Label font. |
| gap | `double` | `0` | Space token between options. |
| pageController | `PageController?` | `null` | Pill follows a `PageView` swipe. |
| tabBuilder | `CdsTabContentBuilder?` | `null` | Custom label content per option. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Names the group for screen readers. |

## Examples

### Equal width

```dart
CdsSegmentedTabs(
  equalWidth: true,
  tabs: const [
    CdsTabValue(id: '1d', label: '1D'),
    CdsTabValue(id: '1w', label: '1W'),
    CdsTabValue(id: '1m', label: '1M'),
    CdsTabValue(id: '1y', label: '1Y'),
  ],
  activeTab: range,
  onChange: (id) => setState(() => range = id),
)
```

## Accessibility

- Tab bar and tab roles with selected state and tap action.
- Left and Right arrows (mirrored in RTL), Home and End move the selection.
- Each option is at least 44px tall.

## Motion

- The pill springs (`CdsSprings.standard`) from its current position and width.
- Label colors cross-fade over `CdsDurations.fast3` with `CdsCurves.global`.
- Reduced motion moves the pill and colors instantly.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `tabs`, `activeTab`, `onChange` | `tabs`, `activeTab` (id), `onChange` (id) |
| `equalWidth` | `equalWidth` |
| `background`, `activeBackground` | `background`, `activeBackground` |
| `color`, `activeColor` | `color`, `activeColor` |
| `borderRadius` | `borderRadius` |
| `TabComponent` | `tabBuilder` |
| `TabsActiveIndicatorComponent` | not exposed |

Deviation: options are at least 44px tall (CDS draws 40px) so each pill meets the minimum tap target.

source: doc/components/CdsSelect.md

# CdsSelect

A form control for choosing one option (`CdsSelect`) or several (`CdsSelect.multi`) from a list; opens a tray on phones and an anchored menu on wide screens.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/Select

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsSelect<String>(
  label: 'Network',
  placeholder: 'Choose a network',
  value: network,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => network = v),
  options: const [
    CdsSelectOption(value: 'eth', label: 'Ethereum'),
    CdsSelectOption(value: 'sol', label: 'Solana'),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use in forms for 4 or more options. For 2 or 3 options prefer radio buttons or a segmented control. For long lists (countries, assets) use `CdsCombobox`. For filter bars use `CdsSelectChip`. For a menu on a button use `CdsDropdown`.

## Parameters

### CdsSelect<T> (single)

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| options | `List<CdsSelectOption<T>>` | required | The choices. |
| value | `T?` | required | Selected value, or null. |
| onChange | `ValueChanged<T?>?` | required | Called with the picked value. Null disables the control. |
| label | `String?` | `null` | Shown above the control (`label2`, `fgMuted`) and as the tray title. |
| placeholder | `String?` | `null` | Shown when nothing is selected. |
| helperText | `String?` | `null` | Hint or error under the control, colored by `variant`. |
| variant | `CdsSelectVariant?` | `null` | `foreground`, `foregroundMuted`, `positive`, `negative`, `primary`, `secondary`. |
| size | `CdsSelectSize` | `CdsSelectSize.l` | Vertical padding: `s` 8, `m` 12, `l` 16. |
| disabled | `bool` | `false` | Dimmed, cannot open. |
| readOnly | `bool` | `false` | Shows the value on `bgSecondary`, cannot open. |
| start | `Widget?` | `null` | Leading content inside the control. |
| presentation | `CdsSelectPresentation` | `CdsSelectPresentation.auto` | `auto` (tray below 768px, menu from 768px), `dropdown`, `tray`. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Defaults to `label`. |
| accessibilityHint | `String?` | `null` | Screen reader hint. |
| emptyOptionsLabel | `String` | `'No options available'` | Shown when there are no options. |
| onOpen | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called on open. |
| onClose | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called on close. |

### CdsSelect<T>.multi

Same as above, with `value` typed `List<T>` and `onChange` typed `ValueChanged<List<T>>?`, plus:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| maxSelectedOptionsToShow | `int` | `3` | Chips in the control before "+N more". |
| hiddenSelectedOptionsLabel | `String` | `'more'` | Word after the hidden count. |
| selectAllLabel | `String` | `'Select all'` | First row label (shows the count). |
| clearAllLabel | `String` | `'Clear all'` | Button on the select-all row. |
| hideSelectAll | `bool` | `false` | Hide the select-all row. |
| removeSelectedOptionAccessibilityLabel | `String` | `'Remove'` | Prefix of each chip's label. |

Getters: `value` (single) and `values` (multi), `isMulti`.

### CdsSelectOption<T>

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | `T` | required | The value reported by `onChange`. |
| label | `String?` | `null` | Row title and control text. Falls back to `description`, then `value.toString()`. |
| description | `String?` | `null` | Muted second line. |
| disabled | `bool` | `false` | Not selectable. |
| media | `Widget?` | `null` | Leading row content. |
| accessory | `Widget?` | `null` | Trailing indicator; replaces the check mark. |
| end | `Widget?` | `null` | Trailing content, for example a balance. |

Control: 1px `bgLineHeavy` border (2px `bgLinePrimary` while open), radius 200, caret that turns while open. Menu: `bg`, 1px `bgLine`, radius 400, elevation 2, max 300px tall, same width as the control.

## Examples

### Error state

```dart
CdsSelect<String>(
  label: 'Payment method',
  value: method,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => method = v),
  variant: CdsSelectVariant.negative,
  helperText: 'Choose a payment method to buy Bitcoin.',
  options: const [
    CdsSelectOption(value: 'bank', label: 'Bank account', description: 'Sample data: ending 1234'),
    CdsSelectOption(value: 'card', label: 'Debit card', description: 'Sample data: ending 4242'),
  ],
)
```

### Multiple choice

```dart
CdsSelect<String>.multi(
  label: 'Assets',
  placeholder: 'All assets',
  value: assets,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => assets = v),
  options: const [
    CdsSelectOption(value: 'btc', label: 'Bitcoin'),
    CdsSelectOption(value: 'eth', label: 'Ethereum'),
    CdsSelectOption(value: 'usdc', label: 'USDC'),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

- The control is a button whose label combines `label` and the current value ("Network, Ethereum").
- Menu: focus moves to the selected option; Up/Down, Home/End and typeahead navigate; Enter/Space choose; Escape closes and returns focus. Tray: standard tray behavior.
- Single rows expose `selected` and show a check mark; multi rows expose a toggled check box.
- Helper text is visible text, not color alone. Rows and chips have 44px targets.

## Motion

The caret turns over `fast3`. Menus use dropdown motion (fade, 16px slide, slight scale from the control, `moderate3`); trays use tray physics. Reduced motion: fades and instant caret.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `type: 'single' \| 'multi'` | `CdsSelect` / `CdsSelect.multi` |
| `options` (incl. groups) | `options` (flat list; groups not ported) |
| `value`, `onChange` | `value`, `onChange` (typed `T`) |
| `label`, `placeholder`, `helperText`, `variant`, `size`, `disabled`, `readOnly` | same |
| `startNode` | `start` |
| `maxSelectedOptionsToShow`, `hiddenSelectedOptionsLabel`, `selectAllLabel`, `clearAllLabel`, `hideSelectAll`, `emptyOptionsLabel`, `removeSelectedOptionAccessibilityLabel` | same |
| `accessibilityLabel`, `accessibilityHint` | same |
| `SelectControlComponent`, `SelectDropdownComponent`, `SelectOptionComponent` | not customizable |
| (mobile always opens a Tray) | `presentation` (`auto` adds the wide-screen menu) |

`CdsSelectVariant` mirrors CDS `InputVariant`; it is named for select so it does not clash with the text input family.

---
source: doc/components/CdsSelectChip.md
---

# CdsSelectChip

A chip-shaped select for filter bars; it inverts its colors while it holds a value so an applied filter stands out.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/SelectChip

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsSelectChip<String>(
  placeholder: 'All assets',
  value: filter,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => filter = v),
  options: const [
    CdsSelectOption(value: 'gainers', label: 'Top gainers'),
    CdsSelectOption(value: 'losers', label: 'Top losers'),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use in a row of filters above a list. In forms, use `CdsSelect` (it has a label and helper text).

## Parameters

### CdsSelectChip<T>

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| options | `List<CdsSelectOption<T>>` | required | The choices. |
| value | `T?` | required | Selected value. |
| onChange | `ValueChanged<T?>?` | required | Called with the picked value. Null disables. |
| label | `String?` | `null` | Tray title; chip text when no placeholder is set. |
| placeholder | `String?` | `null` | Chip text when nothing is selected. |
| displayValue | `String?` | `null` | Overrides the chip text. |
| compact | `bool` | `false` | Smaller chip (`label1`, 12 by 6 padding). |
| disabled | `bool` | `false` | Cannot open. |
| start | `Widget?` | `null` | Leading content in the chip. |
| presentation | `CdsSelectPresentation` | `CdsSelectPresentation.auto` | Tray below 768px, menu from 768px. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Screen reader label. |
| emptyOptionsLabel | `String` | `'No options available'` | Shown with no options. |
| onOpen | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called on open. |
| onClose | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called on close. |

`CdsSelectChip.multi` takes `List<T>` and `ValueChanged<List<T>>?`, plus `maxSelectedOptionsToShow` (2), `hiddenSelectedOptionsLabel` ('more'), `selectAllLabel` ('Select all'), `clearAllLabel` ('Clear all'), `hideSelectAll` (false).

Chip: `bgSecondary`, radius 700, 16 by 8 padding, `headline` text up to 200px, caret icon; inverted scheme while it has a value. The menu is at least 240px wide.

## Examples

### Multiple filters

```dart
CdsSelectChip<String>.multi(
  placeholder: 'Networks',
  value: networks,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => networks = v),
  options: const [
    CdsSelectOption(value: 'eth', label: 'Ethereum'),
    CdsSelectOption(value: 'sol', label: 'Solana'),
    CdsSelectOption(value: 'btc', label: 'Bitcoin'),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

The chip is a button labelled with its label and current value; 44px hit area. Value state is shown by text, not only by the color inversion.

## Motion

Caret turns over `fast3`; options open like `CdsSelect`. Reduced motion: fades.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value`, `onChange`, `options`, `placeholder`, `label` | same |
| `displayValue` | `displayValue` |
| `compact` | `compact` |
| `startNode` | `start` |
| `active`, `activeBackground`, `activeColor`, `invertColorScheme` | automatic inversion while a value is set; not configurable |
| `type: 'multi'` | `CdsSelectChip.multi` |

# CdsSidebar

Vertical app navigation for tablet and desktop layouts, holding `CdsSidebarItem`s and an optional `CdsSidebarMoreMenu`.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/navigation/Sidebar

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
Row(
  children: [
    CdsSidebar(
      autoCollapse: true,
      children: [
        CdsSidebarItem(icon: CdsIconName.home, title: 'Home', active: true, onPress: () {}),
        CdsSidebarItem(icon: CdsIconName.trading, title: 'Trade', onPress: () {}),
        CdsSidebarItem(icon: CdsIconName.wallet, title: 'Assets', onPress: () {}),
      ],
    ),
    const Expanded(child: Page()),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use on screens 768px and wider for top-level destinations. On phones, use `CdsBottomNavigation` or `CdsTabNavigation` instead.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required | Usually `CdsSidebarItem`s and a `CdsSidebarMoreMenu`. |
| `logo` | `Widget?` | `null` | Shown above the items. Never pass Coinbase marks. |
| `logoBuilder` | `Widget Function(bool collapsed)?` | `null` | Builds the logo for the collapsed state; wins over `logo`. |
| `collapsed` | `bool?` | `null` | Forces the collapsed state. Overrides `autoCollapse`. |
| `autoCollapse` | `bool` | `false` | Collapse to icons when the screen is narrower than 768px (`cdsSidebarAutoCollapseBreakpoint`). |
| `renderEnd` | `Widget Function(bool collapsed)?` | `null` | Content pinned to the bottom, 32px below the items. |
| `variant` | `CdsSidebarVariant` | `CdsSidebarVariant.defaultVariant` | `defaultVariant` (icon and title in a row) or `condensed` (title under the icon). |
| `width` | `double?` | `null` | Overrides the width: 240 expanded, 87 collapsed, 88 condensed. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `String` | `'Sidebar'` | Label for the navigation group. |

Descendants read the collapsed state and variant through `CdsSidebarScope.maybeOf(context)`.

## Examples

### Condensed rail

```dart
CdsSidebar(
  variant: CdsSidebarVariant.condensed,
  children: [
    CdsSidebarItem(icon: CdsIconName.home, title: 'Home', active: true, onPress: () {}),
    CdsSidebarItem(icon: CdsIconName.trading, title: 'Trade', onPress: () {}),
  ],
)
```

### Collapse toggle in the footer

```dart
CdsSidebar(
  collapsed: collapsed,
  renderEnd: (isCollapsed) => CdsIconButton(
    isCollapsed ? CdsIconName.caretRight : CdsIconName.caretLeft,
    semanticLabel: isCollapsed ? 'Expand sidebar' : 'Collapse sidebar',
    onPress: () => setState(() => collapsed = !collapsed),
  ),
  children: items,
)
```

## Accessibility

- The sidebar is a semantics group labelled `accessibilityLabel`; items are buttons, and the active item has the selected state.
- Collapsed items read their title even though only the icon shows.
- Up and Down arrow keys move focus between items; Tab order follows visual order.
- The end border uses `bgLine`, padding 16px (12px condensed) horizontally and 16px vertically.

## Motion

Width changes animate over `CdsDurations.moderate2` with `CdsCurves.global`; under reduced motion they are instant. Titles hide immediately when collapsing so nothing overflows while the width animates.

## CDS React Native mapping

CDS ships Sidebar for web only; this port follows the web API.

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `children` |
| `logo` (element or function) | `logo` / `logoBuilder` |
| `collapsed` | `collapsed` |
| `autoCollapse` | `autoCollapse` |
| `renderEnd` | `renderEnd` |
| `variant` (`'default'`, `'condensed'`) | `variant` (`defaultVariant`, `condensed`) |
| `width` | `width` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `accessibilityLabel` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsSidebarItem.md

# CdsSidebarItem

A destination in a `CdsSidebar`: an icon and a title, highlighted when it is the current page.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/navigation/SidebarItem

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsSidebarItem(
  icon: CdsIconName.wallet,
  title: 'Assets',
  active: route == '/assets',
  onPress: () => go('/assets'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use inside `CdsSidebar` or `CdsSidebarMoreMenu`. For lists of content, use cells instead.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `CdsIconName` | required | Shown at size `m`; the filled glyph when `active`. |
| `title` | `String` | required | Text label, `headline` (or `label1` at legal size in the condensed variant). |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Navigates. Null disables the item. Inside a `CdsSidebarMoreMenu`, pressing also closes the menu. |
| `active` | `bool` | `false` | The current destination: `bgPrimaryWash` background, `fgPrimary` icon and title. |
| `collapsed` | `bool?` | `null` | Overrides the sidebar's collapsed state. |
| `borderRadius` | `int?` | `null` | Radius token. Defaults to 1000 (pill), or 400 in the condensed variant. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Read when collapsed. Defaults to `title`. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | For moving focus programmatically. |

## Examples

### Icon only

```dart
CdsSidebarItem(icon: CdsIconName.settings, title: 'Settings', collapsed: true, onPress: openSettings)
```

## Accessibility

Built on `CdsPressable`: button role, selected state when active, focus ring, Enter and Space activate, 44px minimum hit area. Collapsed items announce the title.

## Motion

Pointer-down tint and 0.98 scale from `CdsPressable`; inactive items show the wash only while pressed or hovered. Selection haptic on press.

## CDS React Native mapping

Web only in CDS.

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `icon` | `icon` |
| `title` | `title` |
| `onClick` | `onPress` |
| `active` | `active` |
| `collapsed` | `collapsed` |
| `borderRadius` | `borderRadius` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `accessibilityLabel` |
| `tooltipContent` | not supported (tooltips live in another package area) |
| `Component` | not supported |

---
source: doc/components/CdsSidebarMoreMenu.md
---

# CdsSidebarMoreMenu

A "More" item in a `CdsSidebar` that opens a menu of extra destinations beside the sidebar.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/navigation/SidebarMoreMenu

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsSidebarMoreMenu(
  children: [
    CdsSidebarItem(icon: CdsIconName.settings, title: 'Settings', onPress: openSettings),
    CdsSidebarItem(icon: CdsIconName.info, title: 'Help', onPress: openHelp),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use when a sidebar has more destinations than fit, or for secondary ones. Keep the most used destinations as top-level items.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required | Menu content, usually `CdsSidebarItem`s. |
| `active` | `bool` | `false` | Highlights the trigger, e.g. when the current page lives in the menu. |
| `triggerTitle` | `String` | `'More'` | Title of the trigger item (icon `moreVertical`). |
| `onOpenChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | `null` | Called with true on open and false on close. |

`CdsSidebarMoreMenu.close(BuildContext context)` closes the menu from custom content inside it.

## Examples

### Custom content that closes the menu

```dart
CdsSidebarMoreMenu(
  children: [
    Builder(
      builder: (context) => CdsButton(
        label: 'Sign out',
        variant: CdsButtonVariant.secondary,
        onPress: () {
          CdsSidebarMoreMenu.close(context);
          signOut();
        },
      ),
    ),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

- The trigger reports the expanded state.
- On open, focus moves to the first focusable item; Up and Down move between items.
- Escape, a tap outside, or pressing an item closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger.

## Motion

The panel opens 24px to the end side of the trigger, aligned to its top, and grows from that corner: scale 0.95 to 1 with a fade over `CdsDurations.fast3` (`enterFunctional` in, `exitFunctional` out). It leaves the same way. Under reduced motion it appears and disappears instantly. Panel: `bgElevation2`, level 2 shadow, radius 400, 200 to 320px wide.

## CDS React Native mapping

Web only in CDS, where it wraps `Dropdown`.

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `children` |
| `active` | `active` |
| `triggerTitle` | `triggerTitle` |
| `onClick` | not needed; the trigger toggles the menu |
| `value` / `onChange` | not supported; use `onPress` on each item |
| `tooltipContent`, `disablePortal`, `Component` | not supported |

---
source: doc/components/CdsSlideButton.md
---

# CdsSlideButton

A slide-to-confirm control: the user drags a handle across the track to commit an action that should not fire on a stray tap, such as sending funds or closing an account.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/SlideButton

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
bool sent = false;

CdsSlideButton(
  checked: sent,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => sent = v),
  uncheckedLabel: 'Slide to send',
  checkedLabel: 'Sending',
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for a single high-stakes confirmation at the bottom of a review screen. Use `CdsButton` for routine actions, and a confirmation dialog when the user needs to read terms before confirming. Do not place two slide buttons on one screen.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | `bool` | required | Whether the action is confirmed. The handle fills the track when true. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | `null` | Called with `true` when a slide commits. The widget never calls it with `false`; reset by passing `checked: false`. |
| `uncheckedLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Text centered on the track while unchecked. Also the accessibility label. |
| `checkedLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Text on the full-width handle while checked. Also the accessibility label when checked. |
| `uncheckedLabelNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom track content; overrides `uncheckedLabel` visually. |
| `checkedLabelNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom checked handle content; overrides `checkedLabel` visually. |
| `startUncheckedNode` | `Widget?` | forward arrow icon | Content at the end of the resting handle. |
| `endCheckedNode` | `Widget?` | indeterminate `CdsProgressCircle` | Content at the end of the checked handle. |
| `onSlideStart` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | A drag on the handle began. |
| `onSlideCancel` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | The drag ended without committing. Called before `onSlideEnd`. |
| `onSlideComplete` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | The slide committed. Called after `onChange`, before `onSlideEnd`. |
| `onSlideEnd` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called last in every slide sequence. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Ignores drags, dims the handle and shows the track label at 50% opacity. |
| `size` | `CdsSlideButtonSize?` | `l` (or `s` with `compact`) | `s` 40px, `m` 48px, `l` 56px tall. |
| `compact` | `bool` | `false` | Same as `size: CdsSlideButtonSize.s`. Kept for parity with the deprecated CDS prop. |
| `height` | `double?` | size height | Overrides the size's height. The control grows when large text needs more room. |
| `variant` | `CdsSlideButtonVariant` | `primary` | Handle color: `primary` (bgPrimary), `positive` (bgPositive), `negative` (bgNegative). |
| `borderRadius` | `int?` | `700` for `s`, `900` for `m`/`l` | Radius token. |
| `checkThreshold` | `double` | `0.7` | Fraction of the track, in (0, 1], the handle must cover to commit. |
| `autoCompleteSlideOnThresholdMet` | `bool` | `false` | Commit as soon as the threshold is reached, without waiting for release. |
| `feedback` | `CdsHapticFeedback` | `normal` | Haptic fired on commit. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | current label | Overrides the accessibility label. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | |

Callback order on commit: `onSlideStart`, `onChange(true)`, `onSlideComplete`, `onSlideEnd`. On cancel: `onSlideStart`, `onSlideCancel`, `onSlideEnd`.

## Examples

### Reset after a failed action

```dart
CdsSlideButton(
  checked: sending,
  onChange: (_) async {
    setState(() => sending = true);
    final ok = await send();
    if (!ok) setState(() => sending = false);
  },
  uncheckedLabel: 'Slide to send',
  checkedLabel: 'Sending',
)
```

### Destructive action

```dart
CdsSlideButton(
  checked: closing,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => closing = v),
  variant: CdsSlideButtonVariant.negative,
  uncheckedLabel: 'Slide to close account',
  checkedLabel: 'Closing account',
)
```

### Compact, custom handle content

```dart
CdsSlideButton(
  checked: done,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => done = v),
  size: CdsSlideButtonSize.s,
  uncheckedLabel: 'Slide to buy',
  startUncheckedNode: const CdsIcon(CdsIconName.arrowRight, size: CdsIconSize.s, color: CdsColor.fgInverse),
  endCheckedNode: const CdsIcon(CdsIconName.checkmark, size: CdsIconSize.s, color: CdsColor.fgInverse),
)
```

## Accessibility

- Exposed as one button whose label is `uncheckedLabel` or `checkedLabel`. While unchecked and enabled it has a tap action that commits, so screen reader users activate it with a double tap instead of a drag.
- Keyboard: Tab focuses it (focus ring drawn outside the track), Enter or Space commits.
- The control grows taller instead of clipping when the text scale is large.
- Pass string labels, or set `semanticLabel` when you use the `...Node` slots.

## Motion

- The handle tints on pointer-down and follows the finger 1:1 from where it was grabbed. Past the end it stretches with `CdsMotion.rubberband` resistance.
- On release it commits when it covers `checkThreshold`, or when the flick velocity projected with `CdsMotion.project` would carry it there. Otherwise it springs back to rest, starting with the release velocity.
- Changes to `checked` spring the handle from wherever it is (`CdsSprings.standard`), so a reset mid-flight never jumps.
- The checked and unchecked handle contents cross-fade over `moderate1`.
- The default checked spinner runs only while `checked` is true and holds still under reduced motion.
- Reduced motion: state changes jump instantly; drags still follow the finger.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `checked` | `checked` |
| `onChange` | `onChange` |
| `uncheckedLabel` (string / node) | `uncheckedLabel` / `uncheckedLabelNode` |
| `checkedLabel` (string / node) | `checkedLabel` / `checkedLabelNode` |
| `startUncheckedNode` | `startUncheckedNode` |
| `endCheckedNode` | `endCheckedNode` |
| `onSlideStart` / `onSlideCancel` / `onSlideComplete` / `onSlideEnd` | same names |
| `disabled` | `disabled` |
| `size` / `compact` | `size` / `compact` |
| `height` | `height` |
| `variant` | `variant` (`CdsSlideButtonVariant`) |
| `borderRadius` | `borderRadius` |
| `checkThreshold` | `checkThreshold` |
| `autoCompleteSlideOnThresholdMet` | `autoCompleteSlideOnThresholdMet` |
| `SlideButtonHandleComponent` / `SlideButtonBackgroundComponent` | not ported; use the `...Node` slots |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsSlider.md

# CdsSlider

Picks one value from a continuous or stepped range by dragging a thumb along a track. CDS has no slider; this one is built from CDS tokens to match the selection controls.

CDS reference: none (extra component, styled after https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/Switch)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
double allocation = 0.4;

CdsSlider(
  value: allocation,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => allocation = v),
  semanticLabel: 'Allocation',
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it when the exact value matters less than its position in a range (allocation, volume, a rough amount). When users need a precise number, use `CdsTextInput` with a numeric keyboard or `CdsNumpad`. For a start and end value, use `CdsRangeSlider`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `double` | required | Current value, between `min` and `max`. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<double>?` | required | Called with each new value while dragging, on tap and on key presses. Null disables the slider. |
| `onChangeStart` | `ValueChanged<double>?` | `null` | Called once when a drag, tap or key press starts a change. |
| `onChangeEnd` | `ValueChanged<double>?` | `null` | Called once with the final value. |
| `min` | `double` | `0` | |
| `max` | `double` | `1` | Must be greater than `min`. |
| `divisions` | `int?` | `null` | Number of discrete steps. Null for a continuous slider. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Ignores input and dims to 50% opacity. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessibility label, e.g. "Volume". |
| `formatValue` | `String Function(double)?` | percentage of the range | Text read by screen readers for the value. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | |

Taps and key presses call `onChangeStart`, `onChange`, `onChangeEnd` in that order. Drags call `onChangeStart` once, `onChange` each time the (snapped) value changes, and `onChangeEnd` on release.

## Examples

### Stepped

```dart
CdsSlider(
  value: amount,
  min: 0,
  max: 1000,
  divisions: 20,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => amount = v),
  semanticLabel: 'Amount',
  formatValue: (v) => '${v.round()} dollars',
)
```

### Commit only on release

```dart
CdsSlider(
  value: draft,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => draft = v),
  onChangeEnd: saveSetting,
  semanticLabel: 'Brightness',
)
```

### Disabled

```dart
const CdsSlider(value: 0.6, onChange: null, semanticLabel: 'Allocation')
```

## Accessibility

- The thumb is a slider in the semantics tree with its label, value, and the values one step up and down. Increase and decrease actions step by one division (1% without `divisions`).
- Keyboard: Tab focuses the thumb (focus ring around it). Arrow keys step by one division; Shift+arrow and Page Up/Down step by 10% of the range (or a tenth of the divisions); Home and End jump to `min` and `max`. Left and right follow reading direction under RTL.
- The touch target is the full 44px-tall track, not only the 24px thumb.
- Set `semanticLabel`; a slider without one is announced only by its value.

## Motion

- The thumb tints on pointer-down and follows the finger 1:1 from where it was grabbed, even with `divisions` set. On release it springs to the snapped value.
- A tap on the track springs the thumb from where it is to the tap point.
- Value changes from outside spring from the current position (`CdsSprings.standard`).
- A selection haptic fires each time a drag crosses a division.
- Reduced motion: value changes jump instantly; drags still follow the finger.

## CDS React Native mapping

CDS has no slider. Names follow CDS conventions:

| Convention | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value` / `onChange` | `value` / `onChange` |
| `disabled` | `disabled` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsSparkline.md

# CdsSparkline

A small, non-interactive trend line for list rows, cards and tables.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/charts/Sparkline

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsSparkline(data: [10, 22, 29, 45, 98, 45, 22], width: 64, height: 20, color: CdsColor.fgPositive)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it to show the shape of a trend next to a value, such as an asset row with its price.
- Use `fill: true` for a larger standalone sparkline that needs more visual weight.
- Do not use it when people need to read exact values. Use `CdsSparklineInteractive` or `CdsLineChart` with a scrubber.
- CDS marks Sparkline as deprecated in favor of LineChart. It is ported because it is small and cheap for list rows.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `List<double>` | required | Values in time order. Non-finite values are skipped. Downsampled to one point per 3px (LTTB). |
| `height` | `double` | required | Height in logical pixels. |
| `width` | `double?` | `null` | Width in logical pixels. Defaults to the parent's width. |
| `color` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.fgPrimary` | Line color token. |
| `dangerouslySetColor` | `Color?` | `null` | Raw line color, for asset brand colors. Takes precedence over `color`. |
| `yAxisScalingFactor` | `double?` | `null` | Below 1 shows less variance, above 1 more (may clip). When set, the path is centered vertically. |
| `strokeType` | `CdsSparklineStrokeType` | `solid` | `gradient` darkens the line from left to right in light mode (solid in dark mode). |
| `fill` | `bool` | `false` | Fill the area under the line. |
| `fillType` | `CdsSparklineFillType` | `dotted` | `dotted` (4px dot pattern, 20% opacity light, 40% dark), `gradient` (30% to 0%), `gradientDotted` (dots fading to the bottom). |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Screen reader label. Defaults to `Trend: lowest X, highest Y, latest Z`. |

## Examples

### Asset row

```dart
const CdsHStack(
  gap: 2,
  alignItems: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
  children: [
    Expanded(child: CdsText.headline('Sample asset')),
    CdsSparkline(data: [4, 6, 5, 8, 7, 9], width: 64, height: 20, color: CdsColor.fgPositive),
  ],
)
```

### Gradient fill

```dart
const CdsSparkline(
  data: [4, 6, 5, 8, 7, 9, 12, 10],
  height: 120,
  fill: true,
  fillType: CdsSparklineFillType.gradient,
)
```

### Brand color from the spectrum

```dart
CdsSparkline(
  data: const [4, 6, 5, 8],
  width: 64,
  height: 20,
  dangerouslySetColor: context.cds.spectrum.of(CdsHue.orange, 50),
)
```

## Accessibility

The sparkline is one image node. Its label summarizes the lowest, highest and latest value; pass `semanticLabel` with formatted values (currency, units) when the plain numbers are not enough. Do not rely on the line color alone to signal gain or loss; show the change as text next to it.

## Motion

New `data` morphs from the current line to the new one over 450ms with ease-out-quint (the CDS sparkline path timing). Point arrays of different lengths are resampled. Under reduced motion the line changes instantly. Nothing animates at rest.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `path` (from `useSparklinePath`) | `data` (the path is built internally) |
| `width`, `height` | `width`, `height` |
| `color` | `color` or `dangerouslySetColor` |
| `color="auto"` + `background` | not ported; pick a token |
| `yAxisScalingFactor` | `yAxisScalingFactor` |
| `strokeType` | `strokeType` |
| `fillType` | `fillType` |
| `children` (`SparklineArea`) | `fill: true` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsSparklineGradient.md
---

# CdsSparklineGradient

A sparkline whose line darkens from left to right in light mode, with an optional dotted area.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/charts/SparklineGradient

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsSparklineGradient(data: [4, 6, 5, 8, 7, 9], width: 64, height: 20, color: CdsColor.fgPositive)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it where CDS products use SparklineGradient: asset rows that want a little more depth than a flat line.
- It is the same as `CdsSparkline(strokeType: CdsSparklineStrokeType.gradient)` with a dotted fill. Prefer `CdsSparkline` for new code.
- CDS turns the gradient off in dark mode; so does this port.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `List<double>` | required | Values in time order. Non-finite values are skipped. |
| `height` | `double` | required | Height in logical pixels. |
| `width` | `double?` | `null` | Defaults to the parent's width. |
| `color` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.fgPrimary` | Line color token. The gradient runs from this color to a 30% darker shade. |
| `dangerouslySetColor` | `Color?` | `null` | Raw line color. Takes precedence over `color`. |
| `yAxisScalingFactor` | `double?` | `null` | Below 1 shows less variance, above 1 more. |
| `fill` | `bool` | `false` | Fill the area with the dot pattern. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Screen reader label. Defaults to the lowest, highest and latest value. |

## Examples

### With dotted area

```dart
const CdsSparklineGradient(data: [4, 6, 5, 8, 7, 9, 12], height: 80, fill: true)
```

## Accessibility

Same as `CdsSparkline`: one image node labeled with a value summary.

## Motion

Data changes morph over 450ms (ease-out-quint), instantly under reduced motion.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `path` | `data` |
| `color` | `color` or `dangerouslySetColor` |
| `yAxisScalingFactor` | `yAxisScalingFactor` |
| `children` (`SparklineArea`) | `fill: true` |

source: doc/components/CdsSparklineInteractive.md

# CdsSparklineInteractive

A full-width price chart with period tabs. Drag across it (or long-press and drag) to read values; the header above can follow along.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/charts/SparklineInteractive

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsSparklineInteractive<String>(
  data: {
    '1D': [
      CdsChartDataPoint(value: 10, date: DateTime(2025, 1, 1, 9)),
      CdsChartDataPoint(value: 14, date: DateTime(2025, 1, 1, 12)),
      CdsChartDataPoint(value: 12, date: DateTime(2025, 1, 1, 15)),
    ],
  },
  periods: const [CdsSparklinePeriod(label: '1D', value: '1D')],
  defaultPeriod: '1D',
  formatDate: (date, period) => '${date.hour}:00',
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for the main price chart on an asset screen: one series, several periods, scrubbing.
- Pair it with `CdsSparklineInteractiveHeader` through `headerNode` and update the header from `onScrub`.
- Use `CdsLineChart` for multiple series, axes or custom elements. CDS marks SparklineInteractive as deprecated in favor of LineChart.
- Provide every period's data up front, or an empty list while loading (the fallback shows).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `Map<T, List<CdsChartDataPoint>>?` | required | Points per period, in time order. Missing or empty shows `fallback`. |
| `periods` | `List<CdsSparklinePeriod<T>>` | required | Tabs under the chart: `label` is shown, `value` keys into `data`. |
| `defaultPeriod` | `T` | required | Period selected on first build. Later selections are internal. |
| `formatDate` | `String Function(DateTime, T)` | required | Formats the five date labels shown under the chart while scrubbing, and screen reader values. |
| `onPeriodChanged` | `ValueChanged<T>?` | `null` | Called when a period tab is pressed. |
| `onScrubStart` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called once when scrubbing begins. |
| `onScrub` | `ValueChanged<CdsChartScrubParams<T>>?` | `null` | Called each time the scrubbed data point changes (not on every pointer move). |
| `onScrubEnd` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called when the finger lifts, the gesture cancels or Escape is pressed. |
| `disableScrubbing` | `bool` | `false` | Turns off drag, long-press and keyboard scrubbing. |
| `strokeColor` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.fgPrimary` | Line, scrub line and selected period color. |
| `dangerouslySetStrokeColor` | `Color?` | `null` | Raw line color, for asset brand colors. |
| `fallback` | `Widget?` | `null` | Shown when the selected period has no data. Defaults to a static placeholder line. |
| `fallbackType` | `CdsSparklineFallbackType` | `positive` | Direction of the default placeholder line. |
| `compact` | `bool` | `false` | 120px chart instead of 320px. |
| `height` | `double?` | `null` | Plot height in logical pixels. Defaults to 320, or 120 when `compact`. |
| `hidePeriodSelector` | `bool` | `false` | Hides the period tabs. |
| `fill` | `bool` | `true` | Fill the area under the line. |
| `fillType` | `CdsSparklineFillType` | `gradient` | `gradient`, or `dotted` (dots fading toward the bottom). |
| `formatHoverDate` | `String Function(DateTime, T)?` | `null` | Formats the date shown above the scrub point. Omit to hide it. |
| `formatHoverPrice` | `String Function(double)?` | `null` | Formats values for screen readers. Defaults to a plain number. |
| `headerNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Content above the chart, usually a `CdsSparklineInteractiveHeader`. |
| `timePeriodGutter` | `double?` | `null` | Space token around the period selector. |
| `periodSelectorPlacement` | `CdsSparklinePeriodSelectorPlacement` | `below` | Put the tabs `above` or `below` the chart. |
| `yAxisScalingFactor` | `double` | `1.0` | Below 1 shows less variance, above 1 more. |
| `hideMinMaxLabel` | `bool` | `false` | Hides the highest and lowest value labels. |
| `formatMinMaxLabel` | `String Function(double)?` | `null` | Formats the highest and lowest value labels. |
| `gutter` | `double` | `3` | Space token for horizontal padding (24px). |
| `disableHorizontalPadding` | `bool` | `false` | Skip the padding when the parent already provides it. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | Focus node for keyboard scrubbing. |

`CdsChartScrubParams<T>` carries `point` (`CdsChartDataPoint`), `period`, `index`, and the point's pixel `x` and `y`.

## Examples

### Header that follows the scrubber

```dart
class PriceChart extends StatefulWidget {
  const PriceChart({super.key, required this.points});

  final List<CdsChartDataPoint> points;

  @override
  State<PriceChart> createState() => _PriceChartState();
}

class _PriceChartState extends State<PriceChart> {
  final _header = CdsSparklineInteractiveHeaderController();

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _header.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return CdsSparklineInteractive<String>(
      data: {'1D': widget.points},
      periods: const [CdsSparklinePeriod(label: '1D', value: '1D')],
      defaultPeriod: '1D',
      formatDate: (d, _) => '${d.hour}:${d.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}',
      formatHoverDate: (d, _) => '${d.month}/${d.day} ${d.hour}:00',
      onScrub: (p) => _header.update(title: '\$${p.point.value.toStringAsFixed(2)}'),
      onScrubEnd: _header.reset,
      headerNode: CdsSparklineInteractiveHeader(
        controller: _header,
        defaultLabel: 'Sample asset',
        defaultTitle: '\$${widget.points.last.value.toStringAsFixed(2)}',
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

### Compact, dotted fill, no min and max labels

```dart
CdsSparklineInteractive<int>(
  data: const {0: []},
  periods: const [CdsSparklinePeriod(label: '1W', value: 0)],
  defaultPeriod: 0,
  compact: true,
  hideMinMaxLabel: true,
  fillType: CdsSparklineFillType.dotted,
  formatDate: (d, _) => '${d.month}/${d.day}',
)
```

## Accessibility

- The chart is an adjustable node. Its label reads the period and the lowest, highest and latest value; its value reads the current point (`date, value`). Screen reader users swipe up and down to move through points.
- Keyboard: when focused, Left and Right arrows move the scrub point (the first press starts at the latest point), Escape ends scrubbing. A focus ring shows for keyboard focus.
- Period tabs are buttons with selected state, spoken names (`1D` reads "1 day") and CDS hints ("Show data for the 1 week timeframe").
- Gain and loss should also appear as text in the header, not only as the line color.

## Motion

- The scrub line follows the finger 1:1. The highlighted point, hover date and `onScrub` snap to the nearest data point, and a selection haptic fires each time that point changes.
- Switching periods morphs the line over 450ms with ease-out-quint (CDS `animatedPathConfig`), starting from wherever the line is, so quick taps never jump. The min and max labels fade back in when the morph finishes.
- Labels and the period selector cross-fade over 200ms when scrubbing starts and ends.
- Reduced motion: period changes and fades are instant. The loading placeholder is static; nothing loops.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `data` | `data` |
| `periods` | `periods` (`CdsSparklinePeriod`) |
| `defaultPeriod` | `defaultPeriod` |
| `onPeriodChanged` | `onPeriodChanged` |
| `onScrubStart`, `onScrub`, `onScrubEnd` | same names |
| `disableScrubbing` | `disableScrubbing` |
| `formatDate` | `formatDate` |
| `strokeColor` | `strokeColor` or `dangerouslySetStrokeColor` |
| `fallback`, `fallbackType` | `fallback`, `fallbackType` |
| `compact`, `hidePeriodSelector`, `fill`, `fillType` | same names |
| `formatHoverDate`, `formatHoverPrice` | same names |
| `headerNode` | `headerNode` |
| `hoverData` | not ported |
| `timePeriodGutter`, `periodSelectorPlacement` | same names |
| `yAxisScalingFactor`, `hideMinMaxLabel`, `formatMinMaxLabel` | same names |
| `gutter`, `disableHorizontalPadding` | same names |
| `allowOverflowGestures` | not needed; drags keep tracking outside the chart |

---
source: doc/components/CdsSparklineInteractiveHeader.md
---

# CdsSparklineInteractiveHeader

The asset header above a price chart: a label, a large tabular price and a change line, updated live while scrubbing.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/charts/SparklineInteractiveHeader

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsSparklineInteractiveHeader(
  defaultLabel: 'Sample asset',
  defaultTitle: r'$1,204.18',
  defaultSubHead: CdsSparklineInteractiveSubHead(
    percent: '4.55%',
    priceChange: r'$52.40',
    sign: CdsSparklineInteractiveHeaderSignVariant.positive,
    variant: CdsSparklineInteractiveHeaderVariant.positive,
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it as the `headerNode` of `CdsSparklineInteractive`, or above a `CdsLineChart` with a scrubber.
- Update it from scrub callbacks through a `CdsSparklineInteractiveHeaderController` so only the header rebuilds.
- Do not use it as a generic page header; use the navigation components for that.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultTitle` | `String` | required | Title shown when the controller has no override, usually the price. Set in `title1` with tabular figures; titles longer than 12 characters shrink proportionally. |
| `defaultLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Muted `label1` text above the title. |
| `defaultSubHead` | `CdsSparklineInteractiveSubHead?` | `null` | The change line under the title. |
| `controller` | `CdsSparklineInteractiveHeaderController?` | `null` | Live overrides for label, title and sub head. |
| `labelNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Replaces the text label. |
| `trailing` | `Widget?` | `null` | Content at the end of the row, such as an icon button. |
| `compact` | `bool` | `false` | Use `title3` for the title. |

### CdsSparklineInteractiveSubHead

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `percent` | `String` | required | Formatted percent change. |
| `sign` | `CdsSparklineInteractiveHeaderSignVariant` | required | `positive` (+), `negative` (-), `upwardTrend`, `downwardTrend`, `none`. |
| `variant` | `CdsSparklineInteractiveHeaderVariant` | required | `positive` (fgPositive), `negative` (fgNegative), `foregroundMuted` (fgMuted, no sign space). |
| `priceChange` | `String?` | `null` | Formatted amount. Shown as `priceChange (percent)`. |
| `accessoryText` | `String?` | `null` | Muted text after the change, such as `All time`. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Localized screen reader text for the change. |

### CdsSparklineInteractiveHeaderController

`update({String? label, String? title, CdsSparklineInteractiveSubHead? subHead})` overrides any part; null arguments keep the current value. `reset()` returns to the defaults. Dispose it with the owning state.

## Examples

### Updating while scrubbing

```dart
final header = CdsSparklineInteractiveHeaderController();

final chart = CdsSparklineInteractive<String>(
  data: const {'1D': []},
  periods: const [CdsSparklinePeriod(label: '1D', value: '1D')],
  defaultPeriod: '1D',
  formatDate: (d, _) => '${d.hour}:00',
  onScrub: (p) => header.update(title: p.point.value.toStringAsFixed(2)),
  onScrubEnd: header.reset,
  headerNode: CdsSparklineInteractiveHeader(controller: header, defaultTitle: '0.00'),
);
```

## Accessibility

The header is one header node and a polite live region, so updates are announced. Its label reads `label, title, up|down priceChange, percent` (or the sub head's `accessibilityLabel`) with the CDS hint "The price and difference for this time period". The sign character never carries meaning alone; the change text and its color go together.

## Motion

None. Values swap instantly; the sign column has a fixed width so the text does not shift when + becomes -.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `defaultTitle`, `defaultLabel`, `defaultSubHead` | same names |
| `ref.update({label, title, subHead})` | `controller.update(...)` |
| `labelNode`, `trailing`, `compact` | same names |
| `SparklineInteractiveSubHead` | `CdsSparklineInteractiveSubHead` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsSpinner.md

# CdsSpinner

An indeterminate loading indicator for waits of unknown length.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/feedback/Spinner

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsSpinner()
```

## When to use / when not to

Use for short, unknown waits. For buttons use their `loading` flag. For content with a known shape, use `CdsFallback`; for known progress, `CdsProgressBar`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| size | `CdsSpinnerSize` | `CdsSpinnerSize.small` | `small` 20px, `large` 36px. |
| pixelSize | `double?` | `null` | Exact diameter; overrides `size`. |
| color | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bgPrimary` | Arc color. |
| animating | `bool` | `true` | False hides it while keeping its space. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String` | `'Loading'` | Announced to screen readers. |

## Examples

### Large

```dart
const CdsSpinner(size: CdsSpinnerSize.large)
```

## Accessibility

A live region labelled "Loading" by default.

## Motion

Built on `CdsProgressCircle.indeterminate`: spins only while on screen; under reduced motion it holds still and still announces loading.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `size` (`'small' \| 'large'`) | `size` (`CdsSpinnerSize`) |
| `size` (number, web) | `pixelSize` |
| `color` | `color` |
| `animating` | `animating` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `accessibilityLabel` |

# CdsHStack / CdsVStack

Rows and columns with token-based gaps. The workhorse of every CDS layout.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/layout/HStack, https://cds.coinbase.com/components/layout/VStack

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsVStack(gap: 2, padding: 3, children: [
  CdsText.title1('Send'),
  CdsText.body('Choose an asset to send.'),
])

CdsHStack(gap: 1, children: [CdsIcon(CdsIconName.wallet), CdsText.headline('Wallet')])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required | |
| `gap` | `double?` | `null` | Space token between children. |
| `alignItems` | `CrossAxisAlignment?` | stretch (VStack), center (HStack) | |
| `justifyContent` | `MainAxisAlignment` | `start` | |
| `mainAxisSize` | `MainAxisSize` | `max` | Use `min` to shrink-wrap. |
| `wrap` | `bool` | `false` | Flow onto new lines (`flexWrap: wrap`). |
| `rowGap` | `double?` | `gap` | Space between wrapped lines. |
| `padding*`, `background`, `borderRadius`, `bordered` | | | Box props, as on `CdsBox`. |

## Related

- `CdsSpacer()` fills remaining space; `CdsSpacer.fixed(2)` is a 16px gap.
- `CdsDivider()` draws a 1px `bgLine` line; `direction: Axis.vertical` for rows; `paddingX`/`paddingY` tokens.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `<HStack gap={1} alignItems="center">` | `CdsHStack(gap: 1, alignItems: CrossAxisAlignment.center)` |
| `justifyContent="space-between"` | `justifyContent: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween` |
| `flexWrap="wrap"` | `wrap: true` |

# CdsStepper

Shows progress through a fixed sequence of steps, such as identity verification or a multi-screen form.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/navigation/Stepper

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsStepper(
  direction: CdsStepperDirection.horizontal,
  activeStepId: 'id',
  steps: const [
    CdsStepperStep(id: 'email', label: 'Verify email'),
    CdsStepperStep(id: 'id', label: 'Verify identity'),
    CdsStepperStep(id: 'bank', label: 'Link a bank'),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use when a task has a known number of ordered steps and seeing the remaining work helps. Use horizontal at the top of a flow screen; use vertical for an overview with labels and nested sub-steps. Do not use for free navigation between sections; use tabs. For a single percentage, use a progress bar.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `direction` | `CdsStepperDirection` | required | `horizontal` or `vertical`. |
| `steps` | `List<CdsStepperStep>` | required | The steps, in order. |
| `activeStepId` | `String?` | required | Id of the current step (may be a sub-step), or null for none. |
| `complete` | `bool` | `false` | Marks every step done and hides the horizontal header text. |
| `animate` | `bool` | `true` | Fill bars one step at a time. Off, bars change instantly. |
| `completedStepAccessibilityLabel` | `String` | `'Complete'` | Appended to visited step labels for screen readers. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Horizontal: replaces the "Label N of M" announcement. Vertical: labels the group. |

`CdsStepperStep({required String id, String? label, String? accessibilityLabel, List<CdsStepperStep>? subSteps})`.

## Examples

### Vertical with sub-steps

```dart
CdsStepper(
  direction: CdsStepperDirection.vertical,
  activeStepId: 'selfie',
  steps: const [
    CdsStepperStep(id: 'email', label: 'Verify email'),
    CdsStepperStep(id: 'id', label: 'Verify identity', subSteps: [
      CdsStepperStep(id: 'doc', label: 'Upload document'),
      CdsStepperStep(id: 'selfie', label: 'Take a selfie'),
    ]),
    CdsStepperStep(id: 'bank', label: 'Link a bank'),
  ],
)
```

### Finished flow

```dart
CdsStepper(direction: CdsStepperDirection.horizontal, steps: steps, activeStepId: null, complete: true)
```

## Visual reference

- Horizontal: caption header "N/M Label" (`fgMuted` count, 12px gap, 12px bottom padding) over one 4px bar per top-level step, 4px apart. Track `bgLine`, radius 200. Fill `bgPrimary` for the active step and `bgLinePrimarySubtle` for visited or complete steps.
- Vertical: a 16px icon (`outline` in `bgLine`, `outline` in `bgLinePrimarySubtle` when active, `circleCheckmark` in `bgPrimary` when visited or complete), a 2px connector (minimum 16px, `bgPrimary` once passed, partially filled while a sub-step is active), and a label (`label1`, `label2` for sub-steps; `fgPrimary` when active, otherwise `fgMuted`) with 24px below it.

## Accessibility

- Horizontal: one node announcing "Label N of M" (for example "Link a bank 3 of 3"), or "No active step".
- Vertical: each step label is its own node reading "Label N of M", with " (Complete)" for visited steps and the selected state on the active step.

## Motion

Bars fill over `CdsDurations.slow2` with `CdsCurves.global`. When the active step jumps ahead, bars fill one after another, `slow2` apart, driven by a ticker that stops when the target is reached and pauses off screen. The horizontal header fades out and in over `fast1` each when the step changes. Under reduced motion, or with `animate: false`, everything changes instantly.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `direction` | `direction` |
| `steps` (`StepperValue`) | `steps` (`CdsStepperStep`) |
| `activeStepId` | `activeStepId` |
| `complete` | `complete` |
| `animate` | `animate` |
| `completedStepAccessibilityLabel` | `completedStepAccessibilityLabel` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `accessibilityLabel` |
| `disableAnimateOnMount` | not supported; bars animate in on mount unless `animate` is false |
| `Stepper*Component` overrides, `metadata`, `progressTimingConfig` | not supported |

source: doc/components/CdsStickyFooter.md

# CdsStickyFooter

A bar pinned to the bottom of a screen that holds the primary action, such as "Continue" or "Buy Bitcoin".

CDS reference: none on cds.coinbase.com. Ported from CDS React Native `StickyFooter` (`packages/mobile/src/sticky-footer`).

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsStickyFooter(
  child: CdsButton(label: 'Continue', block: true, onPress: next),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use for the one action that completes a screen, below scrolling content. Pair it with `CdsScaffold`, which pins it and lifts it above the keyboard. For a footer with legal text under the action, see `CdsPageFooter`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | Usually a block `CdsButton` or a row of buttons. |
| `compact` | `bool` | `false` | Top padding 2 (16px) instead of 3 (24px). |
| `elevated` | `bool` | `false` | Adds the level 1 shadow. |
| `paddingX` | `double` | `3` | Space token for start and end padding (24px). |
| `paddingTop` | `double?` | `null` | Space token; defaults to 3, or 2 when `compact`. |
| `paddingBottom` | `double?` | `null` | Space token for the minimum bottom gap; defaults to 2 (16px). |
| `background` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bg` | Background token. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `String` | `'footer'` | Label for the footer group. |
| `respectSafeArea` | `bool` | `true` | Bottom padding becomes the larger of `paddingBottom` and the safe-area inset. |

## Examples

### Two actions

```dart
CdsStickyFooter(
  elevated: true,
  child: Row(
    spacing: 8,
    children: [
      Expanded(child: CdsButton(label: 'Cancel', variant: CdsButtonVariant.secondary, block: true, onPress: cancel)),
      Expanded(child: CdsButton(label: 'Send USDC', block: true, onPress: send)),
    ],
  ),
)
```

## Accessibility

A semantics group labelled `accessibilityLabel` (CDS uses the toolbar role). The child's own semantics are unchanged.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `child` |
| `compact` | `compact` |
| `elevated` / `elevation` | `elevated` |
| `paddingX` | `paddingX` |
| `paddingTop` | `paddingTop` |
| `background` | `background` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `accessibilityLabel` |
| (safe area handled by the app in CDS) | `paddingBottom`, `respectSafeArea` |

# CdsSwitch

An on/off switch with an optional label, for settings that take effect as soon as they change.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/Switch

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsSwitch(
  label: 'Price alerts',
  checked: alerts,
  onChange: (value) => setState(() => alerts = value),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for a binary setting applied immediately (notifications, biometrics, hide balances).
- Use `CdsCheckbox` when the choice is submitted later with a form, or for selecting items in a list.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | `bool` | `false` | Whether the switch is on. Controlled. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | `null` | Called with the next state after a tap or a drag that changes sides. Null makes the switch inert and dimmed. |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Label next to the switch. Also the accessibility label. |
| `labelNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom label widget. Takes precedence over `label`. |
| `variant` | `CdsSwitchVariant` | `CdsSwitchVariant.primary` | Track color when on: `primary` (`bgPrimary`), `positive` (`bgPositive`), `negative` (`bgNegative`). |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Blocks taps and drags, dims to 50%. |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Blocks interaction and dims, announced as read-only. |
| `background` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Track color when on. Overrides `variant`. The off track is always `bgTertiary`. |
| `controlColor` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Thumb color. Defaults to `fgInverse` in light and `fg` in dark. |
| `elevation` | `CdsElevation` | `CdsElevation.none` | Thumb shadow. |
| `font` | `CdsFont` | `CdsFont.body` | Label ramp entry. |
| `color` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Fixed label color. By default `fgMuted` off and `fg` on. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Replaces the label for screen readers. Required when there is no `label`. |
| `semanticHint` | `String?` | `null` | Extra hint. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | Focus node for the control. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | Request focus on first build. |

Track and thumb sizes come from `theme.controlSize`: `switchWidth` 52, `switchHeight` 32, `switchThumbSize` 30.

## Examples

### Variants

```dart
CdsSwitch(semanticLabel: 'Auto-invest', variant: CdsSwitchVariant.positive, checked: on, onChange: setOn)
CdsSwitch(semanticLabel: 'Lock account', variant: CdsSwitchVariant.negative, checked: locked, onChange: setLocked)
```

### Disabled and read-only

```dart
const CdsSwitch(label: 'Managed by your organization', checked: true, disabled: true)
const CdsSwitch(label: 'Two-step verification', checked: true, readOnly: true)
```

## Accessibility

- Exposes toggled state, the label, enabled state and a tap action.
- The whole row is pressable; the hit area is at least 44px tall.
- Tab focuses and shows the focus ring; Space or Enter toggles.
- In right-to-left layouts "on" sits at the left and drag direction is mirrored.

## Motion

- Tapping springs the thumb to the other side with `CdsSprings.standard`, starting from wherever it is, so rapid taps never jump. The track color follows the thumb position.
- The thumb can be dragged. It follows the finger 1:1 from the touch point, and rubberbands (`CdsMotion.rubberband`) past either end. On release, `CdsMotion.project` of the release velocity decides the side, so a short quick flick commits while a slow short drag returns. The settle spring (`CdsSprings.momentum` after a flick) carries the release velocity.
- A light haptic fires when the value changes. If a controlled parent rejects the change, the thumb springs back to the parent's value.
- Reduced motion: the thumb jumps to its new side; dragging still follows the finger.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `checked` | `checked` |
| `onChange(value, checked)` | `onChange(bool)` |
| `children` | `label` / `labelNode` |
| `variant` | `variant` (`CdsSwitchVariant`) |
| `background` | `background` |
| `controlColor` | `controlColor` |
| `elevation` | `elevation` |
| `disabled` / `readOnly` | `disabled` / `readOnly` |
| `accessibilityLabel` / `accessibilityHint` | `semanticLabel` / `semanticHint` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsTabIndicator.md

# CdsTabIndicator

The 2px bar that marks the active tab. It fills its parent's width and springs its bar to a new `x` and `width` from wherever it currently is.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/navigation/TabIndicator

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsTabIndicator(x: activeRect.left, width: activeRect.width)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use when you build your own tab row and measure tab positions yourself.
- [CdsTabs](CdsTabs.md) and [CdsTabNavigation](CdsTabNavigation.md) already place and drive it.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| x | `double` | required | Bar offset from the parent's left edge (not the start edge), in logical pixels. |
| width | `double` | required | Bar width in logical pixels. Zero hides the bar. |
| background | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bgPrimary` | Bar color. |
| animate | `bool` | `true` | `false` jumps to the new geometry, for example while tracking a drag. |

## Examples

### Randomized position

```dart
double x = 120, width = 120;

Column(
  children: [
    CdsButton(
      label: 'Move',
      onPress: () => setState(() {
        x = 40 + (x + 90) % 200;
        width = 60 + (width + 40) % 120;
      }),
    ),
    CdsTabIndicator(x: x, width: width),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

Purely visual. Selection must be exposed by the tabs themselves (selected state).

## Motion

- Position and width spring independently with `CdsSprings.standard`, starting from the current value and velocity, so retargeting mid-flight is smooth.
- The first frame and reduced motion place the bar without animating.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `x` | `x` |
| `width` | `width` |
| `background` | `background` (CDS paints the bar `bgPrimary` and uses `background` for the track mask; here it is the bar color) |

source: doc/components/CdsTabLabel.md

# CdsTabLabel

The text of one tab in a [CdsTabNavigation], with an optional count badge that animates in and out.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/navigation/TabLabel

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsTabLabel('Watchlist', active: true, count: 2)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use inside a custom tab row, or via `CdsTabNavigation.tabBuilder` to reuse the CDS look.
- `CdsTabNavigation` already renders `CdsTabLabel` for each tab; you rarely need it directly.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | `String` | required (positional) | Tab text. |
| active | `bool` | `false` | Active styling. |
| variant | `CdsTabLabelVariant` | `primary` | `primary`: headline, `fgPrimary` when active, `fg` otherwise, padding 16 top / 14 bottom to sit on a 2px indicator. `secondary`: `title3` active / `title4` inactive, `fg` / `fgMuted`. |
| count | `int` | `0` | Badge value; zero or less hides it. |
| max | `int?` | `null` (99) | Counts above this show as `max+`. |

## Examples

### Secondary variant

```dart
const CdsTabLabel('Assets', variant: CdsTabLabelVariant.secondary, active: true)
```

The secondary variant reserves the width of its bold active style, so switching tabs never shifts neighbouring labels. CDS marks it deprecated; prefer primary tabs or [CdsTabbedChips](CdsTabbedChips.md).

## Accessibility

- Renders plain text; the surrounding tab supplies the role and selected state.
- The badge digits are read with the label (for example "Inbox 3").

## Motion

- The badge grows from zero width with `CdsDurations.fast1` and `CdsCurves.global` and fades in; it fades out and collapses when the count returns to zero.
- Reduced motion shows and hides the badge instantly.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `label` |
| `active` | `active` |
| `variant` | `variant` |
| `count` | `count` |
| `max` | `max` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsTabNavigation.md
---

# CdsTabNavigation

The top-level tab bar of a screen: a horizontally scrolling row of [CdsTabLabel]s with a [CdsTabIndicator] under the active one.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/navigation/TabNavigation

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
String section = 'foryou';

CdsTabNavigation(
  accessibilityLabel: 'Home sections',
  tabs: const [
    CdsTabValue(id: 'foryou', label: 'For you'),
    CdsTabValue(id: 'portfolio', label: 'Portfolio'),
    CdsTabValue(id: 'explore', label: 'Explore'),
  ],
  value: section,
  onChange: (id) => setState(() => section = id),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use directly under a navigation bar (often in its `bottom` slot) to switch between a screen's main sections.
- Use [CdsBottomNavigation](CdsBottomNavigation.md) for app destinations on phones. CDS `TabNavigation` is a top tab bar only.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| tabs | `List<CdsTabValue>` | required | Tabs in display order. |
| onChange | `ValueChanged<String>` | required | Called with the picked id. |
| value | `String?` | first tab | Id of the active tab. |
| variant | `CdsTabLabelVariant` | `primary` | `secondary` has no indicator and is deprecated in CDS. |
| background | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bg` | Bar background. |
| gap | `double` | `4` | Space token between tabs. |
| paddingX | `double` | `0` | Space token inset at both ends of the scrolling row. |
| role | `CdsTabNavigationRole` | `tablist` | `radiogroup` exposes the tabs as a radio group. |
| pageController | `PageController?` | `null` | Indicator follows a `PageView` swipe. |
| tabBuilder | `CdsTabContentBuilder?` | `null` | Replaces each tab's label. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Names the bar for screen readers. |

## Examples

### In a top navigation bar

```dart
CdsTopNavBar(
  child: const CdsNavigationTitle('Home'),
  bottom: CdsTabNavigation(tabs: tabs, value: section, onChange: (id) => setState(() => section = id)),
)
```

## Accessibility

- `tablist` role: tab bar with tab children and selected state. `radiogroup` role: mutually exclusive, checked state.
- Arrow keys, Home and End move the selection and scroll it into view.
- Tab hit areas are at least 44px tall.

## Motion

- Indicator springs from its current position; follows `pageController` during swipes.
- The active tab scrolls into view; the trailing edge fades while more tabs are offscreen.
- Reduced motion removes the spring and scroll animation.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `tabs` (`id`, `label`, `count`, `max`, `disabled`, `accessibilityLabel`) | `tabs` (`CdsTabValue`) |
| `tabs[].onPress` | use `onChange` |
| `value` | `value` |
| `onChange` | `onChange` |
| `variant` | `variant` |
| `background` | `background` |
| `gap` | `gap` |
| `role` | `role` |
| `Component` | `tabBuilder` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsTabbedChips.md
---

# CdsTabbedChips

A horizontally scrolling row of chips that behaves as a tab list. The active chip inverts its color scheme. Reach for it for nested tabs and filters under a top-level tab bar.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/navigation/TabbedChips

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
String filter = 'all';

CdsTabbedChips(
  accessibilityLabel: 'Asset filters',
  tabs: const [
    CdsTabValue(id: 'all', label: 'All'),
    CdsTabValue(id: 'gainers', label: 'Top gainers'),
    CdsTabValue(id: 'new', label: 'New'),
  ],
  value: filter,
  onChange: (id) => setState(() => filter = id),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for secondary navigation or filters, many options, or labels of varied length.
- Use [CdsTabNavigation](CdsTabNavigation.md) for the primary tab bar of a screen.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| tabs | `List<CdsTabValue>` | required | Chips in display order. |
| onChange | `ValueChanged<String>` | required | Called with the picked id. |
| value | `String?` | first tab | Id of the active chip. |
| gap | `double` | `1` | Space token between chips. |
| paddingX | `double` | `0` | Space token inset at both ends of the scrolling row. |
| tabBuilder | `CdsTabContentBuilder?` | `null` | Custom chip content. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Names the list for screen readers. |

## Examples

### Edge-to-edge row with page gutters

```dart
CdsTabbedChips(paddingX: 3, tabs: filters, value: filter, onChange: (id) => setState(() => filter = id))
```

## Accessibility

- Tab bar and tab roles with selected state. The inverted chip is not the only cue: selection is also exposed semantically.
- Arrow keys, Home and End move the selection; the chip keeps keyboard focus as it inverts.
- Chips are 40px tall and centered in a 44px hit area.

## Motion

- The active chip scrolls into view (`CdsDurations.moderate2`, `CdsCurves.global`; instant under reduced motion).
- The trailing fade appears only while more chips are offscreen.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `tabs` | `tabs` |
| `value` | `value` |
| `onChange` | `onChange` |
| `Component` | `tabBuilder` |
| `gap` | `gap` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsTable.md
