# CdsTable

A data table built from `CdsTableCaption`, `CdsTableHeader`, `CdsTableBody` and `CdsTableFooter`, with rows of `CdsTableCell`s.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/data-display/Table

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsTable(
  variant: CdsTableVariant.ruled,
  children: [
    const CdsTableCaption('Holdings'),
    CdsTableHeader(children: [
      CdsTableRow(children: const [
        CdsTableCell(title: 'Asset'),
        CdsTableCell(title: 'Balance', alignItems: CrossAxisAlignment.end),
      ]),
    ]),
    CdsTableBody(children: [
      for (final h in holdings)
        CdsTableRow(
          onPress: () => openHolding(h),
          semanticLabel: 'Open ${h.name}',
          children: [
            CdsTableCell(title: h.name, subtitle: h.symbol),
            CdsTableCell(title: h.balance, alignItems: CrossAxisAlignment.end),
          ],
        ),
    ]),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use for tabular data people compare across columns. On phones, prefer `CdsListCell` lists for one or two values per item.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required | `CdsTableCaption`, `CdsTableHeader`, `CdsTableBody`, `CdsTableFooter`. Rendered in table order regardless of list order. |
| `variant` | `CdsTableVariant` | `standard` | `standard` (no lines), `ruled` (lines between rows), `graph` (lines between rows and columns). |
| `bordered` | `bool` | `false` | 1px `bgLine` border, 8px corners. |
| `tableLayout` | `CdsTableLayout` | `auto` | `auto`: columns size to content, extra width is shared, the table scrolls horizontally when wider than its parent. `fixed`: columns share the width (`FlexColumnWidth`), no horizontal scroll. |
| `compact` | `bool` | `false` | 8px cell padding instead of 16px. |
| `cellPaddingX` / `cellPaddingY` | `double?` | `2` (`1` compact) | Space tokens for every cell. |
| `columnWidths` | `Map<int, TableColumnWidth>?` | `null` | Per-column widths; win over `CdsTableCell.width`. |
| `height` | `double?` | `null` | Fixed height; rows scroll vertically. |
| `maxHeight` | `double?` | `null` | Rows scroll vertically past it. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Table name for screen readers. |

### CdsTableHeader / CdsTableBody / CdsTableFooter

`const CdsTableHeader({required List<CdsTableRow> children})`, same for body and footer. Header cells use muted `headline` and are marked as headers; body cells use `body` in `fg`; footer cells use `body` in `fgMuted`.

### CdsTableRow

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required | `CdsTableCell` or `CdsTableCellFallback`, one per column. Short rows are padded with empty cells. |
| `backgroundColor` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | |
| `color` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Text color for the row's cells. |
| `disableHoverIndicator` | `bool` | `false` | Body rows tint on hover (gray 5 at 35%) unless set. |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Tap on any cell, or Enter/Space when the row's first cell has focus. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Row button label, e.g. "Open Bitcoin". |

### CdsTableCaption

`const CdsTableCaption(String text, {TextAlign align = TextAlign.start, CdsColor? color, CdsColor? backgroundColor})` renders `title3` above the header (with a bottom line in `ruled` and `graph`). `CdsTableCaption.custom(child: ...)` takes any widget.

See also [CdsTableCell](CdsTableCell.md) and [CdsTableCellFallback](CdsTableCellFallback.md).

## Examples

### Sortable column

```dart
CdsTableCell(
  title: 'Price',
  sortDirection: sortBy == 'price' ? direction : CdsTableSortDirection.none,
  onPress: () => toggleSort('price'),
  alignItems: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
)
```

### Loading rows

```dart
CdsTableBody(children: [
  for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++)
    CdsTableRow(children: [
      CdsTableCellFallback(title: true, subtitle: true, start: CdsCellMediaType.asset, rectWidthVariant: i),
      CdsTableCellFallback(title: true, rectWidthVariant: i),
    ]),
])
```

### Empty and error states

Render one row with the message in the first cell, for example `CdsTableRow(children: const [CdsTableCell(title: 'No trades yet', subtitle: 'Place an order to see it here.')])`, or replace the table with an explanation and a retry button.

## Accessibility

Header cells are marked as headers; sortable cells announce "Sorted ascending", "Sorted descending" or "Not sorted". Pressable rows put one focus stop and button role on the first cell, with `semanticLabel`. Cell text wraps by default, so large text grows rows instead of clipping.

## Motion

Pressable rows tint on pointer-down and clear on release. Hover tint is instant. No other motion.

## CDS React Native mapping

Table is a CDS web component; this is a Flutter port of `@coinbase/cds-web` tables.

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `variant="default"` | `variant: CdsTableVariant.standard` (`default` is reserved in Dart) |
| `variant="graph"` / `"ruled"` | same names |
| `bordered`, `tableLayout`, `compact`, `height`, `maxHeight` | same names |
| `cellSpacing` (`inner` / `outer`) | `cellPaddingX`, `cellPaddingY` (net padding) |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |
| `TableHeader sticky` | not supported |
| `TableRow fullWidth`, `TableCell colSpan` | not supported (Flutter's `Table` has no column spanning) |
| `TableRow onClick` | `onPress` |

source: doc/components/CdsTableBody.md

# CdsTableCell

One cell of a `CdsTableRow`: a title with optional subtitle, or any child, with optional start and end widgets.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/data-display/TableCell

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsTableCell(title: 'Bitcoin', subtitle: 'BTC', start: CdsCellMedia.icon(CdsIconName.wallet))
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String?` | `null` | `headline` in the header, `body` elsewhere. |
| `subtitle` | `String?` | `null` | `label2` under the title. |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom content; replaces title and subtitle. Plain `Text` inherits the section style. |
| `start` | `Widget?` | `null` | Before the content. |
| `end` | `Widget?` | `null` | After the content. |
| `color` | `CdsColor?` | row color, then section default | Color of all text. |
| `titleColor` | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Wins over `color`. |
| `subtitleColor` | `CdsColor` | `fgMuted` | |
| `direction` | `CdsTableCellDirection` | `vertical` | `horizontal` lays title and subtitle in a row. |
| `justifyContent` | `MainAxisAlignment?` | `start` (vertical) / `spaceBetween` (horizontal) | |
| `alignItems` | `CrossAxisAlignment?` | `start` (vertical) / `center` (horizontal) | `end` right-aligns numeric columns (mirrored in RTL). |
| `overflow` | `TextOverflow?` | `null` | Truncates to one line. Needs a column width (`width`, `columnWidths` or `tableLayout: fixed`). |
| `width` | `double?` | `null` | Fixed column width; the first cell in a column that sets it wins. |
| `paddingX` / `paddingY` | `double?` | table padding | Space tokens. |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Makes the cell pressable, e.g. to sort. |
| `sortDirection` | `CdsTableSortDirection?` | `null` | Marks the cell sortable: `none`, `ascending`, `descending`. Shows `CdsTableCellSortIcon`, colors the active column `fgPrimary`, sets the semantics value. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Replaces the cell's text for screen readers. |

`CdsTableCellSortIcon({CdsTableSortDirection direction = none})` is the up/down caret pair on its own.

## Examples

### Right-aligned amount

```dart
const CdsTableCell(title: r'$64,201.10', alignItems: CrossAxisAlignment.end)
```

### Truncating in a fixed column

```dart
const CdsTableCell(title: 'A long transaction memo', width: 140, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis)
```

## Accessibility

Header cells are marked as headers. Sort state is announced as the cell's value.

## Motion

Pressable cells tint on pointer-down (no scale).

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop (web) | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `title`, `subtitle`, `children`, `start`, `end`, `color`, `titleColor`, `subtitleColor` | `title`, `subtitle`, `child`, `start`, `end`, `color`, `titleColor`, `subtitleColor` |
| `direction`, `justifyContent`, `alignItems`, `overflow`, `width` | same names |
| `onClick` | `onPress` |
| `useSortableCell` / `aria-sort` | `sortDirection` + `onPress` |
| `innerSpacing`, `outerSpacing` | `paddingX`, `paddingY` |
| `as="th"`, `scope`, `colSpan` | not supported |

source: doc/components/CdsTableCellFallback.md

# CdsTableCellFallback

A loading placeholder for one table cell.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/data-display/TableCellFallback

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsTableRow(children: const [
  CdsTableCellFallback(title: true, subtitle: true, start: CdsCellMediaType.asset),
  CdsTableCellFallback(title: true),
])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `bool` | `false` | 24px bar. |
| `subtitle` | `bool` | `false` | 16px bar. |
| `start` | `CdsCellMediaType?` | `null` | Leading media placeholder. |
| `end` | `CdsCellMediaType?` | `null` | Trailing media placeholder. |
| `titleWidth` | `double` | `96` | Base width in px. |
| `subtitleWidth` | `double` | `64` | Base width in px. |
| `rectWidthVariant` | `int?` | `null` | Varies widths deterministically; pass the row index. |
| `width` | `double?` | `null` | Fixed column width, like `CdsTableCell.width`. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `'Loading cell'` | |

## Accessibility

Each placeholder is one node labelled `semanticLabel`.

## Motion

None. CDS animates a shimmer; this port keeps placeholders still.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop (web) | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `title`, `subtitle`, `start`, `end`, `rectWidthVariant`, `width` | same names |
| percentage bar widths | `titleWidth`, `subtitleWidth` in px (intrinsic columns have no width to take a percentage of) |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |

# CdsTabs

A row of text tabs with a 2px underline that springs to the active tab. Reach for it to switch between sibling views inside a screen section.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/navigation/Tabs

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
String tab = 'crypto';

CdsTabs(
  accessibilityLabel: 'Portfolio sections',
  tabs: const [
    CdsTabValue(id: 'crypto', label: 'Crypto'),
    CdsTabValue(id: 'nfts', label: 'NFTs'),
    CdsTabValue(id: 'defi', label: 'DeFi'),
  ],
  activeTab: tab,
  onChange: (id) => setState(() => tab = id),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for two to five peer views that share one screen region.
- Use [CdsSegmentedTabs](CdsSegmentedTabs.md) for a compact pill control (Buy / Sell).
- Use [CdsTabNavigation](CdsTabNavigation.md) for the top-level tab bar of a screen, especially when tabs may overflow and need to scroll.
- Use [CdsTabbedChips](CdsTabbedChips.md) for nested or filter-like tabs.
- Use [CdsBottomNavigation](CdsBottomNavigation.md) to switch between app destinations on phones.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| tabs | `List<CdsTabValue>` | required | Tabs in display order. |
| activeTab | `String?` | required | Id of the active tab. `null` shows no active tab and no underline. |
| onChange | `ValueChanged<String>` | required | Called with the picked tab's id. Not called when the active tab is tapped again. |
| disabled | `bool` | `false` | Disables every tab. |
| color | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.fg` | Inactive label color. |
| activeColor | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.fgPrimary` | Active label color. |
| activeBackground | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bgPrimary` | Underline color. |
| background | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Fill behind the tab row. |
| font | `CdsFont` | `CdsFont.headline` | Label font. |
| gap | `double` | `4` | Space token between tabs (4 = 32px). |
| borderRadius | `int?` | `null` | Radius token for the row background. |
| pageController | `PageController?` | `null` | Makes the underline follow a `PageView` swipe 1:1. |
| tabBuilder | `CdsTabContentBuilder?` | `null` | `(context, tab, active) => Widget`. Replaces each tab's label content; focus, press and semantics stay managed. |
| indicatorBuilder | `CdsTabsIndicatorBuilder?` | `null` | `(context, x, width, animate) => Widget`. Replaces the underline. The widget fills the tab row; `x` is measured from its left edge. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Names the tab list for screen readers. |

`CdsTabValue`:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | `String` | required | Unique within the list. |
| label | `String` | required | Visible text. |
| disabled | `bool` | `false` | The tab cannot be selected and is skipped by arrow keys. |
| count | `int?` | `null` | Badge after the label when greater than zero. |
| max | `int?` | `null` (99) | Counts above this show as `max+`. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Read instead of `label`. |

## Examples

### Count badges

```dart
CdsTabs(
  tabs: const [
    CdsTabValue(id: 'inbox', label: 'Inbox', count: 3),
    CdsTabValue(id: 'sent', label: 'Sent'),
  ],
  activeTab: folder,
  onChange: (id) => setState(() => folder = id),
)
```

### Synced with a PageView

```dart
final pages = PageController();

Column(
  children: [
    CdsTabs(
      tabs: tabs,
      activeTab: tabs[index].id,
      pageController: pages,
      onChange: (id) {
        final next = tabs.indexWhere((t) => t.id == id);
        pages.animateToPage(next, duration: CdsDurations.moderate3, curve: CdsCurves.global);
      },
    ),
    Expanded(
      child: PageView(
        controller: pages,
        onPageChanged: (i) => setState(() => index = i),
        children: panels,
      ),
    ),
  ],
)
```

### No initial selection

```dart
CdsTabs(tabs: tabs, activeTab: null, onChange: (id) => setState(() => tab = id))
```

## Accessibility

- The row is a tab bar (`SemanticsRole.tabBar`) and each tab has `SemanticsRole.tab`, a selected state and a tap action.
- Left and Right arrows move the selection and focus to the previous or next enabled tab (mirrored in RTL); Home and End jump to the first and last. Selection follows focus.
- Each tab's hit area is at least 44px tall.
- The underline is excluded from semantics; selection is announced through the selected state, not color.

## Motion

- The underline position and width spring with `CdsSprings.standard` from their current values, so a second tap mid-flight redirects without a jump.
- With `pageController`, the underline tracks the page offset exactly during a swipe and springs the last bit when the page settles.
- Layout changes (rotation, count badges appearing) move the underline without animation.
- Reduced motion places the underline instantly.
- Selection changes fire a selection haptic.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `tabs` | `tabs` (`CdsTabValue`) |
| `activeTab` (tab object) | `activeTab` (tab id) |
| `onChange` (tab object) | `onChange` (tab id) |
| `disabled` | `disabled` |
| `color`, `activeColor` | `color`, `activeColor` |
| `activeBackground` | `activeBackground` |
| `background` | `background` |
| `font` | `font` |
| `gap` | `gap` (CDS has no default; examples use 4) |
| `TabComponent` | `tabBuilder` |
| `TabsActiveIndicatorComponent` | `indicatorBuilder` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `accessibilityLabel` |
| `onActiveTabElementChange` | not ported; the active tab scrolls into view automatically in scrolling variants |

---
source: doc/components/CdsTag.md
---

# CdsTag

A short label that categorizes or flags content, such as "New" or "Pending".

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/typography/Tag

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsTag('Pending', colorScheme: CdsTagColorScheme.yellow)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use `informational` for status and metadata, `promotional` for marketing call-outs. Tags are not pressable; use a chip for filters.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String` | required (positional) | One line; truncates. |
| `intent` | `CdsTagIntent` | `informational` | `informational`: `label1`, 4px corners, 4px side padding. `promotional`: uppercase `caption`, pill, 8px side padding. |
| `emphasis` | `CdsTagEmphasis?` | `low` for informational, `high` for promotional | `low`: tinted background, colored text. `high`: solid background. |
| `colorScheme` | `CdsTagColorScheme` | `blue` | `green`, `purple`, `blue`, `yellow`, `red`, `gray`. |
| `dangerouslySetBackground` | `Color?` | `null` | |
| `dangerouslySetColor` | `Color?` | `null` | Text and icon color. |
| `start` / `startIcon` / `startIconActive` | `Widget?` / `CdsIconName?` / `bool` | `null` / `null` / `false` | 12px leading icon. |
| `end` / `endIcon` / `endIconActive` | `Widget?` / `CdsIconName?` / `bool` | `null` / `null` / `false` | 12px trailing icon. |
| `maxWidth` | `double?` | `null` | Truncate past this width. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | |

Colors follow `tagEmphasisColorMap`: for example low blue is blue 0 on blue 60, high yellow is yellow 70 on yellow 30.

## Examples

### Status with icon

```dart
const CdsTag('Verified', colorScheme: CdsTagColorScheme.green, startIcon: CdsIconName.circleCheckmark)
```

### Promotional

```dart
const CdsTag('New', intent: CdsTagIntent.promotional)
```

## Accessibility

Screen readers read the original text, not the uppercased form. The label itself carries the meaning, so status is not conveyed by color alone.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `label` |
| `intent`, `emphasis`, `colorScheme` | same names |
| `background` (spectrum color) | `dangerouslySetBackground` |
| `color` (spectrum color) | `dangerouslySetColor` |
| `start`, `startIcon`, `startIconActive`, `end`, `endIcon`, `endIconActive`, `maxWidth` | same names |

---
source: doc/components/CdsText.md
---

# CdsText

Text set in the CDS type ramp, colored with semantic tokens.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/typography/Text

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsText('Portfolio', font: CdsFont.title1)
CdsText.label2('Updated 2 min ago', color: CdsColor.fgMuted)
```

## The ramp

| Font | Size / line height | Weight | Typical use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display1` | 64 / 72 | 400 | Hero numbers |
| `display2` | 48 / 56 | 400 | |
| `display3` | 40 / 48 | 400 | Balance on a home screen |
| `title1` | 28 / 36 | 600 | Screen titles |
| `title2` | 28 / 36 | 400 | Large values |
| `title3` | 20 / 28 | 600 | Section titles |
| `title4` | 20 / 28 | 400 | |
| `headline` | 16 / 24 | 600 | Cell titles, button labels |
| `body` | 16 / 24 | 400 | Paragraphs (default) |
| `label1` | 14 / 20 | 600 | Emphasised small text |
| `label2` | 14 / 20 | 400 | Secondary details |
| `caption` | 13 / 16 | 600, uppercase | Overlines |
| `legal` | 13 / 16 | 400 | Disclosures |

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `String` | required (positional) | The text. |
| `font` | `CdsFont` | `body` | Ramp entry. Named constructors (`CdsText.title1(...)`) set it for you. |
| `color` | `CdsColor` | `fg` | Semantic color token. |
| `dangerouslySetColor` | `Color?` | `null` | Raw color escape hatch. |
| `mono` | `bool` | `false` | Use the monospace family for this ramp entry. |
| `tabularNumbers` | `bool` | `false` | Equal-width digits for prices and counters. |
| `align` | `TextAlign?` | `null` | |
| `maxLines` | `int?` | `null` | Truncates with an ellipsis when set. |
| `overflow` | `TextOverflow?` | ellipsis when `maxLines` is set | |
| `softWrap` | `bool?` | `null` | |
| `textTransform` | `CdsTextTransform?` | from the font | Override `caption`'s uppercase. |
| `underline` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `semanticsLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Uppercased text is read as written by default. |

`CdsText.rich(InlineSpan span, ...)` renders spans that inherit the ramp style.

## Examples

```dart
CdsText(r'$12,408.22', font: CdsFont.display3, tabularNumbers: true)
CdsText.label1('+2.4%', color: CdsColor.fgPositive)
CdsText.legal('Prices are indicative.', color: CdsColor.fgMuted)
```

## Accessibility

Scales with the platform text size. Uppercase captions are announced in their original case.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `<Text font="title1">` / `<TextTitle1>` | `CdsText(font: CdsFont.title1)` / `CdsText.title1()` |
| `color="fgMuted"` | `color: CdsColor.fgMuted` |
| `mono`, `tabularNumbers`, `align`, `numberOfLines` | `mono`, `tabularNumbers`, `align`, `maxLines` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsTextArea.md
---

# CdsTextArea

A multiline `CdsTextInput` for longer text such as notes or a support message. It grows from `minLines` to `maxLines`, then scrolls, and can show a character counter.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/TextInput (CDS uses TextInput with `multiline`; this wraps that setup.)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsTextArea(
  label: 'Message',
  placeholder: 'Describe what happened',
  value: message,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => message = v),
  maxLength: 280,
)
```

Control it with `value` + `onChange`, or with a `controller`, exactly like `CdsTextInput`.

## When to use / when not to

- Use for text that can run to several lines: feedback, notes, descriptions.
- Use `CdsTextInput` for short single-line values.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `controller` | `TextEditingController?` | `null` | Owns the text when given. |
| `value` | `String?` | `null` | Text to show when no controller is given. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Full text after every edit. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | |
| `labelNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | `null` | |
| `helperText` | `String?` | `null` | Colored by `variant`. |
| `helperTextErrorIconSemanticLabel` | `String` | `'error'` | |
| `variant` | `CdsInputVariant` | `foregroundMuted` | |
| `minLines` | `int` | `3` | Visible lines when empty. |
| `maxLines` | `int?` | `6` | Lines before scrolling. Null grows without limit. |
| `maxLength` | `int?` | `null` | Character limit. Shows a `count/max` counter at the end of the helper row; it turns `fgNegative` at the limit. |
| `textAlign` | `TextAlign` | `TextAlign.start` | |
| `font` | `CdsFont` | `CdsFont.body` | |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `bordered` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `borderRadius` | `int` | `200` | Radius token. |
| `inputBackground` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bg` | |
| `keyboardType` | `TextInputType?` | `null` (`multiline`) | |
| `textInputAction` | `TextInputAction?` | `null` (`newline`) | |
| `textCapitalization` | `TextCapitalization` | `sentences` | |
| `inputFormatters` | `List<TextInputFormatter>?` | `null` | |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `autocorrect` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `enableSuggestions` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `onFocus` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `onBlur` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | |
| `counterSemanticLabel` | `String Function(int count, int max)?` | `null` | Counter's accessibility label. Defaults to `'$count of $max characters'`. |

## Examples

### Error state

```dart
const CdsTextArea(
  label: 'Reason',
  variant: CdsInputVariant.negative,
  helperText: 'Add a reason to continue',
)
```

### Fixed height that scrolls

```dart
CdsTextArea(label: 'Notes', minLines: 4, maxLines: 4, controller: notesController)
```

## Accessibility

The field is one multiline text field node labeled with `label`. The counter reads as "12 of 280 characters". Negative helper text is a live region with an error icon.

## Motion

Same as `CdsTextInput`: the focus border cross-fades in `moderate1`; instant under reduced motion. The field grows line by line without animation.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `multiline` | always on |
| `numberOfLines` | `minLines` |
| `maxLength` | `maxLength` (plus counter) |
| other TextInput props | same as `CdsTextInput` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsTextFormField.md
---

# CdsTextFormField

A `CdsTextInput` that takes part in a Flutter `Form`: validators, autovalidate, save and reset. Reach for it when a screen collects several fields and checks them together.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/TextInput (CDS has no form-field variant; this is the Flutter `FormField` integration of TextInput.)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
final formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();

Form(
  key: formKey,
  child: CdsTextFormField(
    label: 'Email',
    validator: (v) => v == null || !v.contains('@') ? 'Enter a valid email address' : null,
    onSaved: (v) => email = v ?? '',
  ),
)

// On submit:
if (formKey.currentState!.validate()) formKey.currentState!.save();
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use inside a `Form` when fields are validated together on submit or as the user types.
- Use `CdsTextInput` with your own `variant`/`helperText` when one field validates itself.

## Behavior

- While the field has an error (from `validator` or `forceErrorText`), it shows `CdsInputVariant.negative` and the error message as helper text, with an error icon. The message is announced to screen readers when it appears.
- Without an error it shows the `variant` and `helperText` you passed.
- The text lives in a `TextEditingController`. Pass `controller` to own it, or `initialValue` to let the field create one. Not both.
- `FormState.reset()` restores `initialValue` (or the controller's text at creation).

## Parameters

Form parameters:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `controller` | `TextEditingController?` | `null` | Owns the text. Edits made to it update the form value. |
| `initialValue` | `String?` | `null` (`''`) | Starting text when no controller is given. |
| `validator` | `FormFieldValidator<String>?` | `null` | Return an error message, or null when valid. |
| `onSaved` | `FormFieldSetter<String>?` | `null` | Called by `FormState.save()`. |
| `autovalidateMode` | `AutovalidateMode?` | `null` (`disabled`) | For example `AutovalidateMode.onUserInteraction`. |
| `forceErrorText` | `String?` | `null` | Shows this error regardless of `validator`. |
| `restorationId` | `String?` | `null` | |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Called with the full text after every edit. |

Visual and input parameters, with the same types, defaults and meaning as on [CdsTextInput](CdsTextInput.md): `focusNode`, `label`, `labelNode`, `labelVariant`, `placeholder`, `helperText`, `helperTextErrorIconSemanticLabel`, `variant`, `size`, `compact`, `start`, `end`, `prefix`, `suffix`, `textAlign`, `font`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `bordered`, `borderRadius`, `inputBackground`, `obscureText`, `keyboardType`, `textInputAction`, `textCapitalization`, `inputFormatters`, `maxLength`, `minLines`, `maxLines` (default `1`), `autofocus`, `autocorrect`, `enableSuggestions`, `autofillHints`, `onSubmitEditing`, `onFocus`, `onBlur`, `semanticLabel`.

`disabled: true` also sets the `FormField` `enabled` flag to false, so the field skips validation.

## Examples

### Validate as the user types

```dart
CdsTextFormField(
  label: 'Email',
  keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
  autovalidateMode: AutovalidateMode.onUserInteraction,
  validator: (v) => v == null || !v.contains('@') ? 'Enter a valid email address' : null,
)
```

### Server-side error

```dart
CdsTextFormField(
  label: 'Promo code',
  forceErrorText: serverError, // e.g. 'This code has expired'
)
```

### Save and reset

```dart
CdsButton(label: 'Save', onPress: () {
  if (formKey.currentState!.validate()) formKey.currentState!.save();
})
CdsButton(label: 'Reset', variant: CdsButtonVariant.secondary, onPress: () => formKey.currentState!.reset())
```

## Accessibility

Same as `CdsTextInput`: a labeled text field node, helper text as its hint, and errors in a live region with an error icon so the state is not color alone.

## Motion

Same as `CdsTextInput`: the focus border cross-fades in `moderate1`; instant under reduced motion. Switching to the error state changes colors without animation.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| TextInput props | same as `CdsTextInput` |
| (none) | `validator`, `onSaved`, `autovalidateMode`, `forceErrorText`, `initialValue` |

---
source: doc/components/CdsTextInput.md
---

# CdsTextInput

A labeled text field with a bordered input area, optional `start`/`end` slots, prefix and suffix text, and helper text that reflects validation state. Reach for it for any single-line or short multiline text entry.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/TextInput

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsTextInput(
  label: 'Email',
  placeholder: 'satoshi@example.com',
  value: email,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => email = v),
  keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
)
```

### Controlling the text

`CdsTextInput` supports two modes. Pick one per field.

| Mode | How | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` + `onChange` | Pass the current string and update it in `onChange`. | CDS style. When `value` changes from outside, the text is replaced and the caret moves to the end. |
| `controller` | Pass a `TextEditingController` you own and dispose. | Use for selection control or reading text imperatively. `value` is ignored; `onChange` still fires. |

## When to use / when not to

- Use for names, emails, amounts, addresses and other free text.
- Use `CdsTextFormField` when the field belongs to a `Form` with validators.
- Use `CdsTextArea` for long text that needs several lines and a character counter.
- Use `CdsSearchInput` for search; it has the filled pill look and a clear button.
- Do not use it to pick from a fixed list; use a select component instead.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `controller` | `TextEditingController?` | `null` | Owns the text. See "Controlling the text". |
| `value` | `String?` | `null` | Text to show when no controller is given. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Called with the full text after every edit. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | Created internally when null. |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Label text. Also the accessibility label unless `semanticLabel` is set. |
| `labelNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom label widget, shown instead of `label`. |
| `labelFont` | `CdsFont` | `CdsFont.label2` | Ramp entry for `label`. |
| `labelColor` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.fgMuted` | Color of `label`. |
| `labelVariant` | `CdsInputLabelVariant` | `outside` | `outside` puts the label above the field. `inside` puts it inside the border: stacked above the text at size `l`, inline at `m` and `s`. |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | `null` | Hint text shown while empty, in `fgMuted`. |
| `helperText` | `String?` | `null` | Text under the field, colored by `variant`. With `negative` it leads with an error icon. |
| `helperTextNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom helper widget, shown instead of `helperText`. |
| `helperTextErrorIconSemanticLabel` | `String` | `'error'` | Accessibility label of the error icon. |
| `variant` | `CdsInputVariant` | `foregroundMuted` | Sentiment: `positive`, `negative`, `foreground`, `primary`, `foregroundMuted`, `secondary`. |
| `size` | `CdsTextInputSize?` | `null` (`l`) | Vertical density inside the border: `l` 16px, `m` 12px, `s` 8px vertical padding. |
| `compact` | `bool` | `false` | Size `s` with the label inline. Used only when `size` is null. |
| `start` | `Widget?` | `null` | Content inside the border before the text, for example `CdsInputIcon`. |
| `end` | `Widget?` | `null` | Content inside the border after the text, for example `CdsInputIconButton`. |
| `prefix` | `String?` | `null` | Muted text fixed before the input, for example `'$'`. |
| `suffix` | `String?` | `null` | Muted text fixed after the input (`label1`), for example `'USD'`. |
| `textAlign` | `TextAlign` | `TextAlign.start` | Aligns the typed text and the helper text. |
| `font` | `CdsFont` | `CdsFont.body` | Ramp entry for the typed text. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Not editable, not focusable, 50% opacity. |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Not editable but focusable and selectable. Shows a `bgSecondary` field. |
| `bordered` | `bool` | `true` | Draw the border and focus border. |
| `borderRadius` | `int` | `200` | Radius token (200 is 8px, 1000 is a pill). |
| `focusedBorderWidth` | `int?` | `null` (100) | Extra border width token while focused. |
| `inputBackground` | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bg` | Field background. |
| `obscureText` | `bool` | `false` | Hide characters, for passwords. Forces one line. |
| `keyboardType` | `TextInputType?` | `null` | Multiline fields default to `TextInputType.multiline`. |
| `textInputAction` | `TextInputAction?` | `null` | Keyboard action button. |
| `textCapitalization` | `TextCapitalization` | `none` | |
| `inputFormatters` | `List<TextInputFormatter>?` | `null` | Filters and reshapes input. |
| `maxLength` | `int?` | `null` | Hard character limit. No counter is drawn. |
| `minLines` | `int?` | `null` | |
| `maxLines` | `int?` | `1` | Null grows without limit. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `autocorrect` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `enableSuggestions` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `autofillHints` | `Iterable<String>?` | `null` | For example `[AutofillHints.email]`. |
| `onSubmitEditing` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Keyboard submit. |
| `onFocus` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `onBlur` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `onTap` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Tap on the editable area. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Overrides `label` for screen readers. |
| `semanticHint` | `String?` | `null` | Defaults to `helperText` (except for `negative`, which is announced instead). |

## Examples

### Validation states

```dart
CdsTextInput(
  label: 'Email',
  value: email,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => email = v),
  variant: valid ? CdsInputVariant.positive : CdsInputVariant.negative,
  helperText: valid ? 'Looks good' : 'Enter a valid email address',
)
```

### Prefix and suffix

```dart
CdsTextInput(
  label: 'Amount',
  prefix: r'$',
  suffix: 'USD',
  keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),
  value: amount,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => amount = v),
)
```

### Password with reveal button

```dart
CdsTextInput(
  label: 'Password',
  obscureText: hidden,
  value: password,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => password = v),
  end: CdsInputIconButton(
    hidden ? CdsIconName.visible : CdsIconName.invisible,
    semanticLabel: hidden ? 'Show password' : 'Hide password',
    onPress: () => setState(() => hidden = !hidden),
  ),
)
```

### Inside label and sizes

```dart
const CdsTextInput(label: 'Name', labelVariant: CdsInputLabelVariant.inside)
const CdsTextInput(label: 'Name', labelVariant: CdsInputLabelVariant.inside, size: CdsTextInputSize.m)
const CdsTextInput(label: 'Name', compact: true)
```

### Disabled and read only

```dart
const CdsTextInput(label: 'Account ID', value: '0042', readOnly: true)
const CdsTextInput(label: 'Network', value: 'Ethereum', disabled: true)
```

## Accessibility

- The editable area is one text field node labeled with `semanticLabel ?? label` and hinted with `helperText`.
- With `variant: negative`, the helper text is a live region, so the error is announced when it appears, and it carries an info icon so the state is not color alone.
- Tapping the label, prefix or suffix focuses the field.
- Works without `MaterialApp`: Material localizations are supplied when the app does not provide them.
- Text scales with the platform setting; the field uses minimum heights, never fixed ones.

## Motion

On focus a second border fades in over the first in `CdsDurations.moderate1` with `CdsCurves.enterFunctional`, and fades out with `CdsCurves.exitFunctional`. Under reduced motion the change is instant.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value` / `onChangeText` | `value` / `onChange` |
| `onChange` (event) | `onChange` (string) |
| `label`, `labelNode`, `labelFont`, `labelColor`, `labelVariant` | same names |
| `placeholder`, `helperText`, `variant` | same names |
| `helperTextErrorIconAccessibilityLabel` | `helperTextErrorIconSemanticLabel` |
| `size`, `compact` | `size`, `compact` |
| `start`, `end`, `suffix` | `start`, `end`, `suffix` |
| (none) | `prefix` |
| `align`, `textAlign` | `textAlign` |
| `font` | `font` |
| `disabled`, `readOnly`, `bordered`, `borderRadius`, `focusedBorderWidth`, `inputBackground` | same names |
| `secureTextEntry` | `obscureText` |
| `keyboardType`, `returnKeyType` | `keyboardType`, `textInputAction` |
| `maxLength`, `multiline`, `numberOfLines` | `maxLength`, `maxLines`, `minLines` |
| `onSubmitEditing`, `onFocus`, `onBlur` | same names |
| `accessibilityLabel`, `accessibilityHint` | `semanticLabel`, `semanticHint` |
| `enableColorSurge`, `testIDMap`, `width`, `height` | not ported |

---
source: doc/components/CdsTileButton.md

# CdsTileButton

A square button with media above a short title, for shortcut grids such as Send, Receive and Buy.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/inputs/TileButton

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsTileButton(
  title: 'Send',
  onPress: openSend,
  child: const CdsIcon(CdsIconName.paperAirplane, size: CdsIconSize.l),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use in a grid or wrap of related shortcuts.
- Do not use for a single primary action (use `CdsButton`) or for list rows.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String` | required | Short label under the media. |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | Media above the title. About 48px reads best. |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | `null` renders inert. |
| `onLongPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `count` | `int?` | `null` | Shows a red count badge at the media's top-end when greater than 0. |
| `maxCount` | `int` | `99` | Larger counts show as `99+`. |
| `showOverflow` | `bool` | `false` | Let the title wrap instead of truncating. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `feedback` | `CdsHapticFeedback` | `light` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `title` (plus count) | |
| `semanticHint` | `String?` | `null` | |
| `focusNode`, `autofocus` | | | |

The tile is `context.cds.controlSize.tileSize` square (106px by default) and grows taller only if the text scale needs it.

## Examples

### Shortcut row with a badge

```dart
CdsHStack(gap: 1, wrap: true, children: [
  CdsTileButton(title: 'Send', onPress: send, child: const CdsIcon(CdsIconName.paperAirplane, size: CdsIconSize.l)),
  CdsTileButton(title: 'Inbox', count: unread, onPress: openInbox, child: const CdsIcon(CdsIconName.bell, size: CdsIconSize.l)),
])
```

### Long title

```dart
CdsTileButton(title: 'Recurring purchases', showOverflow: true, onPress: open, child: icon)
```

## Accessibility

- A button labeled with the title, plus the count when the badge shows ("Inbox, 3").
- The 106px tile is well above the 44px minimum. Tab focuses; Enter and Space press.

## Motion

Like CDS, the tile does not scale on press. It stays clear until hovered or pressed, then shows the pressed tint.

## CDS React Native mapping

CDS ships TileButton on web only. This port follows the web component.

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `title`, `count`, `showOverflow`, `onPress`, `disabled` | same names |
| `pictogram` | `child` (pictograms are not part of this package; pass any widget) |
| `children` | `child` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |

Deviation: CDS reveals a truncated title on hover; on touch there is no hover, so pass `showOverflow: true` when titles are long.

source: doc/components/CdsTimePicker.md

# CdsTimePicker

A time field: type `hh:mm`, switch AM/PM, or pick from hour and minute columns in a popover opened by the clock button. CDS has no time picker; this one is built from CDS inputs and tokens.

CDS reference: none (extra component, styled after https://cds.coinbase.com/components/other/DatePicker)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

`TimeOfDay` comes from `package:flutter/material.dart`.

## Usage

```dart
CdsTimePicker(
  label: 'Reminder time',
  value: time,
  onChange: (t) => setState(() => time = t),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for a time of day (alert times, call-back windows). For durations, use a numeric `CdsTextInput` with a unit suffix instead.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `TimeOfDay?` | required | The time shown. A non-null value replaces the text. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<TimeOfDay?>` | required | Called with the time when typed text becomes complete and valid, with null when a complete time is edited or turns invalid, and immediately on picks from the columns. |
| `use24HourFormat` | `bool?` | `MediaQuery.alwaysUse24HourFormatOf` | 24-hour clock (`00` to `23`) or 12-hour with an AM/PM button. |
| `minuteInterval` | `int` | `1` | Step of the minute column. Must divide 60. Typed minutes are accepted as entered. |
| `minTime` | `TimeOfDay?` | `null` | Earliest valid time, inclusive. |
| `maxTime` | `TimeOfDay?` | `null` | Latest valid time, inclusive. |
| `required` | `bool` | `false` | Leaving the field empty after typing shows `requiredError`. |
| `onError` | `ValueChanged<String?>?` | `null` | Validation message, or null when it clears. |
| `requiredError` | `String` | `'This field is required'` | Message for an emptied required field. |
| `invalidTimeError` | `String` | `'Please enter a valid time'` | Message for impossible or incomplete times. |
| `disabledTimeError` | `String` | `'Time unavailable'` | Message for times outside `minTime`/`maxTime`. |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Field label. |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | `'hh:mm'` | Placeholder text. |
| `helperText` | `String?` | message, else `'hh:mm'` or `'hh:mm (24-hour)'` | Text under the field. |
| `variant` | `CdsInputVariant?` | `negative` with a message, else `foregroundMuted` | Field sentiment. |
| `size` | `CdsTextInputSize?` | `l` | Density inside the border. |
| `compact` | `bool` | `false` | Dense field with an inline label. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Blocks typing, the AM/PM button and the clock button. |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Shows the time without allowing changes. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | Focus node of the text field. |
| `onOpen` / `onClose` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Popover opened or closed. |
| `openPickerSemanticLabel` | `String` | `'Open time picker'` | Label of the clock button. |
| `doneLabel` | `String` | `'Done'` | Label of the button that closes the popover. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `label` | Accessibility label override. |

The validation message is transient UI state derived from the typed text; `value` stays controlled.

## Examples

### 12-hour, 15 minute steps

```dart
CdsTimePicker(
  label: 'Price alert time',
  value: time,
  onChange: (t) => setState(() => time = t),
  use24HourFormat: false,
  minuteInterval: 15,
)
```

### Business hours only

```dart
CdsTimePicker(
  label: 'Call back time',
  value: time,
  onChange: (t) => setState(() => time = t),
  use24HourFormat: true,
  minTime: const TimeOfDay(hour: 9, minute: 0),
  maxTime: const TimeOfDay(hour: 17, minute: 0),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The AM/PM button reads "AM" or "PM" with the hint "Switch to PM" or "Switch to AM".
- In the popover, each column is a labeled group ("Hour", "Minute", "AM or PM"); items read "Hour 9", "Minute 30" and expose `selected`. Unavailable items are disabled.
- Opening moves focus to the selected hour (or the first hour). Arrow keys move between items, Enter or Space picks, Escape or a tap outside closes, and focus returns to the clock button.
- Errors show with an info icon and are announced as a live region. Column items stop growing at 1.4x text scale so the 40px rows stay legible.

## Motion

The popover scales from 0.95 and fades from the field edge over `moderate1` (enter-functional in, exit-functional out). Picks give a selection haptic. Under reduced motion the popover appears and disappears at once.

## CDS React Native mapping

CDS has no TimePicker. Parameters follow the `CdsDatePicker` naming: `value`/`onChange` for the controlled value, `...Error` strings for messages, `onOpen`/`onClose` for the popover.

source: doc/components/CdsTimeline.md

# CdsTimeline

A vertical list of events joined by a line, each with a status dot. Use it for order history, transfer progress and account activity.

CDS reference: none. This is a cds_flutter extra built from CDS tokens.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsTimeline(events: [
  CdsTimelineEvent(title: 'Order placed', timestamp: 'Today, 09:41', status: CdsTimelineStatus.complete),
  CdsTimelineEvent(title: 'Processing', status: CdsTimelineStatus.active),
  CdsTimelineEvent(title: 'Funds available'),
])
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it to show what happened and what comes next. For a flow the user steps through, use `CdsStepper`.

## Parameters

`CdsTimeline`

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `events` | `List<CdsTimelineEvent>` | required | Events from first to last. |

`CdsTimelineEvent`

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String` | required | `headline`. |
| `description` | `String?` | `null` | `label2`, `fgMuted`. |
| `timestamp` | `String?` | `null` | `legal`, `fgMuted`, under the title. |
| `status` | `CdsTimelineStatus` | `upcoming` | `complete`, `active`, `upcoming` or `error`. |
| `statusLabel` | `String?` | `Complete` / `In progress` / `Upcoming` / `Failed` | Spoken status. |
| `media` | `Widget?` | `null` | Extra content below the text, such as a button. |

Dots follow the CDS vertical Stepper: `circleCheckmark` in `bgPrimary` (complete), `outline` in `bgPrimary` (active), `outline` in `bgLineHeavy` (upcoming), `error` in `fgNegative` (error). The 2px connector is `bgPrimary` below a complete event and `bgLine` otherwise.

## Examples

### With an action

```dart
CdsTimeline(events: [
  const CdsTimelineEvent(title: 'Withdrawal sent', status: CdsTimelineStatus.complete),
  CdsTimelineEvent(
    title: 'Receipt ready',
    media: CdsButton(label: 'View receipt', size: CdsButtonSize.s, onPress: openReceipt),
  ),
])
```

## Accessibility

Each event reads as one phrase: `title, status, timestamp, description`. Status has its own glyph and spoken label, so it never depends on color alone.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

| Closest CDS piece | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `Stepper direction="vertical"` icon and progress styling | `status` |
| `StepperValue.label` | `title` |

source: doc/components/CdsToast.md

# CdsToast

A brief message at the bottom of the screen that confirms an action, optionally with one action button; shown with `showCdsToast`.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/overlay/Toast

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
showCdsToast(context, 'Address copied');

showCdsToast(
  context,
  'Sent 25 USDC',
  action: CdsToastAction(label: 'Undo', onPress: undoSend),
);
```

## When to use / when not to

Use to confirm something that just happened. Do not use for errors that need action (use `CdsBanner` or inline errors) or for anything the person must read (toasts disappear).

## Parameters

### showCdsToast

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| context | `BuildContext` | required | Finds the nearest `CdsToastHost`, or the root `Overlay`. |
| text | `String` | required | Message in `headline`. |
| action | `CdsToastAction?` | `null` | One button at the end. Pressing it runs `onPress` and hides the toast. |
| duration | `Duration?` | `null` | Time on screen. Defaults to `cdsToastDuration(text, hasAction:)`. |
| variant | `CdsColor?` | `null` | Color of the one-time tint flash on arrival. Defaults to `bgPrimary`. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Announcement text. Defaults to the text plus the action label. |
| onDidHide | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called after the toast leaves. |

Durations (CDS toast tokens): 5000ms, plus 2000ms with an action, plus 300ms per 10 characters past 50 (`cdsToastDuration`). Constants: `cdsToastDefaultDuration`, `cdsToastActionDuration`.

### CdsToastAction

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | `String` | required | Button label. |
| onPress | `VoidCallback` | required | Called on press. |

### CdsToastHost

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| child | `Widget` | required | The app subtree. |
| bottomOffset | `double?` | `null` | Distance from the bottom. Defaults to the bottom safe-area inset. |

`CdsToastHost.of(context)` returns the `CdsToastController` (nearest host, or the root overlay's when there is no host). Controller: `show(...)`, `hide()`, `clearQueue()`, `hasActiveToast`, `queueLength`.

### CdsToast

The surface only (`text`, `action`, `onActionPress`); use it for previews. `bgAlternate`, 1px `bgLine` border, radius 200, elevation 2.

## Examples

### Host under MaterialApp

```dart
MaterialApp(
  builder: (context, child) => CdsToastHost(child: child!),
  home: const HomePage(),
)
```

### Clear pending toasts

```dart
CdsToastHost.of(context).clearQueue();
```

## Accessibility

- Announced to screen readers when it finishes entering (`SemanticsService.sendAnnouncement`) and marked as a live region.
- The timer pauses while the toast is touched, so people can read it or reach the action.
- The action is a `CdsButton` with a 44px hit area.

## Motion

- Enters by fading in and rising 25px (`moderate3`, enterFunctional) with a single 30% tint flash; leaves the same way (exitFunctional).
- Swipe down, left or right to dismiss: the toast follows the finger, upward drags resist, and release velocity decides between dismissing (with the momentum spring) and springing back.
- Toasts queue: the next one enters after the current one leaves.
- Reduced motion: short fade, no rise or flash.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS API | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `useToast().show(text, options)` | `showCdsToast(context, text, ...)` |
| `useToast().hide()` | `CdsToastHost.of(context).hide()` |
| `useToast().clearQueue()` | `CdsToastHost.of(context).clearQueue()` |
| `ToastProvider` / `toastBottomOffset` | `CdsToastHost` / `bottomOffset` (optional) |
| `action: {label, onPress}` | `CdsToastAction(label:, onPress:)` |
| `duration`, `variant`, `accessibilityLabel`, `onDidHide` | same names |

source: doc/components/CdsTooltip.md

# CdsTooltip

A short label that explains a control, opened by long-press on touch screens and by hover or keyboard focus with a mouse or keyboard.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/overlay/Tooltip

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsTooltip(
  content: 'Network fees go to validators, not to this app.',
  child: CdsIconButton(CdsIconName.info, semanticLabel: 'About fees', onPress: showFees),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use for a one-line explanation of an icon or a term. Do not put actions or essential information in a tooltip: touch users may never open it. Use `CdsPopoverPanel` for interactive content.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| child | `Widget` | required | The trigger. |
| content | `String?` | `null` | Tooltip text in `label2`. One of `content` or `contentWidget` is required. |
| contentWidget | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom content; overrides `content` visually. |
| placement | `CdsPlacement` | `CdsPlacement.top` | Preferred side; flips when it does not fit. |
| gap | `double` | `1` | Space token between anchor and tooltip. |
| visible | `bool` | `true` | False suppresses the tooltip. |
| openDelay | `Duration` | `Duration.zero` | Delay before opening on hover or focus. |
| closeDelay | `Duration` | `Duration.zero` | Delay before closing when the pointer leaves. |
| touchDisplayDuration | `Duration` | `Duration(milliseconds: 1500)` | Time the tooltip stays after a long-press is released. |
| invertColorScheme | `bool` | `true` | Render on the opposite color scheme. |
| elevation | `CdsElevation` | `CdsElevation.none` | Shadow level. |
| maxWidth | `double` | `260` | Maximum width (CDS `tooltipMaxWidth`). |
| onOpenTooltip | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called when it opens. |
| onCloseTooltip | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called when it closes. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Screen reader text. Defaults to `content`. |

Surface: `bg` of the inverted scheme, radius 200, padding 16 by 8.

Also exported: `CdsInvertedTheme({required Widget child})`, which flips light and dark for a subtree.

## Examples

### Below the anchor, with a hover delay

```dart
CdsTooltip(
  content: 'Sample data: price updated 10 seconds ago',
  placement: CdsPlacement.bottom,
  openDelay: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
  child: const CdsText('Sample data: 64,210.55 USD'),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The text is exposed as the trigger's semantic tooltip, so screen readers read it without opening anything.
- Opens on keyboard focus (when the last input was a keyboard), closes on Escape, focus loss, a tap outside or the pointer leaving.
- The popup itself is excluded from semantics to avoid reading the text twice.

## Motion

CDS tooltip tokens: opacity over `fast1` with a 16px slide away from the anchor, plus a slight scale from the edge facing the anchor so it grows out of it. Exit runs the same path in reverse. Reduced motion: a `fast1` fade.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `child` |
| `content` (string / node) | `content` / `contentWidget` |
| `placement` (`'top' \| 'bottom'`) | `placement` (`CdsPlacement`, any side) |
| `gap` | `gap` |
| `visible` | `visible` |
| `openDelay`, `closeDelay` | `openDelay`, `closeDelay` (`Duration`) |
| `invertColorScheme` | `invertColorScheme` |
| `elevation`, `maxWidth` | same |
| `onOpenTooltip`, `onCloseTooltip` | same |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `accessibilityLabel` |

CDS mobile opens tooltips on press; this port opens on long-press so the trigger's own tap action keeps working.

---
source: doc/components/CdsTopNavBar.md
---

# CdsTopNavBar

The CDS React Native top navigation bar: a start slot (back or close), a centered middle (usually a [CdsNavigationTitle]), an end slot for actions, and an optional bottom row for tabs.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/navigation/TopNavBar

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsTopNavBar(
  start: CdsNavBarIconButton(CdsIconName.arrowLeft, semanticLabel: 'Back', onPress: () => Navigator.of(context).pop()),
  child: const CdsNavigationTitle('Profile'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use at the top of a mobile screen when the title should be centered.
- Use [CdsNavigationBar](CdsNavigationBar.md) when the title should sit next to the back button, or a hairline under the bar is wanted.
- Use [CdsPageHeader](CdsPageHeader.md) for a large in-content page title.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| start | `Widget?` | `null` | Leading control. Collapses smoothly when added or removed. |
| child | `Widget?` | `null` | Middle content, kept centered on the bar. |
| end | `Widget?` | `null` | Trailing actions. Collapses smoothly when added or removed. |
| bottom | `Widget?` | `null` | Full-width row below, such as [CdsTabNavigation](CdsTabNavigation.md). |
| accessibilityLabel | `String` | `'main navigation'` | Names the bar region. |
| paddingX | `double` | `3` | Space token. |
| paddingTop | `double` | `2` | Space token, added below the top safe area. |
| paddingBottom | `double?` | `2` without `bottom`, `0` with it | Space token. |
| columnGap | `double` | `2` | Space token between the middle and a non-empty side slot. |
| rowGap | `double` | `0` | Space token between the bar and `bottom`. |
| background | `CdsColor` | `CdsColor.bg` | Bar background. |
| respectSafeArea | `bool` | `true` | Adds `MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).top` above the bar. |

## Examples

### Start and end actions

```dart
CdsTopNavBar(
  start: CdsNavBarIconButton(CdsIconName.arrowLeft, semanticLabel: 'Back', onPress: pop),
  end: Row(
    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
    children: [
      CdsNavBarIconButton(CdsIconName.search, semanticLabel: 'Search', onPress: search),
      CdsNavBarIconButton(CdsIconName.moreVertical, semanticLabel: 'More options', onPress: more),
    ],
  ),
  child: const CdsNavigationTitle('Profile'),
)
```

### With tabs below

```dart
CdsTopNavBar(
  start: CdsNavBarIconButton(CdsIconName.close, semanticLabel: 'Close', onPress: close),
  bottom: CdsTabNavigation(tabs: tabs, value: tab, onChange: (id) => setState(() => tab = id)),
  child: const CdsNavigationTitle('Home'),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The bar is a labelled container; `CdsNavigationTitle` is exposed as a header.
- Slots are laid out in reading order and mirror in RTL.
- Long titles ellipsize between the side slots; they never overlap actions.

## Motion

- Adding or removing `start` or `end` collapses or expands the slot's width with `CdsDurations.fast1` and `CdsCurves.global`, keeping the outgoing content visible while it shrinks. Instant under reduced motion.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `start` | `start` |
| `children` | `child` |
| `end` | `end` |
| `bottom` | `bottom` |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `accessibilityLabel` |
| `paddingX`, `paddingTop`, `paddingBottom` | same |
| `columnGap`, `rowGap` | same |

Deviation: CDS positions the bar absolutely at the top of the screen; here it is a normal widget you place (for example in [CdsScaffold](CdsScaffold.md)'s `header`), and it applies the top safe area itself.

source: doc/components/CdsTour.md

# CdsTour

Steps through feature introductions: each step dims the screen except a spotlight on its target and shows a card (usually a `CdsCoachmark`) with an arrow pointing at it.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/overlay/Tour

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsTour(
  activeTourStep: step,
  onChange: (id) => setState(() => step = id),
  steps: [
    CdsTourStepValue(
      id: 'balance',
      builder: (context, tour) => CdsCoachmark(
        title: 'Your balance',
        content: 'Sample data: the total value of your assets.',
        action: CdsButton(label: 'Next', size: CdsButtonSize.s, onPress: tour.goNextTourStep),
        onClose: tour.stopTour,
      ),
    ),
    CdsTourStepValue(
      id: 'send',
      builder: (context, tour) => CdsCoachmark(
        title: 'Send crypto',
        content: 'Send to any address or username.',
        action: CdsButton(label: 'Done', size: CdsButtonSize.s, onPress: tour.goNextTourStep),
      ),
    ),
  ],
  child: Column(children: [
    const CdsTourStep(id: 'balance', child: CdsText('Sample data: 1,240.00 USD')),
    CdsTourStep(id: 'send', child: CdsButton(label: 'Send', onPress: send)),
  ]),
)

// Start it from anywhere below CdsTour:
CdsTour.of(context).startTour();
```

## When to use / when not to

Use once, for new or changed features, with three to five steps. Do not use to explain basic controls or to block the person repeatedly.

## Parameters

### CdsTour

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| steps | `List<CdsTourStepValue>` | required | Steps in order. |
| activeTourStep | `String?` | required | Id of the step to show; null when not running. |
| onChange | `ValueChanged<String?>` | required | Called with the next step id, or null to end. |
| child | `Widget` | required | The screen containing `CdsTourStep` targets. |
| hideOverlay | `bool` | `false` | Do not dim around the target. |
| tourMaskPadding | `double` | `2` | Space token added around the spotlight (half on each side). |
| tourMaskBorderRadius | `double` | `12` | Spotlight corner radius in px. |
| tourStepOffset | `double` | `3` | Space token between target and card. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Label for the tour layer. |

`CdsTour.of(context)` returns the `CdsTourController`.

### CdsTourStepValue

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | `String` | required | Matches a `CdsTourStep.id`. |
| builder | `CdsTourStepBuilder` | required | `Widget Function(BuildContext, CdsTourController)`. |
| disabled | `bool` | `false` | Skipped by next and previous. |
| hideOverlay | `bool?` | `null` | Per-step override. |
| tourMaskPadding | `double?` | `null` | Per-step override. |
| tourMaskBorderRadius | `double?` | `null` | Per-step override. |
| disableAutoScroll | `bool` | `false` | Do not scroll the target into view. |
| onActive | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called when the step shows. |
| onInactive | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called when the step leaves. |

### CdsTourStep

`CdsTourStep({required String id, required Widget child})` marks `child` as the target of the step with the same id.

### CdsTourController

`activeTourStep`, `startTour([String? tourStepId])`, `stopTour()`, `goNextTourStep()` (ends after the last step), `goPreviousTourStep()`, `setActiveTourStep(String? id)`.

## Examples

### Start at a specific step

```dart
CdsButton(label: 'Show me around', onPress: () => CdsTour.of(context).startTour('send'))
```

## Accessibility

The tour layer is its own semantics scope with focus trapped in the card; Escape ends the tour. The page behind does not react to taps while a step is shown. The step card should include a visible way to end the tour (`onClose` on `CdsCoachmark`).

## Motion

Targets scroll into view first (`moderate3`). The scrim and card fade in (`moderate3`, global) and the card slides 8px from the target. Moving to the next step glides the spotlight to the new target. Reduced motion: no scroll animation or glide; the spotlight jumps.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `steps` (`{id, Component, ...}`) | `steps` (`CdsTourStepValue` with `builder`) |
| `activeTourStep` (step object) | `activeTourStep` (step id) |
| `onChange` | `onChange` (step id or null) |
| `hideOverlay`, `tourMaskPadding`, `tourMaskBorderRadius` | same |
| `tourStepOffset` | `tourStepOffset` (space token) |
| `TourStep` | `CdsTourStep` |
| `useTourContext()` | `CdsTour.of(context)` |
| `TourMaskComponent`, `TourStepArrowComponent` | not customizable; default mask and arrow |

---
source: doc/components/CdsTray.md
---

# CdsTray

A bottom sheet for short tasks and pickers that follows the finger, snaps or dismisses based on release velocity, and can be grabbed mid-animation.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/overlay/Tray

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
final asset = await showCdsTray<String>(
  context,
  builder: (context) => CdsTray(
    title: 'Choose an asset',
    child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
      CdsButton(label: 'Bitcoin', variant: CdsButtonVariant.secondary, onPress: () => CdsTray.close(context, 'BTC')),
      CdsButton(label: 'Ethereum', variant: CdsButtonVariant.secondary, onPress: () => CdsTray.close(context, 'ETH')),
    ]),
  ),
);
```

## When to use / when not to

Use on phones for pickers, short forms, confirmations with context, and action lists. On wide screens prefer a `CdsModal` or an anchored `CdsPopoverPanel`/`CdsDropdown`. Do not put a multi-step flow in a tray (use `CdsFullscreenModal`).

## Parameters

### showCdsTray<T>

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| context | `BuildContext` | required | Context used to find the navigator. |
| builder | `WidgetBuilder` | required | Builds the `CdsTray`. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Names the route for screen readers. |
| useRootNavigator | `bool` | `true` | Push on the root navigator. |
| routeSettings | `RouteSettings?` | `null` | Route name and arguments. |

Returns `Future<T?>` with the value passed to `CdsTray.close(context, value)` or `Navigator.pop(context, value)`; `null` when dismissed by swipe, scrim tap, Escape, back or the handle bar. `Navigator.pop` animates the tray out along its entry path.

### CdsTray

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| child | `Widget` | required | Main content. Use a scrollable for content taller than the tray. |
| title | `String?` | `null` | Title in `title3` at the top. |
| titleWidget | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom title; overrides `title`. |
| header | `Widget?` | `null` | Fixed content under the title (stays put while `child` scrolls). |
| footer | `Widget?` | `null` | Content pinned below `child`, for example actions. |
| handleBarVariant | `CdsHandleBarVariant` | `CdsHandleBarVariant.outside` | Handle above the surface (on the scrim) or inside it. |
| hideHandleBar | `bool` | `false` | Hide the handle. |
| handleBarAccessibilityLabel | `String` | `'Dismiss'` | Screen reader label of the handle (activating it closes the tray). |
| snapPoints | `List<double>?` | `null` | Visible heights as fractions of the screen height, e.g. `[0.4, 0.9]`. Null sizes the tray to its content. |
| initialSnapPointIndex | `int?` | `null` | Index into the ascending `snapPoints` to open at. Null opens at index 0, the smallest. |
| verticalDrawerPercentageOfView | `double` | `0.75` | Max share of the screen height for a content-sized tray. |
| preventDismissGestures | `bool` | `false` | Disable swipe and scrim-tap dismissal. Escape and back still close. |
| disableSafeAreaPaddingBottom | `bool` | `false` | Skip the bottom safe-area inset under the content. |
| onCloseComplete | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called after the tray leaves, when rendered without `showCdsTray`. |
| onOpenComplete | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called when the entry animation settles. |
| accessibilityLabel | `String?` | `null` | Label for the tray. Defaults to `title`. |
| reduceMotion | `bool?` | `null` | Overrides the platform reduced-motion setting. |

Static: `CdsTray.close(BuildContext context, [Object? result])` closes the tray containing `context` with an animation.

Surface: radius 600 (32px) on the top corners, `bgElevation2` with the elevation 2 shadow, 1px `bgLine` border in dark mode, bottom safe-area padding.

## Examples

### Snap points with a scrolling list

```dart
showCdsTray<void>(
  context,
  builder: (context) => CdsTray(
    title: 'Recent activity',
    snapPoints: const [0.5, 0.9],
    initialSnapPointIndex: 0,
    child: ListView(children: [
      for (var i = 1; i <= 30; i++) CdsText('Sample data: transfer $i'),
    ]),
  ),
);
```

Pulling down at the top of the list moves the tray; pushing a lowered tray up raises it before the list scrolls again.

### Declarative, inside a Stack

```dart
if (showFees)
  CdsTray(
    title: 'Network fee',
    onCloseComplete: () => setState(() => showFees = false),
    child: const CdsText('Fees go to the network, not to this app.'),
  ),
```

## Accessibility

- Separate semantics scope; focus moves into the tray, is trapped and is restored on close.
- Escape and back close it. The handle bar is a labelled button for screen reader users ("Dismiss").
- The title is a heading. Keep long content in a scrollable so 2x text never overflows.

## Motion

- Drag follows the finger 1:1 from where it was grabbed. Above the open position it rubberbands (`CdsMotion.rubberband`), stretching the surface so no gap shows.
- On release the velocity is projected (`CdsMotion.project`) and the nearest of the snap points or the dismiss position wins; a gesture heading up never dismisses. The release velocity is handed to `CdsMotion.springTo` with `CdsSprings.sheet`. A selection haptic fires when it settles on a different snap point.
- Every animation starts from the current position: grabbing the tray while it is entering, settling or leaving (before it is off screen) continues from where it is.
- Enters from below and leaves the same way. The scrim dims in proportion to how far the tray is open.
- Reduced motion: the tray appears and leaves with a short fade, drags still follow the finger, and releases snap without a spring.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` (node or render prop) | `child`; close with `CdsTray.close(context)` instead of `handleClose` |
| `title` (string / node) | `title` / `titleWidget` |
| `header`, `footer` | `header`, `footer` |
| `handleBarVariant`, `hideHandleBar`, `handleBarAccessibilityLabel` | same |
| `verticalDrawerPercentageOfView` | same |
| `preventDismissGestures` | same |
| `onCloseComplete`, `onOpenComplete` | same |
| `disableSafeAreaPaddingBottom` | same |
| `reduceMotion` | same |
| `accessibilityLabel` | same |
| (none) | `snapPoints`, `initialSnapPointIndex` (addition) |

CDS animates trays with fixed-duration timings; this port uses springs with velocity projection, per the package motion contract.

# CdsUpsellCard

A promotional card with a title, description, a button, and media anchored to the end edge.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/cards/UpsellCard

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsUpsellCard(
  title: 'Earn rewards on USDC',
  description: 'Sample data. Rates vary.',
  action: 'Start earning',
  onActionPress: openEarn,
  onDismissPress: dismiss,
  media: CdsRemoteImage(source: art, width: 120, height: 158, shape: CdsShape.rectangle),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

CDS deprecates UpsellCard; prefer `CdsMessagingCard` with `type: upsell` for new screens.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` / `titleNode` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | `headline`. A title is required. |
| `description` / `descriptionNode` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | Up to three `label2` lines. |
| `action` | `String?` | `null` | Small secondary button, flush with the text. |
| `actionNode` | `Widget?` | `null` | Wins over `action`. |
| `onActionPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `onDismissPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Close button in the top end corner. |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Whole-card press. |
| `media` | `Widget?` | `null` | Anchored to the end edge, vertically centered, behind the 70%-wide text column. |
| `background` | `CdsColor` | `bgPrimaryWash` | |
| `dangerouslySetBackground` | `Color?` | `null` | |
| `width` | `double?` | `327` | Null fills the parent. Minimum height is 158. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | "Dismiss the {title} card" | Dismiss button label. |

## Accessibility

Action and dismiss are separate labelled buttons.

## Motion

Pressable cards tint and scale to 0.98 on pointer-down; no scale under reduced motion.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `title`, `description`, `action` (string / node) | `x` / `xNode` |
| `onActionPress`, `onDismissPress`, `onPress`, `media`, `background`, `dangerouslySetBackground`, `width` | same names |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `semanticLabel` |

# CdsXAxis

The horizontal axis of a cartesian chart: tick labels, grid lines, tick marks, axis line and title.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/charts/XAxis

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CdsCartesianChart(
  height: 200,
  xAxis: CdsAxisConfig(data: ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar']),
  series: [CdsChartSeries(id: 'a', data: [3, 5, 4])],
  children: [CdsXAxis(showGrid: true), CdsLine(seriesId: 'a')],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Put it first in a chart's `children` so grid lines sit behind data. The chart reserves its height below (or above) the drawing area.
- In `CdsLineChart`, `CdsAreaChart` and `CdsBarChart`, set `showXAxis: true` and pass visuals through `xAxisStyle`.
- Leave axes off for compact charts where a header already shows the values.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `position` | `CdsXAxisPosition` | `bottom` | `top` or `bottom`. |
| `showGrid` | `bool` | `false` | Dotted `bgLine` grid lines across the drawing area at each tick. |
| `showLine` | `bool` | `false` | Solid 1px `fg` axis line. |
| `showTickMarks` | `bool` | `false` | Solid 1px `fg` tick marks. |
| `tickMarkSize` | `double` | `4` | Tick mark length. |
| `ticks` | `List<double>?` | `null` | Exact tick values (category indices for band scales). Overrides every other tick option. |
| `tickFilter` | `bool Function(double)?` | `null` | Keeps only ticks for which it returns true (every index on a category axis). |
| `tickMinStep` | `double` | `1` | Smallest step for interval-based ticks. |
| `tickMaxStep` | `double?` | `null` | Largest step for interval-based ticks. |
| `tickLabelFormatter` | `String Function(double)?` | `null` | Formats tick values. Category labels from `CdsAxisConfig.data` are used when null. |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Axis title. |
| `bandGridLinePlacement` | `CdsAxisBandPlacement` | `edges` | Band scales: grid lines at `start`, `middle`, `end` of each band, or `edges` (start of each plus the closing edge). |
| `bandTickMarkPlacement` | `CdsAxisBandPlacement` | `middle` | Band scales: tick mark placement. |
| `requestedTickCount` | `int?` | `null` | Approximate tick count (d3 `ticks`). Defaults to 5 when x is the value axis (horizontal charts). Overrides `tickInterval`. |
| `tickInterval` | `double` | `32` | Approximate pixel spacing between ticks; always includes the first value. |
| `tickMarkLabelGap` | `double` | `2` | Gap between tick marks (or the axis edge) and labels. |
| `minTickLabelGap` | `double` | `4` | Labels closer than this to a neighbor are hidden; the first and last are kept. |
| `height` | `double?` | `null` | Reserved height. Defaults to 32, or 52 with a `label`. |

## Examples

### Every other month, with tick marks and a title

```dart
const CdsLineChart(
  height: 220,
  showXAxis: true,
  xAxis: CdsAxisConfig(data: ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun']),
  xAxisStyle: CdsXAxis(showLine: true, showTickMarks: true, ticks: [0, 2, 4], label: 'Month'),
  series: [CdsLineSeries(id: 'a', data: [3, 5, 4, 6, 8, 7])],
)
```

## Accessibility

Tick labels are painted, not separate semantics nodes; the chart's own label and scrubber value carry the information. Use `getScrubberAccessibilityLabel` on the chart to read category names. Labels use `label2` in `fgMuted` and scale with the text scale setting.

## Motion

None. The axis redraws immediately when scales change, as on CDS mobile.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `position`, `showGrid`, `showLine`, `showTickMarks`, `tickMarkSize` | same names |
| `ticks` (array) | `ticks` |
| `ticks` (function) | `tickFilter` |
| `requestedTickCount`, `tickInterval`, `tickMinStep`, `tickMaxStep` | same names |
| `tickLabelFormatter` | `tickLabelFormatter` (returns `String`) |
| `tickMarkLabelGap`, `minTickLabelGap`, `label`, `height` | same names |
| `bandGridLinePlacement`, `bandTickMarkPlacement` | same names |
| `axisId` | not ported; one x axis per chart |
| `labelGap`, `tickLabelOverflow`, `*Component` | not ported; edge labels are kept inside the canvas |

---
source: doc/components/CdsYAxis.md

# CdsYAxis

The vertical axis of a cartesian chart: value labels, grid lines, tick marks, axis line and title.

CDS reference: https://cds.coinbase.com/components/charts/YAxis

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cds_flutter/cds_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CdsCartesianChart(
  height: 200,
  series: const [CdsChartSeries(id: 'a', data: [3, 5, 4])],
  children: [
    CdsYAxis(showGrid: true, tickLabelFormatter: (v) => '\$${v.toInt()}'),
    const CdsLine(seriesId: 'a'),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it when people compare values against a scale. Put it first in `children` so grid lines sit behind data.
- In the chart wrappers, set `showYAxis: true` and pass visuals through `yAxisStyle`.
- CDS places it on the right by default.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `position` | `CdsYAxisPosition` | `right` | `left` or `right`. |
| `showGrid` | `bool` | `false` | Dotted `bgLine` grid lines across the drawing area at each tick. |
| `showLine` | `bool` | `false` | Solid 1px `fg` axis line. |
| `showTickMarks` | `bool` | `false` | Solid 1px `fg` tick marks. |
| `tickMarkSize` | `double` | `4` | Tick mark length. |
| `ticks` | `List<double>?` | `null` | Exact tick values (category indices for band scales). Overrides every other tick option. |
| `tickFilter` | `bool Function(double)?` | `null` | Keeps only ticks for which it returns true (every index on a category axis). |
| `tickMinStep` | `double` | `1` | Smallest step for interval-based ticks. |
| `tickMaxStep` | `double?` | `null` | Largest step for interval-based ticks. |
| `tickLabelFormatter` | `String Function(double)?` | `null` | Formats tick values. Category labels from `CdsAxisConfig.data` are used when null. |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Axis title. |
| `bandGridLinePlacement` | `CdsAxisBandPlacement` | `edges` | Band scales: grid lines at `start`, `middle`, `end` of each band, or `edges` (start of each plus the closing edge). |
| `bandTickMarkPlacement` | `CdsAxisBandPlacement` | `middle` | Band scales: tick mark placement. |
| `requestedTickCount` | `int?` | `null` | Approximate tick count. Defaults to 5 when y is the value axis (vertical charts). |
| `tickInterval` | `double?` | `null` | Pixel spacing between ticks, used when no count is requested. |
| `tickMarkLabelGap` | `double` | `8` | Gap between tick marks (or the axis edge) and labels. |
| `minTickLabelGap` | `double` | `0` | Labels closer than this to a neighbor are hidden. |
| `width` | `double?` | `null` | Reserved width. Defaults to 44, or 64 with a `label`. |

## Examples

### Left axis for horizontal bars

```dart
const CdsBarChart(
  height: 160,
  layout: CdsChartLayout.horizontal,
  showYAxis: true,
  yAxis: CdsAxisConfig(data: ['Alpha', 'Beta', 'Gamma']),
  yAxisStyle: CdsYAxis(position: CdsYAxisPosition.left, width: 56),
  series: [CdsChartSeries(id: 'a', data: [12, 30, 21])],
)
```

## Accessibility

Same as `CdsXAxis`: labels are painted, the chart's semantics carry values. Format values the same way in `tickLabelFormatter` and in the chart's `getScrubberAccessibilityLabel`.

## Motion

None.

## CDS React Native mapping

| CDS prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `position` | `position` (default `right`) |
| `ticks` (array / function) | `ticks` / `tickFilter` |
| `width` | `width` |
| other props | same as `CdsXAxis` |
